1001.g: ਮੂੜੇ ਤੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥
1001.t: mooRe tai man te raam bisaario ||
1001.e: You fool, you have forgotten the Lord from your mind!

1001.g: ਲੂਣੁ ਖਾਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰੀ ਪੇਖਤ ਨੈਨ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1001.t: loon khai kareh haraamakhoree pekhat nain bidhaario ||1|| rahaau ||
1001.e: You eat His salt, and then you are untrue to Him; before your very eyes, you shall be torn apart. ||1||Pause||

1001.g: ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਟਰਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਟਾਰਿਓ ॥
1001.t: asaadh rog upajio tan bheetar Tarat na kaahoo Taario ||
1001.e: The incurable disease has arisen in your body; it cannot be removed or overcome.

1001.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੮॥
1001.t: prabh bisarat mahaa dhukh paio ih naanak tat beechaario ||2||8||
1001.e: Forgetting God, one endures utter agony; this is the essence of reality which Nanak has realized. ||2||8||

1001.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1001.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1001.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1001.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
1001.t: charan kamal prabh raakhe cheet ||
1001.e: I have enshrined the lotus feet of God within my consciousness.

1001.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥
1001.t: har gun gaaveh neetaa neet ||
1001.e: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, continually, continuously.

1001.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
1001.t: tis bin dhoojaa avar na kouoo ||
1001.e: There is none other than Him at all.

1001.g: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਊ ॥੧॥
1001.t: aadh madh a(n)t hai souoo ||1||
1001.e: He alone exists, in the beginning, in the middle, and in the end. ||1||

1001.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1001.t: sa(n)tan kee oT aape aap ||1|| rahaau ||
1001.e: He Himself is the Shelter of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

1001.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
1001.t: jaa kai vas hai sagal sa(n)saar ||
1001.e: The entire universe is under His control.

1001.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
1001.t: aape aap aap nira(n)kaar ||
1001.e: He Himself, the Formless Lord, is Himself by Himself.

1001.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਹਿਓ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
1001.t: naanak gahio saachaa soi ||
1001.e: Nanak holds tight to that True Lord.

1001.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੯॥
1001.t: sukh paiaa fir dhookh na hoi ||2||9||
1001.e: He has found peace, and shall never suffer pain again. ||2||9||

1001.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩
1001.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa
1001.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

1001.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1001.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1001.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1001.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਅਗਿਆਨਥ ॥
1001.t: praan sukhadhaataa jeea sukhadhaataa tum kaahe bisaario agiaanath ||
1001.e: He is the Giver of peace to the breath of life, the Giver of life to the soul; how can you forget Him, you ignorant person?

1001.g: ਹੋਛਾ ਮਦੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਵਰ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ॥੧॥
1001.t: hochhaa madh chaakh hoe tum baavar dhulabh janam akaarath ||1||
1001.e: You taste the weak, insipid wine, and you have gone insane. You have uselessly wasted this precious human life. ||1||

1001.g: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਐਸੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਆਨਥ ॥
1001.t: re nar aaisee kareh iaanath ||
1001.e: O man, such is the foolishness you practice.

1001.g: ਤਜਿ ਸਾਰੰਗਧਰ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਤੂ ਭੂਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਨਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1001.t: taj saara(n)gadhar bhram too bhoolaa moh lapaTio dhaasee sa(n)g saanath ||1|| rahaau ||
1001.e: Renouncing the Lord, the Support of the earth, you wander, deluded by doubt; you are engrossed in emotional attachment, associating with Maya, the slave-girl. ||1||Pause||

1001.g: ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵਥ ॥
1001.t: dharaneedhar tiaag neech kul seveh hau hau karat bihaavath ||
1001.e: Abandoning the Lord, the Support of the earth, you serve her of lowly ancestry, and you pass you life acting egotistically.

1001.g: ਫੋਕਟ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਕਹਾਵਥ ॥੨॥
1001.t: fokaT karam kareh agiaanee manmukh a(n)dh kahaavath ||2||
1001.e: You do useless deeds, you ignorant person; this is why you are called a blind, self-willed manmukh. ||2||

1001.g: ਸਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ਅਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜੋ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਜਾਨਥ ॥
1001.t: sat hotaa asat kar maaniaa jo binasat so nihachal jaanath ||
1001.e: That which is true, you believe to be untrue; what is transitory, you believe to be permanent.

1001.g: ਪਰ ਕੀ ਕਉ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਕਰੀ ਐਸੇ ਭੂਲ ਭੁਲਾਨਥ ॥੩॥
1001.t: par kee kau apanee kar pakaree aaise bhool bhulaanath ||3||
1001.e: You grasp as your own, what belongs to others; in such delusions you are deluded. ||3||

1001.g: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਸਭ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਨਥ ॥
1001.t: khatree braahaman soodh vais sabh ekai naam taraanath ||
1001.e: The Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas all cross over, through the Name of the One Lord.

1001.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਥ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
1001.t: gur naanak upadhes kahat hai jo sunai so paar paraanath ||4||1||10||
1001.e: Guru Nanak speaks the Teachings; whoever listens to them is carried across. ||4||1||10||

1001.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1001.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1001.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1001.g: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਹਕਾਵਏ ਮਨੁਖਾਇ ॥
1001.t: gupat karataa sa(n)g so prabh ddahakaave manukhai ||
1001.e: You may act in secrecy, but God is still with you; you can only deceive other people.

1001.g: ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਖੈ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਤਪਤ ਥੰਮ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
1001.t: bisaar har jeeau bikhai bhogeh tapat tha(n)m gal lai ||1||
1001.e: Forgetting your Dear Lord, you enjoy corrupt pleasures, and so you shall have to embrace red-hot pillars. ||1||

1001.g: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਕਾਇ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
1001.t: re nar kai par gireh jai ||
1001.e: O man, why do you go out to the households of others?

1001.g: ਕੁਚਲ ਕਠੋਰ ਕਾਮਿ ਗਰਧਭ ਤੁਮ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1001.t: kuchal kaThor kaam garadhabh tum nahee sunio dharam rai ||1|| rahaau ||
1001.e: You filthy, heartless, lustful donkey! Haven't you heard of the Righteous Judge of Dharma? ||1||Pause||

1001.g: ਬਿਕਾਰ ਪਾਥਰ ਗਲਹਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਨਿੰਦ ਪੋਟ ਸਿਰਾਇ ॥
1001.t: bikaar paathar galeh baadhe ni(n)dh poT sirai ||
1001.e: The stone of corruption is tied around your neck, and the load of slander is on your head.

1001.g: ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਮੁਦੁ ਲੰਘਨਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਰਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
1001.t: mahaa saagar samudh la(n)ghanaa paar na paranaa jai ||2||
1001.e: You must cross over the vast open ocean, but you cannot cross over to the other side. ||2||

1001.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਰਖੇ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
1001.t: kaam karodh lobh moh biaapio netr rakhe firai ||
1001.e: You are engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment; you have turned your eyes away from the Truth.

1001.g: ਸੀਸੁ ਉਠਾਵਨ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮਿਲਈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰ ਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
1001.t: sees uThaavan na kabahoo miliee mahaa dhutar mai ||3||
1001.e: You cannot even raise your head above the water of the vast, impassable sea of Maya. ||3||

1001.g: ਸੂਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਸੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅਲਿਪਾਇ ॥
1001.t: soor mukataa sasee mukataa braham giaanee alipai ||
1001.e: The sun is liberated, and the moon is liberated; the God-realized being is pure and untouched.

1001.g: ਸੁਭਾਵਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
1001.t: subhaavat jaise baisa(n)tar alipat sadhaa niramalai ||4||
1001.e: His inner nature is like that of fire, untouched and forever immaculate. ||4||

1001.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਖੁਲਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
1001.t: jis karam khuliaa tis lahiaa paRadhaa jin gur peh ma(n)niaa subhai ||
1001.e: When good karma dawns, the wall of doubt is torn down. He lovingly accepts the Guru's Will.

1002.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਕਟ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥
1002.t: gur ma(n)tr avakhadh naam dheenaa jan naanak sa(n)kaT jon na pai ||5||2||
1002.e: One who is blessed with the medicine of the GurMantra, the Name of the Lord, O servant Nanak, does not suffer the agonies of reincarnation. ||5||2||

1002.g: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇ ॥
1002.t: re nar in bidh paar parai ||
1002.e: O man, in this way, you shall cross over to the other side.

1002.g: ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
1002.t: dhiaai har jeeau hoi mritak tiaag dhoojaa bhaau || rahaau dhoojaa ||2||11||
1002.e: Meditate on your Dear Lord, and be dead to the world; renounce your love of duality. ||Second Pause||2||11||

1002.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1002.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1002.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1002.g: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂਢਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਪਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
1002.t: baahar ddooddan te chhooT pare gur ghar hee maeh dhikhaiaa thaa ||
1002.e: I have quit searching outside; the Guru has shown me that God is within the home of my own heart.

1002.g: ਅਨਭਉ ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੧॥
1002.t: anabhau acharaj roop prabh pekhiaa meraa man chhodd na katahoo jaiaa thaa ||1||
1002.e: I have seen God, fearless, of wondrous beauty; my mind shall never leave Him to go anywhere else. ||1||

1002.g: ਮਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
1002.t: maanak paio re paio har pooraa paiaa thaa ||
1002.e: I have found the jewel; I have found the Perfect Lord.

1002.g: ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1002.t: mol amol na paiaa jaiee kar kirapaa guroo dhivaiaa thaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1002.e: The invaluable value cannot be obtained; in His Mercy, the Guru bestows it. ||1||Pause||

1002.g: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
1002.t: adhisaT agochar paarabraham mil saadhoo akath kathaiaa thaa ||
1002.e: The Supreme Lord God is imperceptible and unfathomable; meeting the Holy Saint, I speak the Unspoken Speech.

1002.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਵਜਿਓ ਤਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਆਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੨॥
1002.t: anahadh sabadh dhasam dhuaar vajio teh a(n)mirat naam chuaaiaa thaa ||2||
1002.e: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds in the Tenth Gate; the Ambrosial Naam trickles down there. ||2||

1002.g: ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੂਝੀ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
1002.t: toT naahee man tirasanaa boojhee akhuT bha(n)ddaar samaiaa thaa ||
1002.e: I lack nothing; the thirsty desires of my mind are satisfied. The inexhaustible treasure has entered into my being.

1002.g: ਚਰਣ ਚਰਣ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਿਓ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੩॥
1002.t: charan charan charan gur seve aghaR ghaRio ras paiaa thaa ||3||
1002.e: I serve the feet, the feet, the feet of the Guru, and manage the unmanageable. I have found the juice, the sublime essence. ||3||

1002.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
1002.t: sahaje aavaa sahaje jaavaa sahaje man khelaiaa thaa ||
1002.e: Intuitively I come, and intuively I go; my mind intuitively plays.

1002.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਇਆ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
1002.t: kahu naanak bharam gur khoiaa taa har mahalee mahal paiaa thaa ||4||3||12||
1002.e: Says Nanak, when the Guru drives out doubt, then the soul-bride enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||3||12||

1002.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1002.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1002.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1002.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1002.t: jiseh saaj nivaajiaa tiseh siau ruch naeh ||
1002.e: You feel no love for the One who created and embellished you.

1002.g: ਆਨ ਰੂਤੀ ਆਨ ਬੋਈਐ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਫੂਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
1002.t: aan rootee aan boieeaai fal na foolai taeh ||1||
1002.e: The seed, planted out season, does not germinate; it does not produce flower or fruit. ||1||

1002.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਜਣ ਨਾਉ ॥
1002.t: re man vatr beejan naau ||
1002.e: O mind, this is the time to plant the seed of the Name.

1002.g: ਬੋਇ ਖੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਭਲੋ ਸਮਉ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1002.t: boi khetee lai manooaa bhalo samau suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
1002.e: Focus your mind, and cultivate this crop; at the proper time, make this your purpose. ||1||Pause||

1002.g: ਖੋਇ ਖਹੜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
1002.t: khoi khahaRaa bharam man kaa satigur saranee jai ||
1002.e: Eradicate the stubbornness and doubt of your mind, and go to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

1002.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
1002.t: karam jis kau dhurahu likhiaa soiee kaar kamai ||2||
1002.e: He alone does such deeds, who has such pre-ordained karma. ||2||

1002.g: ਭਾਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਿਉ ਘਾਲ ਪਾਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
1002.t: bhaau laagaa gobidh siau ghaal paiee thai ||
1002.e: He falls in love with the Lord of the Universe, and his efforts are approved.

1002.g: ਖੇਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
1002.t: khet merai ja(n)miaa nikhuT na kabahoo jai ||3||
1002.e: My crop has germinated, and it shall never be used up. ||3||

1002.g: ਪਾਇਆ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥
1002.t: paiaa amol padhaaratho chhodd na katahoo jai ||
1002.e: I have obtained the priceless wealth, which shall never leave me or go anywhere else.

1002.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
1002.t: kahu naanak sukh paiaa tirapat rahe aaghai ||4||4||13||
1002.e: Says Nanak, I have found peace; I am satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||4||13||

1002.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1002.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1002.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1002.g: ਫੂਟੋ ਆਂਡਾ ਭਰਮ ਕਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
1002.t: fooTo aa(n)ddaa bharam kaa maneh bhio paragaas ||
1002.e: The egg of doubt has burst; my mind has been enlightened.

1002.g: ਕਾਟੀ ਬੇਰੀ ਪਗਹ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
1002.t: kaaTee beree pageh te gur keenee ba(n)dh khalaas ||1||
1002.e: The Guru has shattered the shackles on my feet, and has set me free. ||1||

1002.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥
1002.t: aavan jaan rahio ||
1002.e: My coming and going in reincarnation is ended.

1002.g: ਤਪਤ ਕੜਾਹਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1002.t: tapat kaRaahaa bujh giaa gur seetal naam dheeo ||1|| rahaau ||
1002.e: The boiling cauldron has cooled down; the Guru has blessed me with the cooling, soothing Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1002.g: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਗਹਾਰ ॥
1002.t: jab te saadhoo sa(n)g bhiaa tau chhodd ge nigahaar ||
1002.e: Since I joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, those who were eyeing me have left.

1002.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਅਟਕ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀ ਤਉ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਟਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
1002.t: jis kee aTak tis te chhuTee tau kahaa karai koTavaar ||2||
1002.e: The one who tied me up, has released me; what can the Watchman of Death do to me now? ||2||

1002.g: ਚੂਕਾ ਭਾਰਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ॥
1002.t: chookaa bhaaraa karam kaa hoe nihakaramaa ||
1002.e: The load of my karma has been removed, and I am now free of karma.

1002.g: ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕੰਢੈ ਚੜੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
1002.t: saagar te ka(n)ddai chaRe gur keene dharamaa ||3||
1002.e: I have crossed the world-ocean, and reached the other shore; the Guru has blessed me with this Dharma. ||3||

1002.g: ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੈਠਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
1002.t: sach thaan sach baiThakaa sach suaau banaiaa ||
1002.e: True is my place, and True is my seat; I have made Truth my life's purpose.

1002.g: ਸਚੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪॥
1002.t: sach poo(n)jee sach vakharo naanak ghar paiaa ||4||5||14||
1002.e: True is my capital, and True is the merchandise, which Nanak has placed into the home of the heart. ||4||5||14||

1002.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1002.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1002.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1003.g: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਪੰਡਤ ਕਾਮਾਮਨ ਕਾ ਮਾਠਾ ॥
1003.t: bedh pukaarai mukh te pa(n)ddat kaamaaman kaa maaThaa ||
1003.e: The Pandit, the religious scholar, proclaims the Vedas, but he is slow to act on them.

1003.g: ਮੋਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਇਕਾਂਤੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਲਪਨ ਗਾਠਾ ॥
1003.t: monee hoi baiThaa ikaa(n)tee hiradhai kalapan gaaThaa ||
1003.e: Another person on silence sits alone, but his heart is tied in knots of desire.

1003.g: ਹੋਇ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਠਾ ॥੧॥
1003.t: hoi udhaasee girahu taj chalio chhuTakai naahee naaThaa ||1||
1003.e: Another becomes an Udaasi, a renunciate; he abandons his home and walks out on his family, but his wandering impulses do not leave him. ||1||

1003.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਬਾਤ ਕਹਾ ॥
1003.t: jeea kee kai peh baat kahaa ||
1003.e: Who can I tell about the state of my soul?

1003.g: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਐਸੋ ਕਹਾ ਲਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1003.t: aap mukat mo kau prabh mele aaiso kahaa lahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1003.e: Where can I find such a person who is liberated, and who can unite me with my God? ||1||Pause||

1003.g: ਤਪਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਾਧੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਨਾ ॥
1003.t: tapasee kar kai dhehee saadhee manooaa dheh dhis dhaanaa ||
1003.e: Someone may practice intensive meditation, and discipline his body, but his mind still runs around in ten directions.

1003.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਜੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
1003.t: brahamachaar brahamachaj keenaa hiradhai bhiaa gumaanaa ||
1003.e: The celibate practices celibacy, but his heart is filled with pride.

1003.g: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਉਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
1003.t: sa(n)niaasee hoi kai teerath bhramio us meh karodh bigaanaa ||2||
1003.e: The Sannyaasi wanders around at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, but his mindless anger is still within him. ||2||

1003.g: ਘੂੰਘਰ ਬਾਧਿ ਭਏ ਰਾਮਦਾਸਾ ਰੋਟੀਅਨ ਕੇ ਓਪਾਵਾ ॥
1003.t: ghoo(n)ghar baadh bhe raamadhaasaa roTeean ke opaavaa ||
1003.e: The temple dancers tie bells around their ankles to earn their living.

1003.g: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਮ ਖਟ ਕੀਨੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵਾ ॥
1003.t: barat nem karam khaT keene baahar bhekh dhikhaavaa ||
1003.e: Others go on fasts, take vows, perform the six rituals and wear religious robes for show.

1003.g: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਗ ਅਲਾਪੇ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੩॥
1003.t: geet naadh mukh raag alaape man nahee har har gaavaa ||3||
1003.e: Some sing songs and melodies and hymns, but their minds do not sing of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

1003.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਰਹਤ ਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
1003.t: harakh sog lobh moh rahat heh niramal har ke sa(n)taa ||
1003.e: The Lord's Saints are immaculately pure; they are beyond pleasure and pain, beyond greed and attachment.

1003.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਪਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
1003.t: tin kee dhooR paae man meraa jaa dhiaa kare bhagava(n)taa ||
1003.e: My mind obtains the dust of their feet, when the Lord God shows mercy.

1003.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
1003.t: kahu naanak gur pooraa miliaa taa(n) utaree man kee chi(n)taa ||4||
1003.e: Says Nanak, I met the Perfect Guru, and then the anxiety of my mind was removed. ||4||

1003.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
1003.t: meraa a(n)tarajaamee har raiaa ||
1003.e: My Sovereign Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

1003.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਬਕਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੬॥੧੫॥
1003.t: sabh kichh jaanai mere jeea kaa preetam bisar ge bakabaiaa ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||6||15||
1003.e: The Beloved of my soul knows everything; all trivial talk is forgotten. ||1||Second Pause||6||15||

1003.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1003.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1003.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1003.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਲਾਖ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
1003.t: koT laakh sarab ko raajaa jis hiradhai naam tumaaraa ||
1003.e: One who has Your Name in his heart is the king of all the hundreds of thousands and millions of beings.

1003.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਦੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
1003.t: jaa kau naam na dheeaa merai satigur se mar janameh gaavaaraa ||1||
1003.e: Those, whom my True Guru has not blessed with Your Name, are poor idiots, who die and are reborn. ||1||

1003.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
1003.t: mere satigur hee pat raakh ||
1003.e: My True Guru protects and preserves my honor.

1003.g: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਰਲੀਐ ਖਾਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1003.t: cheet aaveh tab hee pat pooree bisarat raleeaai khaak ||1|| rahaau ||
1003.e: When You come to mind, Lord, then I obtain perfect honor. Forgetting You, I roll in the dust. ||1||Pause||

1003.g: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਭੋਗਣ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
1003.t: roop ra(n)g khuseeaa man bhogan te te chhidhr vikaaraa ||
1003.e: The mind's pleasures of love and beauty bring just as many blames and sins.

1003.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
1003.t: har kaa naam nidhaan kaliaanaa sookh sahaj ih saaraa ||2||
1003.e: The Name of the Lord is the treasure of Emancipation; it is absolute peace and poise. ||2||

1003.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
1003.t: maiaa ra(n)g bira(n)g khinai meh jiau baadhar kee chhaiaa ||
1003.e: The pleasures of Maya fade away in an instant, like the shade of a passing cloud.

1003.g: ਸੇ ਲਾਲ ਭਏ ਗੂੜੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1003.t: se laal bhe gooRai ra(n)g raate jin gur mil har har gaiaa ||3||
1003.e: They alone are dyed in the deep crimson of the Lord's Love, who meet the Guru, and sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

1003.g: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
1003.t: uooch mooch apaar suaamee agam dharabaaraa ||
1003.e: My Lord and Master is lofty and exalted, grand and infinite. The Darbaar of His Court is inaccessible.

1003.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੬॥
1003.t: naamo vaddiaaiee sobhaa naanak khasam piaaraa ||4||7||16||
1003.e: Through the Naam, glorious greatness and respect are obtained; O Nanak, my Lord and Master is my Beloved. ||4||7||16||

1003.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
1003.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
1003.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

1003.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1003.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1003.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1003.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਉਤਪਾਤੀ ॥
1003.t: oa(n)kaar utapaatee ||
1003.e: The One Universal Creator Lord created the creation.

1003.g: ਕੀਆ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
1003.t: keeaa dhinas sabh raatee ||
1003.e: He made all the days and the nights.

1003.g: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
1003.t: van tiran tirabhavan paanee ||
1003.e: The forests, meadows, three worlds, water,

1003.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
1003.t: chaar bedh chaare khaanee ||
1003.e: the four Vedas, the four sources of creation,

1003.g: ਖੰਡ ਦੀਪ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਆ ॥
1003.t: kha(n)dd dheep sabh loaa ||
1003.e: the countries, the continents and all the worlds,

1003.g: ਏਕ ਕਵਾਵੈ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਆ ॥੧॥
1003.t: ek kavaavai te sabh hoaa ||1||
1003.e: have all come from the One Word of the Lord. ||1||

1003.g: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
1003.t: karanaihaaraa boojhahu re ||
1003.e: Hey - understand the Creator Lord.

1003.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੂਝੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1003.t: satigur milai ta soojhai re ||1|| rahaau ||
1003.e: If you meet the True Guru, then you'll understand. ||1||Pause||

1003.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਆ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
1003.t: trai gun keeaa pasaaraa ||
1003.e: He formed the expanse of the entire universe from the three gunas, the three qualities.

1003.g: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
1003.t: narak surag avataaraa ||
1003.e: People are incarnated in heaven and in hell.

1003.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
1003.t: haumai aavai jaiee ||
1003.e: In egotism, they come and go.

1003.g: ਮਨੁ ਟਿਕਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਰਾਈ ॥
1003.t: man Tikan na paavai raiee ||
1003.e: The mind cannot hold still, even for an instant.

1004.e: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.
Meeting with the True Guru, one is emancipated. ||2||
All the deeds done in egotism,
are just chains around the neck.
Harboring self-conceit and self-interest
is just like placing chains around one's ankles.
He alone meets with the Guru, and realizes the One Lord,
who has such destiny written on his forehead. ||3||

1004.g: ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1004.t: so miliaa j har man bhaiaa ||
1004.e: He alone meets the Lord, who is pleasing to His Mind.
He alone is deluded, who is deluded by God.
No one, by himself, is ignorant or wise.
He alone chants the Naam, whom the Lord inspires to do so.
You have no end or limitation.
Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||17||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
Maya, the enticer, has enticed the world of the three gunas, the three qualities.
The false world is engrossed in greed.

1004.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੰਚੀ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਸਗਲ ਲੇ ਛਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
1004.t: meree meree kar kai sa(n)chee a(n)t kee baar sagal le chhaleeaa ||1||
1004.e: Crying out, ""Mine, mine!"" they collect possessions, but in the end, they are all deceived. ||1||
The Lord is fearless, formless and merciful.
He is the Cherisher of all beings and creatures. ||1||Pause||
Some collect wealth, and bury it in the ground.
Some cannot abandon wealth, even in their dreams.

1004.g: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਕਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਥੈਲੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਚਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
1004.t: raaj kamai karee jin thailee taa kai sa(n)g na cha(n)chal chaleeaa ||2||
1004.e: The king exercises his power, and fills his money-bags, but this fickle companion will not go along with him. ||2||
Some love this wealth even more than their body and breath of life.
Some collect it, forsaking their fathers and mothers.

1004.g: ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਤੇ ਗੁਹਜੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਖਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
1004.t: sut meet bhraat te guhajee taa kai nikaT na hoiee khaleeaa ||3||
1004.e: Some hide it from their children, friends and siblings, but it will not remain with them. ||3||
Some become hermits, and sit in meditative trances.
Some are Yogis, celibates, religious scholars and thinkers.

1004.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਊਠਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਲੀਆ ॥੪॥
1004.t: gireh maRee masaanee ban meh basate uooTh tinaa kai laagee paleeaa ||4||
1004.e: Some dwell in homes, graveyards, cremation grounds and forests; but Maya still clings to them there. ||4||
When the Lord and Master releases one from his bonds,

1004.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸਿਓ ਜੀਅ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
1004.t: har har naam basio jeea taa kai ||
1004.e: the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell in his soul.

1004.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਲੀਆ ॥੫॥੨॥੧੮॥
1004.t: saadhasa(n)g bhe jan mukate gat paiee naanak nadhar nihaleeaa ||5||2||18||
1004.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, His humble servants are liberated; O Nanak, they are redeemed and enraptured by the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||5||2||18||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
Meditate in remembrance on the One Immaculate Lord.

1004.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
1004.t: jaa te birathaa jaat na kouoo ||
1004.e: No one is turned away from Him empty-handed.
He cherished and preserved you in your mother's womb;
He blessed you with body and soul, and embellished you.
Each and every instant, meditate on that Creator Lord.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, all faults and mistakes are covered.
Enshrine the Lord's lotus feet deep within the nucleus of your self.
Save your soul from the waters of corruption.
Your cries and shrieks shall be ended;
meditating on the Lord of the Universe, your doubts and fears shall be dispelled.
Rare is that being, who finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

1004.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
1004.t: naanak taa kai bal bal jaae ||1||
1004.e: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||1||
The Lord's Name is the support of my mind and body.

1004.g: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1004.t: jo simarai tis kaa nisataaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
1004.e: Whoever meditates on Him is emancipated. ||1||Pause||
He believes that the false thing is true.
The ignorant fool falls in love with it.
He is intoxicated with the wine of sexual desire, anger and greed;
he loses this human life in exchance for a mere shell.
He abandons his own, and loves that of others.

1004.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
1004.t: maiaa madh man tan sa(n)g jaataa ||
1004.e: His mind and body are permeated with the intoxication of Maya.
His thirsty desires are not quenched, although he indulges in pleasures.
His hopes are not fulfilled, and all his words are false.
He comes alone, and he goes alone.

1005.g: ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
1005.t: ham tum sa(n)g jhooThe sabh bolaa ||
1005.e: False is all his talk of me and you.
The Lord Himself administers the poisonous potion, to mislead and delude.
O Nanak, the the karma of past actions cannot be erased. ||2||
Beasts, birds, demons and ghosts
- in these many ways, the false wander in reincarnation.

1005.g: ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਤਹ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1005.t: jeh jaano teh rahan na paavai ||
1005.e: Wherever they go, they cannot remain there.

1005.g: ਥਾਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
1005.t: thaan bihoon uTh uTh fir dhaavai ||
1005.e: They have no place of rest; they rise up again and again and run around.
Their minds and bodies are filled with immense, expansive desires.
The poor wretches are cheated by egotism.
They are filled with countless sins, and are severely punished.

1005.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1005.t: taa kee keemat kahan na jaiee ||
1005.e: The extent of this cannot be estimated.
Forgetting God, they fall into hell.

1005.g: ਤਹ ਮਾਤ ਨ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
1005.t: teh maat na ba(n)dh na meet na jaiaa ||
1005.e: There are no mothers there, no siblings, no friends and no spouses.
Those humble beings, unto whom the Lord and Master becomes Merciful,
O Nanak, cross over. ||3||
Rambling and roaming, wandering around, I came to seek the Sanctuary of God.
He is the Master of the meek, the father and mother of the world.
The Merciful Lord God is the Destroyer of sorrow and suffering.
He emancipates whoever He pleases.
He lifts them up and pulls him out of the deep dark pit.
Emancipation comes through loving devotional worship.
The Holy Saint is the very embodiment of the Lord's form.
He Himself saves us from the great fire.

1005.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1005.t: jap tap sa(n)jam is te kichh naahee ||
1005.e: By myself, I cannot practice meditation, austerities, penance and self-discipline.
In the beginning and in the end, God is inaccessible and unfathomable.
Please bless me with Your Name, Lord; Your slave begs only for this.

1005.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੯॥
1005.t: har jeevan padh naanak prabh meraa ||4||3||19||
1005.e: O Nanak, my Lord God is the Giver of the true state of life. ||4||3||19||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1005.g: ਕਤ ਕਉ ਡਹਕਾਵਹੁ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੋਹਨ ਦੀਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
1005.t: kat kau ddahakaavahu logaa mohan dheen kirapaiee ||1||
1005.e: Why do you try to deceive others, O people of the world? The Fascinating Lord is Merciful to the meek. ||1||
This is what I have come to know.

1005.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰੋ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1005.t: saran sooro gur dhaataa raakhai aap vaddaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1005.e: The brave and heroic Guru, the Generous Giver, gives Sanctuary and preserves our honor. ||1||Pause||

1005.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥੨॥
1005.t: bhagataa kaa aagiaakaaree sadhaa sadhaa sukhadhaiee ||2||
1005.e: He submits to the Will of His devotees; He is forever and ever the Giver of peace. ||2||

1005.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
1005.t: apane kau kirapaa kareeahu ik naam dhiaaiee ||3||
1005.e: Please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may meditate on Your Name alone. ||3||

1005.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੦॥
1005.t: naanak dheen naam maagai dhuteeaa bharam chukaiee ||4||4||20||
1005.e: Nanak, the meek and humble, begs for the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it eradicates duality and doubt. ||4||4||20||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
My Lord and Master is utterly powerful.
I am just His poor servant. ||1||

1005.g: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
1005.t: mohan laal meraa preetam man praanaa ||
1005.e: My Enticing Beloved is very dear to my mind and my breath of life.
He blesses me with His gift. ||1||Pause||
I have seen and tested all.
There is none other than Him. ||2||
He sustains and nurtures all beings.
He was, and shall always be. ||3||
Please bless me with Your Mercy, O Divine Lord,
and link Nanak to Your service. ||4||5||21||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1005.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
1005.t: patit udhaaran taaran bal bal bale bal jaieeaai ||
1005.e: The Redeemer of sinners, who carries us across; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him.

1005.g: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
1005.t: aaisaa koiee bheTai sa(n)t jit har hare har dhiaaieeaai ||1||
1005.e: If only I could meet with such a Saint, who would inspire me to meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||

1005.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
1005.t: mo kau koi na jaanat kaheeat dhaas tumaaraa ||
1005.e: No one knows me; I am called Your slave.
This is my support and sustenance. ||1||Pause||

1005.g: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਨ ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
1005.t: sarab dhaaran pratipaaran ik binau dheenaa ||
1005.e: You support and cherish all; I am meek and humble - this is my only prayer.

1005.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਜਲ ਹਮ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੨॥
1005.t: tumaree bidh tum hee jaanahu tum jal ham meenaa ||2||
1005.e: You alone know Your Way; You are the water, and I am the fish. ||2||

1005.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਛੈ ॥
1005.t: pooran bisatheeran suaamee aaeh aaio paachhai ||
1005.e: O Perfect and Expansive Lord and Master, I follow You in love.

1005.g: ਸਗਲੋ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਆਛੈ ॥੩॥
1005.t: sagalo bhoo ma(n)ddal kha(n)ddal prabh tum hee aachhai ||3||
1005.e: O God, You are pervading all the worlds, solar systems and galaxies. ||3||

1006.g: ਅਟਲ ਅਖਇਓ ਦੇਵਾ ਮੋਹਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1006.t: aTal akhio dhevaa mohan alakh apaaraa ||
1006.e: You are eternal and unchanging, imperishable, invisible and infinite, O divine fascinating Lord.

1006.g: ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਨੁ ਦਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੨॥
1006.t: dhaan paavau sa(n)taa sa(n)g naanak ren dhaasaaraa ||4||6||22||
1006.e: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Society of the Saints, and the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||4||6||22||

1006.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1006.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1006.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1006.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਆਘਾਏ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
1006.t: tirapat aaghaae sa(n)taa ||
1006.e: The Saints are fulfilled and satisfied;

1006.g: ਗੁਰ ਜਾਨੇ ਜਿਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
1006.t: gur jaane jin ma(n)taa ||
1006.e: they know the Guru's Mantra and the Teachings.

1006.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1006.t: taa kee kichh kahan na jaiee ||
1006.e: They cannot even be described;

1006.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
1006.t: jaa kau naam baddaiee ||1||
1006.e: they are blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

1006.g: ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
1006.t: laal amolaa laalo ||
1006.e: My Beloved is a priceless jewel.

1006.g: ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ਨਾਮੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1006.t: ageh atolaa naamo ||1|| rahaau ||
1006.e: His Name is unattainable and immeasurable. ||1||Pause||

1006.g: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
1006.t: avigat siau maaniaa maano ||
1006.e: One whose mind is satisfied believing in the imperishable Lord God,

1006.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੋ ॥
1006.t: gurmukh tat giaano ||
1006.e: becomes Gurmukh and attains the essence of spiritual wisdom.

1006.g: ਪੇਖਤ ਸਗਲ ਧਿਆਨੋ ॥
1006.t: pekhat sagal dhiaano ||
1006.e: He sees all in his meditation.

1006.g: ਤਜਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥
1006.t: tajio man te abhimaano ||2||
1006.e: He banishes egotistical pride from his mind. ||2||

1006.g: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਠਾਣਾ ॥
1006.t: nihachal tin kaa Thaanaa ||
1006.e: Permanent is the place of those

1006.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
1006.t: gur te mahal pachhaanaa ||
1006.e: who, through the Guru, realize the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

1006.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
1006.t: anadhin gur mil jaage ||
1006.e: Meeting the Guru, they remain awake and aware night and day;

1006.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
1006.t: har kee sevaa laage ||3||
1006.e: they are committed to the Lord's service. ||3||

1006.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
1006.t: pooran tirapat aghaae ||
1006.e: They are perfectly fulfilled and satisfied,

1006.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
1006.t: sahaj samaadh subhaae ||
1006.e: intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi.

1006.g: ਹਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
1006.t: har bha(n)ddaar haath aaiaa ||
1006.e: The Lord's treasure comes into their hands;

1006.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੩॥
1006.t: naanak gur te paiaa ||4||7||23||
1006.e: O Nanak, through the Guru, they attain it. ||4||7||23||

1006.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਦੁਪਦੇ
1006.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar chhayvaa dhupadhe
1006.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House, Dho-Padhay:

1006.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1006.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1006.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1006.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
1006.t: chhodd sagal siaanapaa mil saadh tiaag gumaan ||
1006.e: Abandon all your clever tricks; meet with the Holy, and renounce your egotistical pride.

1006.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਵਖਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
1006.t: avar sabh kichh mithiaa rasanaa raam raam vakhaan ||1||
1006.e: Everything else is false; with your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||1||

1006.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
1006.t: mere man karan sun har naam ||
1006.e: O my mind, with your ears, listen to the Name of the Lord.

1006.g: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਅਘ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1006.t: miTeh agh tere janam janam ke kavan bapuro jaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1006.e: The sins of your many past lifetimes shall be washed away; then, what can the wretched Messenger of Death do to you? ||1||Pause||

1006.g: ਦੂਖ ਦੀਨ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
1006.t: dhookh dheen na bhau biaapai milai sukh bisraam ||
1006.e: Pain, poverty and fear shall not afflict you, and you shall find peace and pleasure.

1006.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੪॥
1006.t: gur prasaadh naanak bakhaanai har bhajan tat giaan ||2||1||24||
1006.e: By Guru's Grace, Nanak speaks; meditation on the Lord is the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||2||1||24||

1006.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1006.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1006.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1006.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਹੋਤ ਦੇਖੇ ਖੇਹ ॥
1006.t: jinee naam visaariaa se hot dhekhe kheh ||
1006.e: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord - I have seen them reduced to dust.

1006.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤੂਟਤੇ ਏ ਨੇਹ ॥੧॥
1006.t: putr mitr bilaas banitaa tooTate e neh ||1||
1006.e: The love of children and friends, and the pleasures of married life are torn apart. ||1||

1006.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਲੇਹ ॥
1006.t: mere man naam nit nit leh ||
1006.e: O my mind, continually, continuously chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1006.g: ਜਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੂਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1006.t: jalat naahee agan saagar sookh man tan dheh ||1|| rahaau ||
1006.e: You shall not burn in the ocean of fire, and your mind and body shall be blessed with peace. ||1||Pause||

1006.g: ਬਿਰਖ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਪਵਨ ਝੂਲਤ ਮੇਹ ॥
1006.t: birakh chhaiaa jaise binasat pavan jhoolat meh ||
1006.e: Like the shade of a tree, these things shall pass away, like the clouds blown away by the wind.

1006.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਆਵਤ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੫॥
1006.t: har bhagat dhiraR mil saadh naanak terai kaam aavat eh ||2||2||25||
1006.e: Meeting with the Holy, devotional worship to the Lord is implanted within; O Nanak, only this shall work for you. ||2||2||25||

1006.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1006.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1006.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1006.g: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੋ ਨੀਤ ॥
1006.t: purakh pooran sukheh dhaataa sa(n)g basato neet ||
1006.e: The perfect, primal Lord is the Giver of peace; He is always with you.

1006.g: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਉਸਨ ਨ ਸੀਤ ॥੧॥
1006.t: marai na aavai na jai binasai biaapat usan na seet ||1||
1006.e: He does not die, and he does not come or go in reincarnation. He does not perish, and He is not affected by heat or cold. ||1||

1006.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
1006.t: mere man naam siau kar preet ||
1006.e: O my mind, be in love with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1006.g: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਏਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1006.t: chet man meh har har nidhaanaa eh niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
1006.e: Within the mind, think of the Lord, Har, Har, the treasure. This is the purest way of life. ||1||Pause||

1006.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੀਧਿ ॥
1006.t: kirapaal dhiaal gopaal gobidh jo japai tis seedh ||
1006.e: Whoever meditates on the merciful compassionate Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is successful.

1006.g: ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੀਧਿ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੬॥
1006.t: naval navatan chatur su(n)dhar man naanak tis sa(n)g beedh ||2||3||26||
1006.e: He is always new, fresh and young, clever and beautiful; Nanak's mind is pierced through with His Love. ||2||3||26||

1006.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1006.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1006.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1006.g: ਚਲਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ॥
1006.t: chalat baisat sovat jaagat gur ma(n)tr ridhai chitaar ||
1006.e: While walking and sitting, sleeping and waking, contemplate within your heart the GurMantra.

1006.g: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਭਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
1006.t: charan saran bhaj sa(n)g saadhoo bhav saagar utareh paar ||1||
1006.e: Run to the Lord's lotus feet, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and reach the other side. ||1||

1007.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1007.t: mere man naam hiradhai dhaar ||
1007.e: O my mind, enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart.

1007.g: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1007.t: kar preet man tan lai har siau avar sagal visaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1007.e: Love the Lord, and commit your mind and body to Him; forget everything else. ||1||Pause||

1007.g: ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਤੂ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
1007.t: jeeau man tan praan prabh ke too aapan aap nivaar ||
1007.e: Soul, mind, body and breath of life belong to God; eliminate your self-conceit.

1007.g: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਜੁ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਆਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੭॥
1007.t: govidh bhaj sabh suaarath poore naanak kabahu na haar ||2||4||27||
1007.e: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe, and all your desires shall be fulfilled; O Nanak, you shall never be defeated. ||2||4||27||

1007.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1007.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1007.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1007.g: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਤਾਪੁ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧੂ ਥੀਉ ॥
1007.t: taj aap binasee taap ren saadhoo theeau ||
1007.e: Renounce your self-conceit, and the fever shall depart; become the dust of the feet of the Holy.

1007.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੀਉ ॥੧॥
1007.t: tiseh paraapat naam teraa kar kirapaa jis dheeau ||1||
1007.e: He alone receives Your Name, Lord, whom You bless with Your Mercy. ||1||

1007.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
1007.t: mere man naam a(n)mrit peeau ||
1007.e: O my mind, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1007.g: ਆਨ ਸਾਦ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਅਮਰੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1007.t: aan saadh bisaar hochhe amar jug jug jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
1007.e: Abandon other bland, insipid tastes; become immortal, and live throughout the ages. ||1||Pause||

1007.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਇਕ ਰਸ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਲੀਉ ॥
1007.t: naam ik ras ra(n)g naamaa naam laagee leeau ||
1007.e: Savor the essence of the One and only Naam; love the Naam, focus and attune yourself to the Naam.

1007.g: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਉ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੮॥
1007.t: meet saajan sakhaa ba(n)dhap har ek naanak keeau ||2||5||28||
1007.e: Nanak has made the One Lord his only friend, companion and relative. ||2||5||28||

1007.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1007.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1007.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1007.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਦਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਲਗਨਿ ਦੇਤ ਨ ਸੇਕ ॥
1007.t: pratipaal maataa udhar raakhai lagan dhet na sek ||
1007.e: He nourishes and preserves mortals in the womb of the mother, so that the fiery heat does not hurt them.

1007.g: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਈਹਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਬੂਝੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
1007.t: soiee suaamee ieehaa raakhai boojh budh bibek ||1||
1007.e: That Lord and Master protects us here. Understand this in your mind. ||1||

1007.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
1007.t: mere man naam kee kar Tek ||
1007.e: O my mind, take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1007.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੂਝੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1007.t: tiseh boojh jin too keeaa prabh karan kaaran ek ||1|| rahaau ||
1007.e: Understand the One who created you; the One God is the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

1007.g: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਭੇਖ ॥
1007.t: chet man meh taj siaanap chhodd sagale bhekh ||
1007.e: Remember the One Lord in your mind, renounce your clever tricks, and give up all your religious robes.

1007.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਕਈ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੯॥
1007.t: simar har har sadhaa naanak tare kiee anek ||2||6||29||
1007.e: Meditating in remembrance forever on the Lord, Har, Har, O Nanak, countless beings have been saved. ||2||6||29||

1007.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1007.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1007.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1007.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
1007.t: patit paavan naam jaa ko anaath ko hai naath ||
1007.e: His Name is the Purifier of sinners; He is the Master of the masterless.

1007.g: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੁਲਹੋ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਮਾਥ ॥੧॥
1007.t: mahaa bhaujal maeh tulaho jaa ko likhio maath ||1||
1007.e: In the vast and terrifying world-ocean, he is the raft for those who have such destiny inscribed on their foreheads. ||1||

1007.g: ਡੂਬੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
1007.t: ddoobe naam bin ghan saath ||
1007.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, huge numbers of companions have drowned.

1007.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1007.t: karan kaaran chit na aavai dhe kar raakhai haath ||1|| rahaau ||
1007.e: Even if someone does not remember the Lord, the Cause of causes, still, the Lord reaches out with His hand, and saves him. ||1||Pause||

1007.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਥ ॥
1007.t: saadhasa(n)gat gun uchaaran har naam a(n)mirat paath ||
1007.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and take the Path of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

1007.g: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਾਧਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਗਾਥ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੦॥
1007.t: karahu kirapaa muraar maadhau sun naanak jeevai gaath ||2||7||30||
1007.e: Shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord; listening to Your sermon, Nanak lives. ||2||7||30||

1007.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭
1007.t: maaroo a(n)julee mahalaa panjavaa ghar satvaa
1007.e: Maaroo, Anjulee ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer, Fifth Mehla, Seventh House:

1007.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1007.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1007.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1007.g: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਹੂਆ ॥
1007.t: sa(n)jog vijog dhurahu hee hooaa ||
1007.e: Union and separation are ordained by the Primal Lord God.

1007.g: ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
1007.t: pa(n)ch dhaat kar putalaa keeaa ||
1007.e: The puppet is made from the five elements.

1007.g: ਸਾਹੈ ਕੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਅੜੈ ਜੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
1007.t: saahai kai furamaiaRai jee dhehee vich jeeau aai piaa ||1||
1007.e: By the Command of the Dear Lord King, the soul came and entered into the body. ||1||

1007.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੜਹਾਰੇ ॥
1007.t: jithai agan bhakhai bhaRahaare ||
1007.e: In that place, where the fire rages like an oven,

1007.g: ਊਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੇ ॥
1007.t: uooradh mukh mahaa gubaare ||
1007.e: in that darkness where the body lies face down

1007.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਓਥੈ ਖਸਮਿ ਛਡਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥
1007.t: saas saas samaale soiee othai khasam chhaddai liaa ||2||
1007.e: - there, one remembers his Lord and Master with each and every breath, and then he is rescued. ||2||

1007.g: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਰਭੈ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
1007.t: vichahu garabhai nikal aaiaa ||
1007.e: Then, one comes out from within the womb,

1007.g: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੁਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
1007.t: khasam visaar dhunee chit laiaa ||
1007.e: and forgetting his Lord and Master, he attaches his consciousness to the world.

1007.g: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਜੋਨੀ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਕਿਤਹੀ ਥਾਇ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
1007.t: aavai jai bhavaieeaai jonee rahan na kitahee thai bhiaa ||3||
1007.e: He comes and goes, and wanders in reincarnation; he cannot remain anywhere. ||3||

1007.g: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਿ ਰਖਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
1007.t: miharavaan rakh lian aape ||
1007.e: The Merciful Lord Himself emancipates.

1007.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
1007.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh tis ke thaape ||
1007.e: He created and established all beings and creatures.

1007.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਥਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
1007.t: janam padhaarath jin chaliaa naanak aaiaa so paravaan thiaa ||4||1||31||
1007.e: Those who depart after having been victorious in this priceless human life - O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved. ||4||1||31||

1008.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1008.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1008.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1008.g: ਵੈਦੋ ਨ ਵਾਈ ਭੈਣੋ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਏਕੋ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1008.t: vaidho na vaiee bhaino na bhaiee eko sahaiee raam he ||1||
1008.e: The One Lord alone is our help and support; neither physician nor friend, nor sister nor brother can be this. ||1||

1008.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਜਿਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਮਲੋ ਧੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1008.t: keetaa jiso hovai paapaa(n) malo dhovai so simarahu paradhaan he ||2||
1008.e: His actions alone come to pass; He washes off the filth of sins. Meditate in remembrance on that Supreme Lord. ||2||

1008.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਵਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1008.t: ghaT ghaTe vaasee sarab nivaasee asathir jaa kaa thaan he ||3||
1008.e: He abides in each and every heart, and dwells in all; His seat and place are eternal. ||3||

1008.g: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1008.t: aavai na jaavai sa(n)ge samaavai pooran jaa kaa kaam he ||4||
1008.e: He does not come or go, and He is always with us. His actions are perfect. ||4||

1008.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1008.t: bhagat janaa kaa raakhanahaaraa ||
1008.e: He is the Savior and the Protector of His devotees.

1008.g: ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
1008.t: sa(n)t jeeveh jap praan adhaaraa ||
1008.e: The Saints live by meditating on God, the support of the breath of life.

1008.g: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੨॥
1008.t: karan kaaran samarath suaamee naanak tis kurabaan he ||5||2||32||
1008.e: The Almighty Lord and Master is the Cause of causes; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||5||2||32||

1008.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1008.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1008.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1008.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
1008.t: maaroo mahalaa nauvaa ||
1008.e: Maaroo, Ninth Mehla:

1008.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
1008.t: har ko naam sadhaa sukhadhaiee ||
1008.e: The Name of the Lord is forever the Giver of peace.

1008.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਹੂ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1008.t: jaa kau simar ajaamal udhario ganikaa hoo gat paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1008.e: Meditating in remembrance on it, Ajaamal was saved, and Ganika the prostitute was emancipated. ||1||Pause||

1008.g: ਪੰਚਾਲੀ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
1008.t: pa(n)chaalee kau raaj sabhaa meh raam naam sudh aaiee ||
1008.e: Dropadi the princess of Panchaala remembered the Lord's Name in the royal court.

1008.g: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਹਰਿਓ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਪੈਜ ਬਢਾਈ ॥੧॥
1008.t: taa ko dhookh hario karunaa mai apanee paij baddaiee ||1||
1008.e: The Lord, the embodiment of mercy, removed her suffering; thus His own glory was increased. ||1||

1008.g: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਓ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
1008.t: jeh nar jas kirapaa nidh gaio taa kau bhio sahaiee ||
1008.e: That man, who sings the Praise of the Lord, the treasure of mercy, has the help and support of the Lord.

1008.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਇਹੀ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਗਹੀ ਆਨਿ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥
1008.t: kahu naanak mai ihee bharosai gahee aan saranaiee ||2||1||
1008.e: Says Nanak, I have come to rely on this. I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||1||

1008.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
1008.t: maaroo mahalaa nauvaa ||
1008.e: Maaroo, Ninth Mehla:

1008.g: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
1008.t: ab mai kahaa karau ree maiee ||
1008.e: What should I do now, O mother?

1008.g: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਖੋਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਨੑਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1008.t: sagal janam bikhian siau khoiaa simario naeh kan(h)aiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1008.e: I have wasted my whole life in sin and corruption; I never remembered the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1008.g: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਜਬ ਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
1008.t: kaal faas jab gar meh melee teh sudh sabh bisaraiee ||
1008.e: When Death places the noose around my neck, then I lose all my senses.

1008.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਯਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਹਿ ਕੋ ਅਬ ਹੋਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
1008.t: raam naam bin yaa sa(n)kaT meh ko ab hot sahaiee ||1||
1008.e: Now, in this disaster, other than the Name of the Lord, who will be my help and support? ||1||

1008.g: ਜੋ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
1008.t: jo sa(n)pat apanee kar maanee chhin meh bhiee paraiee ||
1008.e: That wealth, which he believes to be his own, in an instant, belongs to another.

1008.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਯਹ ਸੋਚ ਰਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
1008.t: kahu naanak yeh soch rahee man har jas kabahoo na gaiee ||2||2||
1008.e: Says Nanak, this still really bothers my mind - I never sang the Praises of the Lord. ||2||2||

1008.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
1008.t: maaroo mahalaa nauvaa ||
1008.e: Maaroo, Ninth Mehla:

1008.g: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
1008.t: maiee mai man ko maan na tiaagio ||
1008.e: O my mother, I have not renounced the pride of my mind.

1008.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮਦਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਇਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1008.t: maiaa ke madh janam siraio raam bhajan nahee laagio ||1|| rahaau ||
1008.e: I have wasted my life intoxicated with Maya; I have not focused myself in meditation on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1008.g: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਡੰਡੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਤਬ ਸੋਵਤ ਤੈ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥
1008.t: jam ko dda(n)dd pario sir uoopar tab sovat tai jaagio ||
1008.e: When Death's club falls on my head, then I will be wakened from my sleep.

1008.g: ਕਹਾ ਹੋਤ ਅਬ ਕੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ਛੂਟਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਭਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
1008.t: kahaa hot ab kai pachhutaae chhooTat naahin bhaagio ||1||
1008.e: But what good will it do to repent at that time? I cannot escape by running away. ||1||

1008.g: ਇਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜਬ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਨ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਿਓ ॥
1008.t: eeh chi(n)taa upajee ghaT meh jab gur charanan anuraagio ||
1008.e: When this anxiety arises in the heart, then, one comes to love the Guru's feet.

1008.g: ਸੁਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਬ ਹੂਆ ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਸ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਗਿਓ ॥੨॥੩॥
1008.t: sufal janam naanak tab hooaa jau prabh jas meh paagio ||2||3||
1008.e: My life becomes fruitful, O Nanak, only when I am absorbed in the Praises of God. ||2||3||

1008.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧
1008.t: maaroo asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
1008.e: Maaroo, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehla, First House:

1008.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1008.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1008.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1008.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਥੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਹਾਰੇ ਮੁਨੀ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
1008.t: bedh puraan kathe sune haare munee anekaa ||
1008.e: Reciting and listening to the Vedas and the Puraanas, countless wise men have grown weary.

1008.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਭੇਖਾ ॥
1008.t: aThasaTh teerath bahu ghanaa bhram thaake bhekhaa ||
1008.e: So many in their various religious robes have grown weary, wandering to the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

1008.g: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਏਕਾ ॥੧॥
1008.t: saacho saahib niramalo man maanai ekaa ||1||
1008.e: The True Lord and Master is immaculate and pure. The mind is satisfied only by the One Lord. ||1||

1008.g: ਤੂ ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰੀ ॥
1008.t: too ajaraavar amar too sabh chaalanahaaree ||
1008.e: You are eternal; You do not grow old. All others pass away.

1008.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਭਾਇ ਲੈ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1008.t: naam rasain bhai lai parahar dhukh bhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
1008.e: One who lovingly focuses on the Naam, the source of nectar - his pains are taken away. ||1||Pause||

1009.g: ਹਰਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥
1009.t: har paReeaai har bujheeaai gurmatee naam udhaaraa ||
1009.e: Study the Lord's Name, and understand the Lord's Name; follow the Guru's Teachings, and through the Naam, you shall be saved.

1009.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1009.t: gur poorai pooree mat hai poorai sabadh beechaaraa ||
1009.e: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; contemplate the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

1009.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
1009.t: aThasaTh teerath har naam hai kilavikh kaaTanahaaraa ||2||
1009.e: The Lord's Name is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and the Eradicator of sins. ||2||

1009.g: ਜਲੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਜਲੁ ਮਥੈ ਤਤੁ ਲੋੜੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
1009.t: jal bilovai jal mathai tat loRai a(n)dh agiaanaa ||
1009.e: The blind ignorant mortal stirs the water and churns the water, wishing to obtain butter.

1009.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਦਧਿ ਮਥੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
1009.t: gurmatee dhadh matheeaai a(n)mrit paieeaai naam nidhaanaa ||
1009.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, one churns the cream, and the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam is obtained.

1009.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਪਸੂ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
1009.t: manmukh tat na jaananee pasoo maeh samaanaa ||3||
1009.e: The self-willed manmukh is a beast; he does not know the essence of reality that is contained within himself. ||3||

1009.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਰੀ ਮਰੁ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
1009.t: haumai meraa maree mar mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaar ||
1009.e: Dying in egotism and self-conceit, one dies, and dies again, only to be reincarnated over and over again.

1009.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
1009.t: gur kai sabadhe je marai fir marai na dhoojee vaar ||
1009.e: But when he dies in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, then he does not die, ever again.

1009.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥
1009.t: gurmatee jagajeevan man vasai sabh kul udhaaranahaar ||4||
1009.e: When he follows the Guru's Teachings, and enshrines the Lord, the Life of the World, within his mind, he redeems all his generations. ||4||

1009.g: ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
1009.t: sachaa vakhar naam hai sachaa vaapaaraa ||
1009.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the true object, the true commodity.

1009.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1009.t: laahaa naam sa(n)saar hai gurmatee veechaaraa ||
1009.e: The Naam is the only true profit in this world. Follow the Guru's Teachings, and contemplate it.

1009.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਨਿਤ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੈਸਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
1009.t: dhoojai bhai kaar kamaavanee nit toTaa saisaaraa ||5||
1009.e: To work in the love of duality, brings constant loss in this world. ||5||

1009.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥ ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
1009.t: saachee sa(n)gat thaan sach sache ghar baaraa || sachaa bhojan bhaau sach sach naam adhaaraa ||
1009.e: True is one's association, true is one's place, and true is one's hearth and home, when one has the support of the Naam.

1009.g: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
1009.t: sachee baanee sa(n)tokhiaa sachaa sabadh veechaaraa ||6||
1009.e: Contemplating the True Word of the Guru's Bani, and the True Word of the Shabad, one becomes content. ||6||

1009.g: ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਘਾਰਾ ॥
1009.t: ras bhogan paatisaaheeaa dhukh sukh sa(n)ghaaraa ||
1009.e: Enjoying princely pleasures, one shall be destroyed in pain and pleasure.

1009.g: ਮੋਟਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਈਐ ਗਲਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
1009.t: moTaa naau dharaieeaai gal aaugan bhaaraa ||
1009.e: Adopting a name of greatness, one strings heavy sins around his neck.

1009.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
1009.t: maanas dhaat na hoviee too dhaataa saaraa ||7||
1009.e: Mankind cannot give gifts; You alone are the Giver of everything. ||7||

1009.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1009.t: agam agochar too dhanee avigat apaaraa ||
1009.e: You are inaccessible and unfathomable; O Lord, You are imperishable and infinite.

1009.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਦਰੁ ਜੋਈਐ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
1009.t: gur sabadhee dhar joieeaai mukate bha(n)ddaaraa ||
1009.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, seeking at the Lord's Door, one finds the treasure of liberation.

1009.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
1009.t: naanak mel na chookiee saache vaapaaraa ||8||1||
1009.e: O Nanak, this union is not broken, if one deals in the merchandise of Truth. ||8||1||

1009.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1009.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1009.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

1009.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਦੀਆ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥
1009.t: bikh bohithaa laadhiaa dheeaa samu(n)dh ma(n)jhaar ||
1009.e: The boat is loaded with sin and corruption, and launched into the sea.

1009.g: ਕੰਧੀ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
1009.t: ka(n)dhee dhis na aaviee naa uravaar na paar ||
1009.e: The shore cannot be seen on this side, nor on the shore beyond.

1009.g: ਵੰਝੀ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਖੇਵਟੂ ਜਲੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਸਰਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
1009.t: va(n)jhee haath na khevaToo jal saagar asaraal ||1||
1009.e: There are no oars, nor any boatmen, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

1009.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਥਾ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
1009.t: baabaa jag faathaa mahaa jaal ||
1009.e: O Baba, the world is caught in the great noose.

1009.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1009.t: gur parasaadhee ubare sachaa naam samaal ||1|| rahaau ||
1009.e: By Guru's Grace, they are saved, contemplating the True Name. ||1||Pause||

1009.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
1009.t: satiguroo hai bohithaa sabadh la(n)ghaavanahaar ||
1009.e: The True Guru is the boat; the Word of the Shabad will carry them across.

1009.g: ਤਿਥੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
1009.t: tithai pavan na paavako naa jal naa aakaar ||
1009.e: There is neither wind nor fire, neither water nor form there.

1009.g: ਤਿਥੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
1009.t: tithai sachaa sach nai bhavajal taaranahaar ||2||
1009.e: The True Name of the True Lord is there; it carries them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

1009.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੰਘੇ ਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
1009.t: gurmukh la(n)ghe se paar pe sache siau liv lai ||
1009.e: The Gurmukhs reach the shore beyond, lovingly focusing on the True Lord.

1009.g: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
1009.t: aavaa gaun nivaariaa jotee jot milai ||
1009.e: Their comings and goings are ended, and their light merges into the Light.

1009.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
1009.t: gurmatee sahaj uoopajai sache rahai samai ||3||
1009.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, intuitive peace wells up within them, and they remain merged in the True Lord. ||3||

1009.g: ਸਪੁ ਪਿੜਾਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
1009.t: sap piRaiee paieeaai bikh a(n)tar man ros ||
1009.e: The snake may be locked in a basket, but it is still poisonous, and the anger within its mind remains.

1009.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੋਸੁ ॥
1009.t: poorab likhiaa paieeaai kis no dheejai dhos ||
1009.e: One obtains what is pre-ordained; why does he blame others?

1009.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਰੜੁ ਜੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੰਤੋਸੁ ॥੪॥
1009.t: gurmukh gaaraR je sune ma(n)ne naau sa(n)tos ||4||
1009.e: If one, as Gurmukh, hears and believes in the Name, the charm against poison, his mind becomes content. ||4||

1009.g: ਮਾਗਰਮਛੁ ਫਹਾਈਐ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਲੁ ਵਤਾਇ ॥
1009.t: maagaramachh fahaieeaai ku(n)ddee jaal vatai ||
1009.e: The crocodile is caught by the hook and line;

1009.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਫਾਥਾ ਫਾਹੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਇ ॥
1009.t: dhuramat faathaa faaheeaai fir fir pachhotai ||
1009.e: caught in the trap of evil-mindedness, he regrets and repents, again and again.

1009.g: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
1009.t: ja(n)man maran na sujhiee kirat na meTiaa jai ||5||
1009.e: He does not understand birth and death; the inscription of one's past actions cannot be erased. ||5||

1009.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
1009.t: haumai bikh pai jagat upaiaa sabadh vasai bikh jai ||
1009.e: Injecting the poison of egotism, the world was created; with the Shabad enshrined within, the poison is eliminated.

1009.g: ਜਰਾ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
1009.t: jaraa joh na sakiee sach rahai liv lai ||
1009.e: Old age cannot torment one who remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.

1009.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
1009.t: jeevan mukat so aakheeaai jis vichahu haumai jai ||6||
1009.e: He alone is called Jivan-Mikta, liberated while yet alive, from within whom egotism is eradicated. ||6||

1010.g: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1010.t: dha(n)dhai dhaavat jag baadhiaa naa boojhai veechaar ||
1010.e: The world is chasing after worldly affairs; caught and bound, it does not understand contemplative meditation.

1010.g: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
1010.t: ja(n)man maran visaariaa manmukh mugadh gavaar ||
1010.e: The foolish, ignorant, self-willed manmukh has forgotten birth and death.

1010.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
1010.t: gur raakhe se ubare sachaa sabadh veechaar ||7||
1010.e: Those whom the Guru has protected are saved, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad. ||7||

1010.g: ਸੂਹਟੁ ਪਿੰਜਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
1010.t: soohaT pi(n)jar prem kai bolai bolanahaar ||
1010.e: In the cage of divine love, the parrot, speaks.

1010.g: ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਤ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
1010.t: sach chugai a(n)mrit peeaai uddai ta ekaa vaar ||
1010.e: It pecks at the Truth, and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar; it flies away, only once.

1010.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
1010.t: gur miliaai khasam pachhaaneeaai kahu naanak mokh dhuaar ||8||2||
1010.e: Meeting with the Guru, one recognizes his Lord and Master; says Nanak, he finds the gate of liberation. ||8||2||

1010.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1010.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1010.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

1010.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ ਭਾਗੋ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
1010.t: sabadh marai taa maar mar bhaago kis peh jaau ||
1010.e: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad conquers death; otherwise, where can you run?

1010.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਡਰਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
1010.t: jis kai ddar bhai bhaageeaai a(n)mrit taa ko naau ||
1010.e: Through the Fear of God, fear runs away; His Name is Ambrosial Nectar.

1010.g: ਮਾਰਹਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਬੀਜਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
1010.t: maareh raakheh ek too beejau naahee thaau ||1||
1010.e: You alone kill and protect; except for You, there is no place at all. ||1||

1010.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਕਾਚਉ ਮਤਿਹੀਨ ॥
1010.t: baabaa mai kucheel kaachau matiheen ||
1010.e: O Baba, I am filthy, shallow and totally without understanding.

1010.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਕੀਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1010.t: naam binaa ko kachh nahee gur poorai pooree mat keen ||1|| rahaau ||
1010.e: Without the Naam, no one is anything; the Perfect Guru has made my intellect perfect. ||1||Pause||

1010.g: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਸੁਭਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
1010.t: avagan subhar gun nahee bin gun kiau ghar jaau ||
1010.e: I am full of faults, and I have no virtue at all. Without virtues, how can I go home?

1010.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1010.t: sahaj sabadh sukh uoopajai bin bhaagaa dhan naeh ||
1010.e: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace wells up; without good destiny, the wealth is not obtained.

1010.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
1010.t: jin kai naam na man vasai se baadhe dhookh sahaeh ||2||
1010.e: Those whose minds are not filled with the Naam are bound and gagged, and suffer in pain. ||2||

1010.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
1010.t: jinee naam visaariaa se kit aae sa(n)saar ||
1010.e: Those who have forgotten the Naam - why have they even come into the world?

1010.g: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਡੇ ਲਾਦੇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
1010.t: aagai paachhai sukh nahee gaadde laadhe chhaar ||
1010.e: Here and hereafter, they do not find any peace; they have loaded their carts with ashes.

1010.g: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥੩॥
1010.t: vichhuRiaa melaa nahee dhookh ghano jam dhuaar ||3||
1010.e: Those who are separated, do not meet with the Lord; they suffer in terrible pain at Death's Door. ||3||

1010.g: ਅਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਭੂਲੇ ਤੂ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
1010.t: agai kiaa jaanaa naeh mai bhoole too samajhai ||
1010.e: I do not know what will happen in the world hereafter; I am so confused - please teach me, Lord!

1010.g: ਭੂਲੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜੋ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
1010.t: bhoole maarag jo dhase tis kai laagau pai ||
1010.e: I am confused; I would fall at the feet of one who shows me the Way.

1010.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
1010.t: gur bin dhaataa ko nahee keemat kahan na jai ||4||
1010.e: Without the Guru, there is no giver at all; His value cannot be described. ||4||

1010.g: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਠਾਇਓ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
1010.t: saajan dhekhaa taa gal milaa saach paThaio lekh ||
1010.e: If I see my friend, then I will embrace Him; I have sent Him the letter of Truth.

1010.g: ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਮਾਣੈ ਧਨ ਖੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
1010.t: mukh dhimaanai dhan khaRee gurmukh aakhee dhekh ||
1010.e: His soul-bride stands waiting expectantly; as Gurmukh, I see Him with my eyes.

1010.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੂ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੫॥
1010.t: tudh bhaavai too man vaseh nadharee karam visekh ||5||
1010.e: By the Pleasure of Your Will, You abide in my mind, and bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||5||

1010.g: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੋ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦੇਇ ॥
1010.t: bhookh piaaso je bhavai kiaa tis maagau dhei ||
1010.e: One who is wandering hungry and thirsty - what can he give, and what can anyone ask from him?

1010.g: ਬੀਜਉ ਸੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
1010.t: beejau soojhai ko nahee man tan pooran dhei ||
1010.e: I cannot conceive of any other, who can bless my mind and body with perfection.

1010.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੬॥
1010.t: jin keeaa tin dhekhiaa aap vaddaiee dhei ||6||
1010.e: The One who created me takes care of me; He Himself blesses me with glory. ||6||

1010.g: ਨਗਰੀ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਨਵਤਨੋ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਲੀਲ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
1010.t: nagaree naik navatano baalak leel anoop ||
1010.e: In the body-village is my Lord and Master, whose body is ever-new, Innocent and child-like, incomparably playful.

1010.g: ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪੰਖਣੂ ਸਾਚਉ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
1010.t: naar na purakh na pa(n)khanoo saachau chatur saroop ||
1010.e: He is neither a woman, nor a man, nor a bird; the True Lord is so wise and beautiful.

1010.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਤੂ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਤੂ ਧੂਪੁ ॥੭॥
1010.t: jo tis bhaavai so theeaai too dheepak too dhoop ||7||
1010.e: Whatever pleases Him, happens; You are the lamp, and You are the incense. ||7||

1010.g: ਗੀਤ ਸਾਦ ਚਾਖੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਬਾਦ ਸਾਦ ਤਨਿ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
1010.t: geet saadh chaakhe sune baadh saadh tan rog ||
1010.e: He hears the songs and tastes the flavors, but these flavors are useless and insipid, and bring only disease to the body.

1010.g: ਸਚੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਉ ਚਵੈ ਛੂਟੈ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
1010.t: sach bhaavai saachau chavai chhooTai sog vijog ||
1010.e: One who loves the Truth and speaks the Truth, escapes from the sorrow of separation.

1010.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
1010.t: naanak naam na veesarai jo tis bhaavai su hog ||8||3||
1010.e: Nanak does not forget the Naam; whatever happens is by the Lord's Will. ||8||3||

1010.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1010.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1010.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

1010.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਲਾਲਚ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
1010.t: saachee kaar kamaavanee hor laalach baadh ||
1010.e: Practice Truth - other greed and attachments are useless.

1010.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
1010.t: eih man saachai mohiaa jihavaa sach saadh ||
1010.e: The True Lord has fascinated this mind, and my tongue enjoys the taste of Truth.

1010.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
1010.t: bin naavai ko ras nahee hor chaleh bikh laadh ||1||
1010.e: Without the Name, there is no juice; the others depart, loaded with poison. ||1||

1010.g: ਐਸਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੋ ਸੁਣਿ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
1010.t: aaisaa laalaa mere laal ko sun khasam hamaare ||
1010.e: I am such a slave of Yours, O my Beloved Lord and Master.

1010.g: ਜਿਉ ਫੁਰਮਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1010.t: jiau furamaaveh tiau chalaa sach laal piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
1010.e: I walk in harmony with Your Command, O my True, Sweet Beloved. ||1||Pause||

1010.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਲੇ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਗੋਲੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
1010.t: anadhin laale chaakaree gole sir meeraa ||
1010.e: Night and day, the slave works for his overlord.

1010.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
1010.t: gur bachanee man vechiaa sabadh man dheeraa ||
1010.e: I have sold my mind for the Word of the Guru's Shabad; my mind is comforted and consoled by the Shabad.

1011.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਾਟੈ ਮਨ ਪੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
1011.t: gur poore saabaas hai kaaTai man peeraa ||2||
1011.e: The Perfect Guru is honored and celebrated; He has taken away the pains of my mind. ||2||

1011.g: ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਧਣੀ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਵਡਿਆਈਐ ॥
1011.t: laalaa golaa dhanee ko kiaa kahau vaddiaaieeaai ||
1011.e: I am the servant and slave of my Master; what glorious greatness of His can I describe?

1011.g: ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
1011.t: bhaanai bakhase pooraa dhanee sach kaar kamaieeaai ||
1011.e: The Perfect Master, by the Pleasure of His Will, forgives, and then one practices Truth.

1011.g: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
1011.t: vichhuRiaa kau mel le gur kau bal jaieeaai ||3||
1011.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who re-unites the separated ones. ||3||

1011.g: ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਮਤਿ ਖਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
1011.t: laale gole mat kharee gur kee mat neekee ||
1011.e: The intellect of His servant and slave is noble and true; it is made so by the Guru's intellect.

1011.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕੀ ॥
1011.t: saachee surat suhaavanee manmukh mat feekee ||
1011.e: The intuition of those who are true is beautiful; the intellect of the self-willed manmukh is insipid.

1011.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਚੁ ਧੀਰਕ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ॥੪॥
1011.t: man tan teraa too prabhoo sach dheerak dhur kee ||4||
1011.e: My mind and body belong to You, God; from the very beginning, Truth has been my only support. ||4||

1011.g: ਸਾਚੈ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਉਠਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
1011.t: saachai baisan uThanaa sach bhojan bhaakhiaa ||
1011.e: In Truth I sit and stand; I eat and speak the Truth.

1011.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਸਚੈ ਵਿਤੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
1011.t: chit sachai vito sachaa saachaa ras chaakhiaa ||
1011.e: With Truth in my consciousness, I gather the wealth of Truth, and drink in the sublime essence of Truth.

1011.g: ਸਾਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੫॥
1011.t: saachai ghar saachai rakhe gur bachan subhaakhiaa ||5||
1011.e: In the home of Truth, the True Lord protects me; I speak the Words of the Guru's Teachings with love. ||5||

1011.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਘਣੋ ਫਾਥੇ ਓਜਾੜੀ ॥
1011.t: manmukh kau aalas ghano faathe ojaaRee ||
1011.e: The self-willed manmukh is very lazy; he is trapped in the wilderness.

1011.g: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੁਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਚੋਗੜੀ ਲਗਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਵਿਗਾੜੀ ॥
1011.t: faathaa chugai nit chogaRee lag ba(n)dh vigaaRee ||
1011.e: He is drawn to the bait, and continually pecking at it, he is trapped; his link to the Lord is ruined.

1011.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਿਜ ਤਾੜੀ ॥੬॥
1011.t: gur parasaadhee mukat hoi saache nij taaRee ||6||
1011.e: By Guru's Grace, one is liberated, absorbed in the primal trance of Truth. ||6||

1011.g: ਅਨਹਤਿ ਲਾਲਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
1011.t: anahat laalaa bedhiaa prabh het piaaree ||
1011.e: His slave remains continually pierced through with love and affection for God.

1011.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਝੂਠੇ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥
1011.t: bin saache jeeau jal balau jhooThe vekaaree ||
1011.e: Without the True Lord, the soul of the false, corrupt person is burnt to ashes.

1011.g: ਬਾਦਿ ਕਾਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਛੋਡੀਆ ਸਾਚੀ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
1011.t: baadh kaaraa sabh chhoddeeaa saachee tar taaree ||7||
1011.e: Abandoning all evil actions, he crosses over in the boat of Truth. ||7||

1011.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
1011.t: jinee naam visaariaa tinaa Thaur na Thaau ||
1011.e: Those who have forgotten the Naam have no home, no place of rest.

1011.g: ਲਾਲੈ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
1011.t: laalai laalach tiaagiaa paiaa har naau ||
1011.e: The Lord's slave renounces greed and attachment, and obtains the Lord's Name.

1011.g: ਤੂ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੮॥੪॥
1011.t: too bakhaseh taa mel laih naanak bal jaau ||8||4||
1011.e: If You forgive him, Lord, then He is united with You; Nanak is a sacrifice. ||8||4||

1011.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1011.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1011.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

1011.g: ਲਾਲੈ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
1011.t: laalai gaarab chhoddiaa gur kai bhai sahaj subhaiee ||
1011.e: The Lord's slave renounces his egotistical pride, through the Guru's Fear, intuitively and easily.

1011.g: ਲਾਲੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1011.t: laalai khasam pachhaaniaa vaddee vaddiaaiee ||
1011.e: The slave realizes his Lord and Master; glorious is his greatness!

1011.g: ਖਸਮਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
1011.t: khasam miliaai sukh paiaa keemat kahan na jaiee ||1||
1011.e: Meeting with his Lord and Master, he finds peace; His value cannot be desribed. ||1||

1011.g: ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1011.t: laalaa golaa khasam kaa khasamai vaddiaaiee ||
1011.e: I am the slave and servant of my Lord and Master; all glory is to my Master.

1011.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1011.t: gur parasaadhee ubare har kee saranaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1011.e: By Guru's Grace, I am saved, in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1011.g: ਲਾਲੇ ਨੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
1011.t: laale no sir kaar hai dhur khasam furamaiee ||
1011.e: The slave has been given the most excellent task, by the Primal Command of the Master.

1011.g: ਲਾਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
1011.t: laalai hukam pachhaaniaa sadhaa rahai rajaiee ||
1011.e: The slave realizes the Hukam of His Command, and submits to His Will forever.

1011.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੀਰਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
1011.t: aape meeraa bakhas le vaddee vaddiaaiee ||2||
1011.e: The Lord King Himself grants forgiveness; how glorious is His greatness! ||2||

1011.g: ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
1011.t: aap sachaa sabh sach hai gur sabadh bujhaiee ||
1011.e: He Himself is True, and everything is True; this is revealed through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1011.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲੈਹਿ ਤੂ ਲਾਈ ॥
1011.t: teree sevaa so kare jis no laih too laiee ||
1011.e: He alone serves You, whom You have enjoined to do so.

1011.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥੩॥
1011.t: bin sevaa kinai na paiaa dhoojai bharam khuaaiee ||3||
1011.e: Without serving Him, no one finds Him; in duality and doubt, they are ruined. ||3||

1011.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
1011.t: so kiau manahu visaareeaai nit dhevai chaRai savaiaa ||
1011.e: How could we forget Him from our minds? The gifts which he bestows increase day by day.

1011.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1011.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis dhaa saahu tinai vich paiaa ||
1011.e: Soul and body, all belong to Him; He infused the breath into us.

1011.g: ਜਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1011.t: jaa kirapaa kare taa seveeaai sev sach samaiaa ||4||
1011.e: If he shows His Mercy, then we serve Him; serving Him, we merge in Truth. ||4||

1011.g: ਲਾਲਾ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
1011.t: laalaa so jeevat marai mar vichahu aap gavaae ||
1011.e: He alone is the Lord's slave, who remains dead while yet alive, and eradicates egotism from within.

1011.g: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
1011.t: ba(n)dhan tooTeh mukat hoi tirasanaa agan bujhaae ||
1011.e: His bonds are broken, the fire of his desire is quenched, and he is liberated.

1011.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
1011.t: sabh meh naam nidhaan hai gurmukh ko paae ||5||
1011.e: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within all, but how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, obtain it. ||5||

1011.g: ਲਾਲੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਲਾ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੁ ॥
1011.t: laale vich gun kichh nahee laalaa avaganiaar ||
1011.e: Within the Lord's slave, there is no virtue at all; the Lord's slave is totally unworthy.

1011.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
1011.t: tudh jevadd dhaataa ko nahee too bakhasanahaar ||
1011.e: There is no Giver as great as You, Lord; You alone are the Forgiver.

1011.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਏਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
1011.t: teraa hukam laalaa ma(n)ne eh karanee saar ||6||
1011.e: Your slave obeys the Hukam of Your Command; this is the most excellent action. ||6||

1011.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
1011.t: gur saagar a(n)mirat sar jo ichhe so fal paae ||
1011.e: The Guru is the pool of nectar in the world-ocean; whatever one desires, that fruit is obtained.

1011.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
1011.t: naam padhaarath amar hai hiradhai ma(n)n vasaae ||
1011.e: The treasure of the Naam brings immortality; enshrine it in your heart and mind.

1012.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੭॥
1012.t: gur sevaa sadhaa sukh hai jis no hukam manaae ||7||
1012.e: Serving the Guru, eternal peace is obtained, by those whom the Lord inspires to obey the Hukam of His Command. ||7||

1012.g: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸਭ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
1012.t: suinaa rupaa sabh dhaat hai maaTee ral jaiee ||
1012.e: Gold and silver, and all metals, mix with dust in the end

1012.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
1012.t: bin naavai naal na chaliee satigur boojh bujhaiee ||
1012.e: Without the Name, nothing goes along with you; the True Guru has imparted this understanding.

1012.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੮॥੫॥
1012.t: naanak naam rate se niramale saachai rahe samaiee ||8||5||
1012.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; they remain merged in the Truth. ||8||5||

1012.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1012.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1012.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

1012.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਫਾਟੇ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
1012.t: hukam bhiaa rahanaa nahee dhur faaTe cheerai ||
1012.e: The Order is issued, and he cannot remain; the permit to stay has been torn up.

1012.g: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰੈ ॥
1012.t: eh man avagan baadhiaa sahu dheh sareerai ||
1012.e: This mind is tied to its faults; it suffers terrible pain in its body.

1012.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਾਈਅਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਨਹ ਫਕੀਰੈ ॥੧॥
1012.t: poorai gur bakhasaie'eeh sabh guneh fakeerai ||1||
1012.e: The Perfect Guru forgives all the mistakes of the beggar at His Door. ||1||

1012.g: ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਬੁਝੁ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1012.t: kiau raheeaai uTh chalanaa bujh sabadh beechaaraa ||
1012.e: How can he stay here? He must get up and depart. Contemplate the Word of the Shabad, and understand this.

1012.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
