1012.t: jis too meleh so milai dhur hukam apaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
1012.e: He alone is united, whom You, O Lord, unite. Such is the Primal Command of the Infinite Lord. ||1||Pause||

1012.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਖਾਉ ॥
1012.t: jiau too raakheh tiau rahaa jo dheh su khaau ||
1012.e: As You keep me, I remain; whatever You give me, I eat.

1012.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਉ ॥
1012.t: jiau too chalaaveh tiau chalaa mukh a(n)mirat naau ||
1012.e: As You lead me, I follow, with the Ambrosial Name in my mouth.

1012.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥
1012.t: mere Thaakur hath vaddiaaieeaa meleh man chaau ||2||
1012.e: All glorious greatness rests in the hands of my Lord and Master; my mind yearns to unite with You. ||2||

1012.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
1012.t: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeaai kar dhekhai soiee ||
1012.e: Why should anyone praise any other created being? That Lord acts and sees.

1012.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
1012.t: jin keeaa so man vasai mai avar na koiee ||
1012.e: The One who created me, abides within my mind; there is no other at all.

1012.g: ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
1012.t: so saachaa saalaaheeaai saachee pat hoiee ||3||
1012.e: So praise that True Lord, and you shall be blessed with true honor. ||3||

1012.g: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜਿ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਈ ਬਹੁ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
1012.t: pa(n)ddit paR na pahuchiee bahu aal ja(n)jaalaa ||
1012.e: The Pandit, the religious scholar, reads, but does not reach the Lord; he is totally entangled in worldly affairs.

1012.g: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਦੁਇ ਸੰਗਮੇ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਜਮਕਾਲਾ ॥
1012.t: paap pu(n)n dhui sa(n)game khudhiaa jamakaalaa ||
1012.e: He keeps the company of both virtue and vice, tormented by hunger and the Messenger of Death.

1012.g: ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਭਉ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
1012.t: vichhoRaa bhau veesarai pooraa rakhavaalaa ||4||
1012.e: One who is protected by the Perfect Lord, forgets separation and fear. ||4||

1012.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
1012.t: jin kee lekhai pat pavai se poore bhaiee ||
1012.e: They alone are perfect, O Siblings of Destiny, whose honor is certified.

1012.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1012.t: poore pooree mat hai sachee vaddiaaiee ||
1012.e: Perfect is the intellect of the Perfect Lord. True is His glorious greatness.

1012.g: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
1012.t: dhedhe toT na aaviee lai lai thak paiee ||5||
1012.e: His gifts never run short, although those who receive may grow weary of receiving. ||5||

1012.g: ਖਾਰ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਢੰਢੋਲੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1012.t: khaar samudhr dda(n)ddoleeaai ik maneeaa paavai ||
1012.e: Searching the salty sea, one finds the pearl.

1012.g: ਦੁਇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
1012.t: dhui dhin chaar suhaavanaa maaTee tis khaavai ||
1012.e: It looks beautiful for a few days, but in the end, it is eaten away by dust.

1012.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੬॥
1012.t: gur saagar sat seveeaai dhe toT na aavai ||6||
1012.e: If one serves the Guru, the ocean of Truth, the gifts one receives never run short. ||6||

1012.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਊਜਲੇ ਸਭ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
1012.t: mere prabh bhaavan se uoojale sabh mail bhareejai ||
1012.e: They alone are pure, who are pleasing to my God; all others are soiled with filth.

1012.g: ਮੈਲਾ ਊਜਲੁ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਾਰਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
1012.t: mailaa uoojal taa theeaai paaras sa(n)g bheejai ||
1012.e: The filthy become pure, when they meet with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

1012.g: ਵੰਨੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੀ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
1012.t: va(n)nee saache laal kee kin keemat keejai ||7||
1012.e: Who can estimate the value of the color of the true jewel? ||7||

1012.g: ਭੇਖੀ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਨੇ ॥
1012.t: bhekhee haath na labhiee teerath nahee dhaane ||
1012.e: Wearing religious robes, the Lord is not obtained, nor is He obtained by giving donations at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

1012.g: ਪੂਛਉ ਬੇਦ ਪੜੰਤਿਆ ਮੂਠੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
1012.t: poochhau bedh paRa(n)tiaa mooThee vin maane ||
1012.e: Go and ask the readers of the Vedas; without faith, the world is cheated.

1012.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥੮॥੬॥
1012.t: naanak keemat so kare pooraa gur giaane ||8||6||
1012.e: O Nanak, he alone values the jewel, who is blessed with the spiritual wisdom of the Perfect Guru. ||8||6||

1012.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1012.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1012.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1012.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲਹਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਗੂਚੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹੇਰੈ ॥
1012.t: manmukh lahar ghar taj vigoochai avaraa ke ghar herai ||
1012.e: The self-willed manmukh, in a fit of passion, abandons his home, and is ruined; then, he spies on the homes of others.

1012.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਭੇਟੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
1012.t: gireh dharam gavaae satigur na bheTai dhuramat ghooman gherai ||
1012.e: He neglects his household duties, and does not meet with the True Guru; he is caught in the whirlpool of evil-mindedness.

1012.g: ਦਿਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਵਧੇਰੈ ॥
1012.t: dhisa(n)tar bhavai paaTh paR thaakaa tirasanaa hoi vadherai ||
1012.e: Wandering in foreign lands and reading scriptures, he grows weary, and his thirsty desires only increase.

1012.g: ਕਾਚੀ ਪਿੰਡੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਢੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
1012.t: kaachee pi(n)ddee sabadh na cheenai udhar bharai jaise ddorai ||1||
1012.e: His perishable body does not remember the Word of the Shabad; like a beast, he fills his belly. ||1||

1012.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਐਸੀ ਰਵਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
1012.t: baabaa aaisee ravat ravai sa(n)niaasee ||
1012.e: O Baba, this is the way of life of the Sannyaasi, the renunciate.

1012.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1012.t: gur kai sabadh ek liv laagee terai naam rate tirapataasee ||1|| rahaau ||
1012.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is to enshrine love for the One Lord. Imbued with Your Name, Lord, he remains satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

1012.g: ਘੋਲੀ ਗੇਰੂ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੇਖ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
1012.t: gholee geroo ra(n)g chaRaiaa vasatr bhekh bhekhaaree ||
1012.e: He dyes his robes with saffron dye, and wearing these robes, he goes out begging.

1012.g: ਕਾਪੜ ਫਾਰਿ ਬਨਾਈ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
1012.t: kaapaR faar banaiee khi(n)thaa jholee maiaadhaaree ||
1012.e: Tearing his robes, he makes a patched coat, and puts the money in his wallet.

1012.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗੈ ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਪਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
1012.t: ghar ghar maagai jag parabodhai man a(n)dhai pat haaree ||
1012.e: From house to house he goes begging, and tries to teach the world; but his mind is blind, and so he loses his honor.

1012.g: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
1012.t: bharam bhulaanaa sabadh na cheenai jooaai baajee haaree ||2||
1012.e: He is deluded by doubt, and does not remember the Word of the Shabad. He loses his life in the gamble. ||2||

1013.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੂਅਰ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
1013.t: a(n)tar agan na gur bin boojhai baahar pooar taapai ||
1013.e: Without the Guru, the fire within is not quenched; and outside, the fire still burns.

1013.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਆਪੈ ॥
1013.t: gur sevaa bin bhagat na hovee kiau kar cheenas aapai ||
1013.e: Without serving the Guru, there is no devotional worship. How can anyone, by himself, know the Lord?

1013.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
1013.t: ni(n)dhaa kar kar narak nivaasee a(n)tar aatam jaapai ||
1013.e: Slandering others, one lives in hell; within him is hazy darkness.

1013.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਚਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਪੈ ਪਾਪੈ ॥੩॥
1013.t: aThasaTh teerath bharam vigoocheh kiau mal dhopai paapai ||3||
1013.e: Wandering to the eixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, he is ruined. How can the filth of sin be washed away? ||3||

1013.g: ਛਾਣੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਚੜਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
1013.t: chhaanee khaak bibhoot chaRaiee maiaa kaa mag johai ||
1013.e: He sifts through the dust, and applies ashes to his body, but he is searching for the path of Maya's wealth.

1013.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੇ ਤੇ ਛੋਹੈ ॥
1013.t: a(n)tar baahar ek na jaanai saach kahe te chhohai ||
1013.e: Inwardly and outwardly, he does not know the One Lord; if someone tells him the Truth, he grows angry.

1013.g: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਓਹੈ ॥
1013.t: paaTh paRai mukh jhooTho bolai nigure kee mat ohai ||
1013.e: He reads the scriptures, but tells lies; such is the intellect of one who has no guru.

1013.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਈ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੪॥
1013.t: naam na japiee kiau sukh paavai bin naavai kiau sohai ||4||
1013.e: Without chanting the Naam, how can he find peace? Without the Name, how can he look good? ||4||

1013.g: ਮੂੰਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇ ਜਟਾ ਸਿਖ ਬਾਧੀ ਮੋਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
1013.t: moo(n)dd muddai jaTaa sikh baadhee mon rahai abhimaanaa ||
1013.e: Some shave their heads, some keep their hair in matted tangles; some keep it in braids, while some keep silent, filled with egotistical pride.

1013.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਤ ਆਤਮ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
1013.t: manooaa ddolai dheh dhis dhaavai bin rat aatam giaanaa ||
1013.e: Their minds waver and wander in ten directions, without loving devotion and enlightenment of the soul.

1013.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ॥
1013.t: a(n)mrit chhodd mahaa bikh peevai maiaa kaa dhevaanaa ||
1013.e: They abandon the Ambrosial Nectar, and drink the deadly poison, driven mad by Maya.

1013.g: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਸੂਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
1013.t: kirat na miTiee hukam na boojhai pasooaa maeh samaanaa ||5||
1013.e: Past actions cannot be erased; without understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they become beasts. ||5||

1013.g: ਹਾਥ ਕਮੰਡਲੁ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
1013.t: haath kama(n)ddal kaapaReeaa man tirasanaa upajee bhaaree ||
1013.e: With bowl in hand, wearing his patched coat, great desires well up in his mind.

1013.g: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਜਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
1013.t: eisatree taj kar kaam viaapiaa chit laiaa par naaree ||
1013.e: Abandoning his own wife, he is engrossed in sexual desire; his thoughts are on the wives of others.

1013.g: ਸਿਖ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਲੰਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
1013.t: sikh kare kar sabadh na cheenai la(n)paT hai baajaaree ||
1013.e: He teaches and preaches, but does not contemplate the Shabad; he is bought and sold on the street.

1013.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੀ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥੬॥
1013.t: a(n)tar bikh baahar nibharaatee taa jam kare khuaaree ||6||
1013.e: With poison within, he pretends to be free of doubt; he is ruined and humiliated by the Messenger of Death. ||6||

1013.g: ਸੋ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
1013.t: so sa(n)niaasee jo satigur sevai vichahu aap gavaae ||
1013.e: He alone is a Sannyaasi, who serves the True Guru, and removes his self-conceit from within.

1013.g: ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਕਰਈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
1013.t: chhaadhan bhojan kee aas na kariee achi(n)t milai so paae ||
1013.e: He does not ask for clothes or food; without asking, he accepts whatever he receives.

1013.g: ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
1013.t: bakai na bolai khimaa dhan sa(n)grahai taamas naam jalaae ||
1013.e: He does not speak empty words; he gathers in the wealth of tolerance, and burns away his anger with the Naam.

1013.g: ਧਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
1013.t: dhan girahee sa(n)niaasee jogee j har charanee chit laae ||7||
1013.e: Blessed is such a householder, Sannyaasi and Yogi, who focuses his consciousness on the Lord's feet. ||7||

1013.g: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
1013.t: aas niraas rahai sa(n)niaasee ekas siau liv laae ||
1013.e: Amidst hope, the Sannyaasi remains unmoved by hope; he remains lovingly focused on the One Lord.

1013.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
1013.t: har ras peevai taa saat aavai nij ghar taaRee laae ||
1013.e: He drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord, and so finds peace and tranquility; in the home of his own being, he remains absorbed in the deep trance of meditation.

1013.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
1013.t: manooaa na ddolai gurmukh boojhai dhaavat varaj rahaae ||
1013.e: His mind does not waver; as Gurmukh, he understands. He restrains it from wandering out.

1013.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥
1013.t: girahu sareer gurmatee khoje naam padhaarath paae ||8||
1013.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, he searches the home of his body, and obtains the wealth of the Naam. ||8||

1013.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
1013.t: brahamaa bisan mahes saresaT naam rate veechaaree ||
1013.e: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are exalted, imbued with contemplative meditation on the Naam.

1013.g: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਗਨ ਪਤਾਲੀ ਜੰਤਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
1013.t: khaanee baanee gagan pataalee ja(n)taa jot tumaaree ||
1013.e: The sources of creation, speech, the heavens and the underworld, all beings and creatures, are infused with Your Light.

1013.g: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
1013.t: sabh sukh mukat naam dhun baanee sach naam ur dhaaree ||
1013.e: All comforts and liberation are found in the Naam, and the vibrations of the Guru's Bani; I have enshrined the True Name within my heart.

1013.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ ਤਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੯॥੭॥
1013.t: naam binaa nahee chhooTas naanak saachee tar too taaree ||9||7||
1013.e: Without the Naam, no one is saved; O Nanak, with the Truth, cross over to the other side. ||9||7||

1013.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1013.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1013.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

1013.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
1013.t: maat pitaa sa(n)jog upaae rakat bi(n)dh mil pi(n)dd kare ||
1013.e: Through the union of mother and father, the fetus is formed. The egg and sperm join together to make the body.

1013.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਰਭ ਉਰਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
1013.t: a(n)tar garabh uradh liv laagee so prabh saare dhaat kare ||1||
1013.e: Upside-down within the womb, it lovingly dwells on the Lord; God provides for it, and gives it nourishment there. ||1||

1013.g: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੈ ॥
1013.t: sa(n)saar bhavajal kiau tarai ||
1013.e: How can he cross over the terrifying world-ocean?

1013.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰੁ ਟਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1013.t: gurmukh naam nira(n)jan paieeaai afario bhaar afaar Tarai ||1|| rahaau ||
1013.e: The Gurmukh obtains the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unbearable load of sins is removed. ||1||Pause||

1013.g: ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮੈ ਬਉਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਉ ਹਰੇ ॥
1013.t: te gun visar ge aparaadhee mai bauraa kiaa karau hare ||
1013.e: I have forgotten Your Virtues, Lord; I am insane - what can I do now?

1013.g: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਭੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
1013.t: too dhaataa dhiaal sabhai sir ahinis dhaat samaar kare ||2||
1013.e: You are the Merciful Giver, above the heads of all. Day and night, You give gifts, and take care of all. ||2||

1013.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲੈ ਜਗਿ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
1013.t: chaar padhaarath lai jag janamiaa siv sakatee ghar vaas dhare ||
1013.e: One is born to achieve the four great objectives of life. The spirit has taken up its home in the material world.

1014.g: ਲਾਗੀ ਭੂਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੩॥
1014.t: laagee bhookh maiaa mag johai mukat padhaarath moh khare ||3||
1014.e: Driven by hunger, it sees the path of Maya's riches; this emotional attachment takes away the treasure of liberation. ||3||

1014.g: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਢੂਢਤ ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
1014.t: karan palaav kare nahee paavai it ut ddooddat thaak pare ||
1014.e: Weeping and wailing, he does not receive them; he searches here and there, and grows weary.

1014.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਕੂੜ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥
1014.t: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar viaape kooR kuTa(n)b siau preet kare ||4||
1014.e: Engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism, he falls in love with his false relatives. ||4||

1014.g: ਖਾਵੈ ਭੋਗੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕਾਲ ਘਰੇ ॥
1014.t: khaavai bhogai sun sun dhekhai pahir dhikhaavai kaal ghare ||
1014.e: He eats and enjoys, listens and watches, and dresses up to show off in this house of death.

1014.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਟਰੇ ॥੫॥
1014.t: bin gur sabadh na aap pachhaanai bin har naam na kaal Tare ||5||
1014.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he does not undersand himself. Without the Lord's Name, death cannot be avoided. ||5||

1014.g: ਜੇਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਛੀਨਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
1014.t: jetaa moh haumai kar bhoole meree meree karate chheen khare ||
1014.e: The more attachment and egotism delude and confuse him, the more he cries out, ""Mine, mine!"", and the more he loses out.

1014.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਹਸੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੬॥
1014.t: tan dhan binasai sahasai sahasaa fir pachhutaavai mukh dhoor pare ||6||
1014.e: His body and wealth pass away, and he is torn by skepticism and cynicism; in the end, he regrets and repents, when the dust falls on his face. ||6||

1014.g: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖਿਸਿਆ ਕਫੁ ਕੰਠੁ ਬਿਰੂਧੋ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਢਰੇ ॥
1014.t: biradh bhiaa joban tan khisiaa kaf ka(n)Th biroodho nainahu neer ddare ||
1014.e: He grows old, his body and youth waste away, and his throat is plugged with mucous; water flows from his eyes.

1014.g: ਚਰਣ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਕੰਪਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰੇ ॥੭॥
1014.t: charan rahe kar ka(n)pan laage saakat raam na ridhai hare ||7||
1014.e: His feet fail him, and his hands shake and tremble; the faithless cynic does not enshrine the Lord in his heart. ||7||

1014.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਈ ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂ ਧਉਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਖਿਓ ਘਰੇ ॥
1014.t: surat giee kaalee hoo dhaule kisai na bhaavai rakhio ghare ||
1014.e: His intellect fails him, his black hair turns white, and no one wants to keep him in their home.

1014.g: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਐਸੇ ਦੋਖ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੮॥
1014.t: bisarat naam aaise dhokh laageh jam maar samaare narak khare ||8||
1014.e: Forgetting the Naam, these are the stigmas which stick to him; the Messenger of Death beats him, and drags him to hell. ||8||

1014.g: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
1014.t: poorab janam ko lekh na miTiee janam marai kaa kau dhos dhare ||
1014.e: The record of one's past actions cannot be erased; who else is to blame for one's birth and death?

1014.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਦਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰੇ ॥੯॥
1014.t: bin gur baadh jeevan hor maranaa bin gur sabadhai janam jare ||9||
1014.e: Without the Guru, life and death are pointless; without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, life just burns away. ||9||

1014.g: ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰ ਭਏ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਫੋਕਟ ਕਰਮ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ॥
1014.t: khusee khuaar bhe ras bhogan fokaT karam vikaar kare ||
1014.e: The pleasures enjoyed in happiness bring ruin; acting in corruption is useless indulgence.

1014.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਪਰੇ ॥੧੦॥
1014.t: naam bisaar lobh mool khoio sir dharam rai kaa dda(n)dd pare ||10||
1014.e: Forgetting the Naam, and caught by greed, he betrays his own source; the club of the Righteous Judge of Dharma will strike him over the head. ||10||

1014.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
1014.t: gurmukh raam naam gun gaaveh jaa kau har prabh nadhar kare ||
1014.e: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name; the Lord God blesses them with His Glance of Grace.

1014.g: ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੧॥
1014.t: te niramal purakh apara(n)par poore te jag meh gur govi(n)dh hare ||11||
1014.e: Those beings are pure, perfect unlimited and infinite; in this world, they are the embodiment of the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||11||

1014.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ॥
1014.t: har simarahu gur bachan samaarahu sa(n)gat har jan bhaau kare ||
1014.e: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord; meditate and contemplate the Guru's Word, and love to associate with the humble servants of the Lord.

1014.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੨॥੮॥
1014.t: har jan gur paradhaan dhuaarai naanak tin jan kee ren hare ||12||8||
1014.e: The Lord's humble servants are the embodiment of the Guru; they are supreme and respected in the Court of the Lord. Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those humble servants of the Lord. ||12||8||

1014.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1014.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1014.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1014.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
1014.t: maaroo kaafee mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa ||
1014.e: Maaroo, Kaafee, First Mehla, Second House:

1014.g: ਆਵਉ ਵੰਞਉ ਡੁੰਮਣੀ ਕਿਤੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
1014.t: aavau va(n)n(j)au ddu(n)manee kitee mitr kareau ||
1014.e: The double-minded person comes and goes, and has numerous friends.

1014.g: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਵਾਢੀ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੇਉ ॥੧॥
1014.t: saa dhan ddoiee na lahai vaaddee kiau dheereau ||1||
1014.e: The soul-bride is separated from her Lord, and she has no place of rest; how can she be comforted? ||1||

1014.g: ਮੈਡਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪਿਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1014.t: maiddaa man rataa aapanaRe pir naal ||
1014.e: My mind is attuned to the Love of my Husband Lord.

1014.g: ਹਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਕੀਤੀ ਹਿਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1014.t: hau ghol ghumaiee kha(n)neeaai keetee hik bhoree nadhar nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
1014.e: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to the Lord; if only He would bless me with His Glance of Grace, even for an instant! ||1||Pause||

1014.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
1014.t: peieeaRai ddohaaganee saahuraRai kiau jaau ||
1014.e: I am a rejected bride, abandoned in my parents' home; how can I go to my in-laws now?

1014.g: ਮੈ ਗਲਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਾਉ ॥੨॥
1014.t: mai gal aaugan muThaRee bin pir jhoor maraau ||2||
1014.e: I wear my faults around my neck; without my Husband Lord, I am grieving, and wasting away to death. ||2||

1014.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
1014.t: peieeaRai pir sa(n)malaa saahuraRai ghar vaas ||
1014.e: But if, in my parents' home, I remember my Husband Lord, then I will come to dwell in the home of my in-laws yet.

1014.g: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵੰਧਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
1014.t: sukh sava(n)dh sohaaganee pir paiaa gunataas ||3||
1014.e: The happy soul-brides sleep in peace; they find their Husband Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||3||

1014.g: ਲੇਫੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪਟ ਕੀ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
1014.t: lef nihaalee paT kee kaapaR a(n)g banai ||
1014.e: Their blankets and mattresses are made of silk, and so are the clothes on their bodies.

1014.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਮੁਤੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਡੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੪॥
1014.t: pir mutee ddohaaganee tin ddukhee rain vihai ||4||
1014.e: The Lord rejects the impure soul-brides. Their life-night passes in misery. ||4||

1015.g: ਕਿਤੀ ਚਖਉ ਸਾਡੜੇ ਕਿਤੀ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
1015.t: kitee chakhau saaddaRe kitee ves kareau ||
1015.e: I have tasted many flavors, and worn many robes,

1015.g: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਗਇਅਮੁ ਵਾਢੀ ਝੂਰੇਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਉ ॥੫॥
1015.t: pir bin joban baadh giam vaaddee jhooredhee jhooreau ||5||
1015.e: but without my Husband Lord, my youth is slipping away uselessly; I am separated from Him, and I cry out in pain. ||5||

1015.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦਾ ਸਦੜਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1015.t: sache sa(n)dhaa sadhaRaa suneeaai gur veechaar ||
1015.e: I have heard the True Lord's message, contemplating the Guru.

1015.g: ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੬॥
1015.t: sache sachaa baihanaa nadharee nadhar piaar ||6||
1015.e: True is the home of the True Lord; by His Gracious Grace, I love Him. ||6||

1015.g: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਡੇਖੈ ਡੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
1015.t: giaanee a(n)jan sach kaa ddekhai ddekhanahaar ||
1015.e: The spiritual teacher applies the ointment of Truth to his eyes, and sees God, the Seer.

1015.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
1015.t: gurmukh boojhai jaaneeaai haumai garab nivaar ||7||
1015.e: The Gurmukh comes to know and understand; ego and pride are subdued. ||7||

1015.g: ਤਉ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਤਉ ਜੇਹੀਆ ਮੂ ਜੇਹੀਆ ਕਿਤੀਆਹ ॥
1015.t: tau bhaavan tau jeheeaa moo jeheeaa kiteeaaeh ||
1015.e: O Lord, You are pleased with those who are like Yourself; there are many more like me.

1015.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੈ ਰਤੜੀਆਹ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
1015.t: naanak naahu na veechhuRai tin sachai rataReeaaeh ||8||1||9||
1015.e: O Nanak, the Husband does not separate from those who are imbued with Truth. ||8||1||9||

1015.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1015.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1015.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

1015.g: ਨਾ ਭੈਣਾ ਭਰਜਾਈਆ ਨਾ ਸੇ ਸਸੁੜੀਆਹ ॥
1015.t: naa bhainaa bharajaieeaa naa se sasuReeaaeh ||
1015.e: Neither the sisters, nor the sisters-in-law, nor the mothers-in-law, shall remain.

1015.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਕੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਹੀਆਹ ॥੧॥
1015.t: sachaa saak na tuTiee gur mele saheeaaeh ||1||
1015.e: The true relationship with the Lord cannot be broken; it was established by the Lord, O sister soul-brides. ||1||

1015.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
1015.t: balihaaree gur aapane sadh balihaarai jaau ||
1015.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.

1015.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਤਾ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਮੁ ਦਿਤਮੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1015.t: gur bin etaa bhav thakee gur pir melim dhitam milai ||1|| rahaau ||
1015.e: Wandering so far without the Guru, I grew weary; now, the Guru has united me in Union with my Husband Lord. ||1||Pause||

1015.g: ਫੁਫੀ ਨਾਨੀ ਮਾਸੀਆ ਦੇਰ ਜੇਠਾਨੜੀਆਹ ॥
1015.t: fufee naanee maaseeaa dher jeThaanaReeaaeh ||
1015.e: Aunts, uncles, grandparents and sisters-in-law

1015.g: ਆਵਨਿ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਨਾ ਰਹਨਿ ਪੂਰ ਭਰੇ ਪਹੀਆਹ ॥੨॥
1015.t: aavan va(n)n(j)n naa rahan poor bhare paheeaaeh ||2||
1015.e: - they all come and go; they cannot remain. They are like boatloads of passengers embarking. ||2||

1015.g: ਮਾਮੇ ਤੈ ਮਾਮਾਣੀਆ ਭਾਇਰ ਬਾਪ ਨ ਮਾਉ ॥
1015.t: maame tai maamaaneeaa bhair baap na maau ||
1015.e: Uncles, aunts, and cousins of all sorts, cannot remain.

1015.g: ਸਾਥ ਲਡੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਠੀਆ ਭੀੜ ਘਣੀ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥੩॥
1015.t: saath ladde tin naaTheeaa bheeR ghanee dhareeaau ||3||
1015.e: The caravans are full, and great crowds of them are loading up at the riverbank. ||3||

1015.g: ਸਾਚਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੋ ਸਖੀ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
1015.t: saachau ra(n)g ra(n)gaavalo sakhee hamaaro ka(n)t ||
1015.e: O sister-friends, my Husband Lord is dyed in the color of Truth.

1015.g: ਸਚਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੰਤੁ ॥੪॥
1015.t: sach vichhoRaa naa theeaai so sahu ra(n)g rava(n)t ||4||
1015.e: She who lovingly remembers her True Husband Lord is not separated from Him again. ||4||

1015.g: ਸਭੇ ਰੁਤੀ ਚੰਗੀਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
1015.t: sabhe rutee cha(n)geeaa jit sache siau neh ||
1015.e: All the seasons are good, in which the soul-bride falls in love with the True Lord.

1015.g: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਨਿਸਿ ਡੇਹੁ ॥੫॥
1015.t: saa dhan ka(n)t pachhaaniaa sukh sutee nis ddeh ||5||
1015.e: That soul-bride, who knows her Husband Lord, sleeps in peace, night and day. ||5||

1015.g: ਪਤਣਿ ਕੂਕੇ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਵੰਞਹੁ ਧ੍ਰੁਕਿ ਵਿਲਾੜਿ ॥
1015.t: patan kooke paatanee va(n)n(j)h dhruk vilaaR ||
1015.e: At the ferry, the ferryman announces, ""O travellers, hurry up and cross over.""

1015.g: ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੰਦੜੇ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਚਾੜਿ ॥੬॥
1015.t: paar pava(n)dhaRe ddiTh mai satigur bohith chaaR ||6||
1015.e: I have seen them crossing over there, on the boat of the True Guru. ||6||

1015.g: ਹਿਕਨੀ ਲਦਿਆ ਹਿਕਿ ਲਦਿ ਗਏ ਹਿਕਿ ਭਾਰੇ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1015.t: hikanee ladhiaa hik ladh ge hik bhaare bhar naal ||
1015.e: Some are getting on board, and some have already set out; some are weighed down with their loads.

1015.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
1015.t: jinee sach vana(n)jiaa se sache prabh naal ||7||
1015.e: Those who deal in Truth, remain with their True Lord God. ||7||

1015.g: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਚੰਗੇ ਆਖੀਅਹ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
1015.t: naa ham cha(n)ge aakhe'eeh buraa na dhisai koi ||
1015.e: I am not called good, and I see none who are bad.

1015.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਜੇਹੜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੦॥
1015.t: naanak haumai maareeaai sache jehaRaa soi ||8||2||10||
1015.e: O Nanak, one who conquers and subdues his ego, becomes just like the True Lord. ||8||2||10||

1015.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1015.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1015.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

1015.g: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
1015.t: naa jaanaa moorakh hai koiee naa jaanaa siaanaa ||
1015.e: I do not believe that anyone is foolish; I do not believe that anyone is clever.

1015.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
1015.t: sadhaa saahib kai ra(n)ge raataa anadhin naam vakhaanaa ||1||
1015.e: Imbued forever with the Love of my Lord and Master, I chant His Name, night and day. ||1||

1015.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਾ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
1015.t: baabaa moorakh haa naavai bal jaau ||
1015.e: O Baba, I am so foolish, but I am a sacrifice to the Name.

1015.g: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1015.t: too karataa too dhaanaa beenaa terai naam taraau ||1|| rahaau ||
1015.e: You are the Creator, You are wise and all-seeing. Through Your Name, we are carried across. ||1||Pause||

1015.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਉ ॥
1015.t: moorakh siaanaa ek hai ek jot dhui naau ||
1015.e: The same person is foolish and wise; the same light within has two names.

1015.g: ਮੂਰਖਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
1015.t: moorakhaa sir moorakh hai j ma(n)ne naahee naau ||2||
1015.e: The most foolish of the foolish are those who do not believe in the Name. ||2||

1015.g: ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
1015.t: gur dhuaarai naau paieeaai bin satigur palai na pai ||
1015.e: Through the Guru's Gate, the Gurdwara, the Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, it is not received.

1015.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
1015.t: satigur kai bhaanai man vasai taa ahinis rahai liv lai ||3||
1015.e: Through the Pleasure of the True Guru's Will, the Name comes to dwell in the mind, and then, night and day, one remains lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||3||

1015.g: ਰਾਜੰ ਰੰਗੰ ਰੂਪੰ ਮਾਲੰ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇ ਜੂਆਰੀ ॥
1015.t: raaja(n) ra(n)ga(n) roopa(n) maala(n) joban te jooaaree ||
1015.e: In power, pleasures, beauty, wealth and youth, one gambles his life away.

1015.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਾਧੇ ਪਾਸੈ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਏਕਾ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
1015.t: hukamee baadhe paasai kheleh chaupaR ekaa saaree ||4||
1015.e: Bound by the Hukam of God's Command, the dice are thrown; he is just a piece in the game of chess. ||4||

1015.g: ਜਗਿ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
1015.t: jag chatur siaanaa bharam bhulaanaa naau pa(n)ddit paReh gaavaaree ||
1015.e: The world is clever and wise, but it is deluded by doubt, and forgets the Name; the Pandit, the religious scholar, studies the scriptures, but he is still a fool.

1015.g: ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
1015.t: naau visaareh bedh samaaleh bikh bhoole lekhaaree ||5||
1015.e: Forgetting the Name, he dwells upon the Vedas; he writes, but he is confused by his poisonous corruption. ||5||

1016.g: ਕਲਰ ਖੇਤੀ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੰਠੇ ਬਾਗਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਕਜਲੁ ਝਰੈ ॥
1016.t: kalar khetee taravar ka(n)The baagaa pahireh kajal jharai ||
1016.e: He is like the crop planted in the salty soil, or the tree growing on the river bank, or the white clothes sprinkled with dirt.

1016.g: ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਕੋਠੀ ਜੋ ਪੈਸੈ ਸੋ ਗਰਬਿ ਜਰੈ ॥੬॥
1016.t: eh sa(n)saar tisai kee koThee jo paisai so garab jarai ||6||
1016.e: This world is the house of desire; whoever enters it, is burnt down by egotistical pride. ||6||

1016.g: ਰਯਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਕਹਾ ਸਬਾਏ ਦੁਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
1016.t: rayat raaje kahaa sabaae dhuh a(n)tar so jaasee ||
1016.e: Where are all the kings and their subjects? Those who are immersed in duality are destroyed.

1016.g: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਰਹਸੀ ਅਲਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥੭॥੩॥੧੧॥
1016.t: kahat naanak gur sache kee pauRee rahasee alakh nivaasee ||7||3||11||
1016.e: Says Nanak, these are the steps of the ladder, of the Teachings of the True Guru; only the Unseen Lord shall remain. ||7||3||11||

1016.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ghar panjavaa asaTapadhee
1016.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla, Fifth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
One whose mind is filled with the Lord's Love,
is intuitively exalted by the True Word of the Shabad.

1016.g: ਏਹਾ ਵੇਦਨ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
1016.t: ehaa vedhan soiee jaanai avar k jaanai kaaree jeeau ||1||
1016.e: He alone knows the pain of this love; what does anyone else know about its cure? ||1||
He Himself unites in His Union.
He Himself inspires us with His Love.

1016.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1016.t: prem kee saar soiee jaanai jis no nadhar tumaaree jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
1016.e: He alone appreciates the value of Your Love, upon whom You shower Your Grace, O Lord. ||1||Pause||
One whose spiritual vision is awakened - his doubt is driven out.
By Guru's Grace, he obtains the supreme status.

1016.g: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
1016.t: so jogee ieh jugat pachhaanai gur kai sabadh beechaaree jeeau ||2||
1016.e: He alone is a Yogi, who understands this way, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
By good destiny, the soul-bride is united with her Husband Lord.
Following the Guru's Teachings, she eradicates her evil-mindedness from within.

1016.g: ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
1016.t: ra(n)g siau nit raleeaa maanai apane ka(n)t piaaree jeeau ||3||
1016.e: With love, she continually enjoys pleasure with Him; she becomes the beloved of her Husband Lord. ||3||
Other than the True Guru, there is no physician.
He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.

1016.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਰੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
1016.t: satigur miliaai marai ma(n)dhaa hovai giaan beechaaree jeeau ||4||
1016.e: Meeting with the True Guru, evil is conquered, and spiritual wisdom is contemplated. ||4||

1016.g: ਏਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ॥
1016.t: eh sabadh saar jis no laae ||
1016.e: One who is committed to this most sublime Shabad
becomes Gurmukh, and is rid of thirst and hunger.

1016.g: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
1016.t: aapan leeaa kichhoo na paieeaai kar kirapaa kal dhaaree jeeau ||5||
1016.e: By one's own efforts, nothing can be accomplished; the Lord, in His Mercy, bestows power. ||5||
The True Guru has revealed the essence of the Shaastras and the Vedas.
In His Mercy, He has come into the home of my self.

1016.g: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
1016.t: a(n)jan maeh nira(n)jan jaataa jin kau nadhar tumaaree jeeau ||6||
1016.e: In the midst of Maya, the Immaculate Lord is known, by those upon whom You bestow Your Grace. ||6||
One who becomes Gurmukh, obtains the essence of reality;
he eradictes his self-conceit from within.

1016.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਧੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
1016.t: satigur baajhahu sabh dha(n)dh kamaavai vekhahu man veechaaree jeeau ||7||
1016.e: Without the True Guru, all are entangled in worldly affairs; consider this in your mind, and see. ||7||
Some are deluded by doubt; they strut around egotistically.
Some, as Gurmukh, subdue their egotism.

1016.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
1016.t: sachai sabadh rate bairaagee hor bharam bhule gaavaaree jeeau ||8||
1016.e: Attuned to the True Word of the Shabad, they remain detached from the world. The other ignorant fools wander, confused and deluded by doubt. ||8||
Those who have not become Gurmukh, and who have not found the Naam, the Name of the Lord
those self-willed manmukhs waste their lives uselessly.

1016.g: ਅਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
1016.t: agai vin naavai ko belee naahee boojhai gur beechaaree jeeau ||9||
1016.e: In the world hereafter, nothing except the Name will be of any assistance; this is understood by contemplating the Guru. ||9||
The Ambrosial Naam is the Giver of peace forever.
Throughout the four ages, it is known through the Perfect Guru.

1016.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
1016.t: jis too dheveh soiee paae naanak tat beechaaree jeeau ||10||1||
1016.e: He alone receives it, unto whom You bestow it; this is the essence of reality which Nanak has realized. ||10||1||

1017.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
1017.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa asaTapadheeaa
1017.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Third House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

1017.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1017.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1017.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1017.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਬ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
1017.t: lakh chauraaseeh bhramate bhramate dhulabh janam ab paio ||1||
1017.e: Wandering and roaming through 8.4 million incarnations, you have now been given this human life, so difficult to obtain. ||1||

1017.g: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਤੂ ਹੋਛੈ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥
1017.t: re mooRe too hochhai ras lapaTaio ||
1017.e: You fool! You are attached and clinging to such trivial pleasures!

1017.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1017.t: a(n)mrit sa(n)g basat hai terai bikhiaa siau urajhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
1017.e: The Ambrosial Nectar abides with you, but you are engrossed in sin and corruption. ||1||Pause||

1017.g: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਬਨਜਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਕਾਲਰੁ ਲਾਦਿ ਚਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
1017.t: ratan javehar banajan aaio kaalar laadh chalaio ||2||
1017.e: You have come to trade in gems and jewels, but you have loaded only barren soil. ||2||

1017.g: ਜਿਹ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਹਨਾ ਬਸਨਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥
1017.t: jeh ghar meh tudh rahanaa basanaa so ghar cheet na aaio ||3||
1017.e: That home within which you live - you have not kept that home in your thoughts. ||3||

1017.g: ਅਟਲ ਅਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
1017.t: aTal akha(n)dd praan sukhadhaiee ik nimakh nahee tujh gaio ||4||
1017.e: He is immovable, indestructible, the Giver of peace to the soul; and yet you do not sing His Praises, even for an instant. ||4||

1017.g: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
1017.t: jahaa jaanaa so thaan visaario ik nimakh nahee man laio ||5||
1017.e: You have forgotten that place where you must go; you have not attached your mind to the Lord, even for an instant. ||5||

1017.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥੬॥
1017.t: putr kalatr gireh dhekh samagree is hee meh urajhaio ||6||
1017.e: Gazing upon your children, spouse, household and paraphernalia, you are entangled in them. ||6||

1017.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਓ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
1017.t: jit ko laio tit hee laagaa taise karam kamaio ||7||
1017.e: As God links the mortals, so are they linked, and so are the deeds they do. ||7||

1017.g: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥੮॥੧॥
1017.t: jau bhio kirapaal taa saadhasa(n)g paiaa jan naanak braham dhiaaio ||8||1||
1017.e: When He becomes Merciful, then the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is found; servant Nanak meditates on God. ||8||1||

1017.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1017.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1017.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1017.g: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
1017.t: kar anugrahu raakh leeno bhio saadhoo sa(n)g ||
1017.e: Granting His Grace, He has protected me; I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

1017.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਾਰੈ ਮਿਸਟ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
1017.t: har naam ras rasanaa uchaarai misaT gooRaa ra(n)g ||1||
1017.e: My tongue lovingly chants the Lord's Name; this love is so sweet and intense! ||1||

1017.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਨ ਕੋ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
1017.t: mere maan ko asathaan ||
1017.e: He is the place of rest for my mind,

1017.g: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1017.t: meet saajan sakhaa ba(n)dhap a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
1017.e: my friend, companion, associate and relative; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||

1017.g: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ॥
1017.t: sa(n)saar saagar jin upaio saran prabh kee gahee ||
1017.e: He created the world-ocean; I seek the Sanctuary of that God.

1017.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥੨॥
1017.t: gur prasaadhee prabh araadhe jamaka(n)kar kichh na kahee ||2||
1017.e: By Guru's Grace, I worship and adore God; the Messenger of Death can't say anything to me. ||2||

1017.g: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦਾ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
1017.t: mokh mukat dhuaar jaa kai sa(n)t ridhaa bha(n)ddaar ||
1017.e: Emancipation and liberation are at His Door; He is the treasure in the hearts of the Saints.

1017.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
1017.t: jeea jugat sujaan suaamee sadhaa raakhanahaar ||3||
1017.e: The all-knowing Lord and Master shows us the true way of life; He is our Savior and Protector forever. ||3||

1017.g: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਕਲੇਸ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1017.t: dhookh dharadh kales binaseh jis basai man maeh ||
1017.e: Pain, suffering and troubles are eradicated, when the Lord abides in the mind.

1017.g: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨਰਕੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
1017.t: mrit narak asathaan bikhaRe bikh na pohai taeh ||4||
1017.e: Death, hell and the most horrible dwelling of sin and corruption cannot even touch such a person. ||4||

1017.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਹ ॥
1017.t: ridh sidh nav nidh jaa kai a(n)mritaa paravaeh ||
1017.e: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures come from the Lord, as do the streams of Ambrosial Nectar.

1017.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹ ॥੫॥
1017.t: aadh a(n)te madh pooran uooch agam agaeh ||5||
1017.e: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is perfect, lofty, unapproachable and unfathomable. ||5||

1017.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਬੇਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਚਾਰੁ ॥
1017.t: sidh saadhik dhev mun jan bedh kareh uchaar ||
1017.e: The Siddhas, seekers, angelic beings, silent sages, and the Vedas speak of Him.

1017.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਭੁੰਚਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
1017.t: simar suaamee sukh sahaj bhu(n)cheh nahee a(n)t paaraavaar ||6||
1017.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, celestial peace is enjoyed; He has no end or limitation. ||6||

1017.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
1017.t: anik praachhat miTeh khin meh ridhai jap bhagavaan ||
1017.e: Countless sins are erased in an instant, meditating on the Benevolent Lord within the heart.

1017.g: ਪਾਵਨਾ ਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥੭॥
1017.t: paavanaa te mahaa paavan koT dhaan isanaan ||7||
1017.e: Such a person becomes the purest of the pure, and is blessed with the merits of millions of donations to charity and cleansing baths. ||7||

1017.g: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਰਾਣ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
1017.t: bal budh sudh paraan sarabas sa(n)tanaa kee raas ||
1017.e: God is power, intellect, understanding, the breath of life, wealth, and everything for the Saints.

1017.g: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
1017.t: bisar naahee nimakh man te naanak kee aradhaas ||8||2||
1017.e: May I never forget Him from my mind, even for an instant - this is Nanak's prayer. ||8||2||

1017.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1017.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1017.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1017.g: ਸਸਤ੍ਰਿ ਤੀਖਣਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
1017.t: sasatr teekhan kaaT ddaario man na keeno ros ||
1017.e: The sharp tool cuts down the tree, but it does not feel anger in its mind.

1017.g: ਕਾਜੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਲੇ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਦੀਨੋ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੧॥
1017.t: kaaj uaa ko le savaario til na dheeno dhos ||1||
1017.e: It serves the purpose of the cutter, and does not blame him at all. ||1||

1017.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
1017.t: man mere raam rau nit neet ||
1017.e: O my mind, continually, continuously, meditate on the Lord.

1017.g: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1017.t: dhiaal dhev kirapaal gobi(n)dh sun sa(n)tanaa kee reet ||1|| rahaau ||
1017.e: The Lord of the Universe is merciful, divine and compassionate. Listen - this is the way of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

1018.g: ਚਰਣ ਤਲੈ ਉਗਾਹਿ ਬੈਸਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
1018.t: charan talai ugaeh baisio sram na rahio sareer ||
1018.e: He plants his feet in the boat, and then sits down in it; the fatigue of his body is relieved.

1018.g: ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਖਿਨਹਿ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਤੀਰਿ ॥੨॥
1018.t: mahaa saagar neh viaapai khineh utario teer ||2||
1018.e: The great ocean does not even affect him; in an instant, he arrives on the other shore. ||2||

1018.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਅਗਰ ਕਪੂਰ ਲੇਪਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
1018.t: cha(n)dhan agar kapoor lepan tis sa(n)ge nahee preet ||
1018.e: Sandalwood, aloe, and camphor-paste - the earth does not love them.

1018.g: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਖੋਦਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਮਨੀ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
1018.t: bisaTaa mootr khodh til til man na manee bipareet ||3||
1018.e: But it doesn't mind, if someone digs it up bit by bit, and applies manure and urine to it. ||3||

1018.g: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਲਗਨ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥
1018.t: uooch neech bikaar sukirat sa(n)lagan sabh sukh chhatr ||
1018.e: High and low, bad and good - the comforting canopy of the sky stretches evenly over all.

1018.g: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਸਮਤ ॥੪॥
1018.t: mitr satr na kachhoo jaanai sarab jeea samat ||4||
1018.e: It knows nothing of friend and enemy; all beings are alike to it. ||4||

1018.g: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
1018.t: kar pragaas pracha(n)dd pragaTio a(n)dhakaar binaas ||
1018.e: Blazing with its dazzling light, the sun rises, and dispels the darkness.

1018.g: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਹ ਕਿਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਭਇਓ ਬਿਖਾਦੁ ॥੫॥
1018.t: pavitr apavitreh kiran laage man na bhio bikhaadh ||5||
1018.e: Touching both the pure and the impure, it harbors no hatred to any. ||5||

1018.g: ਸੀਤ ਮੰਦ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
1018.t: seet ma(n)dh suga(n)dh chalio sarab thaan samaan ||
1018.e: The cool and fragrant wind gently blows upon all places alike.

1018.g: ਜਹਾ ਸਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਹਾ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਕਾ ਮਾਨ ॥੬॥
1018.t: jahaa saa kichh tahaa laagio til na sa(n)kaa maan ||6||
1018.e: Wherever anything is, it touches it there, and does not hesitate a bit. ||6||

1018.g: ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਭਾਇ ਜੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੀਤੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
1018.t: subhai abhai ju nikaT aavai seet taa kaa jai ||
1018.e: Good or bad, whoever comes close to the fire - his cold is taken away.

1018.g: ਆਪ ਪਰ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
1018.t: aap par kaa kachh na jaanai sadhaa sahaj subhai ||7||
1018.e: It knows nothing of its own or others'; it is constant in the same quality. ||7||

1018.g: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਸਨਾਥ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਲਾਲ ॥
1018.t: charan saran sanaath ih man ra(n)g raate laal ||
1018.e: Whoever seeks the Sancuary of the feet of the Sublime Lord - his mind is attuned to the Love of the Beloved.

1018.g: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੮॥੩॥
1018.t: gopaal gun nit gaau naanak bhe prabh kirapaal ||8||3||
1018.e: Constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, O Nanak, God becomes merciful to us. ||8||3||

1018.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
1018.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa asaTapadheeaa
1018.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

1018.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1018.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1018.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1018.g: ਚਾਦਨਾ ਚਾਦਨੁ ਆਂਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਦਨਾ ॥੧॥
1018.t: chaadhanaa chaadhan aa(n)gan prabh jeeau a(n)tar chaadhanaa ||1||
1018.e: Moonlight, moonlight - in the courtyard of the mind, let the moonlight of God shine down. ||1||

1018.g: ਆਰਾਧਨਾ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਨਾ ॥੨॥
1018.t: aaraadhanaa araadhan neekaa har har naam araadhanaa ||2||
1018.e: Meditation, meditation - sublime is meditation on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

1018.g: ਤਿਆਗਨਾ ਤਿਆਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
1018.t: tiaaganaa tiaagan neekaa kaam karodh lobh tiaaganaa ||3||
1018.e: Renunciation, renunciation - noble is the renunciation of sexual desire, anger and greed. ||3||

1018.g: ਮਾਗਨਾ ਮਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
1018.t: maaganaa maagan neekaa har jas gur te maaganaa ||4||
1018.e: Begging, begging - it is noble to beg for the Lord's Praise from the Guru. ||4||

1018.g: ਜਾਗਨਾ ਜਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਗਨਾ ॥੫॥
1018.t: jaaganaa jaagan neekaa har keeratan meh jaaganaa ||5||
1018.e: Vigils, vigils - sublime is the vigil spent singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||5||

1018.g: ਲਾਗਨਾ ਲਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਨਾ ॥੬॥
1018.t: laaganaa laagan neekaa gur charanee man laaganaa ||6||
1018.e: Attachment, attachment - sublime is the attachment of the mind to the Guru's Feet. ||6||

1018.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਨਾ ॥੭॥
1018.t: eeh bidh tiseh paraapate jaa kai masatak bhaaganaa ||7||
1018.e: He alone is blessed with this way of life, upon whose forehead such destiny is recorded. ||7||

1018.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਗਨਾ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
1018.t: kahu naanak tis sabh kichh neekaa jo prabh kee saranaaganaa ||8||1||4||
1018.e: Says Nanak, everything is sublime and noble, for one who enters the Sanctuary of God. ||8||1||4||

1018.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1018.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1018.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1018.g: ਆਉ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਆਉ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1018.t: aau jee too aau hamaarai har jas sravan sunaavanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1018.e: Please come, O please come into the home of my heart, that I may hear with my ears the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||

1018.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਵਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
1018.t: tudh aavat meraa man tan hariaa har jas tum sa(n)g gaavanaa ||1||
1018.e: With your coming, my soul and body are rejuvenated, and I sing with you the Lord's Praises. ||1||

1018.g: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਵਨਾ ॥੨॥
1018.t: sa(n)t kirapaa te hiradhai vaasai dhoojaa bhaau miTaavanaa ||2||
1018.e: By the Grace of the Saint, the Lord dwells within the heart, and the love of duality is eradicated. ||2||

1018.g: ਭਗਤ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਖ ਤਜਾਵਨਾ ॥੩॥
1018.t: bhagat dhiaa te budh paragaasai dhuramat dhookh tajaavanaa ||3||
1018.e: By the kindness of the devotee, the intellect is enlightened, and pain and evil-mindedness are eradicated. ||3||

1018.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਨਾ ॥੪॥
1018.t: dharasan bheTat hot puneetaa punarap garabh na paavanaa ||4||
1018.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is sanctified, and is no longer consigned to the womb of reincarnation. ||4||

1018.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨਾ ॥੫॥
1018.t: nau nidh ridh sidh paiee jo tumarai man bhaavanaa ||5||
1018.e: The nine treasures, wealth and miraculous spiritual powers are obtained, by one who is pleasing to Your mind. ||5||

1018.g: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਜਾਵਨਾ ॥੬॥
1018.t: sa(n)t binaa mai thaau na koiee avar na soojhai jaavanaa ||6||
1018.e: Without the Saint, I have no place of rest at all; I cannot think of any other place to go. ||6||

1018.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਨਾ ॥੭॥
1018.t: moh niragun kau koi na raakhai sa(n)taa sa(n)g samaavanaa ||7||
1018.e: I am unworthy; no one gives me sanctuary. But in the Society of the Saints, I merge in God. ||7||

1018.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵਨਾ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
1018.t: kahu naanak gur chalat dhikhaiaa man madhe har har raavanaa ||8||2||5||
1018.e: Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed this miracle; within my mind, I enjoy the Lord, Har, Har. ||8||2||5||

1019.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1019.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1019.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1019.g: ਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1019.t: jeevanaa safal jeevan sun har jap jap sadh jeevanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1019.e: Fruitful is the life, the life of one who hears about the Lord, and chants and meditates on Him; he lives forever. ||1||Pause||

1019.g: ਪੀਵਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਘਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
1019.t: peevanaa jit man aaghaavai naam a(n)mirat ras peevanaa ||1||
1019.e: The real drink is that which satisfies the mind; this drink is the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||

1019.g: ਖਾਵਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਵਨਾ ॥੨॥
1019.t: khaavanaa jit bhookh na laagai sa(n)tokh sadhaa tirapateevanaa ||2||
1019.e: The real food is that which will never leave you hungry again; it will leave you contented and satisfied forever. ||2||

1019.g: ਪੈਨਣਾ ਰਖੁ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਗੇ ਨਹੀ ਥੀਵਨਾ ॥੩॥
1019.t: painanaa rakh pat paramesur fir naage nahee theevanaa ||3||
1019.e: The real clothes are those which protect your honor before the Transcendent Lord, and do not leave you naked ever again. ||3||

1019.g: ਭੋਗਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਲੀਵਨਾ ॥੪॥
1019.t: bhoganaa man madhe har ras sa(n)tasa(n)gat meh leevanaa ||4||
1019.e: The real enjoyment within the mind is to be absorbed in the sublime essence of the Lord, in the Society of the Saints. ||4||

1019.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੂਈ ਆਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੀਵਨਾ ॥੫॥
1019.t: bin taage bin sooiee aanee man har bhagatee sa(n)g seevanaa ||5||
1019.e: Sew devotional worship to the Lord into the mind, without any needle or thread. ||5||

1019.g: ਮਾਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਅਉਖੀਵਨਾ ॥੬॥
1019.t: maatiaa har ras meh raate tis bahuR na kabahoo aaukheevanaa ||6||
1019.e: Imbued and intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, this experience will never wear off again. ||6||

1019.g: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੀਵਨਾ ॥੭॥
1019.t: milio tis sarab nidhaanaa prabh kirapaal jis dheevanaa ||7||
1019.e: One is blessed with all treasures, when God, in His Mercy, gives them. ||7||

1019.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਣ ਸੰਤ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਨਾ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
1019.t: sukh naanak sa(n)tan kee sevaa charan sa(n)t dhoi peevanaa ||8||3||6||
1019.e: O Nanak, service to the Saints beings peace; I drink in the wash water of the feet of the Saints. ||8||3||6||

1019.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਅੰਜੁਲੀਆ
1019.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar atthvaa a(n)juleeaa
1019.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Eighth House, Anjulees ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer:

1019.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1019.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1019.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1019.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
1019.t: jis gireh bahut tisai gireh chi(n)taa ||
1019.e: The household which is filled with abundance - that household suffers anxiety.

1019.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਸੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਾ ॥
1019.t: jis gireh thoree su firai bhrama(n)taa ||
1019.e: One whose household has little, wanders around searching for more.

1019.g: ਦੁਹੂ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਭਾਲੀਐ ॥੧॥
1019.t: dhuhoo bivasathaa te jo mukataa soiee suhelaa bhaaleeaai ||1||
1019.e: He alone is happy and at peace, who is liberated from both conditions. ||1||

1019.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਨਰਕੁ ਉਦਾਸ ਕਰੋਧਾ ॥
1019.t: gireh raaj meh narak udhaas karodhaa ||
1019.e: Householders and kings fall into hell, along with renunciates and angry men,

1019.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਧਾ ॥
1019.t: bahu bidh bedh paaTh sabh sodhaa ||
1019.e: and all those who study and recite the Vedas in so many ways.

1019.g: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ਅਲਿਪਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥੨॥
1019.t: dhehee meh jo rahai alipataa tis jan kee pooran ghaaleeaai ||2||
1019.e: Perfect is the work of that humble servant, who remains unattached while in the body. ||2||

1019.g: ਜਾਗਤ ਸੂਤਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
1019.t: jaagat sootaa bharam vigootaa ||
1019.e: The mortal sleeps, even while he is awake; he is being plundered by doubt.

1019.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
1019.t: bin gur mukat na hoieeaai meetaa ||
1019.e: Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained, friend.

1019.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਹਉ ਬੰਧਨ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
1019.t: saadhasa(n)g tuTeh hau ba(n)dhan eko ek nihaaleeaai ||3||
1019.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the bonds of egotism are released, and one comes to behold the One and only Lord. ||3||

1019.g: ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਤ ਬੰਧਾ ਨਹ ਕਰੈ ਤ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
1019.t: karam karai ta ba(n)dhaa neh karai ta ni(n)dhaa ||
1019.e: Doing deeds, one is placed in bondage; but if he does not act, he is slandered.

1019.g: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
1019.t: moh magan man viaapiaa chi(n)dhaa ||
1019.e: Intoxicated with emotional attachment, the mind is afflicted with anxiety.

1019.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਜਾਣੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਿਆਲੀਐ ॥੪॥
1019.t: gur prasaadh sukh dhukh sam jaanai ghaT ghaT raam hiaaleeaai ||4||
1019.e: One who looks alike upon pleasure and pain, by Guru's Grace, sees the Lord in each and every heart. ||4||

1019.g: ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
1019.t: sa(n)saarai meh sahasaa biaapai ||
1019.e: Within the world, one is afflicted by skepticism;

1019.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
1019.t: akath kathaa agochar nahee jaapai ||
1019.e: he does not know the imperceptible Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

1019.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਓਹੁ ਬਾਲਕ ਵਾਗੀ ਪਾਲੀਐ ॥੫॥
1019.t: jiseh bujhaae soiee boojhai oh baalak vaagee paaleeaai ||5||
1019.e: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. The Lord cherishes him as His child. ||5||

1019.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਬਹੈ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1019.t: chhodd bahai tau chhooTai naahee ||
1019.e: He may try to abandon Maya, but he is not released.

1019.g: ਜਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਤਉ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
1019.t: jau sa(n)chai tau bhau man maahee ||
1019.e: If he collects things, then his mind is afraid of losing them.

1019.g: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਉਰੁ ਢਾਲੀਐ ॥੬॥
1019.t: eis hee meh jis kee pat raakhai tis saadhoo chaur ddaaleeaai ||6||
1019.e: I wave the fly-brush over that holy person, whose honor is protected in the midst of Maya. ||6||

1019.g: ਜੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
1019.t: jo sooraa tis hee hoi maranaa ||
1019.e: He alone is a warrior hero, who remains dead to the world.

1019.g: ਜੋ ਭਾਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਣਾ ॥
1019.t: jo bhaagai tis jonee firanaa ||
1019.e: One who runs away will wander in reincarnation.

1019.g: ਜੋ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਲੀਐ ॥੭॥
1019.t: jo varataae soiee bhal maanai bujh hukamai dhuramat jaaleeaai ||7||
1019.e: Whatever happens, accept that as good. Realize the Hukam of His Command, and your evil-mindedness will be burnt away. ||7||

1019.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
1019.t: jit jit laaveh tit tit laganaa ||
1019.e: Whatever He links us to, to that we are linked.

1019.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਜਚਨਾ ॥
1019.t: kar kar vekhai apane jachanaa ||
1019.e: He acts, and does, and watches over His Creation.

1019.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥੮॥੧॥੭॥
1019.t: naanak ke pooran sukhadhaate too dheh ta naam samaaleeaai ||8||1||7||
1019.e: You are the Giver of peace, the Perfect Lord of Nanak; as You grant Your blessings, I dwell upon Your Name. ||8||1||7||

1019.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1019.t: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
1019.e: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

1019.g: ਬਿਰਖੈ ਹੇਠਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ ਇਕਠੇ ॥
1019.t: birakhai heTh sabh ja(n)t ikaThe ||
1019.e: Beneath the tree, all beings have gathered.

1019.g: ਇਕਿ ਤਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਮਿਠੇ ॥
1019.t: eik tate ik bolan miThe ||
1019.e: Some are hot-headed, and some speak very sweetly.

1019.g: ਅਸਤੁ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਅਉਧ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥
1019.t: asat udhot bhiaa uTh chale jiau jiau aaudh vihaaneeaa ||1||
1019.e: Sunset has come, and they rise up and depart; their days have run their course and expired. ||1||

1019.g: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇਦੜ ਸਰਪਰ ਮੁਠੇ ॥
1019.t: paap karedhaR sarapar muThe ||
1019.e: Those who committed sins are sure to be ruined.

1019.g: ਅਜਰਾਈਲਿ ਫੜੇ ਫੜਿ ਕੁਠੇ ॥
1019.t: ajaraieel faRe faR kuThe ||
1019.e: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, seizes and tortures them.

1020.g: ਦੋਜਕਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥੨॥
1020.t: dhojak paae sirajanahaarai lekhaa ma(n)gai baaneeaa ||2||
1020.e: They are consigned to hell by the Creator Lord, and the Accountant calls them to give their account. ||2||
No brothers or sisters can go with them.
Leaving behind their property, youth and wealth, they march off.

1020.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਤੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਿਲ ਪੀੜੇ ਜਿਉ ਘਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥
1020.t: karan kareem na jaato karataa til peeRe jiau ghaaneeaa ||3||
1020.e: They do not know the kind and compassionate Lord; they shall be crushed like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||3||
You happily, cheerfully steal the possessions of others,
but the Lord God is with you, watching and listening.

1020.g: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਲਬਿ ਪਇਆ ਖਾਤ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਗਲ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੪॥
1020.t: dhuneeaa lab piaa khaat a(n)dhar agalee gal na jaaneeaa ||4||
1020.e: Through worldly greed, you have fallen into the pit; you know nothing of the future. ||4||

1020.g: ਜਮਿ ਜਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ॥
1020.t: jam jam marai marai fir ja(n)mai ||
1020.e: You shall be born and born again, and die and die again, only to be reincarnated again.
You shall suffer terrible punishment, on your way to the land beyond.

1020.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹੈ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ ॥੫॥
1020.t: jin keetaa tisai na jaanee a(n)dhaa taa dhukh sahai paraaneeaa ||5||
1020.e: The mortal does not know the One who created him; he is blind, and so he shall suffer. ||5||
Forgetting the Creator Lord, he is ruined.
The drama of the world is bad; it brings sadness and then happiness.

1020.g: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਵਤੈ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੀਆ ॥੬॥
1020.t: sidhak sabooree sa(n)t na milio vatai aapan bhaaneeaa ||6||
1020.e: One who does not meet the Saint does not have faith or contentment; he wanders just as he pleases. ||6||

1020.g: ਮਉਲਾ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥ ਇਕਿ ਕਢੇ ਇਕਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
1020.t: maulaa khel kare sabh aape || ik kadde ik lahar viaape ||
1020.e: The Lord Himself stages all this drama. Some, he lifts up, and some he throws into the waves.

1020.g: ਜਿਉ ਨਚਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਨਚਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਿਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ॥੭॥
1020.t: jiau nachaae tiau tiau nachan sir sir kirat vihaaneeaa ||7||
1020.e: As He makes them dance, so do they dance. Everyone lives their lives according to their past actions. ||7||
When the Lord and Master grants His Grace, then we meditate on Him.
In the Society of the Saints, one is not consigned to hell.

1020.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੀਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਵਖਾਣੀਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥੨੦॥
1020.t: a(n)mirat naam dhaan naanak kau gun geetaa nit vakhaaneeaa ||8||2||8||12||20||
1020.e: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord; he continually sings the songs of Your Glories. ||8||2||8||12||20||
Maaroo, Solahas, First Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1020.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
1020.t: saachaa sach soiee avar na koiee ||
1020.e: The True Lord is True; there is no other at all.

1020.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
1020.t: jin sirajee tin hee fun goiee ||
1020.e: He who created, shall in the end destroy.

1020.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਕਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1020.t: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu rahanaa tum siau kiaa mukaraiee he ||1||
1020.e: As it pleases You, so You keep me, and so I remain; what excuse could I offer to You? ||1||
You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy.
You yourself link each and every person to their tasks.

1020.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1020.t: aape veechaaree gunakaaree aape maarag laiee he ||2||
1020.e: You contemplate Yourself, You Yourself make us worthy; You Yourself place us on the Path. ||2||
You Yourself are all-wise, You Yourself are all-knowing.
You Yourself created the Universe, and You are pleased.

1020.g: ਆਪੇ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1020.t: aape paun paanee baisa(n)tar aape mel milaiee he ||3||
1020.e: You Yourself are the air, water and fire; You Yourself unite in Union. ||3||
You Yourself are the moon, the sun, the most perfect of the perfect.
You Yourself are spiritual wisdom, meditation, and the Guru, the Warrior Hero.

1020.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1020.t: kaal jaal jam joh na saakai saache siau liv laiee he ||4||
1020.e: The Messenger of Death, and his noose of death, cannot touch one, who is lovingly focused on You, O True Lord. ||4||
You Yourself are the male, and You Yourself are the female.
You Yourself are the chess-board, and You Yourself are the chessman.

1020.g: ਆਪੇ ਪਿੜ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1020.t: aape piR baadhee jag khelai aape keemat paiee he ||5||
1020.e: You Yourself staged the drama in the arena of the world, and You Yourself evaluate the players. ||5||
You Yourself are the bumble bee, the flower, the fruit and the tree.
You Yourself are the water, the desert, the ocean and the pool.

1020.g: ਆਪੇ ਮਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੀਕਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1020.t: aape machh kachh karaneekar teraa roop na lakhanaa jaiee he ||6||
1020.e: You Yourself are the great fish, the tortoise, the Cause of causes; Your form cannot be known. ||6||
You Yourself are the day, and You Yourself are the night.
You Yourself are pleased by the Word of the Guru's Bani.

1020.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1020.t: aadh jugaadh anaahadh anadhin ghaT ghaT sabadh rajaiee he ||7||
1020.e: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the unstruck sound current resounds, night and day; in each and every heart, the Word of the Shabad, echoes Your Will. ||7||
You Yourself are the jewel, incomparably beautiful and priceless.
You Yourself are the Assessor, the Perfect Weigher.

1021.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਸਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਲੈ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1021.t: aape kis hee kas bakhase aape dhe lai bhaiee he ||8||
1021.e: You Yourself test and forgive. You Yourself give and take, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||
He Himself is the bow, and He Himself is the archer.
He Himself is all-wise, beautiful and all-knowing.

1021.g: ਕਹਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸੁਣਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1021.t: kahataa bakataa sunataa soiee aape banat banaiee he ||9||
1021.e: He is the speaker, the orator and the listener. He Himself made what is made. ||9||
Air is the Guru, and water is known to be the father.
The womb of the great mother earth gives birth to all.

1021.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1021.t: rain dhinas dhui dhaiee dhaiaa jag khelai khelaiee he ||10||
1021.e: Night and day are the two nurses, male and female; the world plays in this play. ||10||
You Yourself are the fish, and You Yourself are the net.
You Yourself are the cows, and You yourself are their keeper.

1021.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1021.t: sarab jeeaa jag jot tumaaree jaisee prabh furamaiee he ||11||
1021.e: Your Light fills all the beings of the world; they walk according to Your Command, O God. ||11||
You Yourself are the Yogi, and You Yourself are the enjoyer.
You Yourself are the reveller; You form the supreme Union.

1021.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1021.t: aape vebaanee nira(n)kaaree nirabhau taaRee laiee he ||12||
1021.e: You Yourself are speechless, formless and fearless, absorbed in the primal ecstasy of deep meditation. ||12||
The sources of creation and speech are contained within You, Lord.
All that is seen, is coming and going.

1021.g: ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1021.t: seiee saeh sache vaapaaree satigur boojh bujhaiee he ||13||
1021.e: They are the true bankers and traders, whom the True Guru has inspired to understand. ||13||
The Word of the Shabad is understood through the Perfect True Guru.
The True Lord is overflowing with all powers.

1021.g: ਅਫਰਿਓ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1021.t: afario veparavaahu sadhaa too naa tis til na tamaiee he ||14||
1021.e: You are beyond our grasp, and forever independent. You do not have even an iota of greed. ||14||
Birth and death are meaningless, for those
who enjoy the sublime celestial essence of the Shabad within their minds.

1021.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1021.t: aape mukat tirapat varadhaataa bhagat bhai man bhaiee he ||15||
1021.e: He Himself is the Giver of liberation, satisfaction and blessings, to those devotees who love Him in their minds. ||15||
He Himself is immaculate; by contact with the Guru, spiritual wisdom is obtained.
Whatever is seen, shall merge into You.

1021.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
1021.t: naanak neech bhikhiaa dhar jaachai mai dheejai naam vaddaiee he ||16||1||
1021.e: Nanak, the lowly, begs for charity at Your Door; please, bless him with the glorious greatness of Your Name. ||16||1||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
He Himself is the earth, the mythical bull which supports it and the Akaashic ethers.
The True Lord Himself reveals His Glorious Virtues.

1021.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1021.t: jatee satee sa(n)tokhee aape aape kaar kamaiee he ||1||
1021.e: He Himself is celibate, chaste and contented; He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||1||

1021.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
1021.t: jis karanaa so kar kar vekhai ||
1021.e: He who created the creation, beholds what He has created.
No one can erase the Inscription of the True Lord.

1021.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1021.t: aape kare karaae aape aape dhe vaddiaaiee he ||2||
1021.e: He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes; He Himself is the One who bestows glorious greatness. ||2||
The five thieves cause the fickle consciousness to waver.

1021.g: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਲਹਿ ॥
1021.t: par ghar joheh ghar nahee bhaaleh ||
1021.e: It looks into the homes of others, but does not search its own home.

1021.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਢਹੈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1021.t: kaiaa nagar ddahai ddeh dderee bin sabadhai pat jaiee he ||3||
1021.e: The body-village crumbles into dust; without the Word of the Shabad, one's honor is lost. ||3||
One who realizes the Lord through the Guru, comprehends the three worlds.
He subdues his desires, and struggles with his mind.

1021.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਧ ਹੀ ਜੇਹੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1021.t: jo tudh seveh se tudh hee jehe nirabhau baal sakhaiee he ||4||
1021.e: Those who serve You, become just like You; O Fearless Lord, You are their best friend from infancy. ||4||
You Yourself are the heavenly realms, this world and the nether regions of the underworld.
You Yourself are the embodiment of light, forever young.

1021.g: ਜਟਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1021.t: jaTaa bikaT bikaraal saroopee roop na rekhiaa kaiee he ||5||
1021.e: With matted hair, and a horrible, dreadful form, still, You have no form or feature. ||5||
The Vedas and the Bible do not know the mystery of God.

1021.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
1021.t: naa tis maat pitaa sut bhraataa ||
1021.e: He has no mother, father, child or brother.

1021.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਸੈਲ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਏ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1021.t: sagale sail upai samaae alakh na lakhanaa jaiee he ||6||
1021.e: He created all the mountains, and levels them again; the Unseen Lord cannot be seen. ||6||
I have grown weary of making so many friends.
No one can rid me of my sins and mistakes.

1021.g: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1021.t: sur nar naath saahib sabhanaa sir bhai milai bhau jaiee he ||7||
1021.e: God is the Supreme Lord and Master of all the angels and mortal beings; blessed with His Love, their fear is dispelled. ||7||
He puts back on the Path those who have wandered and strayed.
You Yourself make them stray, and You teach them again.

1021.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1021.t: bin naavai mai avar na dheesai naavahu gat mit paiee he ||8||
1021.e: I cannot see anything except the Name. Through the Name comes salvation and merit. ||8||

1022.e: The Ganges, the Jamunaa where Krishna played, Kaydar Naat'h,
Benares, Kanchivaram, Puri, Dwaarkaa,

1022.g: ਗੰਗਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1022.t: ga(n)gaa saagar benee sa(n)gam aThasaTh a(n)k samaiee he ||9||
1022.e: Ganga Saagar where the Ganges empties into the ocean, Trivaynee where the three rivers come together, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, are all merged in the Lord's Being. ||9||
He Himself is the Siddha, the seeker, in meditative contemplation.
He Himself is the King and the Council.

1022.g: ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਅਦਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1022.t: takhat bahai adhalee prabh aape bharam bhedh bhau jaiee he ||10||
1022.e: God Himself, the wise Judge, sits on the throne; He takes away doubt, duality and fear. ||10||
He Himself is the Qazi; He Himself is the Mullah.
He Himself is infallible; He never makes mistakes.

1022.g: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1022.t: aape mihar dhiaapat dhaataa naa kisai ko bairaiee he ||11||
1022.e: He Himself is the Giver of Grace, compassion and honor; He is no one's enemy. ||11||
Whoever He forgives, He blesses with glorious greatness.
He is the Giver of all; He does not have even an iota of greed.

1022.g: ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1022.t: bharapur dhaar rahiaa nihakeval gupat pragaT sabh Thaiee he ||12||
1022.e: The Immaculate Lord is all pervading, permeating everywhere, both hidden and manifest. ||12||
How can I praise the inaccessible, infinite Lord?
The True Creator Lord is the Enemy of ego.

1022.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1022.t: jis no nadhar kare tis mele mel milai melaiee he ||13||
1022.e: He unites those whom He blesses with His Grace; uniting them in His Union, they are united. ||13||
Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva stand at His Door;
they serve the unseen, infinite Lord.

1022.g: ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1022.t: hor ketee dhar dheesai bilalaadhee mai ganat na aavai kaiee he ||14||
1022.e: Millions of others can be seen crying at His door; I cannot even estimate their numbers. ||14||
True is the Kirtan of His Praise, and True is the Word of His Bani.
I can see no other in the Vedas and the Puraanas.

1022.g: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਹੋਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1022.t: poo(n)jee saach sache gun gaavaa mai dhar hor na kaiee he ||15||
1022.e: Truth is my capital; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. I have no other support at all. ||15||

1022.g: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
1022.t: jug jug saachaa hai bhee hosee ||
1022.e: In each and every age, the True Lord is, and shall always be.

1022.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਨ ਮਰਸੀ ॥
1022.t: kaun na mooaa kaun na marasee ||
1022.e: Who has not died? Who shall not die?

1022.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
1022.t: naanak neech kahai bena(n)tee dhar dhekhahu liv laiee he ||16||2||
1022.e: Nanak the lowly offers this prayer; see Him within your own self, and lovingly focus on the Lord. ||16||2||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
In duality and evil-mindedness, the soul-bride is blind and deaf.
She wears the dress of sexual desire and anger.

1022.g: ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਛੋਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1022.t: ghar var sahaj na jaanai chhohar bin pir needh na paiee he ||1||
1022.e: Her Husband Lord is within the home of her own heart, but she does not know Him; without her Husband Lord, she cannot go to sleep. ||1||
The great fire of desire blazes within her.
The self-willed manmukh looks around in the four directions.

1022.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1022.t: bin satigur seve kiau sukh paieeaai saache haath vaddaiee he ||2||
1022.e: Without serving the True Guru, how can she find peace? Glorious greatness rests in the hands of the True Lord. ||2||
Eradicating sexual desire, anger and egotism,
she destroys the five thieves through the Word of the Shabad.

1022.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਲੈ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1022.t: giaan khaRag lai man siau loojhai manasaa maneh samaiee he ||3||
1022.e: Taking up the sword of spiritual wisdom, she struggles with her mind, and hope and desire are smoothed over in her mind. ||3||

1022.g: ਮਾ ਕੀ ਰਕਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਦੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
1022.t: maa kee rakat pitaa bidh dhaaraa ||
1022.e: From the union of the mother's egg and the father's sperm,
the form of infinite beauty has been created.

1022.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1022.t: jot dhaat jetee sabh teree too karataa sabh Thaiee he ||4||
1022.e: The blessings of light all come from You; You are the Creator Lord, pervading everywhere. ||4||
You have created birth and death.

1022.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਪੜੀ ਕਿਆ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
1022.t: gur te samajh paRee kiaa ddaranaa ||
1022.e: Why should anyone fear, if they come to understand through the Guru?

1022.g: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1022.t: too dhiaal dhiaa kar dhekheh dhukh dharadh sareerahu jaiee he ||5||
1022.e: When You, O Merciful Lord, look with Your kindness, then pain and suffering leave the body. ||5||

1022.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਉ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
1022.t: nij ghar bais rahe bhau khaiaa ||
1022.e: One who sits in the home of his own self, eats his own fears.
He quiets and holds his wandering mind still.

1022.g: ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਹਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1022.t: kamal bigaas hare sar subhar aatam raam sakhaiee he ||6||
1022.e: His heart-lotus blossoms forth in the overflowing green pool, and the Lord of his soul becomes his companion and helper. ||6||
With their death already ordained, mortals come into this world.
How can they remain here? They have to go to the world beyond.

1022.g: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਮਰਾ ਪੁਰਿ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1022.t: sachaa amar sache amaraa pur so sach milai vaddaiee he ||7||
1022.e: True is the Lord's Command; the true ones dwell in the eternal city. The True Lord blesses them with glorious greatness. ||7||
He Himself created the whole world.
The One who made it, assigns the tasks to it.

1023.g: ਸਚੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1023.t: sachai uoopar avar na dheesai saache keemat paiee he ||8||
1023.e: I cannot see any other above the True Lord. The True Lord does the appraisal. ||8||
In this green pasture, the mortal stays only a few days.
He plays and frolics in utter darkness.

1023.g: ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲਿ ਗਏ ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭਖਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1023.t: baajee khel ge baajeegar jiau nis supanai bhakhalaiee he ||9||
1023.e: The jugglers have staged their show, and left, like people mumbling in a dream. ||9||
They alone are blessed with glorious greatness at the Lord's throne,
who enshrine the fearless Lord in their minds, and lovingly center themselves on Him.

1023.g: ਖੰਡੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਪੁਰੀਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1023.t: kha(n)ddee brahama(n)ddee paataalee pureeiee tirabhavan taaRee laiee he ||10||
1023.e: In the galaxies and solar systems, nether regions, celestial realms and the three worlds, the Lord is in the primal void of deep absorption. ||10||
True is the village, and true is the throne,
of those Gurmukhs who meet with the True Lord, and find peace.

1023.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1023.t: saache saachai takhat vaddaiee haumai ganat gavaiee he ||11||
1023.e: In Truth, seated upon the true throne, they are blessed with glorious greatness; their egotism is eradicated, along with the calculation of their account. ||11||
Calculating its account, the soul becomes anxious.
How can one find peace, through duality and the three gunas - the three qualities?

1023.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1023.t: niramal ek nira(n)jan dhaataa gur poore te pat paiee he ||12||
1023.e: The One Lord is immaculate and formless, the Great Giver; through the Perfect Guru, honor is obtained. ||12||
In each and every age, very rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize the Lord.
Their minds are imbued with the True, all-pervading Lord.

1023.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1023.t: tis kee oT gahee sukh paiaa man tan mail na kaiee he ||13||
1023.e: Seeking His Shelter, they find peace, and their minds and bodies are not stained with filth. ||13||
Their tongues are imbued with the True Lord, the source of nectar;

1023.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਉ ਨ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
1023.t: har prabh sa(n)gee bhau na bharaatee ||
1023.e: abiding with the Lord God, they have no fear or doubt.

1023.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਰਜੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1023.t: sravan srot raje gurbaanee jotee jot milaiee he ||14||
1023.e: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, their ears are satisfied, and their light merges into the Light. ||14||

1023.g: ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ਧਰੇ ਪਉ ਧਰਣਾ ॥
1023.t: rakh rakh pair dhare pau dharanaa ||
1023.e: Carefully, carefully, I place my feet upon the ground.
Wherever I go, I behold Your Sanctuary.

1023.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1023.t: dhukh sukh dheh toohai man bhaaveh tujh hee siau ban aaiee he ||15||
1023.e: Whether You grant me pain or pleasure, You are pleasing to my mind. I am in harmony with You. ||15||
No one is anyone's companion or helper at the very last moment;
as Gurmukh, I realize You and praise You.

1023.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
1023.t: naanak naam rate bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laiee he ||16||3||
1023.e: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, I am detached; in the home of my own self deep within, I am absorbed in the primal void of deep meditation. ||16||3||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You are infinite and incomparable.
You are my primal, immaculate Lord and Master.

1023.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1023.t: saache jog jugat veechaaree saache taaRee laiee he ||1||
1023.e: I contemplate the Way of Yoga, the Way of Union with the True Lord. I am truly absorbed in the primal void of deep meditation. ||1||
For so many ages, there was only pitch darkness;
the Creator Lord was absorbed in the primal void.

1023.g: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1023.t: sach naam sachee vaddiaaiee saachai takhat vaddaiee he ||2||
1023.e: There was the True Name, the glorious greatness of the Truth, and the glory of His true throne. ||2||
In the Golden Age of Truth, Truth and contentment filled the bodies.
Truth was pervasive, Truth, deep, profound and unfathomable.

1023.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1023.t: sachaa saahib sach parakhai saachai hukam chalaiee he ||3||
1023.e: The True Lord appraises the mortals on the Touchstone of Truth, and issues His True Command. ||3||
The Perfect True Guru is true and contented.

1023.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
1023.t: gur kaa sabadh mane so sooraa ||
1023.e: He alone is a spiritual hero, who believes in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1023.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
