1023.t: saachee dharageh saach nivaasaa maanai hukam rajaiee he ||4||
1023.e: He alone obtains a true seat in the True Court of the Lord, who surrenders to the Command of the Commander. ||4||
In the Golden Age of Truth, everyone spoke the Truth.
Truth was pervasive - the Lord was Truth.

1023.g: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1023.t: man mukh saach bharam bhau bha(n)jan gurmukh saach sakhaiee he ||5||
1023.e: With Truth in their minds and mouths, mortals were rid of doubt and fear. Truth was the friend of the Gurmukhs. ||5||
In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yoga, one power of Dharma was lost.
Three feet remained; through duality, one was cut off.

1023.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਚੈ ਅਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1023.t: gurmukh hovai su saach vakhaanai manmukh pachai avaiee he ||6||
1023.e: Those who were Gurmukh spoke the Truth, while the self-willed manmukhs wasted away in vain. ||6||
The manmukh never succeeds in the Court of the Lord.
Without the Word of the Shabad, how can one be pleased within?

1023.g: ਬਾਧੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1023.t: baadhe aaveh baadhe jaaveh sojhee boojh na kaiee he ||7||
1023.e: In bondage they come, and in bondage they go; they understand and comprehend nothing. ||7||
In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, compassion was cut in half.

1024.e: Only a few, as Gurmukh, remembered the Lord.

1024.g: ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰੇ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1024.t: dhui pag dharam dhare dharaneedhar gurmukh saach tithaiee he ||8||
1024.e: Dharmic faith, which upholds and supports the earth, had only two feet; Truth was revealed to the Gurmukhs. ||8||
The kings acted righteously only out of self-interest.
Tied to hopes of reward, they gave to charities.

1024.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1024.t: raam naam bin mukat na hoiee thaake karam kamaiee he ||9||
1024.e: Without the Lord's Name, liberation did not come, although they grew weary of performing rituals. ||9||
Practicing religious rituals, they sought liberation,
but the treasure of liberation comes only by praising the Shabad.

1024.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1024.t: bin gur sabadhai mukat na hoiee parapa(n)ch kar bharamaiee he ||10||
1024.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, liberation is not obtained; practicing hypocrisy, they wander around confused. ||10||
Love and attachment to Maya cannot be abandoned.
They alone find release, who practice deeds of Truth.

1024.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1024.t: ahinis bhagat rate veechaaree Thaakur siau ban aaiee he ||11||
1024.e: Day and night, the devotees remain imbued with contemplative meditation; they become just like their Lord and Master. ||11||

1024.g: ਇਕਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
1024.t: eik jap tap kar kar teerath naaveh ||
1024.e: Some chant and practice intensive meditation, and take cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
They walk as You will them to walk.

1024.g: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਪਤੀਜੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1024.t: haTh nigreh apateej na bheejai bin har gur kin pat paiee he ||12||
1024.e: By stubborn rituals of self-suppression, the Lord is not pleased. No one has ever obtained honor, without the Lord, without the Guru. ||12||

1024.g: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਇਕ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
1024.t: kalee kaal meh ik kal raakhee ||
1024.e: In the Iron Age, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only one power remains.

1024.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
1024.t: bin gur poore kinai na bhaakhee ||
1024.e: Without the Perfect Guru, no one has even described it.

1024.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1024.t: manmukh kooR varatai varataaraa bin satigur bharam na jaiee he ||13||
1024.e: The self-willed manmukhs have staged the show of falsehood. Without the True Guru, doubt does not depart. ||13||
The True Guru is the Creator Lord, independent and carefree.

1024.g: ਨਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
1024.t: naa jam kaan na chha(n)dhaa ba(n)dhaa ||
1024.e: He does not fear death, and He is not dependent on mortal men.

1024.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1024.t: jo tis seve so abinaasee naa tis kaal sa(n)taiee he ||14||
1024.e: Whoever serves Him becomes immortal and imperishable, and will not be tortured by death. ||14||
The Creator Lord has enshrined Himself within the Guru.
The Gurmukh saves countless millions.

1024.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1024.t: sarab jeeaa jagajeevan dhaataa nirabhau mail na kaiee he ||15||
1024.e: The Life of the World is the Great Giver of all beings. The Fearless Lord has no filth at all. ||15||
Everyone begs from the Guru, God's Treasurer.
He Himself is the immaculate, unknowable, infinite Lord.

1024.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
1024.t: naanak saach kahai prabh jaachai mai dheejai saach rajaiee he ||16||4||
1024.e: Nanak speaks the Truth; he begs from God. Please bless me with the Truth, by Your Will. ||16||4||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
The True Lord unites with those who are united with the Word of the Shabad.
When it pleases Him, we intuitively merge with Him.

1024.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1024.t: tirabhavan jot dharee paramesar avar na dhoojaa bhaiee he ||1||
1024.e: The Light of the Transcendent Lord pervades the three worlds; there is no other at all, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

1024.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
1024.t: jis ke chaakar tis kee sevaa ||
1024.e: I am His servant; I serve Him.
He is unknowable and mysterious; He is pleased by the Shabad.

1024.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1024.t: bhagataa kaa gunakaaree karataa bakhas le vaddiaaiee he ||2||
1024.e: The Creator is the Benefactor of His devotees. He forgives them - such is His greatness. ||2||
The True Lord gives and gives; His blessings never run short.
The false ones receive, and then deny having received.

1024.g: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਨ ਰੀਝਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1024.t: mool na boojheh saach na reejheh dhoojai bharam bhulaiee he ||3||
1024.e: They do not understand their origins, they are not pleased with the Truth, and so they wander in duality and doubt. ||3||
The Gurmukhs remain awake and aware, day and night.
Following the Guru's Teachings, they know the Love of the True Lord.

1024.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸੇ ਲੂਟੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1024.t: manmukh soi rahe se looTe gurmukh saabat bhaiee he ||4||
1024.e: The self-willed manmukhs remain asleep, and are plundered. The Gurmukhs remain safe and sound, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||
The false come, and the false go;
imbued with falsehood, they practice only falsehood.

1024.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1024.t: sabadh mile se dharageh paidhe gurmukh surat samaiee he ||5||
1024.e: Those who are imbued with the Shabad are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord; the Gurmukhs focus their consciousness on Him. ||5||
The false are cheated, and robbed by the robbers.
The garden is laid waste, like the rough wilderness.

1024.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1024.t: naam binaa kichh saadh na laagai har bisariaai dhukh paiee he ||6||
1024.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing tastes sweet; forgetting the Lord, they suffer in sorrow. ||6||
Receiving the food of Truth, one is satisfied.
True is the glorious greatness of the jewel of the Name.

1024.g: ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1024.t: cheenai aap pachhaanai soiee jotee jot milaiee he ||7||
1024.e: One who understands his own self, realizes the Lord. His light merges into the Light. ||7||

1025.g: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਏ ॥
1025.t: naavahu bhulee choTaa khaae ||
1025.e: Wandering from the Name, he endures beatings.

1025.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
1025.t: bahut siaanap bharam na jaae ||
1025.e: Even great cleverness does not dispel doubt.

1025.g: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਅਜਗਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1025.t: pach pach mue achet na cheteh ajagar bhaar ladhaiee he ||8||
1025.e: The unconscious fool does not remain conscious of the Lord; he putrifies and rots away to death, carrying his heavy load of sin. ||8||

1025.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਰੋਧਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1025.t: bin baadh birodheh koiee naahee ||
1025.e: No one is free of conflict and strife.

1025.g: ਮੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
1025.t: mai dhekhaalih tis saalaahee ||
1025.e: Show me anyone who is, and I will praise him.

1025.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1025.t: man tan arap milai jagajeevan har siau banat banaiee he ||9||
1025.e: Dedicating mind and body to God, one meets the Lord, the Life of the World, and becomes just like Him. ||9||

1025.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1025.t: prabh kee gat mit koi na paavai ||
1025.e: No one knows the state and extent of God.

1025.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
1025.t: je ko vaddaa kahai vaddaiee khaavai ||
1025.e: Whoever calls himself great, will be eaten by his greatness.

1025.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਦਾਤੀ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1025.t: saache saahib toT na dhaatee sagalee tineh upaiee he ||10||
1025.e: There is no lack of gifts of our True Lord and Master. He created all. ||10||

1025.g: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
1025.t: vaddee vaddiaaiee veparavaahe ||
1025.e: Great is the glorious greatness of the independent Lord.

1025.g: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ॥
1025.t: aap upaae dhaan samaahe ||
1025.e: He Himself created, and gives sustanance to all.

1025.g: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1025.t: aap dhiaal dhoor nahee dhaataa miliaa sahaj rajaiee he ||11||
1025.e: The Merciful Lord is not far away; the Great Giver spontaneously unites with Himself, by His Will. ||11||

1025.g: ਇਕਿ ਸੋਗੀ ਇਕਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
1025.t: eik sogee ik rog viaape ||
1025.e: Some are sad, and some are afflicted with disease.

1025.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
1025.t: jo kichh kare su aape aape ||
1025.e: Whatever God does, He does by Himself.

1025.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1025.t: bhagat bhaau gur kee mat pooree anahadh sabadh lakhaiee he ||12||
1025.e: Through loving devotion, and the Perfect Teachings of the Guru, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad is realized. ||12||

1025.g: ਇਕਿ ਨਾਗੇ ਭੂਖੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਭਵਾਏ ॥
1025.t: eik naage bhookhe bhaveh bhavaae ||
1025.e: Some wander and roam around, hungry and naked.

1025.g: ਇਕਿ ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
1025.t: eik haTh kar mareh na keemat paae ||
1025.e: Some act in stubbornness and die, but do not know the value of God.

1025.g: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਿਗਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1025.t: gat avigat kee saar na jaanai boojhai sabadh kamaiee he ||13||
1025.e: They do not know the difference between good and bad; this is understood only through the practice of the Word of the Shabad. ||13||

1025.g: ਇਕਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
1025.t: eik teerath naaveh a(n)n na khaaveh ||
1025.e: Some bathe at sacred shrines and refuse to eat.

1025.g: ਇਕਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ਦੇਹ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
1025.t: eik agan jalaaveh dheh khapaaveh ||
1025.e: Some torment their bodies in burning fire.

1025.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1025.t: raam naam bin mukat na hoiee kit bidh paar la(n)ghaiee he ||14||
1025.e: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained; how can anyone cross over? ||14||

1025.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
1025.t: gurmat chhoddeh ujhaR jaiee ||
1025.e: Abandoning the Guru's Teachings, some wander in the wilderness.

1025.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਾਈ ॥
1025.t: manmukh raam na japai avaiee ||
1025.e: The self-willed manmukhs are destitute; they do not meditate on the Lord.

1025.g: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਬੂਡਹਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1025.t: pach pach booddeh kooR kamaaveh kooR kaal bairaiee he ||15||
1025.e: They are ruined, destroyed and drowned from practicing falsehood; death is the enemy of the false. ||15||

1025.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
1025.t: hukame aavai hukame jaavai ||
1025.e: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they come, and by the Hukam of His Command, they go.

1025.g: ਬੂਝੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
1025.t: boojhai hukam so saach samaavai ||
1025.e: One who realizes His Hukam, merges in the True Lord.

1025.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
1025.t: naanak saach milai man bhaavai gurmukh kaar kamaiee he ||16||5||
1025.e: O Nanak, he merges in the True Lord, and his mind is pleased with the Lord. The Gurmukhs do His work. ||16||5||

1025.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1025.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1025.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

1025.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
1025.t: aape karataa purakh bidhaataa ||
1025.e: He Himself is the Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

1025.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
1025.t: jin aape aap upai pachhaataa ||
1025.e: He evaluates those whom He Himself has created.

1025.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1025.t: aape satigur aape sevak aape sirasaT upaiee he ||1||
1025.e: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the servant; He Himself created the Universe. ||1||

1025.g: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
1025.t: aape neRai naahee dhoore ||
1025.e: He is near at hand, not far away.

1025.g: ਬੂਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
1025.t: boojheh gurmukh se jan poore ||
1025.e: The Gurmukhs understand Him; perfect are those humble beings.

1025.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਏਹ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1025.t: tin kee sa(n)gat ahinis laahaa gur sa(n)gat eh vaddaiee he ||2||
1025.e: Associating with them night and day is profitable. This is the glorious greatness of associating with the Guru. ||2||

1025.g: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
1025.t: jug jug sa(n)t bhale prabh tere ||
1025.e: Throughout the ages, Your Saints are holy and sublime, O God.

1025.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸੇਰੇ ॥
1025.t: har gun gaaveh rasan rasere ||
1025.e: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, savoring it with their tongues.

1025.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1025.t: ausatat kareh parahar dhukh dhaaladh jin naahee chi(n)t paraiee he ||3||
1025.e: They chant His Praises, and their pain and poverty are taken away; they are not afraid of anyone else. ||3||

1025.g: ਓਇ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਨ ਸੂਤੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ॥
1025.t: oi jaagat raheh na soote dheeseh ||
1025.e: They remain awake and aware, and do not appear to sleep.

1025.g: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਸਹਿ ॥
1025.t: sa(n)gat kul taare saach pareeseh ||
1025.e: They serve up Truth, and so save their companions and relatives.

1025.g: ਕਲਿਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਓਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1025.t: kalimal mail naahee te niramal oi raheh bhagat liv laiee he ||4||
1025.e: They are not stained with the filth of sins; they are immaculate and pure, and remain absorbed in loving devotional worship. ||4||

1025.g: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1025.t: boojhahu har jan satigur baanee ||
1025.e: O humble servants of the Lord, understand the Word of the Guru's Bani.

1025.g: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
1025.t: eh joban saas hai dheh puraanee ||
1025.e: This youth, breath and body shall pass away.

1025.g: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1025.t: aaj kaal mar jaieeaai praanee har jap jap ridhai dhiaaiee he ||5||
1025.e: O mortal, you shall die today or tomorrow; chant, and meditate on the Lord within your heart. ||5||

1025.g: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕੂੜ ਕਬਾੜਾ ॥
1025.t: chhoddahu praanee kooR kabaaRaa ||
1025.e: O mortal, abandon falsehood and your worthless ways.

1025.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਉਛਾਹਾੜਾ ॥
1025.t: kooR maare kaal uchhaahaaRaa ||
1025.e: Death viciously kills the false beings.

1025.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1025.t: saakat kooR pacheh man haumai dhuh maarag pachai pachaiee he ||6||
1025.e: The faithless cynic is ruined through falsehood and his egotistical mind.On the path of duality, he rots away and decomposes. ||6||

1026.e: Abandon slander and envy of others.

1026.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
1026.t: paR paR dhajheh saat na aaiee ||
1026.e: Reading and studying, they burn, and do not find tranquility.

1026.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1026.t: mil satasa(n)gat naam salaahahu aatam raam sakhaiee he ||7||
1026.e: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Lord, the Supreme Soul, shall be your helper and companion. ||7||
Abandon sexual desire, anger and wickedness.
Abandon your involvement in egotistical affairs and conflicts.

1026.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹੁ ਇਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1026.t: satigur saran parahu taa ubarahu iau tareeaai bhavajal bhaiee he ||8||
1026.e: If you seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, then you shall be saved. In this way you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||

1026.g: ਆਗੈ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਦੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਝੇਲਾ ॥
1026.t: aagai bimal nadhee agan bikh jhelaa ||
1026.e: In the hereafter, you shall have to cross over the fiery river of poisonous flames.

1026.g: ਤਿਥੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
1026.t: tithai avar na koiee jeeau ikelaa ||
1026.e: No one else will be there; your soul shall be all alone.

1026.g: ਭੜ ਭੜ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇ ਲਹਰੀ ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1026.t: bhaR bhaR agan saagar dhe laharee paR dhajheh manmukh taiee he ||9||
1026.e: The ocean of fire spits out waves of searing flames; the self-willed manmukhs fall into it, and are roasted there. ||9||

1026.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
1026.t: gur peh mukat dhaan dhe bhaanai ||
1026.e: Liberation comes from the Guru; He grants this blessing by the Pleasure of His Will.
He alone knows the way, who obtains it.

1026.g: ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1026.t: jin paiaa tin poochhahu bhaiee sukh satigur sev kamaiee he ||10||
1026.e: So ask one who has obtained it, O Siblings of Destiny. Serve the True Guru, and find peace. ||10||
Without the Guru, he dies entangled in sin and corruption.
The Messenger of Death smashes his head and humiliates him.

1026.g: ਬਾਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਡੂਬਹਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1026.t: baadhe mukat naahee nar ni(n)dhak ddoobeh ni(n)dh paraiee he ||11||
1026.e: The slanderous person is not freed of his bonds; he is drowned, slandering others. ||11||
So speak the Truth, and realize the Lord deep within.
He is not far away; look, and see Him.

1026.g: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਇਉ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1026.t: bighan naahee gurmukh tar taaree iau bhavajal paar la(n)ghaiee he ||12||
1026.e: No obstacles shall block your way; become Gurmukh, and cross over to the other side. This is the way to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||12||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the body.
The Creator Lord is eternal and imperishable.

1026.g: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1026.t: naa jeeau marai na maariaa jaiee kar dhekhai sabadh rajaiee he ||13||
1026.e: The soul does not die, and it cannot be killed; God creates and watches over all. Through the Word of the Shabad, His Will is manifest. ||13||
He is immaculate, and has no darkness.
The True Lord Himself sits upon His throne.

1026.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਆਈ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1026.t: saakat kooRe ba(n)dh bhavaie'eeh mar janameh aaiee jaiee he ||14||
1026.e: The faithless cynics are bound and gagged, and forced to wander in reincarnation. They die, and are reborn, and continue coming and going. ||14||
The Guru's servants are the Beloveds of the True Guru.

1026.g: ਓਇ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
1026.t: oi baiseh takhat su sabadh veechaare ||
1026.e: Contemplating the Shabad, they sit upon His throne.

1026.g: ਤਤੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1026.t: tat laheh a(n)taragat jaaneh satasa(n)gat saach vaddaiee he ||15||
1026.e: They realize the essence of reality, and know the state of their inner being. This is the true glorious greatness of those who join the Sat Sangat. ||15||
He Himself saves His humble servant, and saves his ancestors as well.
His companions are liberated; He carries them across.

1026.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
1026.t: naanak tis kaa laalaa golaa jin gurmukh har liv laiee he ||16||6||
1026.e: Nanak is the servant and slave of that Gurmukh who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Lord. ||16||6||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
For many ages, only darkness prevailed;
the infinite, endless Lord was absorbed in the primal void.

1026.g: ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1026.t: dhu(n)dhookaar niraalam baiThaa naa tadh dha(n)dh pasaaraa he ||1||
1026.e: He sat alone and unaffected in absolute darkness; the world of conflict did not exist. ||1||
Thirty-six ages passed like this.
He causes all to happen by the Pleasure of His Will.

1026.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1026.t: tiseh sareek na dheesai koiee aape apar apaaraa he ||2||
1026.e: No rival of His can be seen. He Himself is infinite and endless. ||2||
God is hidden throughout the four ages - understand this well.
He pervades each and every heart, and is contained within the belly.

1026.g: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕਾ ਏਕੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1026.t: jug jug ekaa ekee varatai koiee boojhai gur veechaaraa he ||3||
1026.e: The One and Only Lord prevails throughout the ages. How rare are those who contemplate the Guru, and understand this. ||3||
From the union of the sperm and the egg, the body was formed.
From the union of air, water and fire, the living being is made.

1026.g: ਆਪੇ ਚੋਜ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1026.t: aape choj kare ra(n)g mahalee hor maiaa moh pasaaraa he ||4||
1026.e: He Himself plays joyfully in the mansion of the body; all the rest is just attachment to Maya's expanse. ||4||
Within the mother's womb, upside-down, the mortal meditated on God.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.

1026.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1026.t: saas saas sach naam samaale a(n)tar udhar majhaaraa he ||5||
1026.e: With each and every breath, he contemplated the True Name, deep within himself, within the womb. ||5||

1027.e: He came into the world to obtain the four great blessings.
He came to dwell in the home of the Shiva and Shakti, energy and matter.

1027.g: ਏਕੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਿੜ ਹਾਰੇ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1027.t: ek visaare taa piR haare a(n)dhulai naam visaaraa he ||6||
1027.e: But he forgot the One Lord, and he has lost the game. The blind person forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||
The child dies in his childish games.
They cry and mourn, saying that he was such a playful child.

1027.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਸੋ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਭੂਲਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1027.t: jis kaa saa so tin hee leeaa bhoolaa rovanahaaraa he ||7||
1027.e: The Lord who owns him has taken him back. Those who weep and mourn are mistaken. ||7||

1027.g: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
1027.t: bhar joban mar jaeh k keejai ||
1027.e: What can they do, if he dies in his youth?
They cry out, ""His is mine, he is mine!""

1027.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰੋਇ ਵਿਗੂਚਹਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1027.t: maiaa kaaran roi vigoocheh dhirag jeevan sa(n)saaraa he ||8||
1027.e: They cry for the sake of Maya, and are ruined; their lives in this world are cursed. ||8||
Their black hair eventually turns grey.
Without the Name, they lose their wealth, and then leave.

1027.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਮੂਠੇ ਰੋਇ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1027.t: dhuramat a(n)dhulaa binas binaasai mooThe roi pookaaraa he ||9||
1027.e: They are evil-minded and blind - they are totally ruined; they are plundered, and cry out in pain. ||9||
One who understands himself, does not cry.
When he meets the True Guru, then he understands.

1027.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਨ ਖੂਲਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1027.t: bin gur bajar kapaaT na khooleh sabadh milai nisataaraa he ||10||
1027.e: Without the Guru, the heavy, hard doors are not opened. Obtaining the Word of the Shabad, one is emancipated. ||10||
The body grows old, and is beaten out of shape.
But he does not meditate on the Lord, His only friend, even at the end.

1027.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1027.t: naam visaar chalai muh kaalai dharageh jhooTh khuaaraa he ||11||
1027.e: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he departs with his face blackened. The false are humiliated in the Court of the Lord. ||11||
Forgetting the Naam, the false ones depart.
Coming and going, dust falls on their heads.

1027.g: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1027.t: saahuraRai ghar vaas na paae peieeaRai sir maaraa he ||12||
1027.e: The soul-bride finds no home in her in-laws' home, the world hereafter; she suffers in agony in this world of her parents' home. ||12||
She eats, dresses and plays joyfully,
but without loving devotional worship of the Lord, she dies uselessly.

1027.g: ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1027.t: sar apasar kee saar na jaanai jam maare kiaa chaaraa he ||13||
1027.e: One who does not distinguish between good and evil, is beaten by the Messenger of Death; how can anyone escape this? ||13||
One who realizes what he has to possess, and what he has to abandon,

1027.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
1027.t: gur kai sa(n)g sabadh ghar jaanai ||
1027.e: associating with the Guru, comes to know the Word of the Shabad, within the home of his own self.

1027.g: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸਚਿ ਖਰਾ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1027.t: kis hee ma(n)dhaa aakh na chalai sach kharaa sachiaaraa he ||14||
1027.e: Do not call anyone else bad; follow this way of life. Those who are true are judged to be genuine by the True Lord. ||14||

1027.g: ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਿਝੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
1027.t: saach binaa dhar sijhai na koiee ||
1027.e: Without Truth, no one succeeds in the Court of the Lord.
Through the True Shabad, one is robed in honor.

1027.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1027.t: aape bakhas le tis bhaavai haumai garab nivaaraa he ||15||
1027.e: He forgives those with whom He is pleased; they silence their egotism and pride. ||15||
One who realizes the Hukam of God's Command, by the Grace of the Guru,
comes to know the lifestyle of the ages.

1027.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੭॥
1027.t: naanak naam japahu tar taaree sach taare taaranahaaraa he ||16||1||7||
1027.e: O Nanak, chant the Naam, and cross over to the other side. The True Lord will carry you across. ||16||1||7||
Maaroo, First Mehla:

1027.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
1027.t: har saa meet naahee mai koiee ||
1027.e: I have no other friend like the Lord.

1027.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ ॥
1027.t: jin tan man dheeaa surat samoiee ||
1027.e: He gave me body and mind, and infused consciousness into my being.

1027.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1027.t: sarab jeeaa pratipaal samaale so a(n)tar dhaanaa beenaa he ||1||
1027.e: He cherishes and cares for all beings; He is deep within, the wise, all-knowing Lord. ||1||
The Guru is the sacred pool, and I am His beloved swan.

1027.g: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
1027.t: saagar meh ratan laal bahu saare ||
1027.e: In the ocean, there are so many jewels and rubies.

1027.g: ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1027.t: motee maanak heeraa har jas gaavat man tan bheenaa he ||2||
1027.e: The Lord's Praises are pearls, gems and diamonds. Singing His Praises, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||
The Lord is inaccessible, inscrutable, unfathomable and unattached.

1027.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
1027.t: har a(n)t na paieeaai gur gopaalaa ||
1027.e: The Lord's limits cannot be found; the Guru is the Lord of the World.

1027.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1027.t: satigur mat taare taaranahaaraa mel le ra(n)g leenaa he ||3||
1027.e: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Lord carries us across to the other side. He unites in His Union those who are colored by His Love. ||3||
Without the True Guru, how can anyone be liberated?
He has been the Friend of the Lord, from the very beginning of time, and all throughout the ages.

1027.g: ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1027.t: dharageh mukat kare kar kirapaa bakhase avagun keenaa he ||4||
1027.e: By His Grace, He grants liberation in His Court; He forgives them for their sins. ||4||

1028.e: The True Guru, the Giver, grants liberation;

1028.g: ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
1028.t: sabh rog gavaae a(n)mirat ras paae ||
1028.e: all diseases are eradicated, and one is blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar.

1028.g: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਠਰੁ ਸੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1028.t: jam jaagaat naahee kar laagai jis agan bujhee Thar seenaa he ||5||
1028.e: Death, the tax collector, does not impose any tax on one whose inner fire has been put out, whose heart is cool and tranquil. ||5||
The body has developed a great love for the soul-swan.

1028.g: ਓਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਓਹ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
1028.t: oh jogee purakh oh su(n)dhar naaree ||
1028.e: He is a Yogi, and she is a beautiful woman.

1028.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਚੋਜ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤੈ ਮਤਾ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1028.t: ahinis bhogai choj binodhee uTh chalatai mataa na keenaa he ||6||
1028.e: Day and night, he enjoys her with delight, and then he arises and departs without consulting her. ||6||
Creating the Universe, God remains diffused throughout it.
In the wind, water and fire, He vibrates and resounds.

1028.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1028.t: manooaa ddolai dhoot sa(n)gat mil so paae jo kichh keenaa he ||7||
1028.e: The mind wavers, keeping company with evil passions; one obtains the rewards of his own actions. ||7||
Forgetting the Naam, one suffers the misery of his evil ways.
When the order to depart is issued, how can he remain here?

1028.g: ਨਰਕ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1028.t: narak koop meh gote khaavai jiau jal te baahar meenaa he ||8||
1028.e: He falls into the pit of hell, and suffers like a fish out of water. ||8||
The faithless cynic has to endure 8.4 million hellish incarnations.
As he acts, so does he suffer.

1028.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1028.t: satigur baajhahu mukat na hoiee kirat baadhaa gras dheenaa he ||9||
1028.e: Without the True Guru, there is no liberation. Bound and gagged by his own actions, he is helpless. ||9||
This path is very narrow, like the sharp edge of a sword.
When his account is read, he shall be crushed like the sesame seed in the mill.

1028.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1028.t: maat pitaa kalatr sut belee naahee bin har ras mukat na keenaa he ||10||
1028.e: Mother, father, spouse and child - none is anyone's friend in the end. Without the Lord's Love, no one is liberated. ||10||
You may have many friends and companions in the world,
but without the Guru, the Transcendent Lord Incarnate, there is no one at all.

1028.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1028.t: gur kee sevaa mukat parain anadhin keeratan keenaa he ||11||
1028.e: Service to the Guru is the way to liberation. Night and day, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||11||
Abandon falsehood, and pursue the Truth,
and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires.

1028.g: ਸਾਚ ਵਖਰ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1028.t: saach vakhar ke vaapaaree virale lai laahaa saudhaa keenaa he ||12||
1028.e: Very few are those who trade in the merchandise of Truth. Those who deal in it, obtain the true profit. ||12||

1028.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ॥
1028.t: har har naam vakhar lai chalahu ||
1028.e: Depart with the merchandise of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,
and you shall intuitively obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, in the Mansion of His Presence.

1028.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਇਉ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਚੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1028.t: gurmukh khoj laheh jan poore iau samadharasee cheenaa he ||13||
1028.e: The Gurmukhs search for Him and find Him; they are the perfect humble beings. In this way, they see Him, who looks upon all alike. ||13||
God is endless; following the Guru's Teachings, some find Him.

1028.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ॥
1028.t: gur kai sabadh man kau samajhaaveh ||
1028.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they instruct their minds.

1028.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਇਉ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੈ ਲੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1028.t: satigur kee baanee sat sat kar maanahu iau aatam raamai leenaa he ||14||
1028.e: Accept as True, Perfectly True, the Word of the True Guru's Bani. In this way, you shall merge in the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||14||
Naarad and Saraswati are Your servants.
Your servants are the greatest of the great, throughout the three worlds.

1028.g: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1028.t: sabh teree kudharat too sir sir dhaataa sabh tero kaaran keenaa he ||15||
1028.e: Your creative power permeates all; You are the Great Giver of all. You created the whole creation. ||15||
Some serve at Your Door, and their sufferings are dispelled.
They are robed with honor in the Court of the Lord, and emancipated by the True Guru.

1028.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੋੜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਚਲਣਿ ਨ ਦੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
1028.t: haumai ba(n)dhan satigur toRe chit cha(n)chal chalan na dheenaa he ||16||
1028.e: The True Guru breaks the bonds of egotism, and restrains the fickle consciousness. ||16||
Meet the True Guru, and search for the way,

1028.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
1028.t: jit prabh paavahu ganat na kaiee ||
1028.e: by which you may find God, and not have to answer for your account.

1028.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੨॥੮॥
1028.t: haumai maar karahu gur sevaa jan naanak har ra(n)g bheenaa he ||17||2||8||
1028.e: Subdue your egotism, and serve the Guru; O servant Nanak, you shall be drenched with the Lord's Love. ||17||2||8||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
My Lord is the Destroyer of demons.
My Beloved Lord is pervading each and every heart.

1028.g: ਨਾਲੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੂਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1028.t: naale alakh na lakheeaai moole gurmukh likh veechaaraa he ||1||
1028.e: The unseen Lord is always with us, but He is not seen at all. The Gurmukh contemplates the record. ||1||
The Holy Gurmukh seeks Your Sanctuary.

1029.e: God grants His Grace, and carries him across to the other side.

1029.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਗਹਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1029.t: agan paanee saagar at gaharaa gur satigur paar utaaraa he ||2||
1029.e: The ocean is very deep, filled with fiery water; the Guru, the True Guru, carries us across to the other side. ||2||
The blind, self-willed manmukh does not understand.
He comes and goes in reincarnation, dying, and dying again.

1029.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1029.t: poorab likhiaa lekh na miTiee jam dhar a(n)dh khuaaraa he ||3||
1029.e: The primal inscription of destiny cannot be erased. The spiritually blind suffer terribly at Death's door. ||3||

1029.g: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
1029.t: eik aaveh jaaveh ghar vaas na paaveh ||
1029.e: Some come and go, and do not find a home in their own heart.
Bound by their past actions, they commit sins.

1029.g: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1029.t: a(n)dhule sojhee boojh na kaiee lobh buraa aha(n)kaaraa he ||4||
1029.e: The blind ones have no understanding, no wisdom; they are trapped and ruined by greed and egotism. ||4||

1029.g: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਸੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
1029.t: pir bin kiaa tis dhan seegaaraa ||
1029.e: Without her Husband Lord, what good are the soul-bride's decorations?
She has forgotten her Lord and Master, and is infatuated with another's husband.

1029.g: ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਪੂਤ ਬਾਪੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਫੋਕਟ ਕਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1029.t: jiau besuaa poot baap ko kaheeaai tiau fokaT kaar vikaaraa he ||5||
1029.e: Just as no one knows who is the father of the prostitute's son, such are the worthless, useless deeds that are done. ||5||
The ghost, in the body-cage, suffers all sorts of afflictions.
Those who are blind to spiritual wisdom, putrefy in hell.

1029.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1029.t: dharam rai kee baakee leejai jin har kaa naam visaaraa he ||6||
1029.e: The Righteous Judge of Dharma collects the balance due on the account, of those who forget the Name of the Lord. ||6||
The scorching sun blazes with flames of poison.
The self-willed manmukh is dishonored, a beast, a demon.

1029.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1029.t: aasaa manasaa kooR kamaaveh rog buraa buriaaraa he ||7||
1029.e: Trapped by hope and desire, he practices falsehood, and is afflicted by the terrible disease of corruption. ||7||
He carries the heavy load of sins on his forehead and head.
How can he cross the terrifying world-ocean?

1029.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1029.t: satigur bohith aadh jugaadhee raam naam nisataaraa he ||8||
1029.e: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, the True Guru has been the boat; through the Lord's Name, He carries us across. ||8||
The love of one's children and spouse is so sweet in this world.
The expansive expanse of the Universe is attachment to Maya.

1029.g: ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੋੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1029.t: jam ke faahe satigur toRe gurmukh tat beechaaraa he ||9||
1029.e: The True Guru snaps the noose of Death, for that Gurmukh who contemplates the essence of reality. ||9||
Cheated by falsehood, the self-willed manmukh walks along many paths;
he may be highly educated, but he burns in the fire.

1029.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1029.t: a(n)mirat naam guroo vadd dhaanaa naam japahu sukh saaraa he ||10||
1029.e: The Guru is the Great Giver of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting the Naam, sublime peace is obtained. ||10||
The True Guru, in His Mercy, implants Truth within.
All suffering is eradicated, and one is placed on the Path.

1029.g: ਕੰਡਾ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਗਡਈ ਮੂਲੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1029.t: ka(n)ddaa pai na gaddiee moole jis satigur raakhanahaaraa he ||11||
1029.e: Not even a thorn ever pierces the foot of one who has the True Guru as his Protector. ||11||
Dust mixes with dust, when the body wastes away.
The self-willed manmukh is like a stone slab, which is impervious to water.

1029.g: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1029.t: karan palaav kare bahutere narak surag avataaraa he ||12||
1029.e: He cries out and weeps and wails; he is reincarnated into heaven and then hell. ||12||
They live with the poisonous snake of Maya.
This duality has ruined so many homes.

1029.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1029.t: satigur baajhahu preet na upajai bhagat rate pateeaaraa he ||13||
1029.e: Without the True Guru, love does not well up. Imbued with devotional worship, the soul is satisfied. ||13||
The faithless cynics chase after Maya.
Forgetting the Naam, how can they find peace?

1029.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1029.t: tirahu gun a(n)tar khapeh khapaaveh naahee paar utaaraa he ||14||
1029.e: In the three qualities, they are destroyed; they cannot cross over to the other side. ||14||
The false are called pigs and dogs.

1029.g: ਭਉਕਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਉ ਭਉ ਭਉ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
1029.t: bhauk mareh bhau bhau bhau haaraa ||
1029.e: They bark themselves to death; they bark and bark and howl in fear.

1029.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1029.t: man tan jhooThe kooR kamaaveh dhuramat dharageh haaraa he ||15||
1029.e: False in mind and body, they practice falsehood; through their evil-mindedness, they lose out in the Court of the Lord. ||15||
Meeting the True Guru, the mind is stabilized.
One who seeks His Sanctuary is blessed with the Lord's Name.

1029.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
1029.t: har dhan naam amolak dhevai har jas dharageh piaaraa he ||16||
1029.e: They are given the priceless wealth of the Lord's Name; singing His Praises, they are His beloveds in His court. ||16||

1030.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
1030.t: raam naam saadhoo saranaiee ||
1030.e: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, chant the Lord's Name.

1030.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
1030.t: satigur bachanee gat mit paiee ||
1030.e: Through the True Guru's Teachings, one comes to know His state and extent.

1030.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੩॥੯॥
1030.t: naanak har jap har man mere har mele melanahaaraa he ||17||3||9||
1030.e: Nanak: chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; the Lord, the Uniter, shall unite you with Himself. ||17||3||9||

1030.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1030.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1030.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

1030.g: ਘਰਿ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
1030.t: ghar rahu re man mugadh iaane ||
1030.e: Remain in your own home, O my foolish and ignorant mind.

1030.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਧਿਆਨੇ ॥
1030.t: raam japahu a(n)taragat dhiaane ||
1030.e: Meditate on the Lord - concentrate deep within your being and meditate on Him.

1030.g: ਲਾਲਚ ਛੋਡਿ ਰਚਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1030.t: laalach chhodd rachahu apara(n)par iau paavahu mukat dhuaaraa he ||1||
1030.e: Renounce your greed, and merge with the infinite Lord. In this way, you shall find the door of liberation. ||1||

1030.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਣਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
1030.t: jis bisariaai jam johan laagai ||
1030.e: If you forget Him, the Messenger of Death will catch sight of you.

1030.g: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਗੈ ॥
1030.t: sabh sukh jaeh dhukhaa fun aagai ||
1030.e: All peace will be gone, and you will suffer in pain in the world hereafter.

1030.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਏਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1030.t: raam naam jap gurmukh jeeaRe eh param tat veechaaraa he ||2||
1030.e: Chant the Name of the Lord as Gurmukh, O my soul; this is the supreme essence of contemplation. ||2||

1030.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
1030.t: har har naam japahu ras meeThaa ||
1030.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the sweetest essence.

1030.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
1030.t: gurmukh har ras a(n)tar ddeeThaa ||
1030.e: As Gurmukh, see the essence of the Lord deep within.

1030.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਏਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1030.t: ahinis raam rahahu ra(n)g raate eh jap tap sa(n)jam saaraa he ||3||
1030.e: Day and night, remain imbued with the Lord's Love. This is the essence of all chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline. ||3||

1030.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬੋਲਹੁ ॥
1030.t: raam naam gur bachanee bolahu ||
1030.e: Speak the Guru's Word, and the Name of the Lord.

1030.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੋਲਹੁ ॥
1030.t: sa(n)t sabhaa meh ih ras Tolahu ||
1030.e: In the Society of the Saints, search for this essence.

1030.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਗਰਭ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1030.t: gurmat khoj lahahu ghar apanaa bahuR na garabh majhaaraa he ||4||
1030.e: Follow the Guru's Teachings - seek and find the home of your own self, and you shall never be consigned to the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

1030.g: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
1030.t: sach teerath naavahu har gun gaavahu ||
1030.e: Bathe at the sacred shrine of Truth, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

1030.g: ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
1030.t: tat veechaarahu har liv laavahu ||
1030.e: Reflect upon the essence of reality, and lovingly focus your consciousness on the Lord.

1030.g: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1030.t: a(n)t kaal jam joh na saakai har bolahu raam piaaraa he ||5||
1030.e: At the very last moment, the Messenger of Death will not be able to touch you, if you chant the Name of the Beloved Lord. ||5||

1030.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ॥
1030.t: satigur purakh dhaataa vadd dhaanaa ||
1030.e: The True Guru, the Primal Being, the Great Giver, is all-knowing.

1030.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
1030.t: jis a(n)tar saachu su sabadh samaanaa ||
1030.e: Whoever has Truth within himself, merges in the Word of the Shabad.

1030.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਭੈ ਭਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1030.t: jis kau satigur mel milaae tis chookaa jam bhai bhaaraa he ||6||
1030.e: One whom the True Guru unites in Union, is rid of the overpowering fear of death. ||6||

1030.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
1030.t: pa(n)ch tat mil kaiaa keenee ||
1030.e: The body is formed from the union of the five elements.

1030.g: ਤਿਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਲੈ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
1030.t: tis meh raam ratan lai cheenee ||
1030.e: Know that the Lord's jewel is within it.

1030.g: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1030.t: aatam raam raam hai aatam har paieeaai sabadh veechaaraa he ||7||
1030.e: The soul is the Lord, and the Lord is the soul; contemplating the Shabad, the Lord is found. ||7||

1030.g: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
1030.t: sat sa(n)tokh rahahu jan bhaiee ||
1030.e: Abide in truth and contentment, O humble Siblings of Destiny.

1030.g: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
1030.t: khimaa gahahu satigur saranaiee ||
1030.e: Hold tight to compassion and the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

1030.g: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਾਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1030.t: aatam cheen paraatam cheenahu gur sa(n)gat ih nisataaraa he ||8||
1030.e: Know your soul, and know the Supreme Soul; associating with the Guru, you shall be emancipated. ||8||

1030.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜ ਕਪਟ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
1030.t: saakat kooR kapaT meh Tekaa ||
1030.e: The faithless cynics are stuck in falsehood and deceit.

1030.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
1030.t: ahinis ni(n)dhaa kareh anekaa ||
1030.e: Day and night, they slander many others.

1030.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਰਕ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1030.t: bin simaran aaveh fun jaaveh grabh jonee narak majhaaraa he ||9||
1030.e: Without meditative remembrance, they come and then go, and are cast into the hellish womb of reincarnation. ||9||

1030.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
1030.t: saakat jam kee kaan na chookai ||
1030.e: The faithless cynic is not rid of his fear of death.

1030.g: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮੂਕੈ ॥
1030.t: jam kaa dda(n)dd na kabahoo mookai ||
1030.e: The Messenger of Death's club is never taken away.

1030.g: ਬਾਕੀ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1030.t: baakee dharam rai kee leejai sir afario bhaar afaaraa he ||10||
1030.e: He has to answer to the Righteous Judge of Dharma for the account of his actions; the egotistical being carries the unbearable load. ||10||

1030.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
1030.t: bin gur saakat kahahu ko tariaa ||
1030.e: Tell me: without the Guru, what faithless cynic has been saved?

1030.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
1030.t: haumai karataa bhavajal pariaa ||
1030.e: Acting egotistically, he falls into the terrifying world-ocean.

1030.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1030.t: bin gur paar na paavai koiee har japeeaai paar utaaraa he ||11||
1030.e: Without the Guru, no one is saved; meditating on the Lord, they are carried across to the other side. ||11||

1030.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
1030.t: gur kee dhaat na meTai koiee ||
1030.e: No one can erase the Guru's blessings.

1030.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
1030.t: jis bakhase tis taare soiee ||
1030.e: The Lord carries across those whom He forgives.

1030.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1030.t: janam maran dhukh neR na aavai man so prabh apar apaaraa he ||12||
1030.e: The pains of birth and death do not even approach those whose minds are filled with God, the infinite and endless. ||12||

1030.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
1030.t: gur te bhoole aavahu jaavahu ||
1030.e: Those who forget the Guru come and go in reincarnation.

1030.g: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
1030.t: janam marahu fun paap kamaavahu ||
1030.e: They are born, only to die again, and continue committing sins.

1030.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1030.t: saakat mooR achet na cheteh dhukh laagai taa raam pukaaraa he ||13||
1030.e: The unconscious, foolish, faithless cynic does not remember the Lord; but when he is stricken with pain, then he cries out for the Lord. ||13||

1030.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
1030.t: sukh dhukh purab janam ke ke'ee ||
1030.e: Pleasure and pain are the consequences of the actions of past lives.

1030.g: ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਦੀਏ ॥
1030.t: so jaanai jin dhaatai dhe'ee ||
1030.e: The Giver, who blesses us with these - He alone knows.

1030.g: ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1030.t: kis kau dhos dheh too praanee sahu apanaa keeaa karaaraa he ||14||
1030.e: So who can you blame, O mortal being? The hardships you suffer are from your own actions. ||14||

1031.e: Practicing egotism and possessiveness, you have come into the world.
Hope and desire bind you and lead you on.

1031.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਚਾਲੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੇ ਛਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1031.t: meree meree karat kiaa le chaale bikh laadhe chhaar bikaaraa he ||15||
1031.e: Indulging in egotism and self-conceit, what will you be able to carry with you, except the load of ashes from poison and corruption? ||15||

1031.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
1031.t: har kee bhagat karahu jan bhaiee ||
1031.e: Worship the Lord in devotion, O humble Siblings of Destiny.
Speak the Unspoken Speech, and the mind will merge back into the Mind.

1031.g: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
1031.t: auTh chalataa Thaak rakhahu ghar apunai dhukh kaaTe kaaTanahaaraa he ||16||
1031.e: Restrain your restless mind within its own home, and the Lord, the Destroyer, shall destroy your pain. ||16||

1031.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਪਰਾਤੀ ॥
1031.t: har gur poore kee oT paraatee ||
1031.e: I seek the support of the Perfect Guru, the Lord.
The Gurmukh loves the Lord; the Gurmukh realizes the Lord.

1031.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੪॥੧੦॥
1031.t: naanak raam naam mat uootam har bakhase paar utaaraa he ||17||4||10||
1031.e: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, the intellect is exalted; granting His forgiveness, the Lord carries him across to the other side. ||17||4||10||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
O Divine Guru, I have entered Your Sanctuary.
You are the Almighty Lord, the Merciful Lord.

1031.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1031.t: tere choj na jaanai koiee too pooraa purakh bidhaataa he ||1||
1031.e: No one knows Your wondrous plays; You are the perfect Architect of Destiny. ||1||
From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You cherish and sustain Your beings.
You are in each and every heart, O Merciful Lord of incomparable beauty.

1031.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1031.t: jiau tudh bhaavai tivai chalaaveh sabh tero keeaa kamaataa he ||2||
1031.e: As You will, You cause all to walk; everyone acts according to Your Command. ||2||
Deep within the nucleus of all, is the Light of the Life of the World.

1031.g: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨ ॥
1031.t: sabh ghaT bhogai har ras peevan ||
1031.e: The Lord enjoys the hearts of all, and drinks in their essence.

1031.g: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1031.t: aape levai aape dhevai tih loiee jagat pit dhaataa he ||3||
1031.e: He Himself gives, and He himself takes; He is the generous father of the beings of the three worlds. ||3||
Creating the world, He has set His play into motion.
He placed the soul in the body of air, water and fire.

1031.g: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਸੋ ਦਸਵਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਹਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1031.t: dhehee nagaree nau dharavaaje so dhasavaa gupat rahaataa he ||4||
1031.e: The body-village has nine gates; the Tenth Gate remains hidden. ||4||
There are four horrible rivers of fire.
How rare is that Gurmukh who understands this, and through the Word of the Shabad, remains unattached.

1031.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਡੂਬਹਿ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1031.t: saakat dhuramat ddoobeh dhaajheh gur raakhe har liv raataa he ||5||
1031.e: The faithless cynics are drowned and burnt through their evil-mindedness. The Guru saves those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||5||
Water, fire, air, earth and ether

1031.g: ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
1031.t: tin meh pa(n)ch tat ghar vaasaa ||
1031.e: in that house of the five elements, they dwell.

1031.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1031.t: satigur sabadh raheh ra(n)g raataa taj maiaa haumai bhraataa he ||6||
1031.e: Those who remain imbued with the Word of the True Guru's Shabad, renounce Maya, egotism and doubt. ||6||
This mind is drenched with the Shabad, and satisfied.
Without the Name, what support can anyone have?

1031.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਇਨਿ ਸਾਕਤਿ ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1031.t: a(n)tar chor muhai ghar ma(n)dhar in saakat dhoot na jaataa he ||7||
1031.e: The temple of the body is being plundered by the thieves within, but this faithless cynic does not even recognize these demons. ||7||
They are argumentative demons, terrifying goblins.
These demons stir up conflict and strife.

1031.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1031.t: sabadh surat bin aavai jaavai pat khoiee aavat jaataa he ||8||
1031.e: Without awareness of the Shabad, one comes and goes in reincarnation; he loses his honor in this coming and going. ||8||
The body of the false person is just a pile of barren dirt.
Without the Name, what honor can you have?

1031.g: ਬਾਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1031.t: baadhe mukat naahee jug chaare jamaka(n)kar kaal paraataa he ||9||
1031.e: Bound and gagged throughout the four ages, there is no liberation; the Messenger of Death keeps such a person under his gaze. ||9||
At Death's door, he is tied up and punished;
such a sinner does not obtain salvation.

1031.g: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਮੀਨੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1031.t: karan palaav kare bilalaavai jiau ku(n)ddee meen paraataa he ||10||
1031.e: He cries out in pain, like the fish pierced by the hook. ||10||
The faithless cynic is caught in the noose all alone.
The miserable spiritually blind person is caught in the power of Death.

1031.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1031.t: raam naam bin mukat na soojhai aaj kaal pach jaataa he ||11||
1031.e: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not known. He shall waste away, today or tomorrow. ||11||
Other than the True Guru, no one is your friend.
Here and hereafter, God is the Savior.

1031.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਇਉ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਮਿਲਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1031.t: raam naam dhevai kar kirapaa iau salalai salal milaataa he ||12||
1031.e: He grants His Grace, and bestows the Lord's Name. He merges with Him, like water with water. ||12||

1032.e: The Guru instructs His wandering Sikhs;
if they go astray, He sets them on the right path.

1032.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1032.t: tis gur sev sadhaa dhin raatee dhukh bha(n)jan sa(n)g sakhaataa he ||13||
1032.e: So serve the Guru, forever, day and night; He is the Destroyer of pain - He is with you as your companion. ||13||

1032.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
1032.t: gur kee bhagat kareh kiaa praanee ||
1032.e: O mortal being, what devotional worship have you performed to the Guru?
Even Brahma, Indra and Shiva do not know it.

1032.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1032.t: satigur alakh kahahu kiau lakheeaai jis bakhase tiseh pachhaataa he ||14||
1032.e: Tell me, how can the unknowable True Guru be known? He alone attains this realization, whom the Lord forgives. ||14||
One who has love within, obtains the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
One who enshrines love for the Word of the Guru's Bani, meets with Him.

1032.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਘਟਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1032.t: ahinis niramal jot sabaiee ghaT dheepak gurmukh jaataa he ||15||
1032.e: Day and night, the Gurmukh sees the immaculate Divine Light everywhere; this lamp illuminates his heart. ||15||
The food of spiritual wisdom is the supremely sweet essence.
Whoever tastes it, sees the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

1032.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
1032.t: dharasan dhekh mile bairaagee man manasaa maar samaataa he ||16||
1032.e: Beholding His Darshan, the unattached one meets the Lord; subduing the mind's desires, he merges into the Lord. ||16||
Those who serve the True Guru are supreme and famous.

1032.g: ਤਿਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
1032.t: tin ghaT ghaT a(n)tar braham pachhaanaa ||
1032.e: Deep within each and every heart, they recognize God.

1032.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੧॥
1032.t: naanak har jas har jan kee sa(n)gat dheejai jin satigur har prabh jaataa he ||17||5||11||
1032.e: Please bless Nanak with the Lord's Praises, and the Sangat, the Congregation of the Lord's humble servants; through the True Guru, they know their Lord God. ||17||5||11||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
The True Lord is the Creator of the Universe.
He established and contemplates the worldly sphere.

1032.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1032.t: aape karataa kar kar vekhai saachaa veparavaahaa he ||1||
1032.e: He Himself created the creation, and beholds it; He is True and independent. ||1||
He created the beings of different kinds.
The two travellers have set out in two directions.

1032.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1032.t: gur poore vin mukat na hoiee sach naam jap laahaa he ||2||
1032.e: Without the Perfect Guru, no one is liberated. Chanting the True Name, one profits. ||2||

1032.g: ਪੜਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
1032.t: paReh manmukh par bidh nahee jaanaa ||
1032.e: The self-willed manmukhs read and study, but they do not know the way.
They do not understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they wander, deluded by doubt.

1032.g: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਵਢੀ ਦੇਨਿ ਉਗਾਹੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1032.t: lai kai vaddee dhen ugaahee dhuramat kaa gal faahaa he ||3||
1032.e: They take bribes, and give false testimony; the noose of evil-mindedness is around their necks. ||3||
They read the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Puraanas;
they argue and debate, but do not know the essence of reality.

1032.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1032.t: vin gur poore tat na paieeaai sach sooche sach raahaa he ||4||
1032.e: Without the Perfect Guru, the essence of reality is not obtained. The true and pure beings walk the Path of Truth. ||4||
All praise God and listen, and listen and speak.
He Himself is wise, and He Himself judges the Truth.

1032.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1032.t: jin kau nadhar kare prabh apanee gurmukh sabadh salaahaa he ||5||
1032.e: Those whom God blesses with His Glance of Grace become Gurmukh, and praise the Word of the Shabad. ||5||
Many listen and listen, and speak the Guru's Bani.

1032.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
1032.t: sun kaheeaai ko a(n)t na jaanee ||
1032.e: Listening and speaking, no one knows His limits.

1032.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1032.t: jaa kau alakh lakhaae aape akath kathaa budh taahaa he ||6||
1032.e: He alone is wise, unto whom the unseen Lord reveals Himself; he speaks the Unspoken Speech. ||6||
At birth, the congratulations pour in;
the ignorant sing songs of joy.

1032.g: ਜੋ ਜਨਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1032.t: jo janamai tis sarapar maranaa kirat piaa sir saahaa he ||7||
1032.e: Whoever is born, is sure to die, according to the destiny of past deeds inscribed upon his head by the Sovereign Lord King. ||7||
Union and separation were created by my God.
Creating the Universe, He gave it pain and pleasure.

1032.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1032.t: dhukh sukh hee te bhe niraale gurmukh seel sanaahaa he ||8||
1032.e: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected by pain and pleasure; they wear the armor of humility. ||8||
The noble people are traders in Truth.
They purchase the true merchandise, contemplating the Guru.

1032.g: ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1032.t: sachaa vakhar jis dhan palai sabadh sachai omaahaa he ||9||
1032.e: One who has the wealth of the true commodity in his lap, is blessed with the rapture of the True Shabad. ||9||
The false dealings lead only to loss.
The trades of the Gurmukh are pleasing to God.

1032.g: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1032.t: poo(n)jee saabat raas salaamat chookaa jam kaa faahaa he ||10||
1032.e: His stock is safe, and his capital is safe and sound. The noose of Death is cut away from around his neck. ||10||

1033.e: Everyone speaks as they please.
The self-willed manmukh, in duality, does not know how to speak.

1033.g: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਅੰਧਲੀ ਬੋਲੀ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1033.t: a(n)dhule kee mat a(n)dhalee bolee aai giaa dhukh taahaa he ||11||
1033.e: The blind person has a blind and deaf intellect; coming and going in reincarnation, he suffers in pain. ||11||

1033.g: ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
1033.t: dhukh meh janamai dhukh meh maranaa ||
1033.e: In pain he is born, and in pain he dies.

1033.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
1033.t: dhookh na miTai bin gur kee saranaa ||
1033.e: His pain is not relieved, without seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru.

1033.g: ਦੂਖੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੂਖੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1033.t: dhookhee upajai dhookhee binasai kiaa lai aaiaa kiaa lai jaahaa he ||12||
1033.e: In pain he is created, and in pain he perishes. What has he brought with himself? And what will he take away? ||12||
True are the actions of those who are under the Guru's influence.
They do not come and go in reincarnation, and they are not subject to the laws of Death.

1033.g: ਡਾਲ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਤੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1033.t: ddaal chhodd tat mool paraataa man saachaa omaahaa he ||13||
1033.e: Whoever abandons the branches, and clings to the true root, enjoys true ecstasy within his mind. ||13||

1033.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
1033.t: har ke log nahee jam maarai ||
1033.e: Death cannot strike down the people of the Lord.
They do not see pain on the most difficult path.

1033.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1033.t: raam naam ghaT a(n)tar poojaa avar na dhoojaa kaahaa he ||14||
1033.e: Deep within the nucleus of their hearts, they worship and adore the Lord's Name; there is nothing else at all for them. ||14||
There is no end to the Lord's sermon and Praise.
As it pleases You, I remain under Your Will.

1033.g: ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1033.t: dharageh paidhe jaan suhele hukam sache paatisaahaa he ||15||
1033.e: I am embellished with robes of honor in the Court of the Lord, by the Order of the True King. ||15||
How can I chant Your uncounted glories?
Even the greatest of the great do not know Your limits.

1033.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੧੨॥
1033.t: naanak saach milai pat raakhahu too sir saahaa paatisaahaa he ||16||6||12||
1033.e: Please bless Nanak with the Truth, and preserve his honor; You are the supreme emperor above the heads of kings. ||16||6||12||
Maaroo, First Mehla, Dakhanee:
Deep within the body-village is the fortress.
The dwelling of the True Lord is within the city of the Tenth Gate.

1033.g: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1033.t: asathir thaan sadhaa niramail aape aap upaidhaa ||1||
1033.e: This place is permanent and forever immaculate. He Himself created it. ||1||
Within the fortress are balconies and bazaars.
He Himself takes care of His merchandise.

1033.g: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਜੜੇ ਜੜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1033.t: bajar kapaaT jaRe jaR jaanai gur sabadhee kholaidhaa ||2||
1033.e: The hard and heavy doors of the Tenth Gate are closed and locked. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are thrown open. ||2||
Within the fortress is the cave, the home of the self.
He established the nine gates of this house, by His Command and His Will.

1033.g: ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1033.t: dhasavai purakh alekh apaaree aape alakh lakhaidhaa ||3||
1033.e: In the Tenth Gate, the Primal Lord, the unknowable and infinite dwells; the unseen Lord reveals Himself. ||3||
Within the body of air, water and fire, the One Lord dwells.
He Himself stages His wondrous dramas and plays.

1033.g: ਬਲਦੀ ਜਲਿ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1033.t: baladhee jal nivarai kirapaa te aape jal nidh paidhaa ||4||
1033.e: By His Grace, water puts out the burning fire; He Himself stores it up in the watery ocean. ||4||
Creating the earth, He established it as the home of Dharma.
Creating and destroying, He remains unattached.

1033.g: ਪਵਣੈ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਕਲਾ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਢਾਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1033.t: pavanai khel keeaa sabh thaiee kalaa khi(n)ch ddaahaidhaa ||5||
1033.e: He stages the play of the breath everywhere. Withdrawing His power, He lets the beings crumble. ||5||
Your gardener is the vast vegetation of nature.
The wind blowing around is the chauree, the fly-brush, waving over You.

1033.g: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਦੀਪਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1033.t: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui dheepak raakhe sas ghar soor samaidhaa ||6||
1033.e: The Lord placed the two lamps, the sun and the moon; the sun merges in the house of the moon. ||6||
The five birds do not fly wild.
The tree of life is fruitful, bearing the fruit of Ambrosial Nectar.

1033.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1033.t: gurmukh sahaj ravai gun gaavai har ras chog chugaidhaa ||7||
1033.e: The Gurmukh intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he eats the food of the Lord's sublime essence. ||7||
The dazzling light glitters, although neither the moon nor the stars are shining;
neither the sun's rays nor the lightning flashes across the sky.

1033.g: ਅਕਥੀ ਕਥਉ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1033.t: akathee kathau chihan nahee koiee poor rahiaa man bhaidhaa ||8||
1033.e: I describe the indescribable state, which has no sign, where the all-pervading Lord is still pleasing to the mind. ||8||
The rays of Divine Light have spread out their brilliant radiance.
Having created the creation, the Merciful Lord Himself gazes upon it.

1033.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1033.t: anahadh run jhunakaar sadhaa dhun nirabhau kai ghar vaidhaa ||9||
1033.e: The sweet, melodious, unstruck sound current vibrates continuously in the home of the fearless Lord. ||9||

1034.e: When the unstruck sound current resounds, doubt and fear run away.
God is all-pervading, giving shade to all.

1034.g: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1034.t: sabh teree too gurmukh jaataa dhar sohai gun gaidhaa ||10||
1034.e: All belong to You; to the Gurmukhs, You are known. Singing Your Praises, they look beautiful in Your Court. ||10||
He is the Primal Lord, immaculate and pure.
I know of no other at all.

1034.g: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1034.t: eka(n)kaar vasai man bhaavai haumai garab gavaidhaa ||11||
1034.e: The One Universal Creator Lord dwells within, and is pleasing to the mind of those who banishe egotism and pride. ||11||
I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, given by the True Guru.
I do not know any other second or third.

1034.g: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਸੁ ਅਪਰ ਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1034.t: eko eku su apar para(n)par parakh khajaanai paidhaa ||12||
1034.e: He is the One, Unique, Infinite and Endless Lord; He evaluates all beings and places some in His treasury. ||12||
Spiritual wisdom and meditation on the True Lord are deep and profound.
No one knows Your expanse.

1034.g: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1034.t: jetee hai tetee tudh jaachai karam milai so paidhaa ||13||
1034.e: All that are, beg from You; You are attained only by Your Grace. ||13||
You hold karma and Dharma in Your hands, O True Lord.
O Independent Lord, Your treasures are inexhaustible.

1034.g: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1034.t: too dhiaal kirapaal sadhaa prabh aape mel milaidhaa ||14||
1034.e: You are forever kind and compassionate, God. You unite in Your Union. ||14||
You Yourself see, and cause Yourself to be seen.
You Yourself establish, and You Yourself disestablish.

1034.g: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1034.t: aape joR vichhoRe karataa aape maar jeevaidhaa ||15||
1034.e: The Creator Himself unites and separates; He Himself kills and rejuvenates. ||15||
As much as there is, is contained within You.
You gaze upon Your creation, sitting within Your royal palace.

1034.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
1034.t: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee har dharasan sukh paidhaa ||16||1||13||
1034.e: Nanak offers this true prayer; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I have found peace. ||16||1||13||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
If I am pleasing to You, Lord, then I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
In loving devotional worship, O True Lord, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

1034.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1034.t: tudh bhaane too bhaaveh karate aape rasan rasaidhaa ||1||
1034.e: By Your Will, O Creator Lord, You have become pleasing to me, and so sweet to my tongue. ||1||
The devotees look beautiful in the Darbaar, the Court of God.
Your slaves, Lord, are liberated.

1034.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1034.t: aap gavai terai ra(n)g raate anadhin naam dhiaaidhaa ||2||
1034.e: Eradicating self-conceit, they are attuned to Your Love; night and day, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
Shiva, Brahma, gods and goddesses,
Indra, ascetics and silent sages serve You.

1034.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਨਵਾਸੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1034.t: jatee satee kete banavaasee a(n)t na koiee paidhaa ||3||
1034.e: Celibates, givers of charity and the many forest-dwellers have not found the Lord's limits. ||3||
No one knows You, unless You let them know You.

1034.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
1034.t: jo kichh kare su aapan bhaanai ||
1034.e: Whatever is done, is by Your Will.

1034.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1034.t: lakh chauraaseeh jeea upaae bhaanai saeh lavaidhaa ||4||
1034.e: You created the 8.4 million species of beings; by Your Will, they draw their breath. ||4||

1034.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
1034.t: jo tis bhaavai so nihachau hovai ||
1034.e: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will, undoubtedly comes to pass.
The self-willed manmukh shows off, and comes to grief.

1034.g: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1034.t: naavahu bhulaa Thaur na paae aai jai dhukh paidhaa ||5||
1034.e: Forgetting the Name, he finds no place of rest; coming and going in reincarnation, he suffers in pain. ||5||
Pure is the body, and immaculate is the swan-soul;
within it is the immaculate essence of the Naam.

1034.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਵੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1034.t: sagale dhookh a(n)mrit kar peevai baahuR dhookh na paidhaa ||6||
1034.e: Such a being drinks in all his pains like Ambrosial Nectar; he never suffers sorrow again. ||6||
For his excessive indulgences, he receives only pain;
from his enjoyments, he contracts diseases, and in the end, he wastes away.

1034.g: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਕਬਹੂ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1034.t: harakhahu sog na miTiee kabahoo vin bhaane bharamaidhaa ||7||
1034.e: His pleasure can never erase his pain; without accepting the Lord's Will, he wanders lost and confused. ||7||
Without spiritual wisdom, they all just wander around.
The True Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere, lovingly engaged.

1034.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1034.t: nirabhau sabadh guroo sach jaataa jotee jot milaidhaa ||8||
1034.e: The Fearless Lord is known through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru; one's light merges into the Light. ||8||
He is the eternal, unchanging, immeasurable Lord.
In an instant, He destroys, ang then reconstructs.

1034.g: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1034.t: roop na rekhiaa mit nahee keemat sabadh bhedh pateeaaidhaa ||9||
1034.e: He has no form or shape, no limit or value. Pierced by the Shabad, one is satisfied. ||9||

1035.e: I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Beloved.
The seekers of Truth and goodness contemplate You.

1035.g: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1035.t: ma(n)ne naau soiee jin jaasee aape saach dhiraRaidhaa ||10||
1035.e: Whoever believes in the Name, wins; He Himself implants Truth within. ||10||
The Truest of the True has the Truth is His lap.
The True Lord is pleased with those who love the Shabad.

1035.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਲਾ ਧਰਿ ਥਾਪੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1035.t: tirabhavan saach kalaa dhar thaapee saache hee pateeaaidhaa ||11||
1035.e: Exerting His power, the Lord has established Truth throughout the three worlds; with Truth He is pleased. ||11||
Everyone calls Him the greatest of the great.

1035.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1035.t: gur bin sojhee kinai na hoiee ||
1035.e: Without the Guru, no one understands Him.

1035.g: ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1035.t: saach milai so saache bhaae naa veechhuR dhukh paidhaa ||12||
1035.e: The True Lord is pleased with those who merge in Truth; they are not separated again, and they do not suffer. ||12||
Separated from the Primal Lord, they loudly weep and wail.
They die and die, only to be reborn, when their time has passed.

1035.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਲਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1035.t: jis bakhase tis dhe vaddiaaiee mel na pachhotaidhaa ||13||
1035.e: He blesses those whom He forgives with glorious greatness; united with Him, they do not regret or repent. ||13 |
| He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
He Himself is satisfied, and He Himself is liberated.

1035.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੀਸਰੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1035.t: aape mukat dhaan mukateesar mamataa moh chukaidhaa ||14||
1035.e: The Lord of liberation Himself grants liberation; He eradicates possessiveness and attachment. ||14||
I consider Your gifts to be the most wonderful gifts.
You are the Cause of causes, Almighty Infinite Lord.

1035.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1035.t: kar kar vekhai keetaa apanaa karanee kaar karaidhaa ||15||
1035.e: Creating the creation, You gaze upon what You have created; You cause all to do their deeds. ||15||
They alone sing Your Glorious Praises, who are pleasing to You, O True Lord.

1035.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
1035.t: tujh te upajeh tujh maeh samaaveh ||
1035.e: They issue forth from You, and merge again into You.

1035.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੪॥
1035.t: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee mil saache sukh paidhaa ||16||2||14||
1035.e: Nanak offers this true prayer; meeting with the True Lord, peace is obtained. ||16||2||14||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
For endless eons, there was only utter darkness.
There was no earth or sky; there was only the infinite Command of His Hukam.

1035.g: ਨਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਨ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1035.t: naa dhin rain na cha(n)dh na sooraj su(n)n samaadh lagaidhaa ||1||
1035.e: There was no day or night, no moon or sun; God sat in primal, profound Samaadhi. ||1||

1035.g: ਖਾਣੀ ਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
1035.t: khaanee na baanee paun na paanee ||
1035.e: There were no sources of creation or powers of speech, no air or water.
There was no creation or destruction, no coming or going.

1035.g: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਪਤ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਦੀ ਨ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1035.t: kha(n)dd pataal sapat nahee saagar nadhee na neer vahaidhaa ||2||
1035.e: There were no continents, nether regions, seven seas, rivers or flowing water. ||2||
There were no heavenly realms, earth or nether regions of the underworld.
There was no heaven or hell, no death or time.

1035.g: ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1035.t: narak surag nahee ja(n)man maranaa naa ko aai na jaidhaa ||3||
1035.e: There was no hell or heaven, no birth or death, no coming or going in reincarnation. ||3||
There was no Brahma, Vishnu or Shiva.
No one was seen, except the One Lord.

1035.g: ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਨਮਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1035.t: naar purakh nahee jaat na janamaa naa ko dhukh sukh paidhaa ||4||
1035.e: There was no female or male, no social class or caste of birth; no one experienced pain or pleasure. ||4||
There were no people of celibacy or charity; no one lived in the forests.
There were no Siddhas or seekers, no one living in peace.

1035.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਭੇਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1035.t: jogee ja(n)gam bhekh na koiee naa ko naath kahaidhaa ||5||
1035.e: There were no Yogis, no wandering pilgrims, no religious robes; no one called himself the master. ||5||

1035.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
1035.t: jap tap sa(n)jam naa brat poojaa ||
1035.e: There was no chanting or meditation, no self-discipline, fasting or worship.
No one spoke or talked in duality.

1035.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1035.t: aape aap upai vigasai aape keemat paidhaa ||6||
1035.e: He created Himself, and rejoiced; He evaluates Himself. ||6||
There was no purification, no self-restraint, no malas of basil seeds.
There were no Gopis, no Krishna, no cows or cowherds.

1035.g: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1035.t: ta(n)t ma(n)t paakha(n)dd na koiee naa ko va(n)s vajaidhaa ||7||
1035.e: There were no tantras, no mantras and no hypocrisy; no one played the flute. ||7||
There was no karma, no Dharma, no buzzing fly of Maya.
Social class and birth were not seen with any eyes.

1035.g: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1035.t: mamataa jaal kaal nahee maathai naa ko kisai dhiaaidhaa ||8||
1035.e: There was no noose of attachment, no death inscribed upon the forehead; no one meditated on anything. ||8||

1035.g: ਨਿੰਦੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਜਿੰਦੋ ॥
1035.t: ni(n)dh bi(n)dh nahee jeeau na ji(n)dho ||
1035.e: There was no slander, no seed, no soul and no life.
There was no Gorakh and no Maachhindra.

1035.g: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕੁਲ ਓਪਤਿ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1035.t: naa tadh giaan dhiaan kul opat naa ko ganat ganaidhaa ||9||
1035.e: There was no spiritual wisdom or meditation, no ancestry or creation, no reckoning of accounts. ||9||

1036.e: There were no castes or social classes, no religious robes, no Brahmin or Kh'shaatriya.
There were no demi-gods or temples, no cows or Gaayatri prayer.

1036.g: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1036.t: hom jag nahee teerath naavan naa ko poojaa laidhaa ||10||
1036.e: There were no burnt offerings, no ceremonial feasts, no cleansing rituals at sacred shrines of pilgrimage; no one worshipped in adoration. ||10||

1036.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਲਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੀ ॥
1036.t: naa ko mulaa naa ko kaajee ||
1036.e: There was no Mullah, there was no Qazi.
There was no Shaykh, or pilgrims to Mecca.

1036.g: ਰਈਅਤਿ ਰਾਉ ਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1036.t: rieeat raau na haumai dhuneeaa naa ko kahan kahaidhaa ||11||
1036.e: There was no king or subjects, and no worldly egotism; no one spoke of himself. ||11||

1036.g: ਭਾਉ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ॥
1036.t: bhaau na bhagatee naa siv sakatee ||
1036.e: There was no love or devotion, no Shiva or Shakti - no energy or matter.
There were no friends or companions, no semen or blood.

1036.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਏਹੋ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1036.t: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa saache eho bhaidhaa ||12||
1036.e: He Himself is the banker, and He Himself is the merchant. Such is the Pleasure of the Will of the True Lord. ||12||
There were no Vedas, Korans or Bibles, no Simritees or Shaastras.
There was no recitation of the Puraanas, no sunrise or sunset.

1036.g: ਕਹਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1036.t: kahataa bakataa aap agochar aape alakh lakhaidhaa ||13||
1036.e: The Unfathomable Lord Himself was the speaker and the preacher; the unseen Lord Himself saw everything. ||13||

1036.g: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
1036.t: jaa tis bhaanaa taa jagat upaiaa ||
1036.e: When He so willed, He created the world.
Without any supporting power, He sustained the universe.

1036.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1036.t: brahamaa bisan mahes upaae maiaa moh vadhaidhaa ||14||
1036.e: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva; He fostered enticement and attachment to Maya. ||14||
How rare is that person who listens to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
He created the creation, and watches over it; the Hukam of His Command is over all.

1036.g: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਅਰੰਭੇ ਗੁਪਤਹੁ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1036.t: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd paataal ara(n)bhe gupatahu paragaTee aaidhaa ||15||
1036.e: He formed the planets, solar systems and nether regions, and brought what was hidden to manifestation. ||15||

1036.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
1036.t: taa kaa a(n)t na jaanai koiee ||
1036.e: No one knows His limits.
This understanding comes from the Perfect Guru.

1036.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੫॥
1036.t: naanak saach rate bisamaadhee bisam bhe gun gaidhaa ||16||3||15||
1036.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Truth are wonderstruck; singing His Glorious Praises, they are filled with wonder. ||16||3||15||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
He Himself created the creation, remaining unattached.
The Merciful Lord has established His True Home.

1036.g: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1036.t: paun paanee aganee kaa ba(n)dhan kaiaa koT rachaidhaa ||1||
1036.e: Binding together air, water and fire, He created the fortress of the body. ||1||
The Creator established the nine gates.
In the Tenth Gate, is the dwelling of the infinite, unseen Lord.

1036.g: ਸਾਇਰ ਸਪਤ ਭਰੇ ਜਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
