1036.t: sair sapat bhare jal niramal gurmukh mail na laidhaa ||2||
1036.e: The seven seas are overflowing with the Ambrosial Water; the Gurmukhs are not stained with filth. ||2||
The lamps of the sun and the moon fill all with light.
Creating them, He beholds His own glorious greatness.

1036.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1036.t: jot saroop sadhaa sukhadhaataa sache sobhaa paidhaa ||3||
1036.e: The Giver of peace is forever the embodiment of Light; from the True Lord, glory is obtained. ||3||
Within the fortress are the stores and markets; the business is transacted there.
The Supreme Merchant weighs with the perfect weights.

1036.g: ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1036.t: aape ratan visaahe levai aape keemat paidhaa ||4||
1036.e: He Himself buys the jewel, and He Himself appraises its value. ||4||
The Appraiser appraises its value.
The Independent Lord is overflowing with His treasures.

1036.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1036.t: sarab kalaa le aape rahiaa gurmukh kisai bujhaidhaa ||5||
1036.e: He holds all powers, He is all-pervading; how few are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this. ||5||
When He bestows His Glance of Grace, one meets the Perfect Guru.
The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot strike him then.

1036.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਬਿਗਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1036.t: jiau jal a(n)tar kamal bigaasee aape bigas dhiaaidhaa ||6||
1036.e: He blossoms forth like the lotus flower in the water; he blossoms forth in joyful meditation. ||6||

1036.g: ਆਪੇ ਵਰਖੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1036.t: aape varakhai a(n)mirat dhaaraa || ratan javehar laal apaaraa ||
1036.e: He Himself rains down the Ambrosial Stream of jewels, diamonds, and rubies of priceless value.

1036.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1036.t: satigur milai ta pooraa paieeaai prem padhaarath paidhaa ||7||
1036.e: When they meet the True Guru, then they find the Perfect Lord; they obtain the treasure of Love. ||7||
Whoever receives the priceless treasure of Love

1036.g: ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਘਾਟਸਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
1036.t: kab hee na ghaaTas pooraa tolo ||
1036.e: - his weight never decreases; he has perfect weight.

1036.g: ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1036.t: sache kaa vaapaaree hovai sacho saudhaa paidhaa ||8||
1036.e: The trader of Truth becomes true, and obtains the merchandise. ||8||
How rare are those who obtain the true merchandise.
Meeting the Perfect True Guru, one meets with the Lord.

1037.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1037.t: gurmukh hoi su hukam pachhaanai maanai hukam samaidhaa ||9||
1037.e: One who becomes Gurmukh realizes the Hukam of His command; surrendering to His Command, one merges in the Lord. ||9||
By His Command we come, and by His command we merge into Him again.
By His Command, the world was formed.

1037.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਲਾ ਰਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1037.t: hukame surag machh piaalaa hukame kalaa rahaidhaa ||10||
1037.e: By His Command, the heavens, this world and the nether regions were created; by His Command, His Power supports them. ||10||
The Hukam of His Command is the mythical bull which supports the burden of the earth on its head.
By His Hukam, air, water and fire came into being.

1037.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1037.t: hukame siv sakatee ghar vaasaa hukame khel khelaidhaa ||11||
1037.e: By His Hukam, one dwells in the house of matter and energy - Shiva and Shakti. By His Hukam, He plays His plays. ||11||
By the Hukam of His command, the sky is spread above.
By His Hukam, His creatures dwell in the water, on the land and throughout the three worlds.

1037.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1037.t: hukame saas giraas sadhaa fun hukame dhekh dhikhaidhaa ||12||
1037.e: By His Hukam, we draw our breath and receive our food; by His Hukam, He watches over us, and inspires us to see. ||12||
By His Hukam, He created His ten incarnations,
and the uncounted and infinite gods and devils.

1037.g: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਝੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1037.t: maanai hukamu su dharageh paijhai saach milai samaidhaa ||13||
1037.e: Whoever obeys the Hukam of His Command, is robed with honor in the Court of the Lord; united with the Truth, He merges in the Lord. ||13||
By the Hukam of His Command, the thirty-six ages passed.
By His Hukam, the Siddhas and seekers contemplate Him.

1037.g: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਥਂੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1037.t: aap naath natha(n)ee sabh jaa kee bakhase mukat karaidhaa ||14||
1037.e: The Lord Himself has brought all under His control. Whoever He forgives, is liberated. ||14||

1037.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਗੜੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸ ਭਲਾ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
1037.t: kaiaa koT gaRai meh raajaa || neb khavaas bhalaa dharavaajaa ||
1037.e: In the strong fortress of the body with its beautiful doors, is the king, with his special assistants and ministers.

1037.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਲਬਿ ਪਾਪਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1037.t: mithiaa lobh naahee ghar vaasaa lab paap pachhutaidhaa ||15||
1037.e: Those gripped by falsehood and greed do not dwell in the celestial home; engrossed in greed and sin, they come to regret and repent. ||15||
Truth and contentment govern this body-village.
Chastity, truth and self-control are in the Sanctuary of the Lord.

1037.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੬॥
1037.t: naanak sahaj milai jagajeevan gur sabadhee pat paidhaa ||16||4||16||
1037.e: O Nanak, one intuitively meets the Lord, the Life of the World; the Word of the Guru's Shabad brings honor. ||16||4||16||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
In the Primal Void, the Infinite Lord assumed His Power.
He Himself is unattached, infinite and incomparable.

1037.g: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1037.t: aape kudharat kar kar dhekhai su(n)nahu su(n)n upaidhaa ||1||
1037.e: He Himself exercised His Creative Power, and He gazes upon His creation; from the Primal Void, He formed the Void. ||1||
From this Primal Void, He fashioned air and water.
He created the universe, and the king in the fortress of the body.

1037.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਕਲਾ ਰਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1037.t: agan paanee jeeau jot tumaaree su(n)ne kalaa rahaidhaa ||2||
1037.e: Your Light pervades fire, water and souls; Your Power rests in the Primal Void. ||2||
From this Primal Void, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva issued forth.
This Primal Void is pervasive throughout all the ages.

1037.g: ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1037.t: eis padh veechaare so jan pooraa tis mileeaai bharam chukaidhaa ||3||
1037.e: That humble being who contemplates this state is perfect; meeting with him, doubt is dispelled. ||3||
From this Primal Void, the seven seas were established.
The One who created them, Himself contemplates them.

1037.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1037.t: tit sat sar manooaa gurmukh naavai fir baahuR jon na paidhaa ||4||
1037.e: That human being who becomes Gurmukh, who bathes in the pool of Truth, is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||
From this Primal Void, came the moon, the sun and the earth.
His Light pervades all the three worlds.

1037.g: ਸੁੰਨੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1037.t: su(n)ne alakh apaar niraalam su(n)ne taaRee laidhaa ||5||
1037.e: The Lord of this Primal Void is unseen, infinite and immaculate; He is absorbed in the Primal Trance of Deep Meditation. ||5||
From this Primal Void, the earth and the Akaashic Ethers were created.

1037.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਥੰਮਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
1037.t: bin tha(n)maa raakhe sach kal paae ||
1037.e: He supports them without any visible support, by exercising His True Power.

1037.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਜਿ ਮੇਖੁਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1037.t: tirabhavan saaj mekhulee maiaa aap upai khapaidhaa ||6||
1037.e: He fashioned the three worlds, and the rope of Maya; He Himself creates and destroys. ||6||
From this Primal Void, came the four sources of creation, and the power of speech.
They were created from the Void, and they will merge into the Void.

1037.g: ਉਤਭੁਜੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਦੇਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1037.t: autabhuj chalat keeaa sir karatai bisamaadh sabadh dhekhaidhaa ||7||
1037.e: The Supreme Creator created the play of Nature; through the Word of His Shabad, He stages His Wondrous Show. ||7||
From this Primal Void, He made both night and day;
creation and destruction, pleasure and pain.

1037.g: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1037.t: sukh dhukh hee te amar ateetaa gurmukh nij ghar paidhaa ||8||
1037.e: The Gurmukh is immortal, untouched by pleasure and pain. He obtains the home of his own inner being. ||8||

1038.g: ਸਾਮ ਵੇਦੁ ਰਿਗੁ ਜੁਜਰੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ॥
1038.t: saam vedh rig jujar atharaban ||
1038.e: The Saam Veda, the Rig Veda, the Jujar Veda and the At'harva Veda

1038.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ॥
1038.t: brahame mukh maiaa hai trai gun ||
1038.e: form the mouth of Brahma; they speak of the three gunas, the three qualities of Maya.

1038.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1038.t: taa kee keemat keh na sakai ko tiau bole jiau bolaidhaa ||9||
1038.e: None of them can describe His worth. We speak as He inspires us to speak. ||9||

1038.g: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸਪਤ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
1038.t: su(n)nahu sapat paataal upaae ||
1038.e: From the Primal Void, He created the seven nether regions.

1038.g: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਭਵਣ ਰਖੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
1038.t: su(n)nahu bhavan rakhe liv laae ||
1038.e: From the Primal Void, He established this world to lovingly dwell upon Him.

1038.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1038.t: aape kaaran keeaa apara(n)par sabh tero keeaa kamaidhaa ||10||
1038.e: The Infinite Lord Himself created the creation. Everyone acts as You make them act, Lord. ||10||

1038.g: ਰਜ ਤਮ ਸਤ ਕਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
1038.t: raj tam sat kal teree chhaiaa ||
1038.e: Your Power is diffused through the three gunas: raajas, taamas and satva.

1038.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1038.t: janam maran haumai dhukh paiaa ||
1038.e: Through egotism, they suffer the pains of birth and death.

1038.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣਿ ਚਉਥੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1038.t: jis no kirapaa kare har gurmukh gun chauthai mukat karaidhaa ||11||
1038.e: Those blessed by His Grace become Gurmukh; they attain the fourth state, and are liberated. ||11||

1038.g: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਉਪਜੇ ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
1038.t: su(n)nahu upaje dhas avataaraa ||
1038.e: From the Primal Void, the ten incarnations welled up.

1038.g: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
1038.t: sirasaT upai keeaa paasaaraa ||
1038.e: Creating the Universe, He made the expanse.

1038.g: ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1038.t: dhev dhaanav gan ga(n)dharab saaje sabh likhiaa karam kamaidhaa ||12||
1038.e: He fashioned the demi-gods and demons, the heavenly heralds and celestial musicians; everyone acts according to their past karma. ||12||

1038.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਝੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1038.t: gurmukh samajhai rog na hoiee ||
1038.e: The Gurmukh understands, and does not suffer the disease.

1038.g: ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
1038.t: eeh gur kee pauRee jaanai jan koiee ||
1038.e: How rare are those who understand this ladder of the Guru.

1038.g: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1038.t: jugeh juga(n)tar mukat parain so mukat bhiaa pat paidhaa ||13||
1038.e: Throughout the ages, they are dedicated to liberation, and so they become liberated; thus they are honored. ||13||

1038.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
1038.t: pa(n)ch tat su(n)nahu paragaasaa ||
1038.e: From the Primal Void, the five elements became manifest.

1038.g: ਦੇਹ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਕਰਮ ਅਭਿਆਸਾ ॥
1038.t: dheh sa(n)jogee karam abhiaasaa ||
1038.e: They joined to form the body, which engages in actions.

1038.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖੇ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1038.t: buraa bhalaa dhui masatak leekhe paap pu(n)n beejaidhaa ||14||
1038.e: Both bad and good are written on the forehead, the seeds of vice and virtue. ||14||

1038.g: ਊਤਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ॥
1038.t: uootam satigur purakh niraale ||
1038.e: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is sublime and detached.

1038.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ॥
1038.t: sabadh rate har ras matavaale ||
1038.e: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, He is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord.

1038.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1038.t: ridh budh sidh giaan guroo te paieeaai poorai bhaag milaidhaa ||15||
1038.e: Riches, intellect, miraculous spiritual powers and spiritual wisdom are obtained from the Guru; through perfect destiny, they are received. ||15||

1038.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ ॥
1038.t: eis man maiaa kau neh ghaneraa ||
1038.e: This mind is so in love with Maya.

1038.g: ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
1038.t: koiee boojhahu giaanee karahu niberaa ||
1038.e: Only a few are spiritually wise enough to understand and know this.

1038.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥
1038.t: aasaa manasaa haumai sahasaa nar lobhee kooR kamaidhaa ||16||
1038.e: In hope and desire, egotism and skepticism, the greedy man acts falsely. ||16||

1038.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1038.t: satigur te paae veechaaraa ||
1038.e: From the True Guru, contemplative meditation is obtained.

1038.g: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਚੇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
1038.t: su(n)n samaadh sache ghar baaraa ||
1038.e: And then, one dwells with the True Lord in His celestial home, the Primal State of Absorption in Deepest Samaadhi.

1038.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੭॥
1038.t: naanak niramal naadh sabadh dhun sach raamai naam samaidhaa ||17||5||17||
1038.e: O Nanak, the immaculate sound current of the Naad, and the Music of the Shabad resound; one merges into the True Name of the Lord. ||17||5||17||

1038.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1038.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
1038.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

1038.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
1038.t: jeh dhekhaa teh dheen dhiaalaa ||
1038.e: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, merciful to the meek.

1038.g: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
1038.t: aai na jaiee prabh kirapaalaa ||
1038.e: God is compassionate; He does not come or go in reincarnation.

1038.g: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1038.t: jeeaa a(n)dhar jugat samaiee rahio niraalam raiaa ||1||
1038.e: He pervades all beings in His mysterious way; the Sovereign Lord remains detached. ||1||

1038.g: ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1038.t: jag tis kee chhaiaa jis baap na maiaa ||
1038.e: The world is a reflection of Him; He has no father or mother.

1038.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੈਣ ਨ ਭਰਾਉ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
1038.t: naa tis bhain na bharaau kamaiaa ||
1038.e: He has not acquired any sister or brother.

1038.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤੀ ਓਹੁ ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1038.t: naa tis opat khapat kul jaatee oh ajaraavar man bhaiaa ||2||
1038.e: There is no creation or destruction for Him; He has no ancestry or social status. The Ageless Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||2||

1038.g: ਤੂ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲਾ ॥
1038.t: too akaal purakh naahee sir kaalaa ||
1038.e: You are the Deathless Primal Being. Death does not hover over Your head.

1038.g: ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਗੰਮ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
1038.t: too purakh alekh aga(n)m niraalaa ||
1038.e: You are the unseen inaccessible and detached Primal Lord.

1038.g: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤਿ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1038.t: sat sa(n)tokh sabadh at seetal sahaj bhai liv laiaa ||3||
1038.e: You are true and content; the Word of Your Shabad is cool and soothing. Through it, we are lovingly, intuitively attuned to You. ||3||

1038.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਵਰਤਾਇ ਚਉਥੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
1038.t: trai varatai chauthai ghar vaasaa ||
1038.e: The three qualities are pervasive; the Lord dwells in His home, the fourth state.

1038.g: ਕਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਲ ਕੀਏ ਇਕ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
1038.t: kaal bikaal ke'ee ik graasaa ||
1038.e: He has made death and birth into a bite of food.

1038.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1038.t: niramal jot sarab jagajeevan gur anahadh sabadh dhikhaiaa ||4||
1038.e: The immaculate Light is the Life of the whole world. The Guru reveals the unstruck melody of the Shabad. ||4||

1038.g: ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
1038.t: uootam jan sa(n)t bhale har piaare ||
1038.e: Sublime and good are those humble Saints, the Beloveds of the Lord.

1038.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
1038.t: har ras maate paar utaare ||
1038.e: They are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and are carried across to the other side.

1038.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਣ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
1038.t: naanak ren sa(n)t jan sa(n)gat har gur parasaadhee paiaa ||5||
1038.e: Nanak is the dust of the Society of the Saints; by Guru's Grace, he finds the Lord. ||5||

1038.g: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜੀਅ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
1038.t: too a(n)tarajaamee jeea sabh tere ||
1038.e: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. All beings belong to You.

1039.e: You are the Great Giver; I am Your slave.

1039.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
1039.t: a(n)mirat naam kirapaa kar dheejai gur giaan ratan dheepaiaa ||6||
1039.e: Please be merciful and bless me with Your Ambrosial Naam, and the jewel, the lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom. ||6||

1039.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
1039.t: pa(n)ch tat mil ih tan keeaa ||
1039.e: From the union of the five elements, this body was made.
Finding the Lord, the Supreme Soul, peace is established.

1039.g: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
1039.t: karam karatoot a(n)mirat fal laagaa har naam ratan man paiaa ||7||
1039.e: The good karma of past actions brings fruitful rewards, and man is blessed with the jewel of the Lord's Name. ||7||

1039.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
1039.t: naa tis bhookh piaas man maaniaa ||
1039.e: His mind does not feel any hunger or thirst.
He knows the Immaculate Lord to be everywhere, in each and every heart.

1039.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਕੇਵਲ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
1039.t: a(n)mirat ras raataa keval bairaagee gurmat bhai subhaiaa ||8||
1039.e: Imbued with the Lord's Ambrosial essence, he becomes a pure, detached renunciate; he is lovingly absorbed in the Guru's Teachings. ||8||
Whoever does the deeds of the soul, day and night,
sees the immaculate Divine Light deep within.

1039.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੇਣੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
1039.t: sabadh rasaal rasan ras rasanaa ben rasaal vajaiaa ||9||
1039.e: Enraptured with the delightful essence of the Shabad, the source of nectar, my tongue plays the sweet music of the flute. ||9||
He alone plays the sweet music of this flute,
who knows the three worlds.

1039.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
1039.t: naanak boojhahu ieh bidh gurmat har raam naam liv laiaa ||10||
1039.e: O Nanak, know this, through the Guru's Teachings, and lovingly focus yourself on the Lord's Name. ||10||
Rare are those beings in this world,
who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and remain detached.

1039.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
1039.t: aap tareh sa(n)gat kul taareh tin safal janam jag aaiaa ||11||
1039.e: They save themselves, and save all their associates and ancestors; fruitful is their birth and coming into this world. ||11||
He alone knows the home of his own heart, and the door to the temple,

1039.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
1039.t: jis poore gur te sojhee hoiee ||
1039.e: who obtains perfect understanding from the Guru.

1039.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜ ਮਹਲ ਮਹਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
1039.t: kaiaa gaR mahal mahalee prabh saachaa sach saachaa takhat rachaiaa ||12||
1039.e: In the body-fortress is the palace; God is the True Master of this Palace. The True Lord established His True Throne there. ||12||

1039.g: ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਹਾਟ ਦੀਵੇ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
1039.t: chatur dhas haaT dheeve dhui saakhee ||
1039.e: The fourteen realms and the two lamps are the witnesses.
The Lord's servants, the self-elect, do not taste the poison of corruption.

1039.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
1039.t: a(n)tar vasat anoop niramolak gur miliaai har dhan paiaa ||13||
1039.e: Deep within, is the priceless, incomparable commodity; meeting with the Guru, the wealth of the Lord is obtained. ||13||
He alone sits on the throne, who is worthy of the throne.
Following the Guru's Teachings, he subdues the five demons, and becomes the Lord's foot soldier.

1039.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
1039.t: aadh jugaadhee hai bhee hosee sahasaa bharam chukaiaa ||14||
1039.e: He has existed from the very beginning of time and throughout the ages; He exists here and now, and will always exist. Meditating on Him, skepticism and doubt are dispelled. ||14||
The Lord of the Throne is greeted and worshipped day and night.

1039.g: ਇਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
1039.t: eih saach vaddaiee gurmat liv jaatee ||
1039.e: This true glorious greatness comes to those who love the Guru's Teachings.

1039.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੧੮॥
1039.t: naanak raam japahu tar taaree har a(n)t sakhaiee paiaa ||15||1||18||
1039.e: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, and swim across the river; they find the Lord, their best friend, in the end. ||15||1||18||
Maaroo, First Mehla:

1039.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਰੇ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
1039.t: har dhan sa(n)chahu re jan bhaiee ||
1039.e: Gather in the wealth of the Lord, O humble Siblings of Destiny.
Serve the True Guru, and remain in His Sanctuary.

1039.g: ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1039.t: tasakar chor na laagai taa kau dhun upajai sabadh jagaiaa ||1||
1039.e: This wealth cannot be stolen; the celestial melody of the Shabad wells up and keeps us awake and aware. ||1||
You are the One Universal Creator, the Immaculate King.

1039.g: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
1039.t: too aap savaareh jan ke kaajaa ||
1039.e: You Yourself arrange and resolve the affairs of Your humble servant.

1039.g: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1039.t: amar addol apaar amolak har asathir thaan suhaiaa ||2||
1039.e: You are immortal, immovable, infinite and priceless; O Lord, Your place is beautiful and eternal. ||2||
In the body-village, the most sublime place,
the supremely noble people dwell.

1039.g: ਊਪਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1039.t: uoopar eka(n)kaar niraalam su(n)n samaadh lagaiaa ||3||
1039.e: Above them is the Immaculate Lord, the One Universal Creator; they are lovingly absorbed in the profound, primal state of Samaadhi. ||3||
There are nine gates to the body-village;
the Creator Lord fashioned them for each and every person.

1039.g: ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1039.t: dhasavai purakh ateet niraalaa aape alakh lakhaiaa ||4||
1039.e: Within the Tenth Gate, dwells the Primal Lord, detached and unequalled. The unknowable reveals Himself. ||4||
The Primal Lord cannot be held to account; True is His Celestial Court.
The Hukam of His Command is in effect; True is His Insignia.

1039.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
1039.t: naanak khoj lahahu ghar apanaa har aatam raam naam paiaa ||5||
1039.e: O Nanak, search and examine your own home, and you shall find the Supreme Soul, and the Name of the Lord. ||5||

1040.e: The Primal Lord is everywhere, immaculate and all-knowing.
He administers justice, and is absorbed in the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

1040.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੈ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
1040.t: kaam karodh lai garadhan maare haumai lobh chukaiaa ||6||
1040.e: He seizes sexual desire and anger by their necks, and kills them; He eradicates egotism and greed. ||6||
In the True Place, the Formless Lord abides.
Whoever understands his own self, contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

1040.g: ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
1040.t: sachai mahal nivaas nira(n)tar aavan jaan chukaiaa ||7||
1040.e: He comes to abide deep within the True Mansion of His Presence, and his comings and goings are ended. ||7||

1040.g: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਪਉਣੁ ਉਡਾਵੈ ॥
1040.t: naa man chalai na paun uddaavai ||
1040.e: His mind does not waver, and he is not buffeted by the winds of desire.
Such a Yogi vibrates the unstruck sound current of the Shabad.

1040.g: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
1040.t: pa(n)ch sabadh jhunakaar niraalam prabh aape vai sunaiaa ||8||
1040.e: God Himself plays the pure music of the Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds to hear. ||8||
In the Fear of God, in detachment, one intuitively merges into the Lord.
Renouncing egotism, he is imbued with the unstruck sound current.

1040.g: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
1040.t: a(n)jan saar nira(n)jan jaanai sarab nira(n)jan raiaa ||9||
1040.e: With the ointment of enlightenment, the Immaculate Lord is known; the Immaculate Lord King is pervading everywhere. ||9||
God is eternal and imperishable; He is the Destroyer of pain and fear.
He cures the disease, and cuts away the noose of death.

1040.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
1040.t: naanak har prabh so bhau bha(n)jan gur miliaai har prabh paiaa ||10||
1040.e: O Nanak, the Lord God is the Destroyer of fear; meeting the Guru, the Lord God is found. ||10||
One who knows the Immaculate Lord chews up death.
One who understands karma, realizes the Word of the Shabad.

1040.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
1040.t: aape jaanai aap pachhaanai sabh tis kaa choj sabaiaa ||11||
1040.e: He Himself knows, and He Himself realizes. This whole world is all His play. ||11||
He Himself is the Banker, and He Himself is the Merchant.
The Appraiser Himself appraises.

1040.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
1040.t: aape kas kasavaTee laae aape keemat paiaa ||12||
1040.e: He Himself tests upon His Touchstone, and He Himself estimates the value. ||12||
God Himself, the Merciful Lord, grants His Grace.
The Gardener pervades and permeates each and every heart.

1040.g: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
1040.t: purakh ateet vasai nihakeval gur purakhai purakh milaiaa ||13||
1040.e: The pure, primal, detached Lord abides within all. The Guru, the Lord Incarnate, leads us to meet the Lord God. ||13||
God is wise and all-knowing; He purges men of their pride.
Eradicating duality, the One Lord reveals Himself.

1040.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
1040.t: aasaa maeh niraalam jonee akul nira(n)jan gaiaa ||14||
1040.e: Such a being remains unattached amidst hope, singing the Praise of the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. ||14||
Eradicating egotism, he obtains the peace of the Shabad.
He alone is spiritually wise, who contemplates his own self.

1040.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੨॥੧੯॥
1040.t: naanak har jas har gun laahaa satasa(n)gat sach fal paiaa ||15||2||19||
1040.e: O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the true profit is obtained; in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the fruit of Truth is obtained. ||15||2||19||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
Speak the Truth, and remain in the home of Truth.
Remain dead while yet alive, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

1040.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1040.t: gur bohith gur beRee tulahaa man har jap paar la(n)ghaiaa ||1||
1040.e: The Guru is the boat, the ship, the raft; meditating on the Lord in your mind, you shall be carried across to the other side. ||1||
Eliminating egotism, possessiveness and greed,
one is liberated from the nine gates, and obtains a place in the Tenth Gate.

1040.g: ਊਪਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1040.t: uoopar parai parai apara(n)par jin aape aap upaiaa ||2||
1040.e: Lofty and high, the farthest of the far and infinite, He created Himself. ||2||
Receiving the Guru's Teachings, and lovingly attuned to the Lord, one crosses over.

1040.g: ਅਕਲੁ ਗਾਇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਡਰੀਐ ॥
1040.t: akal gai jam te kiaa ddareeaai ||
1040.e: Singing the Praises of the absolute Lord, why should anyone be afraid of death?

1040.g: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1040.t: jat jat dhekhau tat tat tum hee avar na dhuteeaa gaiaa ||3||
1040.e: Wherever I look, I see only You; I do not sing of any other at all. ||3||

1040.g: ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
1040.t: sach har naam sach hai saranaa ||
1040.e: True is the Lord's Name, and True is His Sanctuary.

1040.g: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਤੈ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
1040.t: sach gur sabadh jitai lag taranaa ||
1040.e: True is the Word of the Guru's Shabad, grasping it, one is carries across.

1040.g: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1040.t: akath kathai dhekhai apara(n)par fun garabh na jonee jaiaa ||4||
1040.e: Speaking the Unspoken, one sees the Infinite Lord, and then, he does not have to enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

1040.g: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1040.t: sach bin sat sa(n)tokh na paavai ||
1040.e: Without the Truth, no one finds sincerity or contentment.

1040.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
1040.t: bin gur mukat na aavai jaavai ||
1040.e: Without the Guru, no one is liberated; coming and going in reincarnation continue.

1040.g: ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
1040.t: mool ma(n)tr har naam rasain kahu naanak pooraa paiaa ||5||
1040.e: Chanting the Mool Mantra, and the Name of the Lord, the source of nectar, says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Lord. ||5||

1041.g: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
1041.t: sach bin bhavajal jai na tariaa ||
1041.e: Without the Truth, the terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed.

1041.g: ਏਹੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
1041.t: eh samu(n)dh athaahu mahaa bikh bhariaa ||
1041.e: This ocean is vast and unfathomable; it is overflowing with the worst poison.

1041.g: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
1041.t: rahai ateet gurmat le uoopar har nirabhau kai ghar paiaa ||6||
1041.e: One who receives the Guru's Teachings, and remains aloof and detached, obtains a place in the home of the Fearless Lord. ||6||
False is the cleverness of loving attachment to the world.
In no time at all, it comes and goes.

1041.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
1041.t: naam visaar chaleh abhimaanee upajai binas khapaiaa ||7||
1041.e: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the proud egotistical people depart; in creation and destruction they are wasted away. ||7||
In creation and destruction, they are bound in bondage.
The noose of egotism and Maya is around their necks.

1041.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
1041.t: jis raam naam naahee mat gurmat so jam pur ba(n)dh chalaiaa ||8||
1041.e: Whoever does not accept the Guru's Teachings, and does not dwell upon the Lord's Name, is bound and bagged, and dragged into the City of Death. ||8||

1041.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
1041.t: gur bin mokh mukat kiau paieeaai ||
1041.e: Without the Guru, how can anyone be emancipated or liberated?

1041.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
1041.t: bin gur raam naam kiau dhiaaieeaai ||
1041.e: Without the Guru, how can anyone meditate on the Lord's Name?

1041.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਤਰਹੁ ਭਵ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
1041.t: gurmat leh tarahu bhav dhutar mukat bhe sukh paiaa ||9||
1041.e: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over the arduous, terrifying world-ocean; you shall be emancipated, and find peace. ||9||
Through the Guru's Teachings, Krishna lifted up the mountain of Govardhan.
Through the Guru's Teachings, Rama floated stones across the ocean.

1041.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
1041.t: gurmat leh param padh paieeaai naanak gur bharam chukaiaa ||10||
1041.e: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, the supreme status is obtained; O Nanak, the Guru eradicates doubt. ||10||
Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over to the other side through Truth.
O soul, remember the Lord within your heart.

1041.g: ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
1041.t: jam ke faahe kaaTeh har jap akul nira(n)jan paiaa ||11||
1041.e: The noose of death is cut away, meditating on the Lord; you shall obtain the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. ||11||
Through the Guru's Teachings, the Holy become one's friends and Siblings of Destiny.
Through the Guru's Teachings, the inner fire is subdued and extinguished.

1041.g: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
1041.t: man mukh naam japahu jagajeevan ridh a(n)tar alakh lakhaiaa ||12||
1041.e: Chant the Naam with your mind and mouth; know the unknowable Lord, the Life of the World, deep within the nucleus of your heart. ||12||
The Gurmukh understands, and is pleased with the Word of the Shabad.
Who does he praise or slander?

1041.g: ਚੀਨਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
1041.t: cheenahu aap japahu jagadheesar har jaga(n)naath man bhaiaa ||13||
1041.e: Know yourself, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe; let your mind be pleased with the Lord, the Master of the Universe. ||13||
Know the One who pervades all the realms of the universe.
As Gurmukh, understand and realize the Shabad.

1041.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਾ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
1041.t: ghaT ghaT bhoge bhoganahaaraa rahai ateet sabaiaa ||14||
1041.e: The Enjoyer enjoys each and every heart, and yet He remains detached from all. ||14||
Through the Guru's Teachings, chant the Pure Praises of the Lord.
Through the Guru's Teachings, behold the lofty Lord with your eyes.

1041.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੩॥੨੦॥
1041.t: sravanee naam sunai har baanee naanak har ra(n)g ra(n)gaiaa ||15||3||20||
1041.e: Whoever listens to the Lord's Name, and the Word of His Bani, O Nanak, is imbued with the color of the Lord's Love. ||15||3||20||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
Leave behind sexual desire, anger and the slander of others.
Renounce greed and possessiveness, and become carefree.

1041.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਤੋੜਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1041.t: bhram kaa sa(n)gal toR niraalaa har a(n)tar har ras paiaa ||1||
1041.e: Break the chains of doubt, and remain unattached; you shall find the Lord, and the Lord's sublime essence, deep within yourself. ||1||

1041.g: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਚਮਕਿ ਚੰਦਾਇਣੁ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
1041.t: nis dhaaman jiau chamak cha(n)dhain dhekhai ||
1041.e: As one sees the flash of lightning in the night,
see the Divine Light deep within your nucleus, day and night.

1041.g: ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਸਰੂਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1041.t: aana(n)dh roop anoop saroopaa gur poorai dhekhaiaa ||2||
1041.e: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, incomparably beautiful, reveals the Perfect Guru. ||2||
So meet with the True Guru, and God Himself will save you.
He placed the lamps of the sun and the moon in the home of the sky.

1041.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਭੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1041.t: dhekh adhisaT rahahu liv laagee sabh tirabhavan braham sabaiaa ||3||
1041.e: See the invisible Lord, and remain absorbed in loving devotion. God is all throughout the three worlds. ||3||

1041.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਉ ਜਾਏ ॥
1041.t: a(n)mirat ras paae tirasanaa bhau jaae ||
1041.e: Obtaining the sublime ambrosial essence, desire and fear are dispelled.
The state of inspired illumination is obtained, and self-conceit is eradicated.

1041.g: ਊਚੀ ਪਦਵੀ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1041.t: uoochee padhavee uoocho uoochaa niramal sabadh kamaiaa ||4||
1041.e: The lofty and exalted state, the highest of the high is obtained, practicing the immaculate Word of the Shabad. ||4||
The Naam, the Name of the invisible and unfathomable Lord, is infinite.

1042.e: The sublime essence of the Beloved Naam is utterly sweet.

1042.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
1042.t: naanak kau jug jug har jas dheejai har japeeaai a(n)t na paiaa ||5||
1042.e: O Lord, please bless Nanak with Your Praise in each and every age; meditating on the Lord, I cannot find His limits. ||5||
With the Naam deep within the nucleus of the self, the jewel is obtained.

1042.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
1042.t: har japate man man te dheeraa ||
1042.e: Meditating on the Lord, the mind is comforted and consoled by the mind itself.

1042.g: ਦੁਘਟ ਘਟ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
1042.t: dhughaT ghaT bhau bha(n)jan paieeaai baahuR janam na jaiaa ||6||
1042.e: On that most difficult path, the Destroyer of fear is found, and one does not have to enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||6||
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, inspiration for loving devotional worship wells up.
I beg for the treasure of the Naam, and the Lord's Praise.

1042.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
1042.t: har bhaavai gur mel milaae har taare jagat sabaiaa ||7||
1042.e: When it pleases the Lord, He unites me in Union with the Guru; the Lord saves the whole world. ||7||

1042.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਵਾ ਕੇ ॥
1042.t: jin jap japio satigur mat vaa ke ||
1042.e: One who chants the Lord's Chant, attains the Wisdom of the True Guru.

1042.g: ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਗ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥
1042.t: jamaka(n)kar kaal sevak pag taa ke ||
1042.e: The tyrant, the Messenger of Death, becomes a servant at his feet.

1042.g: ਊਤਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
1042.t: uootam sa(n)gat gat mit uootam jag bhaujal paar taraiaa ||8||
1042.e: In the noble congregation of the Sangat, one's state and way of life become noble as well, and one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||8||

1042.g: ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
1042.t: eih bhavajal jagat sabadh gur tareeaai ||
1042.e: Through the Shabad, one crosses over this terrifying world-ocean.
The duality within is burnt away from within.

1042.g: ਪੰਚ ਬਾਣ ਲੇ ਜਮ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
1042.t: pa(n)ch baan le jam kau maarai gagana(n)tar dhanakh chaRaiaa ||9||
1042.e: Taking up the five arrows of virtue, Death is killed, drawing the Bow of the Tenth Gate in the Mind's Sky. ||9||

1042.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
1042.t: saakat nar sabadh surat kiau paieeaai ||
1042.e: How can the faithless cynics attain enlightened awareness of the Shabad?
Without awareness of the Shabad, they come and go in reincarnation.

1042.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
1042.t: naanak gurmukh mukat parain har poorai bhaag milaiaa ||10||
1042.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains the support of liberation; by perfect destiny, he meets the Lord. ||10||
The Fearless True Guru is our Savior and Protector.
Devotional worship is obtained through the Guru, the Lord of the world.

1042.g: ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
1042.t: dhun ana(n)dh anaahadh vaajai gur sabadh nira(n)jan paiaa ||11||
1042.e: The blissful music of the unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is obtained. ||11||
He alone is fearless, who has no destiny written on His head.
God Himself is unseen; He reveals Himself through His wondrous creative power.

1042.g: ਆਪਿ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
1042.t: aap ateet ajonee sa(n)bhau naanak gurmat so paiaa ||12||
1042.e: He Himself is unattached, unborn and self-existent. O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, He is found. ||12||
The True Guru knows the state of one's inner being.
He alone is fearless, who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1042.g: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
1042.t: a(n)tar dhekh nira(n)tar boojhai anat na man ddolaiaa ||13||
1042.e: He looks within his own inner being, and realizes the Lord within all; his mind does not waver at all. ||13||
He alone is fearless, within whose being the Lord abides.
Day and night, he is delighted with the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1042.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
1042.t: naanak har jas sa(n)gat paieeaai har sahaje sahaj milaiaa ||14||
1042.e: O Nanak, in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the Lord's Praise is obtained, and one easily, intuitively meets the Lord. ||14||
One who knows God, within the self and beyond,
remains detached, and brings his wandering mind back to its home.

1042.g: ਊਪਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਸਰਬ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੪॥੨੧॥
1042.t: uoopar aadh sarab tih loiee sach naanak a(n)mirat ras paiaa ||15||4||21||
1042.e: The True Primal Lord is over all the three worlds; O Nanak, His Ambrosial Nectar is obtained. ||15||4||21||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
The Creator Lord is infinite; His creative power is wondrous.
Created beings have no power over Him.

1042.g: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੇ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1042.t: jeea upai rijak dhe aape sir sir hukam chalaiaa ||1||
1042.e: He formed the living beings, and He Himself sustains them; the Hukam of His Command controls each and every one. ||1||
The all-pervading Lord orchestrates all through His Hukam.
Who is near, and who is far away?

1042.g: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਕੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1042.t: gupat pragaT har ghaT ghaT dhekhahu varatai taak sabaiaa ||2||
1042.e: Behold the Lord, both hidden and manifest, in each and every heart; the unique Lord is permeating all. ||2||
One whom the Lord unites with Himself, merges in conscious awareness.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord's Name.

1042.g: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਰਮੁ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1042.t: aanadh roop anoop agochar gur miliaai bharam jaiaa ||3||
1042.e: God is the embodiment of bliss, incomparably beautiful and unfathomable; meeting with the Guru, doubt is dispelled. ||3||

1042.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
1042.t: man tan dhan te naam piaaraa ||
1042.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is more dear to me than my mind, body and wealth.
In the end, when I must depart, it shall be my only help and support.

1043.g: ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1043.t: moh pasaar nahee sa(n)g belee bin har gur kin sukh paiaa ||4||
1043.e: In this world of love and attachment, no one is anyone else's friend or companion; without the Lord, without the Guru, who has ever found peace? ||4||

1043.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
1043.t: jis kau nadhar kare gur pooraa ||
1043.e: He, unto whom the Perfect Guru grants His Grace,
is merged in the Word of the Shabad, through the Teachings of the brave, heroic Guru.

1043.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
1043.t: naanak gur ke charan sarevahu jin bhoolaa maarag paiaa ||5||
1043.e: O Nanak, dwell upon, and serve at the Guru's feet; He places those who wander back on the Path. ||5||

1043.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
1043.t: sa(n)t janaa(n) har dhan jas piaaraa ||
1043.e: The wealth of the Lord's Praise is very dear to the humble Saints.
Through the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained Your Name, Lord.

1043.g: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
1043.t: jaachik sev kare dhar har kai har dharageh jas gaiaa ||6||
1043.e: The beggar serves at the Lord's door, and in the Court of the Lord, sings His Praises. ||6||
When one meets the True Guru, he is called into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
In the True Court, he is blessed with salvation and honor.

1043.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਜਨਮ ਮਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
1043.t: saakat Thaur naahee har ma(n)dhar janam marai dhukh paiaa ||7||
1043.e: The faithless cynic has no place of rest in the Lord's palace; he suffers the pains of birth and death. ||7||
So serve the True Guru, the unfathomable ocean,
and you shall obtain the profit, the wealth, the jewel of the Naam.

1043.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
1043.t: bikhiaa mal jai a(n)mirat sar naavahu gur sar sa(n)tokh paiaa ||8||
1043.e: The filth of corruption is washed away, by bathing in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar. In the Guru's pool, contentment is obtained. ||8||
So serve the Guru without hesitation.
And in the midst of hope, remain unmoved by hope.

1043.g: ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
1043.t: sa(n)saa dhookh binaasan sevahu fir baahuR rog na laiaa ||9||
1043.e: Serve the Eradicator of cynicism and suffering, and you shall never again be afflicted by the disease. ||9||
One who is pleasing to the True Lord is blessed with glorious greatness.
Who else can teach him anything?

1043.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
1043.t: har gur moorat ekaa varatai naanak har gur bhaiaa ||10||
1043.e: The Lord and the Guru are pervading in one form. O Nanak, the Lord loves the Guru. ||10||
Some read scriptures, the Vedas and the Puraanas.
Some sit and listen, and read to others.

1043.g: ਅਜਗਰ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਖੁਲੑੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
1043.t: ajagar kapaT kahahu kiau khul(h)ai bin satigur tat na paiaa ||11||
1043.e: Tell me, how can the heavy, rigid doors be opened? Without the True Guru, the essence of reality is not realized. ||11||
Some collect dust, and smear their bodies with ashes;
but deep within them are the outcasts of anger and egotism.

1043.g: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕੀਨੇ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
1043.t: paakha(n)dd keene jog na paieeaai bin satigur alakh na paiaa ||12||
1043.e: Practicing hypocrisy, Yoga is not obtained; without the True Guru, the unseen Lord is not found. ||12||
Some make vows to visit sacred shrines of pilgrimage, keep fasts and live in the forest.
Some practice chastity, charity and self-discipline, and speak of spiritual wisdom.

1043.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
1043.t: raam naam bin kiau sukh paieeaai bin satigur bharam na jaiaa ||13||
1043.e: But without the Lord's Name, how can anyone find peace? Without the True Guru, doubt is not dispelled. ||13||
Inner cleansing techniques, channeling the energy to raise the Kundalini to the Tenth Gate,
inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath by the force of the mind -

1043.g: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਧਰਮੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
1043.t: paakha(n)dd dharam preet nahee har sau gur sabadh mahaa ras paiaa ||14||
1043.e: by empty hypocritical practices, Dharmic love for the Lord is not produced. Only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sublime, supreme essence obtained. ||14||
Seeing the Lord's creative power, my mind remains satisfied.
Through the Guru's Shabad, I have realized that all is God.

1043.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੫॥੨੨॥
1043.t: naanak aatam raam sabaiaa gur satigur alakh lakhaiaa ||15||5||22||
1043.e: O Nanak, the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is in all. The Guru, the True Guru, has inspired me to see the unseen Lord. ||15||5||22||
Maaroo, Solhay, Third Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
By the Hukam of His Command, He effortlessly created the Universe.
Creating the creation, He gazes upon His own greatness.

1043.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1043.t: aape kare karaae aape hukame rahiaa samaiee he ||1||
1043.e: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act; in His Will, He pervades and permeates all. ||1||
The world is in the darkness of love and attachment to Maya.
How rare is that Gurmukh who contemplates, and understands.

1043.g: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1043.t: aape nadhar kare so paae aape mel milaiee he ||2||
1043.e: He alone attains the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace. He Himself unites in His Union. ||2||

1044.e: Uniting with Himself, He bestows glorious greatness.
By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the Lord's worth.

1044.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1044.t: manmukh bahut firai bilalaadhee dhoojai bhai khuaaiee he ||3||
1044.e: The self-willed manmukh wanders everywhere, weeping and wailing; he is utterly ruined by the love of duality. ||3||
Egotism was instilled into the illusion of Maya.
The self-willed manmukh is deluded, and loses his honor.

1044.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1044.t: gurmukh hovai so nai raachai saachai rahiaa samaiee he ||4||
1044.e: But one who becomes Gurmukh is absorbed in the Name; he remains immersed in the True Lord. ||4||

1044.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1044.t: gur te giaan naam ratan paiaa ||
1044.e: Spiritual wisdom is obtained from the Guru, along with the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Desires are subdued, and one remains immersed in the mind.

1044.g: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1044.t: aape khel kare sabh karataa aape dhei bujhaiee he ||5||
1044.e: The Creator Himself stages all His plays; He Himself bestows understanding. ||5||
One who serves the True Guru eradicates self-conceit.
Meeting with his Beloved, he finds peace through the Word of the Shabad.

1044.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਤੇ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1044.t: a(n)tar piaar bhagatee raataa sahaj mate ban aaiee he ||6||
1044.e: Deep within his inner being, he is imbued with loving devotion; intuitively, he becomes one with the Lord. ||6||
The Destroyer of pain is known through the Guru.
The Great Giver, the Life of the world, Himself has met me.

1044.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1044.t: jis no laae soiee boojhai bhau bharam sareerahu jaiee he ||7||
1044.e: He alone understands, whom the Lord joins with Himself. Fear and doubt are taken away from his body. ||7||
He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself bestows His blessings.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, serve the True Guru.

1044.g: ਜਰਾ ਜਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1044.t: jaraa jam tis joh na saakai saache siau ban aaiee he ||8||
1044.e: Old age and death cannot even touch one who is in harmony with the True Lord. ||8||
The world is burning up in the fire of desire.
It burns and burns, and is destroyed in all its corruption.

1044.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕਬਹੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1044.t: manmukh Thaur na paae kabahoo satigur boojh bujhaiee he ||9||
1044.e: The self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest anywhere. The True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||9||
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
They remain lovingly focused on the True Name forever.

1044.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1044.t: a(n)tar naam raviaa nihakeval tirasanaa sabadh bujhaiee he ||10||
1044.e: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, permeates the nucleus of their inner being; through the Shabad, their desires are quenched. ||10||
True is the Word of the Shabad, and True is the Bani of His Word.
How rare is that Gurmukh who realizes this.

1044.g: ਸਚੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1044.t: sache sabadh rate bairaagee aavan jaan rahaiee he ||11||
1044.e: Those who are imbued with the True Shabad are detached. Their comings and goings in reincarnation are ended. ||11||
One who realizes the Shabad is cleansed of impurities.
The Immaculate Naam abides within his mind.

1044.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1044.t: satigur apanaa sadh hee seveh haumai vichahu jaiee he ||12||
1044.e: He serves his True Guru forever, and egotism is eradicated from within. ||12||

1044.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
1044.t: gur te boojhai taa dhar soojhai ||
1044.e: If one comes to understand, through the Guru, then he comes to know the Lord's Door.
But without the Naam, one babbles and argues in vain.

1044.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1044.t: satigur seve kee vaddiaaiee tirasanaa bhookh gavaiee he ||13||
1044.e: The glory of serving the True Guru is that it eradicates hunger and thirst. ||13||
When the Lord unites them with Himself, then they come to understand.
Without spiritual wisdom, they understand nothing at all.

1044.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1044.t: gur kee dhaat sadhaa man a(n)tar baanee sabadh vajaiee he ||14||
1044.e: One whose mind is filled with the Guru's gift forever - his inner being resounds with the Shabad, and the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||14||

1044.g: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
1044.t: jo dhur likhiaa su karam kamaiaa ||
1044.e: He acts according to his pre-ordained destiny.
No one can erase the Command of the Primal Lord.

1044.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਵਾਸਾ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1044.t: satasa(n)gat meh tin hee vaasaa jin kau dhur likh paiee he ||15||
1044.e: They alone dwell in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||15||
He alone finds the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace.
He links his consciousness to the deep meditative state of the True Shabad.

1044.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
1044.t: naanak dhaas kahai bena(n)tee bheekhiaa naam dhar paiee he ||16||1||
1044.e: Nanak, Your slave, offers this humble prayer; I stand at Your Door, begging for Your Name. ||16||1||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
The One and only Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere.
How rare is that person, who as Gurmukh, understands this.

1044.g: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1044.t: eko rav rahiaa sabh a(n)tar tis bin avar na koiee he ||1||
1044.e: The One Lord is permeating and pervading, deep within the nucleus of all. Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||
He created the 8.4 millions species of beings.

1045.g: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
1045.t: giaanee dhiaanee aakh sunaae ||
1045.e: The spiritual teachers and meditators proclaim this.

1045.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1045.t: sabhanaa rijak samaahe aape keemat hor na hoiee he ||2||
1045.e: He Himself nourishes all; no one else can estimate His value. ||2||

1045.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
1045.t: maiaa moh a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||
1045.e: Love and attachment to Maya are utter darkness.

1045.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
1045.t: haumai meraa pasariaa paasaaraa ||
1045.e: Egotism and possessiveness have spread throughout the expanse of the universe.

1045.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1045.t: anadhin jalat rahai dhin raatee gur bin saa(n)t na hoiee he ||3||
1045.e: Night and day, they burn, day and night; without the Guru, there is no peace or tranquility. ||3||

1045.g: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
1045.t: aape joR vichhoRe aape ||
1045.e: He Himself unites, and He Himself separates.

1045.g: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
1045.t: aape thaap uthaape aape ||
1045.e: He Himself establishes, and He Himself disestablishes.

1045.g: ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ਹੋਰਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1045.t: sachaa hukam sachaa paasaaraa horan hukam na hoiee he ||4||
1045.e: True is the Hukam of His Command, and True is the expanse of His universe. No one else can issue any Command. ||4||

1045.g: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
1045.t: aape lai le so laagai ||
1045.e: He alone is attached to the Lord, whom the Lord attaches to Himself.

1045.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
1045.t: gur parasaadhee jam kaa bhau bhaagai ||
1045.e: By Guru's Grace, the fear of death runs away.

1045.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1045.t: a(n)tar sabadh sadhaa sukhadhaataa gurmukh boojhai koiee he ||5||
1045.e: The Shabad, the Giver of peace, dwells forever deep within the nucleus of the self. One who is Gurmukh understands. ||5||

1045.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
1045.t: aape mele mel milaae ||
1045.e: God Himself unites those united in His Union.

1045.g: ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
1045.t: purab likhiaa so meTanaa na jaae ||
1045.e: Whatever is pre-ordained by destiny, cannot be erased.

1045.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1045.t: anadhin bhagat kare dhin raatee gurmukh sevaa hoiee he ||6||
1045.e: Night and day, His devotees worship Him, day and night; one who becomes Gurmukh serves Him. ||6||

1045.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
1045.t: satigur sev sadhaa sukh jaataa ||
1045.e: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is experienced.

1045.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
1045.t: aape aai miliaa sabhanaa kaa dhaataa ||
1045.e: He Himself, the Giver of all, has come and met me.

1045.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1045.t: haumai maar tirasanaa agan nivaaree sabadh cheen sukh hoiee he ||7||
1045.e: Subduing egotism, the fire of thirst has been extinguished; contemplating the Word of the Shabad, peace is found. ||7||

1045.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
1045.t: kaiaa kuTa(n)b moh na boojhai ||
1045.e: One who is attached to his body and family, does not understand.

1045.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਆਖੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
1045.t: gurmukh hovai ta aakhee soojhai ||
1045.e: But one who becomes Gurmukh, sees the Lord with his eyes.

1045.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1045.t: anadhin naam ravai dhin raatee mil preetam sukh hoiee he ||8||
1045.e: Night and day, he chants the Naam, day and night; meeting with his Beloved, he finds peace. ||8||

1045.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਧਾਤੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੈ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
1045.t: manmukh dhaat dhoojai hai laagaa ||
1045.e: The self-willed manmukh wanders distracted, attached to duality.

1045.g: ਜਨਮਤ ਕੀ ਨ ਮੂਓ ਆਭਾਗਾ ॥
1045.t: janamat kee na mooo aabhaagaa ||
1045.e: That unfortunate wretch - why didn't he just die as soon as he was born?

1045.g: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1045.t: aavat jaat birathaa janam gavaiaa bin gur mukat na hoiee he ||9||
1045.e: Coming and going, he wastes away his life in vain. Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||9||

1045.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
1045.t: kaiaa kusudh haumai mal laiee ||
1045.e: That body which is stained with the filth of egotism is false and impure.

1045.g: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1045.t: je sau dhoveh taa mail na jaiee ||
1045.e: It may be washed a hundred times, but its filth is still not removed.

1045.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਧੋਪੈ ਤਾ ਹਛੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1045.t: sabadh dhopai taa hachhee hovai fir mailee mool na hoiee he ||10||
1045.e: But if it is washed with the Word of the Shabad, then it is truly cleansed, and it shall never be soiled again. ||10||

1045.g: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੰਘਾਰਹਿ ॥
1045.t: pa(n)ch dhoot kaiaa sa(n)ghaareh ||
1045.e: The five demons destroy the body.

1045.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ॥
1045.t: mar mar ja(n)meh sabadh na veechaareh ||
1045.e: He dies and dies again, only to be reincarnated; he does not contemplate the Shabad.

1045.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1045.t: a(n)tar maiaa moh gubaaraa jiau supanai sudh na hoiee he ||11||
1045.e: The darkness of emotional attachment to Maya is within his inner being; as if in a dream, he does not understand. ||11||

1045.g: ਇਕਿ ਪੰਚਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਹੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
1045.t: eik pa(n)chaa maar sabadh hai laage ||
1045.e: Some conquer the five demons, by being attached to the Shabad.

1045.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
1045.t: satigur aai miliaa vaddabhaage ||
1045.e: They are blessed and very fortunate; the True Guru comes to meet them.

1045.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1045.t: a(n)tar saach raveh ra(n)g raate sahaj samaavai soiee he ||12||
1045.e: Within the nucleus of their inner being, they dwell upon the Truth; attuned to the Lord's Love, they intuitively merge in Him. ||12||

1045.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
1045.t: gur kee chaal guroo te jaapai ||
1045.e: The Guru's Way is known through the Guru.

1045.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
1045.t: pooraa sevak sabadh sin(j)aapai ||
1045.e: His perfect servant attains realization through the Shabad.

1045.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1045.t: sadhaa sabadh ravai ghaT a(n)tar rasanaa ras chaakhai sach soiee he ||13||
1045.e: Deep within his heart, he dwells forever upon the Shabad; he tastes the sublime essence of the True Lord with his tongue. ||13||

1045.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
1045.t: haumai maare sabadh nivaare ||
1045.e: Egotism is conquered and subdued by the Shabad.

1045.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
1045.t: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaare ||
1045.e: I have enshrined the Name of the Lord within my heart.

1045.g: ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1045.t: ekas bin hau hor na jaanaa sahaje hoi su hoiee he ||14||
1045.e: Other than the One Lord, I know nothing at all. Whatever will be, will automatically be. ||14||

1045.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1045.t: bin satigur sahaj kinai nahee paiaa ||
1045.e: Without the True Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom.

1045.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
1045.t: gurmukh boojhai sach samaiaa ||
1045.e: The Gurmukh understands, and is immersed in the True Lord.

1045.g: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1045.t: sachaa sev sabadh sach raate haumai sabadhe khoiee he ||15||
1045.e: He serves the True Lord, and is attuned to the True Shabad. The Shabad banishes egotism. ||15||

1045.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
1045.t: aape gunadhaataa beechaaree ||
1045.e: He Himself is the Giver of virtue, the Contemplative Lord.

1045.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
1045.t: gurmukh dheveh pakee saaree ||
1045.e: The Gurmukh is given the winning dice.

1045.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
1045.t: naanak naam samaaveh saachai saache te pat hoiee he ||16||2||
1045.e: O Nanak, immersed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one becomes true; from the True Lord, honor is obtained. ||16||2||

1045.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1045.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
1045.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1045.g: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
1045.t: jagajeevan saachaa eko dhaataa ||
1045.e: One One True Lord is the Life of the World, the Great Giver.

1045.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
1045.t: gur sevaa te sabadh pachhaataa ||
1045.e: Serving the Guru, through the Word of the Shabad, He is realized.

1046.g: ਏਕੋ ਅਮਰੁ ਏਕਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1046.t: eko amar ekaa patisaahee jug jug sir kaar banaiee he ||1||
1046.e: There is only One Command, and there is only One Supreme King. In each and every age, He links each to their tasks. ||1||

1046.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
1046.t: so jan niramal jin aap pachhaataa ||
1046.e: That humble being is immaculate, who knows his own self.
The Lord, the Giver of peace, Himself comes and meets him.

1046.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1046.t: rasanaa sabadh ratee gun gaavai dhar saachai pat paiee he ||2||
1046.e: His tongue is imbued with the Shabad, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he is honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||2||
The Gurmukh is blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam.
The self-willed manmukh, the slanderer, loses his honor.

1046.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1046.t: naam rate param ha(n)s bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laiee he ||3||
1046.e: Attuned to the Naam, the supreme soul-swans remain detached; in the home of the self, they remain absorbed in deep meditative trance. ||3||
That humble being who dies in the Shabad is perfect.
The brave, heroic True Guru chants and proclaims this.

1046.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1046.t: kaiaa a(n)dhar a(n)mirat sar saachaa man peevai bhai subhaiee he ||4||
1046.e: Deep within the body is the true pool of Ambrosial Nectar; the mind drinks it in with loving devotion. ||4||
The Pandit, the religious scholar, reads and instructs others,

1046.g: ਘਰ ਜਲਤੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
1046.t: ghar jalate kee khabar na paae ||
1046.e: but he does not realize that his own home is on fire.

1046.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1046.t: bin satigur seve naam na paieeaai paR thaake saa(n)t na aaiee he ||5||
1046.e: Without serving the True Guru, the Naam is not obtained. You can read until you are exhausted, but you shall not find peace and tranquility. ||5||
Some smear their bodies with ashes, and wander around in religious disguises.
Without the Word of the Shabad, who has ever subdued egotism?

1046.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੇਖਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1046.t: anadhin jalat raheh dhin raatee bharam bhekh bharamaiee he ||6||
1046.e: Night and day, they continue burning, day and night; they are deluded and confused by their doubt and religious costumes. ||6||

1046.g: ਇਕਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
1046.t: eik gireh kuTa(n)b meh sadhaa udhaasee ||
1046.e: Some, in the midst of their household and family, remain always unattached.
They die in the Shabad, and dwell in the Lord's Name.

1046.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1046.t: anadhin sadhaa raheh ra(n)g raate bhai bhai bhagat chit laiee he ||7||
1046.e: Night and day, they remain forever attuned to His Love; they focus their consciousness on loving devotion and the Fear of God. ||7||
The self-willed manmukh indulges in slander, and is ruined.
The dog of greed barks within him.

1046.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1046.t: jamakaal tis kadhe na chhoddai a(n)t giaa pachhutaiee he ||8||
1046.e: The Messenger of Death never leaves him, and in the end, he leaves, regretting and repenting. ||8||
Through the True Word of the Shabad, true honor is obtained.

1046.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
1046.t: bin naavai mukat na paavai koiee ||
1046.e: Without the Name, no one attains liberation.

1046.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਐਸੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1046.t: bin satigur ko naau na paae prabh aaisee banat banaiee he ||9||
1046.e: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name. Such is the making which God has made. ||9||
Some are Siddhas and seekers, and great contemplators.
Some remain imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, day and night.

1046.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1046.t: jis no aap milaae so boojhai bhagat bhai bhau jaiee he ||10||
1046.e: He alone understands, whom the Lord unites with Himself; through loving devotional worship, fear is dispelled. ||10||
Some take cleansing baths and give donations to charities, but they do not understand.

1046.g: ਇਕਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝਹਿ ॥
1046.t: eik manooaa maar manai siau loojheh ||
1046.e: Some struggle with their minds, and conquer and subdue their minds.

1046.g: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1046.t: saachai sabadh rate ik ra(n)gee saachai sabadh milaiee he ||11||
1046.e: Some are imbued with love for the True Word of the Shabad; they merge with the True Shabad. ||11||
He Himself creates and bestows glorious greatness.
By the Pleasure of His Will, He bestows union.

1046.g: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਇਉ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1046.t: aape nadhar kare man vasiaa merai prabh iau furamaiee he ||12||
1046.e: Bestowing His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind; such is the Command ordained by my God. ||12||
Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true.
The false, self-willed manmukhs do not know how to serve the Guru.

1046.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1046.t: aape karataa kar kar vekhai jiau bhaavai tiau laiee he ||13||
1046.e: The Creator Himself creates the creation and watches over it; he attaches all according to the Pleasure of His Will. ||13||
In each and every age, the True Lord is the one and only Giver.
Through perfect destiny, one realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1046.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1046.t: sabadh mile se vichhuRe naahee nadharee sahaj milaiee he ||14||
1046.e: Those who are immersed in the Shabad are not separated again. By His Grace, they are intuitively immersed in the Lord. ||14||
Acting in egotism, they are stained with the filth of Maya.
They die and die again, only to be reborn in the love of duality.

1046.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1046.t: bin satigur seve mukat na hoiee man dhekhahu liv laiee he ||15||
1046.e: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds liberation. O mind, tune into this, and see. ||15||

1047.e: He does whatever He pleases.
No one has done, or can do anything by himself.

1047.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
1047.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee dhar saachai pat paiee he ||16||3||
1047.e: O Nanak, through the Name, one is blessed with glorious greatness, and obtains honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||16||3||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1047.g: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
1047.t: jo aaiaa so sabh ko jaasee ||
1047.e: All who come shall have to depart.
In the love of duality, they are caught by the noose of the Messenger of Death.

1047.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1047.t: satigur raakhe se jan ubare saache saach samaiee he ||1||
1047.e: Those humble beings who are protected by the True Guru, are saved. They merge into the Truest of the True. ||1||
The Creator Himself creates the creation, and watches over it.

1047.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
1047.t: jis no nadhar kare soiee jan lekhai ||
1047.e: Thay alone are acceptable, upon whom He bestows His Glance of Grace.

1047.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1047.t: gurmukh giaan tis sabh kichh soojhai agiaanee a(n)dh kamaiee he ||2||
1047.e: The Gurmukh attains spiritual wisdom, and understands everything. The ignorant ones act blindly. ||2||
The self-willed manmukh is cynical; he doesn't understand.
He dies and dies again, only to be reborn, and loses his life uselessly again.

1047.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1047.t: gurmukh naam rate sukh paiaa sahaje saach samaiee he ||3||
1047.e: The Gurmukh is imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he find peace, and is intuitively immersed in the True Lord. ||3||
Chasing after worldly affairs, the mind has become corroded and rusty.

1047.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
1047.t: fir hovai ka(n)chan bheTai gur pooraa ||
1047.e: But meeting with the Perfect Guru, it is transmuted into gold once again.

1047.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1047.t: aape bakhas le sukh paae poorai sabadh milaiee he ||4||
1047.e: When the Lord Himself grants forgiveness, then peace is obtained; through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, one is united with Him. ||4||
The false and evil-minded are the most wicked of the wicked.
They are the most unworthy of the unworthy.

1047.g: ਕਚੀ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1047.t: kachee mat feekaa mukh bolai dhuramat naam na paiee he ||5||
1047.e: With false intellect, and insipid words of mouth, evil-minded, they do not obtain the Naam. ||5||
The unworthy soul-bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord.
False-minded, her actions are false.

1047.g: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1047.t: pir kaa saau na jaanai moorakh bin gur boojh na paiee he ||6||
1047.e: The foolish person does not know the excellence of her Husband Lord. Without the Guru, she does not understand at all. ||6||
The evil-minded, wicked soul-bride practices wickedness.

1047.g: ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਰ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1047.t: seegaar kare pir khasam na bhaavai ||
1047.e: She decorates herself, but her Husband Lord is not pleased.

1047.g: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1047.t: gunava(n)tee sadhaa pir raavai satigur mel milaiee he ||7||
1047.e: The virtuous soul-bride enjoys and ravishes her Husband Lord forever; the True Guru unites her in His Union. ||7||
God Himself issues the Hukam of His Command, and beholds all.
Some are forgiven, according to their pre-ordained destiny.

1047.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1047.t: anadhin naam rate sach paiaa aape mel milaiee he ||8||
1047.e: Night and day, they are imbued with the Naam, and they find the True Lord. He Himself unites them in His Union. ||8||
Egotism attaches them to the juice of emotional attachment, and makes them run around.
The Gurmukh is intuitively immersed in the True Love of the Lord.

1047.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1047.t: aape melai aape kar vekhai bin satigur boojh na paiee he ||9||
1047.e: He Himself unites, He Himself acts, and beholds. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained. ||9||

1047.g: ਇਕਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
1047.t: eik sabadh veechaar sadhaa jan jaage ||
1047.e: Some contemplate the Word of the Shabad; these humble beings remain always awake and aware.

1047.g: ਇਕਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
1047.t: eik maiaa moh soi rahe abhaage ||
1047.e: Some are attached to the love of Maya; these unfortunate ones remain asleep.

1047.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1047.t: aape kare karaae aape hor karanaa kichhoo na jaiee he ||10||
1047.e: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act; no one else can do anything. ||10||
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, death is conquered and killed.

1047.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
1047.t: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaare ||
1047.e: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined within your heart.

1047.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1047.t: satigur sevaa te sukh paiaa har kai naam samaiee he ||11||
1047.e: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained, and one merges in the Name of the Lord. ||11||
In the love of duality, the world wanders around insane.
Immersed in love and attachment to Maya, it suffers in pain.

1047.g: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਨਹ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1047.t: bahute bhekh karai neh paae bin satigur sukh na paiee he ||12||
1047.e: Wearing all sorts of religious robes, He is not obtained. Without the True Guru, peace is not found. ||12||

1047.g: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
1047.t: kis no kaheeaai jaa aap karaae ||
1047.e: Who is to blame, when He Himself does everything?
As He wills, so is the path we take.

1047.g: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1047.t: aape miharavaan sukhadhaataa jiau bhaavai tivai chalaiee he ||13||
1047.e: He Himself is the Merciful Giver of peace; as He wills, so do we follow. ||13||
He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
He Himself is detached, and He Himself is attached.

1047.g: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1047.t: aape niramal miharavaan madhusoodhan jis dhaa hukam na meTiaa jaiee he ||14||
1047.e: He Himself is immaculate, compassionate, the lover of nectar; the Hukam of His Command cannot be erased. ||14||
Those who know the One Lord are very fortunate.

1048.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
1048.t: ghaT ghaT vas rahiaa jagajeevan dhaataa ||
1048.e: He dwells in each and every heart, the Great Giver, the Life of the world.

1048.g: ਇਕ ਥੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1048.t: eik thai gupat paragaT hai aape gurmukh bhram bhau jaiee he ||15||
1048.e: At the same time, He is both hidden and revealed. For the Gurmukh, doubt and fear are dispelled. ||15||

1048.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
1048.t: gurmukh har jeeau eko jaataa ||
1048.e: The Gurmukh knows the One, the Dear Lord.

1048.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
1048.t: a(n)tar naam sabadh pachhaataa ||
1048.e: Deep within the nucleus of his inner being, is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he realizes the Word of the Shabad.

1048.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
1048.t: jis too dheh soiee jan paae naanak naam vaddaiee he ||16||4||
1048.e: He alone receives it, unto whom You give it. O Nanak, the Naam is glorious greatness. ||16||4||

1048.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1048.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
1048.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1048.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥
1048.t: sach saalaahee gahir ga(n)bheerai ||
1048.e: I praise the true, profound and unfathomable Lord.

1048.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
1048.t: sabh jag hai tis hee kai cheerai ||
1048.e: All the world is in His power.

1048.g: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1048.t: sabh ghaT bhogavai sadhaa dhin raatee aape sookh nivaasee he ||1||
1048.e: He enjoys all hearts forever, day and night; He Himself dwells in peace. ||1||

1048.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
1048.t: sachaa saahib sachee naiee ||
1048.e: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name.

1048.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
1048.t: gur parasaadhee ma(n)n vasaiee ||
1048.e: By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.

1048.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1048.t: aape aai vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar tooTee jam kee faasee he ||2||
1048.e: He Himself has come to dwell deep within the nucleus of my heart; the noose of death has been snapped. ||2||

1048.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
1048.t: kis sevee tai kis saalaahee ||
1048.e: Whom should I serve, and whom should I praise?

1048.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
1048.t: satigur sevee sabadh saalaahee ||
1048.e: I serve the True Guru, and praise the Word of the Shabad.

1048.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1048.t: sachai sabadh sadhaa mat uootam a(n)tar kamal pragaasee he ||3||
1048.e: Through the True Shabad, the intellect is exalted and ennobled forever, and the lotus deep within blossoms forth. ||3||

1048.g: ਦੇਹੀ ਕਾਚੀ ਕਾਗਦ ਮਿਕਦਾਰਾ ॥
1048.t: dhehee kaachee kaagadh mikadhaaraa ||
1048.e: The body is frail and perishable, like paper.

1048.g: ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਢਹਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
1048.t: boo(n)dh pavai binasai ddahat na laagai baaraa ||
1048.e: When the drop of water falls upon it, it crumbles and dissolves instantaneously.

1048.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1048.t: ka(n)chan kaiaa gurmukh boojhai jis a(n)tar naam nivaasee he ||4||
1048.e: But the body of the Gurmukh, who understands, is like gold; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells deep within. ||4||

1048.g: ਸਚਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
1048.t: sachaa chaukaa surat kee kaaraa ||
1048.e: Pure is that kitchen, which is enclosed by spiritual awareness.

1048.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
1048.t: har naam bhojan sach aadhaaraa ||
1048.e: The Lord's Name is my food, and Truth is my support.

1048.g: ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1048.t: sadhaa tirapat pavitr hai paavan jit ghaT har naam nivaasee he ||5||
1048.e: Forever satisfied, sanctified and pure is that person, within whose heart the Lord's Name abides. ||5||

1048.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
1048.t: hau tin balihaaree jo saachai laage ||
1048.e: I am a sacrifice to those who are attached to the Truth.

1048.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
1048.t: har gun gaaveh anadhin jaage ||
1048.e: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and remain awake and aware night and day.

1048.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1048.t: saachaa sookh sadhaa tin a(n)tar rasanaa har ras raasee he ||6||
1048.e: True peace fills them forever, and their tongues savor the sublime essence of the Lord. ||6||

1048.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
1048.t: har naam chetaa avar na poojaa ||
1048.e: I remember the Lord's Name, and no other at all.

1048.g: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
1048.t: eko sevee avar na dhoojaa ||
1048.e: I serve the One Lord, and no other at all.

1048.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1048.t: poorai gur sabh sach dhikhaiaa sachai naam nivaasee he ||7||
1048.e: The Perfect Guru has revealed the whole Truth to me; I dwell in the True Name. ||7||

1048.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
1048.t: bhram bhram jonee fir fir aaiaa ||
1048.e: Wandering, wandering in reincarnation, again and again, he comes into the world.

1048.g: ਆਪਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾ ਖਸਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
1048.t: aap bhoolaa jaa khasam bhulaiaa ||
1048.e: He is deluded and confused, when the Lord and Master confuses him.

1048.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1048.t: har jeeau milai taa gurmukh boojhai cheenai sabadh abinaasee he ||8||
1048.e: He meets with the Dear Lord, when, as Gurmukh, he understands; he remembers the Shabad, the Word of the immortal, eternal Lord God. ||8||

1048.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਭਰੇ ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥
1048.t: kaam karodh bhare ham aparaadhee ||
1048.e: I am a sinner, overflowing with sexual desire and anger.

1048.g: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਬੋਲਹ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
1048.t: kiaa muh lai boleh naa ham gun na sevaa saadhee ||
1048.e: With what mouth should I speak? I have no virtue, and I have rendered no service.

1048.g: ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1048.t: ddubadhe paathar mel laih tum aape saach naam abinaasee he ||9||
1048.e: I am a sinking stone; please, Lord, unite me with Yourself. Your Name is eternal and imperishable. ||9||

1048.g: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
1048.t: naa koiee kare na karanai jogaa ||
1048.e: No one does anything; no one is able to do anything.

1048.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਇਗਾ ॥
1048.t: aape kareh karaaveh su hoigaa ||
1048.e: That alone happens, which the Lord Himself does, and causes to be done.

1048.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1048.t: aape bakhas laih sukh paae sadh hee naam nivaasee he ||10||
1048.e: Those whom He Himself forgives, find peace; they dwell forever in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||

1048.g: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਜਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1048.t: eih tan dharatee sabadh beej apaaraa ||
1048.e: This body is the earth, and the infinite Shabad is the seed.

1048.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
1048.t: har saache setee vanaj vaapaaraa ||
1048.e: Deal and trade with the True Name alone.

1048.g: ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1048.t: sach dhan ja(n)miaa toT na aavai a(n)tar naam nivaasee he ||11||
1048.e: The True wealth increases; it is never exhausted, when the Naam dwells deep within. ||11||

1048.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਨੋ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
1048.t: har jeeau avaganiaare no gun keejai ||
1048.e: O Dear Lord, please bless me, the worthless sinner, with virtue.

1048.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
1048.t: aape bakhas laih naam dheejai ||
1048.e: Forgive me, and bless me with Your Name.

1048.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਇਕਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1048.t: gurmukh hovai so pat paae ikat naam nivaasee he ||12||
