1048.e: One who becomes Gurmukh, is honored; he dwells in the Name of the One Lord alone. ||12||

1048.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1048.t: a(n)tar har dhan samajh na hoiee ||
1048.e: The wealth of the Lord is deep within one's inner being, but he does not realize it.

1048.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
1048.t: gur parasaadhee boojhai koiee ||
1048.e: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand.

1048.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1048.t: gurmukh hovai so dhan paae sadh hee naam nivaasee he ||13||
1048.e: One who becomes Gurmukh is blessed with this wealth; he lives forever in the Naam. ||13||

1048.g: ਅਨਲ ਵਾਉ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
1048.t: anal vaau bharam bhulaiee ||
1048.e: Fire and wind lead him into delusions of doubt.

1049.e: In love and attachment to Maya, he has no understanding at all.

1049.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1049.t: manmukh a(n)dhe kichhoo na soojhai gurmat naam pragaasee he ||14||
1049.e: The blind, self-willed manmukh sees nothing; through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is gloriously revealed. ||14||
The manmukhs are asleep in egotism and Maya.

1049.g: ਅਪਣਾ ਘਰੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ॥
1049.t: apanaa ghar na samaaleh a(n)t vigoote ||
1049.e: They do not watch over their own homes, and are ruined in the end.

1049.g: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੈ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1049.t: par ni(n)dhaa kareh bahu chi(n)taa jaalai dhukhe dhukh nivaasee he ||15||
1049.e: They slander others, and burn in great anxiety; they dwell in pain and suffering. ||15||
The Creator Himself has created the creation.
He blesses the Gurmukh with understanding.

1049.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
1049.t: naanak naam rate man niramal naame naam nivaasee he ||16||5||
1049.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam - their minds become immaculate; they dwell in the Naam, and only the Naam. ||16||5||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
I serve the One Lord, who is eternal, stable and True.
Attached to duality, the whole world is false.

1049.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1049.t: gurmatee sadhaa sach saalaahee saache hee saach pateejai he ||1||
1049.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, I praise the True Lord forever, pleased with the Truest of the True. ||1||

1049.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
1049.t: tere gun bahute mai ek na jaataa ||
1049.e: Your Glorious Virtues are so many, Lord; I do not know even one.
The Life of the world, the Great Giver, attaches us to himself.

1049.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1049.t: aape bakhase dhe vaddiaaiee gurmat ih man bheejai he ||2||
1049.e: He Himself forgives, and bestows glorious greatness. Following the Guru's Teachings, this mind is delighted. ||2||
The Word of the Shabad has subdued the waves of Maya.
Egotism has been conquered, and this mind has become immaculate.

1049.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1049.t: sahaje gun gaavai ra(n)g raataa rasanaa raam raveejai he ||3||
1049.e: I intuitively sing His Glorious Praises, imbued with the Lord's Love. My tongue chants and savors the Lord's Name. ||3||
Crying out, ""Mine, mine!"" he spends his life.
The self-willed manmukh does not understand; he wanders around in ignorance.

1049.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਰਜਾ ਛੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1049.t: jamakaal ghaRee muhat nihaale anadhin aarajaa chheejai he ||4||
1049.e: The Messenger of Death watches over him every moment, every instant; night and day, his life is wasting away. ||4||
He practices greed within, and does not understand.
He does not see the Messenger of Death hovering over his head.

1049.g: ਐਥੈ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਆਇਆ ਅੰਤਕਾਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1049.t: aaithai kamaanaa su agai aaiaa a(n)takaal kiaa keejai he ||5||
1049.e: Whatever one does in this world, will come to face him in the hereafter; what can he do at that very last moment? ||5||

1049.g: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
1049.t: jo sach laage tin saachee soi ||
1049.e: Those who are attached to the Truth are true.
The self-willed manmukhs, attached to duality, weep and wail.

1049.g: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1049.t: dhuhaa siriaa kaa khasam hai aape aape gun meh bheejai he ||6||
1049.e: He is the Lord and Master of both worlds; He Himself delights in virtue. ||6||

1049.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
1049.t: gur kai sabadh sadhaa jan sohai ||
1049.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His humble servant is exalted forever.
This mind is enticed by the Naam, the source of nectar.

1049.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1049.t: maiaa moh mail pata(n)g na laagai gurmatee har naam bheejai he ||7||
1049.e: It is not stained at all by the dirt of attachment to Maya; through the Guru's Teachings, it is pleased and saturated with the Lord's Name. ||7||
The One Lord is contained within all.
By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

1049.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਇ ਸਾਚੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1049.t: haumai maar sadhaa sukh paiaa nai saachai a(n)mrit peejai he ||8||
1049.e: One who subdues his ego, finds lasting peace; he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name. ||8||
God is the Destroyer of sin and pain.
The Gurmukh serves Him, and contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

1049.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1049.t: sabh kichh aape aap varatai gurmukh tan man bheejai he ||9||
1049.e: He Himself is pervading everything. The Gurmukh's body and mind are saturated and pleased. ||9||
The world is burning in the fire of Maya.
The Gurmukh extinguishes this fire, by contemplating the Shabad.

1049.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1049.t: a(n)tar saa(n)t sadhaa sukh paiaa gurmatee naam leejai he ||10||
1049.e: Deep within are peace and tranquility, and lasting peace is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, one is blessed with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||

1049.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
1049.t: ei(n)dhr i(n)dhraasan baiThe jam kaa bhau paaveh ||
1049.e: Even Indra, seated upon his throne, is caught in the fear of death.

1049.g: ਜਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
1049.t: jam na chhoddai bahu karam kamaaveh ||
1049.e: The Messenger of Death will not spare them, even though they try all sorts of things.

1049.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1049.t: satigur bheTai taa mukat paieeaai har har rasanaa peejai he ||11||
1049.e: When one meets with the True Guru, one is liberated, drinking in and savoring the sublime essence of the Lord, Har, Har. ||11||
There is no devotion within the self-willed manmukh.
Through devotional worship, the Gurmukh obtains peace and tranquility.

1049.g: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1049.t: pavitr paavan sadhaa hai baanee gurmat a(n)tar bheejai he ||12||
1049.e: Forever pure and sanctified is the Word of the Guru's Bani; following the Guru's Teachings, one's inner being is drenched in it. ||12||
I have considered Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.
They are bound by the three qualities - the three gunas; they are far away from liberation.

1050.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਜਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1050.t: gurmukh giaan eko hai jaataa anadhin naam raveejai he ||13||
1050.e: The Gurmukh knows the spiritual wisdom of the One Lord. Night and day, he chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||

1050.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ॥
1050.t: bedh paReh har naam na boojheh ||
1050.e: He may read the Vedas, but he does not realize the Lord's Name.

1050.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਲੂਝਹਿ ॥
1050.t: maiaa kaaran paR paR loojheh ||
1050.e: For the sake of Maya, he reads and recites and argues.

1050.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1050.t: a(n)tar mail agiaanee a(n)dhaa kiau kar dhutar tareejai he ||14||
1050.e: The ignorant and blind person is filled with filth within. How can he cross over the impassable world-ocean? ||14||

1050.g: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਦ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
1050.t: bedh baadh sabh aakh vakhaaneh ||
1050.e: He voices all the controversies of the Vedas,

1050.g: ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
1050.t: n a(n)tar bheejai na sabadh pachhaaneh ||
1050.e: but his inner being is not saturated or satisfied, and he does not realize the Word of the Shabad.

1050.g: ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1050.t: pu(n)n paap sabh bedh dhiraRaiaa gurmukh a(n)mrit peejai he ||15||
1050.e: The Vedas tell all about virtue and vice, but only the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||15||

1050.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
1050.t: aape saachaa eko soiee ||
1050.e: The One True Lord is all by Himself.

1050.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
1050.t: tis bin dhoojaa avar na koiee ||
1050.e: There is no one else except Him.

1050.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
1050.t: naanak naam rate man saachaa sacho sach raveejai he ||16||6||
1050.e: O Nanak, true is the mind of one who is attuned to the Naam; he speaks Truth, and nothing but Truth. ||16||6||

1050.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1050.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
1050.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1050.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
1050.t: sachai sachaa takhat rachaiaa ||
1050.e: The True Lord has established the Throne of Truth.

1050.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1050.t: nij ghar vasiaa tithai moh na maiaa ||
1050.e: He dwells in His own home deep within the self, where there is no emotional attachment to Maya.

1050.g: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1050.t: sadh hee saach vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar gurmukh karanee saaree he ||1||
1050.e: The True Lord dwells deep within the nucleus of the Gurmukh's heart forever; his actions are excellent. ||1||

1050.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
1050.t: sachaa saudhaa sach vaapaaraa ||
1050.e: True is his merchandise, and true is his trade.

1050.g: ਨ ਤਿਥੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
1050.t: n tithai bharam na dhoojaa pasaaraa ||
1050.e: There is no doubt within him, and no expanse of duality.

1050.g: ਸਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1050.t: sachaa dhan khaTiaa kadhe toT na aavai boojhai ko veechaaree he ||2||
1050.e: He has earned the true wealth, which is never exhausted. How few are those who contemplate this, and understand. ||2||

1050.g: ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
1050.t: sachai laae se jan laage ||
1050.e: They alone are attached to the True Name, whom the Lord Himself attaches.

1050.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
1050.t: a(n)tar sabadh masatak vaddabhaage ||
1050.e: The Word of the Shabad is deep within the nucleus of the self; good fortune is recorded upon their foreheads.

1050.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1050.t: sachai sabadh sadhaa gun gaaveh sabadh rate veechaaree he ||3||
1050.e: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing the True Praises of the Lord; they are attuned to contemplative meditation on the Shabad. ||3||

1050.g: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
1050.t: sacho sachaa sach saalaahee ||
1050.e: I praise the True Lord, the Truest of the True.

1050.g: ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1050.t: eko vekhaa dhoojaa naahee ||
1050.e: I see the One Lord, and no other.

1050.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਊਚੋ ਊਚੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1050.t: gurmat uoocho uoochee pauRee giaan ratan haumai maaree he ||4||
1050.e: The Guru's Teachings are the ladder to reach the highest of the high. the jewel of spiritual wisdom conquers egotism. ||4||

1050.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
1050.t: maiaa moh sabadh jalaiaa ||
1050.e: Emotional attachment to Maya is burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.

1050.g: ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1050.t: sach man vasiaa jaa tudh bhaiaa ||
1050.e: The True One comes to dwell in the mind, when it pleases You, O Lord.

1050.g: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1050.t: sache kee sabh sachee karanee haumai tikhaa nivaaree he ||5||
1050.e: True are all the actions of the truthful; the thirst of egotism is subdued. ||5||

1050.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
1050.t: maiaa moh sabh aape keenaa ||
1050.e: All by Himself, God created emotional attachment to Maya.

1050.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
1050.t: gurmukh viralai kin hee cheenaa ||
1050.e: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize the Lord.

1050.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1050.t: gurmukh hovai su sach kamaavai saachee karanee saaree he ||6||
1050.e: One who becomes Gurmukh practices Truth; true and excellent are his actions. ||6||

1050.g: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥
1050.t: kaar kamaiee jo mere prabh bhaiee ||
1050.e: He does those deeds which are pleasing to my God;

1050.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
1050.t: haumai tirasanaa sabadh bujhaiee ||
1050.e: through the Shabad, he burns away egotism and the thirst of desire.

1050.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1050.t: gurmat sadh hee a(n)tar seetal haumai maar nivaaree he ||7||
1050.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, he remains forever cool and calm deep within; he conquers and subdues his ego. ||7||

1050.g: ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1050.t: sach lage tin sabh kichh bhaavai ||
1050.e: Those who are attached to the Truth are pleased with everything.

1050.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
1050.t: sachai sabadhe sach suhaavai ||
1050.e: They are embellished with the True Word of the Shabad.

1050.g: ਐਥੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1050.t: aaithai saache se dhar saache nadharee nadhar savaaree he ||8||
1050.e: Those who are true in this world, are true in the Court of the Lord. The Merciful Lord adorns them with His Mercy. ||8||

1050.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
1050.t: bin saache jo dhoojai laiaa ||
1050.e: Those who are attached to duality, and not the Truth,

1050.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
1050.t: maiaa moh dhukh sabaiaa ||
1050.e: are trapped in emotional attachment to Maya; they totally suffer in pain.

1050.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1050.t: bin gur dhukh sukh jaapai naahee maiaa moh dhukh bhaaree he ||9||
1050.e: Without the Guru, they do not understand pain and pleasure; attached to Maya, they suffer in terrible pain. ||9||

1050.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1050.t: saachaa sabadh jinaa man bhaiaa ||
1050.e: Those whose minds are pleased with the True Word of the Shabad

1050.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
1050.t: poorab likhiaa tinee kamaiaa ||
1050.e: act according to pre-ordained destiny.

1050.g: ਸਚੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1050.t: sacho seveh sach dhiaaveh sach rate veechaaree he ||10||
1050.e: They serve the True Lord, and meditate on the True Lord; they are imbued with contemplative meditation on the True Lord. ||10||

1050.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
1050.t: gur kee sevaa meeThee laagee ||
1050.e: Service to the Guru seems sweet to them.

1050.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧੀ ॥
1050.t: anadhin sookh sahaj samaadhee ||
1050.e: Night and day, they are intuitively immersed in celestial peace.

1050.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1050.t: har har karatiaa man niramal hoaa gur kee sev piaaree he ||11||
1050.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds become immaculate; they love to serve the Guru. ||11||

1050.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
1050.t: se jan sukhe'ee satigur sache laae ||
1050.e: Those humble beings are at peace, whom the True Guru attaches to the Truth.

1050.g: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
1050.t: aape bhaane aap milaae ||
1050.e: He Himself, in His Will, merges them into Himself.

1050.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1050.t: satigur raakhe se jan ubare hor maiaa moh khuaaree he ||12||
1050.e: Those humble beings, whom the True Guru protects, are saved. The rest are ruined through emotional attachment to Maya. ||12||

1051.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
1051.t: gurmukh saachaa sabadh pachhaataa ||
1051.e: The Gurmukh realizes the True Word of the Shabad.

1051.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
1051.t: naa tis kuTa(n)b naa tis maataa ||
1051.e: He has no family, and he has no mother.

1051.g: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1051.t: eko ek raviaa sabh a(n)tar sabhanaa jeeaa kaa aadhaaree he ||13||
1051.e: The One and Only Lord is pervading and permeating deep within the nucleus of all. He is the Support of all beings. ||13||

1051.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1051.t: haumai meraa dhoojaa bhaiaa ||
1051.e: Egotism, possessiveness, and the love of duality

1051.g: ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1051.t: kichh na chalai dhur khasam likh paiaa ||
1051.e: - none of these shall go along with you; such is the pre-ordained will of our Lord and Master.

1051.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1051.t: gur saache te saach kamaaveh saachai dhookh nivaaree he ||14||
1051.e: Through the True Guru, practice Truth, and the True Lord shall take away your pains. ||14||

1051.g: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
1051.t: jaa too dheh sadhaa sukh paae ||
1051.e: If You so bless me, then I shall find lasting peace.

1051.g: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
1051.t: saachai sabadhe saach kamaae ||
1051.e: Through the True Word of the Shabad, I live the Truth.

1051.g: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1051.t: a(n)dhar saachaa man tan saachaa bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaaree he ||15||
1051.e: The True Lord is within me, and my mind and body have become True. I am blessed with the overflowing treasure of devotional worship. ||15||

1051.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
1051.t: aape vekhai hukam chalaae ||
1051.e: He Himself watches, and issues His Command.

1051.g: ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
1051.t: apanaa bhaanaa aap karaae ||
1051.e: He Himself inspires us to obey His Will.

1051.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੭॥
1051.t: naanak naam rate bairaagee man tan rasanaa naam savaaree he ||16||7||
1051.e: O Nanak, only those who are attuned to the Naam are detached; their minds, bodies and tongues are embellished with the Naam. ||16||7||

1051.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1051.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
1051.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1051.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਉਪੰਨਾ ॥
1051.t: aape aap upai upa(n)naa ||
1051.e: He Himself created Himself, and came into being.

1051.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੁ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ ॥
1051.t: sabh meh varatai ek parachha(n)naa ||
1051.e: The One Lord is pervading in all, remaining hidden.

1051.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1051.t: sabhanaa saar kare jagajeevan jin apanaa aap pachhaataa he ||1||
1051.e: The Lord, the Life of the world, takes care of all. Whoever knows his own self, realizes God. ||1||

1051.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
1051.t: jin brahamaa bisan mahes upaae ||
1051.e: He who created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva,

1051.g: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
1051.t: sir sir dha(n)dhai aape laae ||
1051.e: links each and every being to its tasks.

1051.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1051.t: jis bhaavai tis aape mele jin gurmukh eko jaataa he ||2||
1051.e: He merges into Himself, whoever is pleasing to His Will. The Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||2||

1051.g: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
1051.t: aavaa gaun hai sa(n)saaraa ||
1051.e: The world is coming and going in reincarnation.

1051.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਚਿਤੈ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
1051.t: maiaa moh bahu chitai bikaaraa ||
1051.e: Attached to Maya, it dwells on its many sins.

1051.g: ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1051.t: thir saachaa saalaahee sadh hee jin gur kaa sabadh pachhaataa he ||3||
1051.e: One who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad, praises forever the eternal, unchanging True Lord. ||3||

1051.g: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਲਗੇ ਓਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1051.t: eik mool lage onee sukh paiaa ||
1051.e: Some are attached to the root - they find peace.

1051.g: ਡਾਲੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
1051.t: ddaalee laage tinee janam gavaiaa ||
1051.e: But those who are attached to the branches, waste their lives away uselessly.

1051.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1051.t: a(n)mirat fal tin jan kau laage jo boleh a(n)mirat baataa he ||4||
1051.e: Those humble beings, who chant the Name of the Ambrosial Lord, produce the ambrosial fruit. ||4||

1051.g: ਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਬੋਲਹ ਬੋਲ ॥
1051.t: ham gun naahee kiaa boleh bol ||
1051.e: I have no virtues; what words should I speak?

1051.g: ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਤੋਲਹਿ ਤੋਲ ॥
1051.t: too sabhanaa dhekheh toleh tol ||
1051.e: You see all, and weigh them on Your scale.

1051.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1051.t: jiau bhaavai tiau raakheh rahanaa gurmukh eko jaataa he ||5||
1051.e: By Your will, You preserve me, and so do I remain. The Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||5||

1051.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
1051.t: jaa tudh bhaanaa taa sachee kaarai laae ||
1051.e: According to Your Will, You link me to my true tasks.

1051.g: ਅਵਗਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
1051.t: avagan chhodd gun maeh samaae ||
1051.e: Renouncing vice, I am immersed in virtue.

1051.g: ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1051.t: gun meh eko niramal saachaa gur kai sabadh pachhaataa he ||6||
1051.e: The One Immaculate True Lord abides in virtue; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||6||

1051.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
1051.t: jeh dhekhaa teh eko soiee ||
1051.e: Wherever I look, there I see Him.

1051.g: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ॥
1051.t: dhoojee dhuramat sabadhe khoiee ||
1051.e: Duality and evil-mindedness are destroyed through the Shabad.

1051.g: ਏਕਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਅਪਣੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਦ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1051.t: ekas meh prabh ek samaanaa apanai ra(n)g sadh raataa he ||7||
1051.e: The One Lord God is immersed in His Oneness. He is attuned forever to His own delight. ||7||

1051.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੁ ਹੈ ਕੁਮਲਾਣਾ ॥
1051.t: kaiaa kamal hai kumalaanaa ||
1051.e: The body-lotus is withering away,

1051.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਇਆਣਾ ॥
1051.t: manmukh sabadh na bujhai iaanaa ||
1051.e: but the ignorant, self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad.

1051.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਖੋਜੇ ਪਾਏ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1051.t: gur parasaadhee kaiaa khoje paae jagajeevan dhaataa he ||8||
1051.e: By Guru's Grace, he searches his body, and finds the Great Giver, the Life of the world. ||8||

1051.g: ਕੋਟ ਗਹੀ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
1051.t: koT gahee ke paap nivaare ||
1051.e: The Lord frees up the body-fortress, which was seized by sins,

1051.g: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
1051.t: sadhaa har jeeau raakhai ur dhaare ||
1051.e: when one keeps the Dear Lord enshrined forever in the heart.

1051.g: ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1051.t: jo ichhe soiee fal paae jiau ra(n)g majeeThai raataa he ||9||
1051.e: The fruits of his desires are obtained, and he is dyed in the permanent color of the Lord's Love. ||9||

1051.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਥੇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1051.t: manmukh giaan kathe na hoiee ||
1051.e: The self-willed manmukh speaks of spiritual wisdom, but does not understand.

1051.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
1051.t: fir fir aavai Thaur na koiee ||
1051.e: Again and again, he comes into the world, but he finds no place of rest.

1051.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1051.t: gurmukh giaan sadhaa saalaahe jug jug eko jaataa he ||10||
1051.e: The Gurmukh is spiritually wise, and praises the Lord forever. Throughout each and every age, the Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||10||

1051.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
1051.t: manmukh kaar kare sabh dhukh sabaae ||
1051.e: All the deeds which the manmukh does bring pain - nothing but pain.

1051.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
1051.t: a(n)tar sabadh naahee kiau dhar jaae ||
1051.e: The Word of the Shabad is not within him; how can he go to the Court of the Lord?

1051.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1051.t: gurmukh sabadh vasai man saachaa sadh seve sukhadhaataa he ||11||
1051.e: The True Shabad dwells deep within the mind of the Gurmukh; he serves the Giver of peace forever. ||11||

1052.e: Wherever I look, I see You, everywhere.
Through the Perfect Guru, all this is known.

1052.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1052.t: naamo naam dhiaaieeaai sadhaa sadh ih man naame raataa he ||12||
1052.e: I meditate forever and ever on the Naam; this mind is imbued with the Naam. ||12||
Imbued with the Naam, the body is sanctified.

1052.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰਾ ॥
1052.t: bin naavai ddoob mue bin neeraa ||
1052.e: Without the Naam, they are drowned and die without water.

1052.g: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1052.t: aaveh jaaveh naam nahee boojheh ikanaa gurmukh sabadh pachhaataa he ||13||
1052.e: They come and go, but do not understand the Naam. Some, as Gurmukh, realize the Word of the Shabad. ||13||
The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.

1052.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
1052.t: vin naavai mukat kinai na paiee ||
1052.e: Without the Name, no one attains liberation.

1052.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1052.t: naame naam milai vaddiaaiee sahaj rahai ra(n)g raataa he ||14||
1052.e: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is blessed with glorious greatness; he remains intuitively attuned to the Lord's Love. ||14||
The body-village crumbles and collapses into a pile of dust.
Without the Shabad, the cycle of reincarnation is not brought to an end.

1052.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1052.t: saach salaahe saach samaavai jin gurmukh eko jaataa he ||15||
1052.e: One who knows the One Lord, through the True Guru, praises the True Lord, and remains immersed in the True Lord. ||15||

1052.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
1052.t: jis no nadhar kare so paae || saachaa sabadh vasai man aae ||
1052.e: The True Word of the Shabad comes to dwell in the mind, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

1052.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੮॥
1052.t: naanak naam rate nira(n)kaaree dhar saachai saach pachhaataa he ||16||8||
1052.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, realize the True Lord in His True Court. ||16||8||
Maaroo, Solhay, Third Mehla:
O Creator, it is You Yourself who does all.
All beings and creatures are under Your Protection.

1052.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1052.t: aape gupat varatai sabh a(n)tar gur kai sabadh pachhaataa he ||1||
1052.e: You are hidden, and yet permeating within all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are realized. ||1||
Devotion to the Lord is a treasure overflowing.
He Himself blesses us with contemplative meditation on the Shabad.

1052.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1052.t: jo tudh bhaavai soiee karaseh sache siau man raataa he ||2||
1052.e: You do whatever You please; my mind is attuned to the True Lord. ||2||
You Yourself are the priceless diamond and jewel.
In Your Mercy, You weigh with Your scale.

1052.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1052.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh saran tumaaree kar kirapaa aap pachhaataa he ||3||
1052.e: All beings and creatures are under Your protection. One who is blessed by Your Grace realizes his own self. ||3||

1052.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
1052.t: jis no nadhar hovai dhur teree ||
1052.e: One who receives Your Mercy, O Primal Lord,
does not die, and is not reborn; he is released from the cycle of reincarnation.

1052.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1052.t: saache gun gaavai dhin raatee jug jug eko jaataa he ||4||
1052.e: He sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, day and night, and, throughout the ages, he knows the One Lord. ||4||
Emotional attachment to Maya wells up throughout the whole world,
from Brahma, Vishnu and all the demi-gods.

1052.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1052.t: jo tudh bhaane se naam laage giaan matee pachhaataa he ||5||
1052.e: Those who are pleasing to Your Will, are attached to the Naam; through spiritual wisdom and understanding, You are recognized. ||5||
The world is engrossed in vice and virtue.

1052.g: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
1052.t: harakh sog sabh dhukh hai bhaaraa ||
1052.e: Happiness and misery are totally loaded with pain.

1052.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1052.t: gurmukh hovai so sukh paae jin gurmukh naam pachhaataa he ||6||
1052.e: One who becomes Gurmukh finds peace; such a Gurmukh recognizes the Naam. ||6||
No one can erase the record of one's actions.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one finds the door of salvation.

1052.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1052.t: poorab likhiaa so fal paiaa jin aap maar pachhaataa he ||7||
1052.e: One who conquers self-conceit and recognizes the Lord, obtains the fruits of his pre-destined rewards. ||7||

1052.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
1052.t: maiaa moh har siau chit na laagai ||
1052.e: Emotionally attached to Maya, one's consciousness is not attached to the Lord.
In the love of duality, he will suffer terrible agony in the world hereafter.

1052.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1052.t: manmukh bharam bhule bhekhadhaaree a(n)t kaal pachhutaataa he ||8||
1052.e: The hypocritical, self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt; at the very last moment, they regret and repent. ||8||

1052.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
1052.t: har kai bhaanai har gun gaae ||
1052.e: In accordance with the Lord's Will, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
He is rid of all sins, and all suffering.

1052.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1052.t: har niramal niramal hai baanee har setee man raataa he ||9||
1052.e: The Lord is immaculate, and immaculate is the Word of His Bani. My mind is imbued with the Lord. ||9||

1052.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
1052.t: jis no nadhar kare so gun nidh paae ||
1052.e: One who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, obtains the Lord, the treasure of virtue.
Egotism and possessiveness are brought to an end.

1052.g: ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1052.t: gun avagan kaa eko dhaataa gurmukh viralee jaataa he ||10||
1052.e: The One Lord is the only Giver of virtue and vice, merits and demerits; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this. ||10||
My God is immaculate, and utterly infinite.
God unites with Himself, through contemplation of the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1053.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1053.t: aape bakhase sach dhiraRaae man tan saachai raataa he ||11||
1053.e: He Himself forgives, and implants the Truth. The mind and body are then attuned to the True Lord. ||11||

1053.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1053.t: man tan mailaa vich jot apaaraa ||
1053.e: Within the polluted mind and body is the Light of the Infinite Lord.

1053.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1053.t: gurmat boojhai kar veechaaraa ||
1053.e: One who understands the Guru's Teachings, contemplates this.

1053.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1053.t: haumai maar sadhaa man niramal rasanaa sev sukhadhaataa he ||12||
1053.e: Conquering egotism, the mind becomes immaculate forever; with his tongue, he serves the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||12||

1053.g: ਗੜ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਹਟ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
1053.t: gaR kaiaa a(n)dhar bahu haT baajaaraa ||
1053.e: In the fortress of the body there are many shops and bazaars;

1053.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1053.t: tis vich naam hai at apaaraa ||
1053.e: within them is the Naam, the Name of the utterly infinite Lord.

1053.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1053.t: gur kai sabadh sadhaa dhar sohai haumai maar pachhaataa he ||13||
1053.e: In His Court, one is embellished forever with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; he conquers egotism and realizes the Lord. ||13||

1053.g: ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1053.t: ratan amolak agam apaaraa ||
1053.e: The jewel is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.

1053.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
1053.t: keemat kavan kare vechaaraa ||
1053.e: How can the poor wretch estimate its worth?

1053.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1053.t: gur kai sabadhe tol tolaae a(n)tar sabadh pachhaataa he ||14||
1053.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is weighed, and so the Shabad is realized deep within. ||14||

1053.g: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
1053.t: simirat saasatr bahut bisathaaraa || maiaa moh pasariaa paasaaraa ||
1053.e: The great volumes of the Simritees and the Shaastras only extend the extension of attachment to Maya.

1053.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੜਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1053.t: moorakh paReh sabadh na boojheh gurmukh viralai jaataa he ||15||
1053.e: The fools read them, but do not understand the Word of the Shabad. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand. ||15||

1053.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
1053.t: aape karataa kare karaae ||
1053.e: The Creator Himself acts, and causes all to act.

1053.g: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
1053.t: sachee baanee sach dhiraRaae ||
1053.e: Through the True Word of His Bani, Truth is implanted deep within.

1053.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੯॥
1053.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee jug jug eko jaataa he ||16||9||
1053.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, one is blessed with glorious greatness, and throughout the ages, the One Lord is known. ||16||9||

1053.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1053.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
1053.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1053.g: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1053.t: so sach sevih sirajanahaaraa ||
1053.e: Serve the True Creator Lord.

1053.g: ਸਬਦੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1053.t: sabadhe dhookh nivaaranahaaraa ||
1053.e: The Word of the Shabad is the Destroyer of pain.

1053.g: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1053.t: agam agochar keemat nahee paiee aape agam athaahaa he ||1||
1053.e: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be evaluated. He Himself is inaccessible and immeasurable. ||1||

1053.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥
1053.t: aape sachaa sach varataae ||
1053.e: The True Lord Himself makes Truth pervasive.

1053.g: ਇਕਿ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
1053.t: eik jan saachai aape laae ||
1053.e: He attaches some humble beings to the Truth.

1053.g: ਸਾਚੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1053.t: saacho seveh saach kamaaveh naame sach samaahaa he ||2||
1053.e: They serve the True Lord and practice Truth; through the Name, they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

1053.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
1053.t: dhur bhagataa mele aap milaae ||
1053.e: The Primal Lord unites His devotees in His Union.

1053.g: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
1053.t: sachee bhagatee aape laae ||
1053.e: He attaches them to true devotional worship.

1053.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1053.t: saachee baanee sadhaa gun gaavai is janamai kaa laahaa he ||3||
1053.e: One who sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord, through the True Word of His Bani, earns the profit of this life. ||3||

1053.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
1053.t: gurmukh vanaj kareh par aap pachhaaneh ||
1053.e: The Gurmukh trades, and understands his own self.

1053.g: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
1053.t: ekas bin ko avar na jaaneh ||
1053.e: He knows no other than the One Lord.

1053.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1053.t: sachaa saahu sache vanajaare poo(n)jee naam visaahaa he ||4||
1053.e: True is the banker, and True are His traders, who buy the merchandise of the Naam. ||4||

1053.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
1053.t: aape saaje sirasaT upaae ||
1053.e: He Himself fashions and creates the Universe.

1053.g: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
1053.t: virale kau gur sabadh bujhaae ||
1053.e: He inspires a few to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1053.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1053.t: satigur seveh se jan saache kaaTe jam kaa faahaa he ||5||
1053.e: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true. He snaps the noose of death from around their necks. ||5||

1053.g: ਭੰਨੈ ਘੜੇ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
1053.t: bha(n)nai ghaRe savaare saaje ||
1053.e: He destroys, creates, embellishes and fashions all beings,

1053.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਜੰਤ ਪਾਜੇ ॥
1053.t: maiaa moh dhoojai ja(n)t paaje ||
1053.e: and attaches them to duality, attachment and Maya.

1053.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1053.t: manmukh fireh sadhaa a(n)dh kamaaveh jam kaa jevaRaa gal faahaa he ||6||
1053.e: The self-willed manmukhs wander around forever, acting blindly. Death has strung his noose around their necks. ||6||

1053.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
1053.t: aape bakhase gur sevaa laae ||
1053.e: He Himself forgives, and enjoins us to serve the Guru.

1053.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
1053.t: gurmatee naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
1053.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam comes to dwell within the mind.

1053.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਾਚਾ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1053.t: anadhin naam dhiaae saachaa is jag meh naamo laahaa he ||7||
1053.e: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the True Lord, and earn the profit of the Naam in this world. ||7||

1053.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
1053.t: aape sachaa sachee naiee ||
1053.e: He Himself is True, and True is His Name.

1053.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
1053.t: gurmukh dhevai ma(n)n vasaiee ||
1053.e: The Gurmukh bestows it, and enshrines it within the mind.

1053.g: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1053.t: jin man vasiaa se jan soheh tin sir chookaa kaahaa he ||8||
1053.e: Noble and exalted are those, within whose mind the Lord abides. Their heads are free of strife. ||8||

1053.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
1053.t: agam agochar keemat nahee paiee ||
1053.e: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be appraised.

1053.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
1053.t: gur parasaadhee ma(n)n vasaiee ||
1053.e: By Guru's Grace, He dwells within the mind.

1053.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਗੈ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1053.t: sadhaa sabadh saalaahee gunadhaataa lekhaa koi na ma(n)gai taahaa he ||9||
1053.e: No one calls that person to account, who praises the Word of the Shabad, the Giver of virtue. ||9||

1053.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
1053.t: brahamaa bisan rudhr tis kee sevaa ||
1053.e: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva serve Him.

1053.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
1053.t: a(n)t na paaveh alakh abhevaa ||
1053.e: Even they cannot find the limits of the unseen, unknowable Lord.

1053.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਅਪਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1053.t: jin kau nadhar kareh too apanee gurmukh alakh lakhaahaa he ||10||
1053.e: Those who are blessed by Your Glance of Grace, become Gurmukh, and comprehend the incomprehensible. ||10||

1054.e: The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.
I have enshrined the Naam, the One Name, within my mind.

1054.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1054.t: naam japee tai naam dhiaaiee mahal pai gun gaahaa he ||11||
1054.e: I chant the Naam, and meditate on the Naam. Singing His Glorious Praises, I enter the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||11||
The servant serves, and obeys the Command of the Infinite Lord.
The self-willed manmukhs do not know the value of the Lord's Command.

1054.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1054.t: hukame ma(n)ne hukame vaddiaaiee hukame veparavaahaa he ||12||
1054.e: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one is exalted; by His Hukam, one is glorified; by His Hukam, one becomes carefree. ||12||
By Guru's Grace, one recognizes the Lord's Hukam.
The wandering mind is restrained, and brought back to the home of the One Lord.

1054.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1054.t: naame raataa sadhaa bairaagee naam ratan man taahaa he ||13||
1054.e: Imbued with the Naam, one remains forever detached; the jewel of the Naam rests within the mind. ||13||

1054.g: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
1054.t: sabh jag meh varatai eko soiee ||
1054.e: The One Lord is pervasive throughout all the world.
By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

1054.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1054.t: sabadh salaaheh se jan niramal nij ghar vaasaa taahaa he ||14||
1054.e: Those humble beings who praise the Shabad are immaculate; they dwell within the home of their own inner self. ||14||
The devotees abide forever in Your Sanctuary, Lord.
You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your value cannot be estimated.

1054.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1054.t: jiau tudh bhaaveh tiau too raakheh gurmukh naam dhiaahaa he ||15||
1054.e: As it pleases Your Will, You keep us; the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam. ||15||
Forever and ever, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
O my True Lord and Master, may I become pleasing to Your Mind.

1054.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
1054.t: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee sach dhevahu sach samaahaa he ||16||1||10||
1054.e: Nanak offers this true prayer: O Lord, please bless me with Truth, that I may merge in the Truth. ||16||1||10||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the True Name.

1054.g: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1054.t: sadhaa sukhadhaataa raviaa ghaT a(n)tar sabadh sachai omaahaa he ||1||
1054.e: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever deep within their hearts; they delight in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
When the Lord grants His Grace, one meets with the Guru.
The Name of the Lord is enshrined within the mind.

1054.g: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1054.t: har man vasiaa sadhaa sukhadhaataa sabadhe man omaahaa he ||2||
1054.e: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever within the mind; the mind is delighted with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He unites in His Union.
Egotism and attachment are burned away by the Shabad.

1054.g: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1054.t: sadhaa mukat rahai ik ra(n)gee naahee kisai naal kaahaa he ||3||
1054.e: In the Love of the One Lord, one remains liberated forever; he is not in conflict with anyone. ||3||
Without serving the True Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.

1054.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
1054.t: bin sabadhai koi na paavai paaraa ||
1054.e: Without the Shabad, no one crosses over to the other side.

1054.g: ਜੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1054.t: jo sabadh raate mahaa bairaagee so sach sabadhe laahaa he ||4||
1054.e: Those who are imbued with the Shabad, are very detached. They earn the profit of the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

1054.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1054.t: dhukh sukh karatai dhur likh paiaa ||
1054.e: Pain and pleasure are pre-ordained by the Creator.
He Himself has caused the love of duality to be pervasive.

1054.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1054.t: gurmukh hovai su alipato varatai manmukh kaa kiaa vesaahaa he ||5||
1054.e: One who becomes Gurmukh remains detached; how can anyone trust the self-willed manmukh? ||5||

1054.g: ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
1054.t: se manmukh jo sabadh na pachhaaneh ||
1054.e: Those who do not recognize the Shabad are manmukhs.

1054.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
1054.t: gur ke bhai kee saar na jaaneh ||
1054.e: They do not know the essence of the Fear of the Guru.

1054.g: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਮੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏਗਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1054.t: bhai bin kiau nirabhau sach paieeaai jam kaadd legaa saahaa he ||6||
1054.e: Without this Fear, how can anyone find the Fearless True Lord? The Messenger of Death will pull the breath out. ||6||
The invulnerable Messenger of Death cannot be killed.

1054.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
1054.t: gur kai sabadhe neR na aaiee ||
1054.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad prevents him from approaching.

1054.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਤਾ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਭਾਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1054.t: sabadh sune taa dhoorahu bhaagai mat maare har jeeau veparavaahaa he ||7||
1054.e: When he hears the Word of the Shabad, he runs far away. He is afraid that the self-sufficient Dear Lord will kill him. ||7||

1054.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਸਿਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
1054.t: har jeeau kee hai sabh sirakaaraa ||
1054.e: The Dear Lord is the Ruler above all.
What can this wretched Messenger of Death do?

1054.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਢਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1054.t: hukamee ba(n)dhaa hukam kamaavai hukame kaddadhaa saahaa he ||8||
1054.e: As slave to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal acts according to His Hukam. According to His Hukam, he is deprived of his breath. ||8||
The Gurmukh realizes that the True Lord created the creation.
The Gurmukh knows that the Lord has expanded the entire expanse.

1054.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1054.t: gurmukh hovai so sach boojhai sabadh sachai sukh taahaa he ||9||
1054.e: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands the True Lord. Through the True Word of the Shabad, he finds peace. ||9||
The Gurmukh knows that the Lord is the Architect of karma.

1055.e: Throughout the four ages, he recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1055.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1055.t: gurmukh marai na janamai gurmukh gurmukh sabadh samaahaa he ||10||
1055.e: The Gurmukh does not die, the Gurmukh is not reborn; the Gurmukh is immersed in the Shabad. ||10||
The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the Shabad.
God is inaccessible, unfathomable and self-sufficient.

1055.g: ਏਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1055.t: ek naam jug chaar udhaare sabadhe naam visaahaa he ||11||
1055.e: The Naam, the Name of the One Lord, saves and redeems throughout the four ages. Through the Shabad, one trades in the Naam. ||11||
The Gurmukh obtains eternal peace and tranqulity.
The Gurmukh enshrines the Naam within his heart.

1055.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1055.t: gurmukh hovai so naam boojhai kaaTe dhuramat faahaa he ||12||
1055.e: One who becomes Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, and the noose of evil-mindedness is snapped. ||12||
The Gurmukh wells up from, and then merges back into Truth.

1055.g: ਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1055.t: naa mar ja(n)mai na joonee paavai ||
1055.e: He does not die and take birth, and is not consigned to reincarnation.

1055.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲੈਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1055.t: gurmukh sadhaa raheh ra(n)g raate anadhin laidhe laahaa he ||13||
1055.e: The Gurmukh remains forever imbued with the color of the Lord's Love. Night and day, he earns a profit. ||13||
The Gurmukhs, the devotees, are exalted and beautified in the Court of the Lord.
They are embellished with the True Word of His Bani, and the Word of the Shabad.

1055.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1055.t: anadhin gun gaavai dhin raatee sahaj setee ghar jaahaa he ||14||
1055.e: Night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night, and they intuitively go to their own home. ||14||
The Perfect True Guru proclaims the Shabad;
night and day, remain lovingly attuned to devotional worship.

1055.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1055.t: har gun gaaveh sadh hee niramal niramal gun paatisaahaa he ||15||
1055.e: One who sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord, becomes immaculate; Immaculate are the Glorious Praises of the Sovereign Lord . ||15||
The True Lord is the Giver of virtue.
How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this.

1055.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੧॥
1055.t: naanak jan naam salaahe bigasai so naam beparavaahaa he ||16||2||11||
1055.e: Servant Nanak praises the Naam; he blossoms forth in the ecstasy of the Name of the self-sufficient Lord. ||16||2||11||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
Serve the Dear Lord, the inaccessible and infinite.

1055.g: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
1055.t: tis dhaa a(n)t na paieeaai paaraavaaraa ||
1055.e: He has no end or limitation.

1055.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1055.t: gur parasaadh raviaa ghaT a(n)tar tit ghaT mat agaahaa he ||1||
1055.e: By Guru's Grace, one who dwells upon the Lord deep within his heart - his heart is filled with infinite wisdom. ||1||
The One Lord is pervading and permeating amidst all.
By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

1055.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1055.t: sabhanaa pratipaal kare jagajeevan dhedhaa rijak sa(n)baahaa he ||2||
1055.e: The Life of the world nurtures and cherishes all, giving sustenance to all. ||2||
The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.
By the Hukam of His Command, He created the entire Universe.

1055.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1055.t: hukam ma(n)ne soiee sukh paae hukam sir saahaa paatisaahaa he ||3||
1055.e: Whoever submits to His Command, finds peace; His Command is above the heads of kings and emperors. ||3||
True is the True Guru. Infinite is the Word of His Shabad.
Through His Shabad, the world is saved.

1055.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਦੇਦਾ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1055.t: aape karataa kar kar vekhai dhedhaa saas giraahaa he ||4||
1055.e: The Creator Himself created the creation; He gazes upon it, and blesses it with breath and nourishment. ||4||
Out of millions, only a few understand.

1055.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
1055.t: gur kai sabadh rate ra(n)g laae ||
1055.e: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are colored in His Love.

1055.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1055.t: har saalaaheh sadhaa sukhadhaataa har bakhase bhagat salaahaa he ||5||
1055.e: They praise the Lord, the Giver of peace forever; the Lord forgives His devotees, and blesses them with His Praise. ||5||
Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true.
The falsest of the false die, only to be reborn.

1055.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1055.t: agam agochar veparavaahaa bhagat vachhal athaahaa he ||6||
1055.e: The inaccessible, unfathomable, self-sufficient, incomprehensible Lord is the Lover of His devotees. ||6||
The Perfect True Guru implants Truth within.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing His Glorious Praises forever.

1055.g: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1055.t: gunadhaataa varatai sabh a(n)tar sir sir likhadhaa saahaa he ||7||
1055.e: The Giver of virtue is pervading deep within the nucleus of all beings; He inscribes the time of destiny upon each and every person's head. ||7||
The Gurmukh knows that God is always ever-present.
That humble being who serves the Shabad, is comforted and fulfilled.

1055.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1055.t: anadhin seveh sachee baanee sabadh sachai omaahaa he ||8||
1055.e: Night and day, he serves the True Word of the Guru's Bani; he delights in the True Word of the Shabad. ||8||
The ignorant and blind cling to all sorts of rituals.
They stubborn-mindedly perform these rituals, and are consigned to reincarnation.

1056.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਦੋਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1056.t: bikhiaa kaaran lab lobh kamaaveh dhuramat kaa dhoraahaa he ||9||
1056.e: For the sake of poison, they act in greed and possessiveness, and evil-minded duality. ||9||

1056.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
1056.t: pooraa satigur bhagat dhiraRaae ||
1056.e: The Perfect True Guru implants devotional worship within.

1056.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
1056.t: gur kai sabadh har naam chit laae ||
1056.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he lovingly centers his consciousness on the Lord's Name.

1056.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭੀਨੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1056.t: man tan har raviaa ghaT a(n)tar man bheenai bhagat salaahaa he ||10||
1056.e: The Lord pervades his mind, body and heart; deep within, his mind is drenched with devotional worship and praise of the Lord. ||10||

1056.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰਣੁ ॥
1056.t: meraa prabh saachaa asur sa(n)ghaaran ||
1056.e: My True Lord God is the Destroyer of demons.

1056.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਣੁ ॥
1056.t: gur kai sabadh bhagat nisataaran ||
1056.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His devotees are saved.

1056.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1056.t: meraa prabh saachaa sadh hee saachaa sir saahaa paatisaahaa he ||11||
1056.e: My True Lord God is forever True. He is the Emperor over the heads of kings. ||11||

1056.g: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
1056.t: se bhagat sache terai man bhaae ||
1056.e: True are those devotees, who are pleasing to Your Mind.

1056.g: ਦਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
1056.t: dhar keeratan kareh gur sabadh suhaae ||
1056.e: They sing the Kirtan of His Praises at His Door; they are embellished and exalted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1056.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1056.t: saachee baanee anadhin gaaveh niradhan kaa naam vesaahaa he ||12||
1056.e: Night and day, they sing the True Word of His Bani. The Naam is the wealth of the poor. ||12||

1056.g: ਜਿਨ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1056.t: jin aape mel vichhoReh naahee ||
1056.e: Those whom You unite, Lord, are never separated again.

1056.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
1056.t: gur kai sabadh sadhaa saalaahee ||
1056.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they praise You forever.

1056.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1056.t: sabhanaa sir too eko saahib sabadhe naam salaahaa he ||13||
1056.e: You are the One Lord and Master over all. Through the Shabad, the Naam is praised. ||13||

1056.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
1056.t: bin sabadhai tudhuno koiee na jaanee ||
1056.e: Without the Shabad, no one knows You.

1056.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਥੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
1056.t: tudh aape kathee akath kahaanee ||
1056.e: You Yourself speak the Unspoken Speech.

1056.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1056.t: aape sabadh sadhaa gur dhaataa har naam jap sa(n)baahaa he ||14||
1056.e: You Yourself are the Shabad forever, the Guru, the Great Giver; chanting the Lord's Name, You bestow Your treasure. ||14||

1056.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1056.t: too aape karataa sirajanahaaraa ||
1056.e: You Yourself are the Creator of the Universe.

1056.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1056.t: teraa likhiaa koi na meTanahaaraa ||
1056.e: No one can erase what You have written.

1056.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1056.t: gurmukh naam dheveh too aape sahasaa ganat na taahaa he ||15||
1056.e: You Yourself bless the Gurmukh with the Naam, who is no longer skeptical, and is not held to account. ||15||

1056.g: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਰਵਾਰੇ ॥
1056.t: bhagat sache terai dharavaare ||
1056.e: Your true devotees stand at the Door of Your Court.

1056.g: ਸਬਦੇ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
1056.t: sabadhe sevan bhai piaare ||
1056.e: They serve the Shabad with love and affection.

1056.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੨॥
1056.t: naanak naam rate bairaagee naame kaaraj sohaa he ||16||3||12||
1056.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam remain detached; through the Naam, their affairs are resolved. ||16||3||12||

1056.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1056.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
1056.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1056.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
1056.t: merai prabh saachai ik khel rachaiaa ||
1056.e: My True Lord God has staged a play.

1056.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
1056.t: koi na kis hee jehaa upaiaa ||
1056.e: He has created no one like anyone else.

1056.g: ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1056.t: aape farak kare vekh vigasai sabh ras dhehee maahaa he ||1||
1056.e: He made them different, and he gazes upon them with pleasure; he placed all the flavors in the body. ||1||

1056.g: ਵਾਜੈ ਪਉਣੁ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
1056.t: vaajai paun tai aap vajaae ||
1056.e: You Yourself vibrate the beat of the breath.

1056.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
1056.t: siv sakatee dhehee meh paae ||
1056.e: Shiva and Shakti, energy and matter - You have placed them into the body.

1056.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1056.t: gur parasaadhee ulaTee hovai giaan ratan sabadh taahaa he ||2||
1056.e: By Guru's Grace, one turns away from the world, and attains the jewel of spiritual wisdom, and the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

1056.g: ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਆ ॥
1056.t: a(n)dheraa chaanan aape keeaa ||
1056.e: He Himself created darkness and light.

1056.g: ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
1056.t: eko varatai avar na beeaa ||
1056.e: He alone is pervasive; there is no other at all.

1056.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1056.t: gur parasaadhee aap pachhaanai kamal bigasai budh taahaa he ||3||
1056.e: One who realizes his own self - by Guru's Grace, the lotus of his mind blossoms forth. ||3||

1056.g: ਅਪਣੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
1056.t: apanee gahan gat aape jaanai ||
1056.e: Only He Himself knows His depth and extent.

1056.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
1056.t: hor lok sun sun aakh vakhaanai ||
1056.e: Other people can only listen and hear what is spoken and said.

1056.g: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1056.t: giaanee hovai su gurmukh boojhai saachee sifat salaahaa he ||4||
1056.e: One who is spiritually wise, understands himself as Gurmukh; he praises the True Lord. ||4||

1056.g: ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1056.t: dhehee a(n)dhar vasat apaaraa ||
1056.e: Deep within the body is the priceless object.

1056.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1056.t: aape kapaT khulaavanahaaraa ||
1056.e: He Himself opens the doors.

1056.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1056.t: gurmukh sahaje a(n)mrit peevai tirasanaa agan bujhaahaa he ||5||
1056.e: The Gurmukh intuitively drings in the Ambrosial Nectar, and the fire of desire is quenched. ||5||

1056.g: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
1056.t: sabh ras dhehee a(n)dhar paae ||
1056.e: He placed all the flavors within the body.

1056.g: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
1056.t: virale kau gur sabadh bujhaae ||
1056.e: How rare are those who understand, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1056.g: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1056.t: a(n)dhar khoje sabadh saalaahe baahar kaahe jaahaa he ||6||
1056.e: So search within yourself, and praise the Shabad. Why run around outside your self? ||6||

1056.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
1056.t: vin chaakhe saadh kisai na aaiaa ||
1056.e: Without tasting, no one enjoys the flavor.

1056.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
1056.t: gur kai sabadh a(n)mrit peeaaiaa ||
1056.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

1056.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਹੋਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1056.t: a(n)mrit pee amaraa padh hoe gur kai sabadh ras taahaa he ||7||
1056.e: The Ambrosial Nectar is drunk, and the immoral status is obtained, when one obtains the sublime essence of the Guru's Shabad. ||7||

1056.g: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
1056.t: aap pachhaanai so sabh gun jaanai ||
1056.e: One who realizes himself, knows all virtues.

1057.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
1057.t: gur kai sabadh har naam vakhaanai ||
1057.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he chants the Name of the Lord.

1057.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1057.t: anadhin naam rataa dhin raatee maiaa moh chukaahaa he ||8||
1057.e: Night and day, he remains imbued with the Naam, day and night; he is rid of emotional attachment to Maya. ||8||

1057.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
1057.t: gur sevaa te sabh kichh paae ||
1057.e: Serving the Guru, all things are obtained;

1057.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
1057.t: haumai meraa aap gavaae ||
1057.e: egotism, possessiveness and self-conceit are taken away.

1057.g: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1057.t: aape kirapaa kare sukhadhaataa gur kai sabadhe sohaa he ||9||
1057.e: The Lord, the Giver of peace Himself grants His Grace; He exalts and adorns with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||9||

1057.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1057.t: gur kaa sabadh a(n)mirat hai baanee ||
1057.e: The Guru's Shabad is the Ambrosial Bani.

1057.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
1057.t: anadhin har kaa naam vakhaanee ||
1057.e: Night and day, chant the Name of the Lord.

1057.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1057.t: har har sachaa vasai ghaT a(n)tar so ghaT niramal taahaa he ||10||
1057.e: That heart becomes immaculate, which is filled with the True Lord, Har, Har. ||10||

1057.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ॥
1057.t: sevak seveh sabadh salaaheh ||
1057.e: His servants serve, and praise His Shabad.

1057.g: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
1057.t: sadhaa ra(n)g raate har gun gaaveh ||
1057.e: Imbued forever with the color of His Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

1057.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਪਰਮਲ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1057.t: aape bakhase sabadh milaae paramal vaas man taahaa he ||11||
1057.e: He Himself forgives, and unites them with the Shabad; the fragrance of sandalwood permeates their minds. ||11||

1057.g: ਸਬਦੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੇ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
1057.t: sabadhe akath kathe saalaahe ||
1057.e: Through the Shabad, they speak the Unspoken, and praise the Lord.

1057.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
1057.t: mere prabh saache veparavaahe ||
1057.e: My True Lord God is self-sufficient.

1057.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1057.t: aape gunadhaataa sabadh milaae sabadhai kaa ras taahaa he ||12||
1057.e: The Giver of virtue Himself unites them with the Shabad; they enjoy the sublime essence of the Shabad. ||12||

1057.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
1057.t: manmukh bhoolaa Thaur na paae ||
1057.e: The confused, self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest.

1057.g: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
1057.t: jo dhur likhiaa su karam kamaae ||
1057.e: They do those deeds which they are pre-destined to do.

1057.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਖੋਜੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1057.t: bikhiaa raate bikhiaa khojai mar janamai dhukh taahaa he ||13||
1057.e: Imbued with poison, they search out poison, and suffer the pains of death and rebirth. ||13||

1057.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
1057.t: aape aap aap saalaahe ||
1057.e: He Himself praises Himself.

1057.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
1057.t: tere gun prabh tujh hee maahe ||
1057.e: Your Glorious Virtues are within You alone, God.

1057.g: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1057.t: too aap sachaa teree baanee sachee aape alakh athaahaa he ||14||
1057.e: You Yourself are True, and True is the Word of Your Bani. You Yourself are invisible and unknowable. ||14||

1057.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
1057.t: bin gur dhaate koi na paae ||
1057.e: Without the Guru, the Giver, no one finds the Lord,

1057.g: ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਜੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
1057.t: lakh koTee je karam kamaae ||
1057.e: though one may make hundreds of thousands and millions of attempts.

1057.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1057.t: gur kirapaa te ghaT a(n)tar vasiaa sabadhe sach saalaahaa he ||15||
1057.e: By Guru's Grace, He dwells deep within the heart; through the Shabad, praise the True Lord. ||15||

1057.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
1057.t: se jan mile dhur aap milaae ||
1057.e: They alone meet Him, whom the Lord unites with Himself.

1057.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
1057.t: saachee baanee sabadh suhaae ||
1057.e: They are adorned and exalted with the True Word of His Bani, and the Shabad.

1057.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
1057.t: naanak jan gun gaavai nit saache gun gaaveh gunee samaahaa he ||16||4||13||
1057.e: Servant Nanak continually sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; singing His Glories, he is immersed in the Glorious Lord of Virtue. ||16||4||13||

1057.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1057.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
1057.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1057.g: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
1057.t: nihachal ek sadhaa sach soiee ||
1057.e: The One Lord is eternal and unchanging, forever True.

1057.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
1057.t: poore gur te sojhee hoiee ||
1057.e: Through the Perfect Guru, this understanding is obtained.

1057.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1057.t: har ras bheene sadhaa dhiaain gurmat seel sa(n)naahaa he ||1||
1057.e: Those who are drenched with the sublime essence of the Lord, meditate forever on Him; following the Guru's Teachings, they obtain the armor of humility. ||1||

1057.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
1057.t: a(n)dhar ra(n)g sadhaa sachiaaraa ||
1057.e: Deep within, they love the True Lord forever.

1057.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
1057.t: gur kai sabadh har naam piaaraa ||
1057.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they love the Lord's Name.

1057.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1057.t: nau nidh naam vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar chhoddiaa maiaa kaa laahaa he ||2||
1057.e: The Naam, the embodiment of the nine treasures, abides within their hearts; they renounce the profit of Maya. ||2||

1057.g: ਰਈਅਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੋਈ ॥
1057.t: rieeat raaje dhuramat dhoiee ||
1057.e: Both the king and his subjects are involved in evil-mindedness and duality.

1057.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1057.t: bin satigur seve ek na hoiee ||
1057.e: Without serving the True Guru, they do not become one with the Lord.

1057.g: ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਤਿਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1057.t: ek dhiaain sadhaa sukh pain nihachal raaj tinaahaa he ||3||
1057.e: Those who meditate on the One Lord find eternal peace. Their power is eternal and unfailing. ||3||

1057.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
1057.t: aavan jaanaa rakhai na koiee ||
1057.e: No one can save them from coming and going.

1057.g: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
1057.t: ja(n)man maran tisai te hoiee ||
1057.e: Birth and death come from Him.

1057.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1057.t: gurmukh saachaa sadhaa dhiaavahu gat mukat tisai te paahaa he ||4||
1057.e: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the True Lord. Emancipation and liberation are obtained from Him. ||4||

1057.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ॥
1057.t: sach sa(n)jam satiguroo dhuaarai ||
1057.e: Truth and self-control are found through the Door of the True Guru.

1057.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
1057.t: haumai karodh sabadh nivaarai ||
1057.e: Egotism and anger are silenced through the Shabad.

1057.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1057.t: satigur sev sadhaa sukh paieeaai seel sa(n)tokh sabh taahaa he ||5||
1057.e: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is found; humility and contentment all come from Him. ||5||

1057.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
1057.t: haumai moh upajai sa(n)saaraa ||
1057.e: Out of egotism and attachment, the Universe welled up.

1057.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
1057.t: sabh jag binasai naam visaaraa ||
1057.e: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all the world perishes.

1057.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1057.t: bin satigur seve naam na paieeaai naam sachaa jag laahaa he ||6||
1057.e: Without serving the True Guru, the Naam is not obtained. The Naam is the True profit in this world. ||6||

1057.g: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
1057.t: sachaa amar sabadh suhaiaa ||
1057.e: True is His Will, beauteous and pleasing through the Word of the Shabad.

1057.g: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਵਾਇਆ ॥
1057.t: pa(n)ch sabadh mil vaajaa vaiaa ||
1057.e: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resonate.

1058.g: ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1058.t: sadhaa kaaraj sach naam suhelaa bin sabadhai kaaraj kehaa he ||7||
1058.e: Through the True Name, one's actions are forever embellished. Without the Shabad, what can anyone do? ||7||

1058.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਸੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
1058.t: khin meh hasai khin meh rovai ||
1058.e: One instant, he laughs, and the next instant, he cries.

1058.g: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
1058.t: dhoojee dhuramat kaaraj na hovai ||
1058.e: Because of duality and evil-mindedness, his affairs are not resolved.

1058.g: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1058.t: sa(n)jog vijog karatai likh paae kirat na chalai chalaahaa he ||8||
1058.e: Union and separation are pre-ordained by the Creator. Actions already committed cannot be taken back. ||8||

1058.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
1058.t: jeevan mukat gur sabadh kamaae ||
1058.e: One who lives the Word of the Guru's Shabad becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

1058.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
1058.t: har siau sadh hee rahai samaae ||
1058.e: He remains forever immersed in the Lord.

1058.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1058.t: gur kirapaa te milai vaddiaaiee haumai rog na taahaa he ||9||
1058.e: By Guru's Grace, one is blessed with glorious greatness; he is not afflicted by the disease of egotism. ||9||

1058.g: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਏ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
1058.t: ras kas khaae pi(n)dd vadhaae ||
1058.e: Eating tasty delicacies, he fattens up his body

1058.g: ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
1058.t: bhekh karai gur sabadh na kamaae ||
1058.e: and wears religious robes, but he does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1058.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1058.t: a(n)tar rog mahaa dhukh bhaaree bisaTaa maeh samaahaa he ||10||
1058.e: Deep with the nucleus of his being is the great disease; he suffers terrible pain, and eventually sinks into the manure. ||10||

1058.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
1058.t: bedh paReh paR baadh vakhaaneh ||
1058.e: He reads and studies the Vedas, and argues about them;

1058.g: ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
1058.t: ghaT meh braham tis sabadh na pachhaaneh ||
1058.e: God is within his own heart, but he does not recognize the Word of the Shabad.

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1058.t: gurmukh hovai su tat bilovai rasanaa har ras taahaa he ||11||
1058.e: One who becomes Gurmukh churns the essence of reality; his tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||11||

1058.g: ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
1058.t: ghar vath chhoddeh baahar dhaaveh ||
1058.e: Those who forsake the object within their own hearts, wander outside.

1058.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
1058.t: manmukh a(n)dhe saadh na paaveh ||
1058.e: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not taste the flavor of God.

1058.g: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਫੀਕੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1058.t: an ras raatee rasanaa feekee bole har ras mool na taahaa he ||12||
1058.e: Imbued with the taste of another, their tongues speak tasteless, insipid words. They never taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||12||

1058.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
1058.t: manmukh dhehee bharam bhataaro ||
1058.e: The self-willed manmukh has doubt as his spouse.

1058.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੋ ॥
1058.t: dhuramat marai nit hoi khuaaro ||
1058.e: He dies of evil-mindedness, and suffers forever.

1058.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1058.t: kaam karodh man dhoojai laiaa supanai sukh na taahaa he ||13||
1058.e: His mind is attached to sexual desire, anger and duality, and he does not find peace, even in dreams. ||13||

1058.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
1058.t: ka(n)chan dhehee sabadh bhataaro ||
1058.e: The body becomes golden, with the Word of the Shabad as its spouse.

1058.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
1058.t: anadhin bhog bhoge har siau piaaro ||
1058.e: Night and day, enjoy the enjoyments, and be in love with the Lord.

1058.g: ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੈਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1058.t: mahalaa a(n)dhar gair mahal paae bhaanaa bujh samaahaa he ||14||
1058.e: Deep within the mansion of the self, one finds the Lord, who transcends this mansion. Realizing His Will, we merge in Him. ||14||

1058.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1058.t: aape dhevai dhevanahaaraa ||
1058.e: The Great Giver Himself gives.

1058.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
1058.t: tis aagai nahee kisai kaa chaaraa ||
1058.e: No one has any power to stand against Him.

1058.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1058.t: aape bakhase sabadh milaae tis dhaa sabadh athaahaa he ||15||
1058.e: He Himself forgives, and unites us with the Shabad; The Word of His Shabad is unfathomable. ||15||

1058.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
1058.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh hai tis keraa ||
1058.e: Body and soul, all belong to Him.

1058.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
1058.t: sachaa saahib Thaakur meraa ||
1058.e: The True Lord is my only Lord and Master.

1058.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੪॥
1058.t: naanak gurbaanee har paiaa har jap jaap samaahaa he ||16||5||14||
1058.e: O Nanak, through the Word of the Guru's Bani, I have found the Lord. Chanting the Lord's Chant, I merge in Him. ||16||5||14||

1058.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1058.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
1058.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1058.t: gurmukh naadh bedh beechaar ||
1058.e: The Gurmukh contemplates the sound current of the Naad instead of the Vedas.

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਆਪਾਰੁ ॥
1058.t: gurmukh giaan dhiaan aapaar ||
1058.e: The Gurmukh attains infinite spiritual wisdom and meditation.

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1058.t: gurmukh kaar kare prabh bhaavai gurmukh pooraa paidhaa ||1||
1058.e: The Gurmukh acts in harmony with God's Will; the Gurmukh finds perfection. ||1||

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਰਾਵੈ ॥
1058.t: gurmukh manooaa ulaT paraavai ||
1058.e: The mind of the Gurmukh turns away from the world.

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥
1058.t: gurmukh baanee naadh vajaavai ||
1058.e: The Gurmukh vibrates the Naad, the sound current of the Guru's Bani.

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1058.t: gurmukh sach rate bairaagee nij ghar vaasaa paidhaa ||2||
1058.e: The Gurmukh, attuned to the Truth, remains detached, and dwells in the home of the self deep within. ||2||

1058.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
1058.t: gur kee saakhee a(n)mirat bhaakhee ||
1058.e: I speak the Ambrosial Teachings of the Guru.

1058.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੀ ॥
1058.t: sachai sabadhe sach subhaakhee ||
1058.e: I lovingly chant the Truth, through the True Word of the Shabad.

1058.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1058.t: sadhaa sach ra(n)g raataa man meraa sache sach samaidhaa ||3||
1058.e: My mind remains forever imbued with the Love of the True Lord. I am immersed in the Truest of the True. ||3||

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
1058.t: gurmukh man niramal sat sar naavai ||
1058.e: Immaculate and pure is the mind of the Gurmukh, who bathes in the Pool of Truth.

1058.g: ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
1058.t: mail na laagai sach samaavai ||
1058.e: No filth attaches to him; he merges in the True Lord.

1058.g: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1058.t: sacho sach kamaavai sadh hee sachee bhagat dhiraRaidhaa ||4||
1058.e: He truly practices Truth forever; true devotion is implanted within him. ||4||

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਬੈਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
1058.t: gurmukh sach bainee gurmukh sach nainee ||
1058.e: True is the speech of the Gurmukh; true are the eyes of the Gurmukh.

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
1058.t: gurmukh sach kamaavai karanee ||
1058.e: The Gurmukh practices and lives the Truth.

1058.g: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1058.t: sadh hee sach kahai dhin raatee avaraa sach kahaidhaa ||5||
1058.e: He speaks the Truth forever, day and night, and inspires others to speak the Truth. ||5||

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1058.t: gurmukh sachee uootam baanee ||
1058.e: True and exalted is the speech of the Gurmukh.

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
1058.t: gurmukh sacho sach vakhaanee ||
1058.e: The Gurmukh speaks Truth, only Truth.

1058.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1058.t: gurmukh sadh seveh sacho sachaa gurmukh sabadh sunaidhaa ||6||
1058.e: The Gurmukh serves the Truest of the True forever; the Gurmukh proclaims the Word of the Shabad. ||6||

1059.e: One who becomes Gurmukh understands.
He rids himself of egotism, Maya and doubt.

1059.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਊਤਮ ਊਚੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1059.t: gur kee pauRee uootam uoochee dhar sachai har gun gaidhaa ||7||
1059.e: He ascends the sublime, exalted ladder of the Guru, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord at His True Door. ||7||
The Gurmukh practices true self-control, and acts in excellence.
The Gurmukh obtains the gate of salvation.

1059.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1059.t: bhai bhagat sadhaa ra(n)g raataa aap gavai samaidhaa ||8||
1059.e: Through loving devotion, he remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love; eradicating self-conceit, he merges in the Lord. ||8||
One who becomes Gurmukh examines his own mind, and instructs others.
He is lovingly attuned to the True Name forever.

1059.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਜੋ ਸਚੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1059.t: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee jo sache man bhaidhaa ||9||
1059.e: They act in harmony with the Mind of the True Lord. ||9||
As it pleases His Will, He unites us with the True Guru.

1059.g: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
1059.t: jaa tis bhaavai taa ma(n)n vasaae ||
1059.e: As it pleases His Will, He comes to dwell within the mind.

1059.g: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1059.t: aapanai bhaanai sadhaa ra(n)g raataa bhaanai ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||10||
1059.e: As it pleases His Will, He imbues us with His Love; as it pleases His Will, He comes to dwell in the mind. ||10||
Those who act stubborn-mindedly are destroyed.
Wearing all sorts of religious robes, they do not please the Lord.

1059.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1059.t: bikhiaa raate dhukh kamaaveh dhukhe dhukh samaidhaa ||11||
1059.e: Tinged by corruption, they earn only pain; they are immersed in pain. ||11||
One who becomes Gurmukh earns peace.
He comes to understand death and birth.

1059.g: ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਜੋ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1059.t: maran jeevan jo sam kar jaanai so mere prabh bhaidhaa ||12||
1059.e: One who looks alike upon death and birth, is pleasing to my God. ||12||
The Gurmukh, while remaining dead, is respected and approved.
He realizes that coming and going are according to God's Will.

1059.g: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1059.t: marai na ja(n)mai naa dhukh paae man hee maneh samaidhaa ||13||
1059.e: He does not die, he is not reborn, and he does not suffer in pain; his mind merges in the Mind of God. ||13||
Very fortunate are those who find the True Guru.
They eradicate egotism and attachment from within.

1059.g: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1059.t: man niramal fir mail na laagai dhar sachai sobhaa paidhaa ||14||
1059.e: Their minds are immaculate, and they are never again stained with filth. They are honored at the Door of the True Court. ||14||
He Himself acts, and inspires all to act.
He Himself watches over all; He establishes and disestablishes.

1059.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1059.t: gurmukh sevaa mere prabh bhaavai sach sun lekhai paidhaa ||15||
1059.e: The service of the Gurmukh is pleasing to my God; one who listens to the Truth is approved. ||15||
The Gurmukh practices Truth, and only Truth.
The Gurmukh is immaculate; no filth attaches to him.

1059.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੫॥
1059.t: naanak naam rate veechaaree naame naam samaidhaa ||16||1||15||
1059.e: O Nanak, those who contemplate the Naam are imbued with it. They merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||1||15||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
He Himself fashioned the Universe, through the Hukam of His Command.
He Himself establishes and disestablishes, and embellishes with grace.

1059.g: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1059.t: aape niaau kare sabh saachaa saache saach milaidhaa ||1||
1059.e: The True Lord Himself administers all justice; through Truth, we merge in the True Lord. ||1||
The body takes the form of a fortress.
Emotional attachment to Maya has expanded throughout its expanse.

1059.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਸਮੈ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1059.t: bin sabadhai bhasamai kee dderee khehoo kheh ralaidhaa ||2||
1059.e: Without the Word of the Shabad, the body is reduced to a pile of ashes; in the end, dust mingles with dust. ||2||
The body is the infinite fortress of gold;
it is permeated by the Infinite Word of the Shabad.

1059.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1059.t: gurmukh gaavai sadhaa gun saache mil preetam sukh paidhaa ||3||
1059.e: The Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord forever; meeting his Beloved, he finds peace. ||3||

1059.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
1059.t: kaiaa har ma(n)dhar har aap savaare ||
1059.e: The body is the temple of the Lord; the Lord Himself embellishes it.

1059.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
1059.t: tis vich har jeeau vasai muraare ||
1059.e: The Dear Lord dwells within it.

1059.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਣਜਨਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1059.t: gur kai sabadh vanajan vaapaaree nadharee aap milaidhaa ||4||
1059.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the merchants trade, and in His Grace, the Lord merges them with Himself. ||4||
He alone is pure, who eradicates anger.
He realizes the Shabad, and reforms himself.

1059.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1059.t: aape kare karaae karataa aape ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||5||
1059.e: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; He Himself abides in the mind. ||5||
Pure and unique is devotional worship.
The mind and body are washed clean, contemplating the Shabad.

1060.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
