1060.t: anadhin sadhaa rahai ra(n)g raataa kar kirapaa bhagat karaidhaa ||6||
1060.e: One who remains forever imbued with His Love, night and day - in His Mercy, the Lord inspires him to perform devotional worship service. ||6||

1060.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
1060.t: eis man ma(n)dhar meh manooaa dhaavai ||
1060.e: In this temple of the mind, the mind wanders around.

1060.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1060.t: sukh palar tiaag mahaa dhukh paavai ||
1060.e: Discarding joy like straw, it suffers in terrible pain.

1060.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1060.t: bin satigur bheTe Thaur na paavai aape khel karaidhaa ||7||
1060.e: Without meeting the True Guru, it finds no place of rest; He Himself has staged this play. ||7||
He Himself is infinite; He contemplates Himself.
He Himself bestows Union through actions of excellence.

1060.g: ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1060.t: kiaa ko kaar kare vechaaraa aape bakhas milaidhaa ||8||
1060.e: What can the poor creatures do? Granting forgiveness, He unites them with Himself. ||8||
The Perfect Lord Himself unites them with the True Guru.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, he makes them brave spiritual heroes.

1060.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1060.t: aape mele dhe vaddiaaiee sache siau chit laidhaa ||9||
1060.e: Uniting them with Himself, He bestows glorious greatness; He inspires them to focus their consciousness on the True Lord. ||9||
The True Lord is deep within the heart.
How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this.

1060.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1060.t: naam nidhaan vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar rasanaa naam dhiaaidhaa ||10||
1060.e: The treasure of the Naam abides deep within their hearts; they meditate on the Naam with their tongues. ||10||
He wanders through foreign lands, but does not look within himself.
Attached to Maya, he is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

1060.g: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1060.t: jam kee faasee kabahoo na tooTai dhoojai bhai bharamaidhaa ||11||
1060.e: The noose of death around his neck will never be untied; in the love of duality, he wanders in reincarnation. ||11||

1060.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1060.t: jap tap sa(n)jam hor koiee naahee ||
1060.e: There is no real chanting, meditation, penance or self-control,

1060.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
1060.t: jab lag gur kaa sabadh na kamaahee ||
1060.e: as long as one does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1060.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1060.t: gur kai sabadh miliaa sach paiaa sache sach samaidhaa ||12||
1060.e: Accepting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one obtains Truth; through Truth, one merges in the True Lord. ||12||
Sexual desire and anger are very powerful in the world.

1060.g: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
1060.t: bahu karam kamaaveh sabh dhukh kaa pasaaraa ||
1060.e: They lead to all sorts of actions, but these only add to all the pain.

1060.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1060.t: satigur seveh se sukh paaveh sachai sabadh milaidhaa ||13||
1060.e: Those who serve the True Guru find peace; they are united with the True Shabad. ||13||
Air, water and fire make up the body.
Emotional attachment to Maya rules deep within all.

1060.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1060.t: jin keete jaa tisai pachhaaneh maiaa moh chukaidhaa ||14||
1060.e: When one realizes the One who created him, emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled. ||14||
Some are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya and pride.
They are self-conceited and egotistical.

1060.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1060.t: jamakaalai kee khabar na paiee a(n)t giaa pachhutaidhaa ||15||
1060.e: They never think about the Messenger of Death; in the end, they leave, regretting and repenting. ||15||
He alone knows the Way, who created it.
The Gurmukh, who is blessed with the Shabad, realizes Him.

1060.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੬॥
1060.t: naanak dhaas kahai bena(n)tee sach naam chit laidhaa ||16||2||16||
1060.e: Slave Nanak offers ths prayer; O Lord, let my consciousness be attached to the True Name. ||16||2||16||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, the Merciful Lord has been the Great Giver.
Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.

1060.g: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1060.t: tudhuno seveh se tujheh samaaveh too aape mel milaidhaa ||1||
1060.e: Those who serve You are immersed in You. You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||1||
You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your limits cannot be found.
All beings and creatures seek Your Sanctuary.

1060.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1060.t: jiau tudh bhaavai tivai chalaaveh too aape maarag paidhaa ||2||
1060.e: As is pleases Your Will, You guide us along; You Yourself place us on the Path. ||2||
The True Lord is, and shall always be.
He Himself creates - there is no other at all.

1060.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1060.t: sabhanaa saar kare sukhadhaataa aape rijak pahuchaidhaa ||3||
1060.e: The Giver of peace takes care of all; He Himself sustains them. ||3||
You are inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite;
no one knows Your extent.

1060.g: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1060.t: aapanaa aap pachhaaneh aape gurmatee aap bujhaidhaa ||4||
1060.e: You Yourself realize Yourself. Through the Guru's Teachings, You reveal Yourself. ||4||

1060.g: ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
1060.t: paataal pureeaa loa aakaaraa || tis vich varatai hukam karaaraa ||
1060.e: Your Almighty Command prevails throughout the nether worlds, realms and worlds of form.

1061.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਢਾਹੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1061.t: hukame saaje hukame ddaahe hukame mel milaidhaa ||5||
1061.e: By the Hukam of Your Command, You create, and by Your Command, You destroy. By Your Command, You unite in Union. ||5||
One who realizes Your Command, praises Your Command.
You are Inaccessible, Unfathomable and Self-Sufficient.

1061.g: ਜੇਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1061.t: jehee mat dheh so hovai too aape sabadh bujhaidhaa ||6||
1061.e: As is the understanding You give, so do I become. You Yourself reveal the Shabad. ||6||
Night and day, the days of our lives wear away.
Night and day both bear witness to this loss.

1061.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਰੂਆਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1061.t: manmukh a(n)dh na chetai mooRaa sir uoopar kaal rooaaidhaa ||7||
1061.e: The blind, foolish, self-willed manmukh is not aware of this; death is hovering over his head. ||7||

1061.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
1061.t: man tan seetal gur charanee laagaa ||
1061.e: The mind and body are cooled and soothed, holding tight to the Guru's Feet.
Doubt is eliminated from within, and fear runs away.

1061.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1061.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh sache gun gaaveh sach baanee bolaidhaa ||8||
1061.e: One is in bliss forever, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, and speaking the True Word of His Bani. ||8||
One who knows You as the Architect of Karma,
has the good fortune of perfect destiny, and recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1061.g: ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1061.t: jat pat sach sachaa sach soiee haumai maar milaidhaa ||9||
1061.e: The Lord, the Truest of the True, is his social class and honor. Conquering his ego, he is united with the Lord. ||9||
The stubborn and insensitive mind is attached to the love of duality.
Deluded by doubt, the unfortunate wander around in confusion.

1061.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1061.t: karam hovai taa satigur seve sahaje hee sukh paidhaa ||10||
1061.e: But if they are blessed by God's Grace, they serve the True Guru, and easily obtain peace. ||10||
He Himself created the 8.4 million species of beings.
Only in this human life, is devotional worship to the Guru implanted within.

1061.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1061.t: bin bhagatee bisaTaa vich vaasaa bisaTaa vich fir paidhaa ||11||
1061.e: Without devotion, one lives in manure; he falls into manure again and again. ||11||
If one is blessed with His Grace, devotional worship to the Guru is implanted within.
Without God's Grace, how can anyone find Him?

1061.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1061.t: aape kare karaae karataa jiau bhaavai tivai chalaidhaa ||12||
1061.e: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; as He wills, he leads us on. ||12||
The Simritees and the Shaastras do not know His limits.
The blind fool does not recognize the essence of reality.

1061.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1061.t: aape kare karaae karataa aape bharam bhulaidhaa ||13||
1061.e: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; He Himself deludes with doubt. ||13||
He Himself causes everything to be done.
He Himself joins each and every person to his tasks.

1061.g: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1061.t: aape thaap uthaape vekhai gurmukh aap bujhaidhaa ||14||
1061.e: He Himself establishes and disestablishes, and watches over all; He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||14||
The True Lord and Master is profoundly deep and unfathomable.
Praising Him forever, the mind is comforted and consoled.

1061.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1061.t: agam agochar keemat nahee paiee gurmukh ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||15||
1061.e: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be estimated. He dwells in the mind of the Gurmukh. ||15||
He Himself is detached; all others are entangled in their affairs.
By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand Him.

1061.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੭॥
1061.t: naanak naam vasai ghaT a(n)tar gurmatee mel milaidhaa ||16||3||17||
1061.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell deep within the heart; through the Guru's Teachings, one is united in His Union. ||16||3||17||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
For thirty-six ages, utter darkness prevailed.
Only You Yourself know this, O Creator Lord.

1061.g: ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1061.t: hor kiaa ko kahai k aakh vakhaanai too aape keemat paidhaa ||1||
1061.e: What can anyone else say? What can anyone explain? Only You Yourself can estimate Your worth. ||1||
The One Universal Creator created the entire Universe.
All the plays and dramas are to Your glory and greatness.

1061.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਕ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1061.t: aape vek kare sabh saachaa aape bha(n)n ghaRaidhaa ||2||
1061.e: The True Lord Himself makes all distinctions; He Himself breaks and builds. ||2||
The Juggler has staged His juggling show.
Through the Perfect Guru, one comes to behold it.

1061.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1061.t: sadhaa alipat rahai gur sabadhee saache siau chit laidhaa ||3||
1061.e: One who remains forever detached in the Word of the Guru's Shabad - his consciousness is attuned to the True Lord. ||3||
The musical instruments of the body vibrate and resound.
The Player Himself plays them.

1061.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਵਣੈ ਸਭ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1061.t: ghaT ghaT paun vahai ik ra(n)gee mil pavanai sabh vajaidhaa ||4||
1061.e: The breath flows equally through the hearts of each and every being. Receiving the breath, all the instruments sing. ||4||

1062.e: Whatever the Creator does, surely comes to pass.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism is consumed.

1062.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1062.t: gur parasaadhee kisai dhe vaddiaaiee naamo naam dhiaaidhaa ||5||
1062.e: By Guru's Grace, some are blessed with glorious greatness; they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||

1062.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1062.t: gur seve jevadd hor laahaa naahee ||
1062.e: There is no other profit as great as service to the Guru.
The Naam abides within my mind, and I praise the Naam.

1062.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1062.t: naamo naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa naamo laahaa paidhaa ||6||
1062.e: The Naam is forever the Giver of peace. Through the Naam, we earn the profit. ||6||
Without the Name, all the world suffers in misery.
The more actions one does, the more the corruption increases.

1062.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1062.t: naam na seveh kiau sukh paieeaai bin naavai dhukh paidhaa ||7||
1062.e: Without serving the Naam, how can anyone find peace? Without the Naam, one suffers in pain. ||7||
He Himself acts, and inspires all to act.
By Guru's Grace, He reveals Himself to a few.

1062.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਹਿ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1062.t: gurmukh hoveh se ba(n)dhan toReh mukatee kai ghar paidhaa ||8||
1062.e: One who becomes Gurmukh breaks his bonds, and attains the home of liberation. ||8||
One who calculates his accounts, burns in the world.
His skepticism and corruption are never dispelled.

1062.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਣਤ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1062.t: gurmukh hovai su ganat chukaae sache sach samaidhaa ||9||
1062.e: One who becomes Gurmukh abandons his calculations; through Truth, we merge in the True Lord. ||9||

1062.g: ਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
1062.t: je sach dhei ta paae koiee ||
1062.e: If God grants Truth, then we may attain it.
By Guru's Grace, it is revealed.

1062.g: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1062.t: sach naam saalaahe ra(n)g raataa gur kirapaa te sukh paidhaa ||10||
1062.e: One who praises the True Name, and remains imbued with the Lord's Love, by Guru's Grace, finds peace. ||10||
The Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord, is chanting, meditation, penance and self-control.
God, the Destroyer, destroys sins.

1062.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1062.t: har kai naam tan man seetal hoaa sahaje sahaj samaidhaa ||11||
1062.e: Through the Name of the Lord, the body and mind are cooled and soothed, and one is intuitively, easily absorbed into the Celestial Lord. ||11||

1062.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
1062.t: a(n)tar lobh man mailai mal laae ||
1062.e: With greed within them, their minds are filthy, and they spread filth around.
They do filthy deeds, and suffer in pain.

1062.g: ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1062.t: kooRo kooR kare vaapaaraa kooR bol dhukh paidhaa ||12||
1062.e: They deal in falsehood, and nothing but falsehood; telling lies, they suffer in pain. ||12||
Rare is that person who enshrines the Immaculate Bani of the Guru's Word within his mind.
By Guru's Grace, his skepticism is removed.

1062.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1062.t: gur kai bhaanai chalai dhin raatee naam chet sukh paidhaa ||13||
1062.e: He walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, day and night; remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace. ||13||
The True Lord Himself is the Creator.
He Himself creates and destroys.

1062.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1062.t: gurmukh hovai su sadhaa salaahe mil saache sukh paidhaa ||14||
1062.e: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord forever. Meeting the True Lord, he finds peace. ||14||

1062.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1062.t: anek jatan kare i(n)dhree vas na hoiee ||
1062.e: Making countless efforts, sexual desire is not overcome.
Everyone is burning in the fires of sexuality and anger.

1062.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1062.t: satigur seve man vas aavai man maare maneh samaidhaa ||15||
1062.e: Serving the True Guru, one brings his mind under control; conquering his mind, he merges in the Mind of God. ||15||
You Yourself created the sense of 'mine' and 'yours.'

1062.g: ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
1062.t: sabh tere ja(n)t tere sabh jeeaa ||
1062.e: All creatures are Yours; You created all beings.

1062.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੮॥
1062.t: naanak naam samaal sadhaa too gurmatee ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||16||4||18||
1062.e: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam forever; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord abides in the mind. ||16||4||18||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
The Dear Lord is the Giver, inaccessible and unfathomable.
He does not have even an iota of greed; He is self-sufficient.

1062.g: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਪੜਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1062.t: tis no apaR na sakai koiee aape mel milaidhaa ||1||
1062.e: No one can reach up to Him; He Himself unites in His Union. ||1||

1062.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਈ ॥
1062.t: jo kichh karai su nihachau hoiee ||
1062.e: Whatever He does, surely comes to pass.

1062.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
1062.t: tis bin dhaataa avar na koiee ||
1062.e: There is no other Giver, except for Him.

1062.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1062.t: jis no naam dhaan kare so paae gur sabadhee melaidhaa ||2||
1062.e: Whoever the Lord blesses with His gift, obtains it. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He unites him with Himself. ||2||
The fourteen worlds are Your markets.
The True Guru reveals them, along with one's inner being.

1062.g: ਨਾਵੈ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1062.t: naavai kaa vaapaaree hovai gur sabadhee ko paidhaa ||3||
1062.e: One who deals in the Name, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, obtains it. ||3||

1063.e: Serving the True Guru, one obtains intuitive bliss.
The Lord of the Universe comes to dwell within the heart.

1063.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1063.t: sahaje bhagat kare dhin raatee aape bhagat karaidhaa ||4||
1063.e: He intuitively practices devotional worship day and night; God Himself practices devotional worship. ||4||

1063.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1063.t: satigur te vichhuRe tinee dhukh paiaa ||
1063.e: Those who are separated from the True Guru, suffer in misery.
Night and day, they are punished, and they suffer in total agony.

1063.g: ਮਥੇ ਕਾਲੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1063.t: mathe kaale mahal na paaveh dhukh hee vich dhukh paidhaa ||5||
1063.e: Their faces are blackened, and they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. They suffer in sorrow and agony. ||5||
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
They intuitively enshrine love for the True Lord.

1063.g: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1063.t: sacho sach kamaaveh sadh hee sachai mel milaidhaa ||6||
1063.e: They practice Truth, forever Truth; they are united in Union with the True Lord. ||6||

1063.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
1063.t: jis no sachaa dhei su paae ||
1063.e: He alone obtains the Truth, unto whom the True Lord gives it.
His inner being is filled with Truth, and his doubt is dispelled.

1063.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1063.t: sach sachai kaa aape dhaataa jis dhevai so sach paidhaa ||7||
1063.e: The True Lord Himself is the Giver of Truth; he alone obtains the Truth, unto whom He gives it. ||7||
He Himself is the Creator of all.

1063.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
1063.t: jis no aap bujhaae boojhai koiee ||
1063.e: Only one whom He instructs, understands Him.

1063.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1063.t: aape bakhase dhe vaddiaaiee aape mel milaidhaa ||8||
1063.e: He Himself forgives, and grants glorious greatness. He himself unites in His Union. ||8||
Acting egotistically, one loses his life.
Even in the world hereafter, emotioal attachment to Maya does not leave him.

1063.g: ਅਗੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਲ ਘਾਣੀ ਪੀੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1063.t: agai jamakaal lekhaa levai jiau til ghaanee peeRaidhaa ||9||
1063.e: In the world hereafter, the Messenger of Death calls him to account, and crushes him like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||9||
By perfect destiny, one serves the Guru.
If God grants His Grace, then one serves.

1063.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1063.t: jamakaal tis neR na aavai mahal sachai sukh paidhaa ||10||
1063.e: The Messenger of Death cannot even approach him, and in the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence, he finds peace. ||10||

1063.g: ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
1063.t: tin sukh paiaa jo tudh bhaae ||
1063.e: They alone find peace, who are pleasing to Your Will.
By perfect destiny, they are attached to the Guru's service.

1063.g: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1063.t: terai hath hai sabh vaddiaaiee jis dheveh so paidhaa ||11||
1063.e: All glorious greatness rests in Your Hands; he alone obtains it, unto whom You give it. ||11||
Through the Guru, one's inner being is enlightened and illumined.
The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in the mind.

1063.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1063.t: giaan ratan sadhaa ghaT chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaidhaa ||12||
1063.e: The jewel of spiritual wisdom ever illumines the heart, and the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled. ||12||
The blind and ignorant are attached to duality.
The unfortunates are drowned without water, and die.

1063.g: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1063.t: chaladhiaa ghar dhar nadhar na aavai jam dhar baadhaa dhukh paidhaa ||13||
1063.e: When they depart from the world, they do not find the Lord's door and home; bound and gagged at Death's door, they suffer in pain. ||13||

1063.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1063.t: bin satigur seve mukat na hoiee ||
1063.e: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds liberation.
Go ask any spiritual teacher or meditator.

1063.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1063.t: satigur seve tis milai vaddiaaiee dhar sachai sobhaa paidhaa ||14||
1063.e: Whoever serves the True Guru is blessed with glorious greatness, and honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||14||

1063.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
1063.t: satigur no seve tis aap milaae ||
1063.e: One who serves the True Guru, the Lord merges into Himself.
Cutting away attachment, one lovingly focuses on the True Lord.

1063.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1063.t: sadhaa sach vanajeh vaapaaree naamo laahaa paidhaa ||15||
1063.e: The merchants deal forever in Truth; they earn the profit of the Naam. ||15||
The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act.
He alone is liberated, who dies in the Word of the Shabad.

1063.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੯॥
1063.t: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar naamo naam dhiaaidhaa ||16||5||19||
1063.e: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the mind; meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||5||19||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1063.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1063.t: jo tudh karanaa so kar paiaa ||
1063.e: Whatever You do, is done.
How rare are those who walk in harmony with the Lord's Will.

1063.g: ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1063.t: bhaanaa ma(n)ne so sukh paae bhaane vich sukh paidhaa ||1||
1063.e: One who surrenders to the Lord's Will finds peace; he finds peace in the Lord's Will. ||1||
Your Will is pleasing to the Gurmukh.
Practicing Truth, he intuitively finds peace.

1063.g: ਭਾਣੇ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1063.t: bhaane no lochai bahuteree aapanaa bhaanaa aap manaidhaa ||2||
1063.e: Many long to walk in harmony with the Lord's Will; He Himself inspires us to surrender to His Will. ||2||

1063.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਏ ॥
1063.t: teraa bhaanaa ma(n)ne su milai tudh aae ||
1063.e: One who surrenders to Your Will, meets with You, Lord.

1064.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
1064.t: jis bhaanaa bhaavai so tujheh samaae ||
1064.e: One who is pleased with Your Will is immersed in You.

1064.g: ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1064.t: bhaane vich vaddee vaddiaaiee bhaanaa kiseh karaidhaa ||3||
1064.e: Glorious greatness rests in God's Will; rare are those who accept it. ||3||

1064.g: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
1064.t: jaa tis bhaavai taa guroo milaae ||
1064.e: When it pleases His Will, He leads us to meet the Guru.

1064.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
1064.t: gurmukh naam padhaarath paae ||
1064.e: The Gurmukh finds the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1064.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਣਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1064.t: tudh aapanai bhaanai sabh sirasaT upaiee jis no bhaanaa dheh tis bhaidhaa ||4||
1064.e: By Your Will, You created the whole Universe; those whom You bless with Your favor are pleased with Your Will. ||4||

1064.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
1064.t: manmukh a(n)dh kare chaturaiee ||
1064.e: The blind, self-willed manmukhs practice cleverness.

1064.g: ਭਾਣਾ ਨ ਮੰਨੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
1064.t: bhaanaa na ma(n)ne bahut dhukh paiee ||
1064.e: They do not surrender to the Lord's Will, and suffer terrible pain.

1064.g: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1064.t: bharame bhoolaa aavai jaae ghar mahal na kabahoo paidhaa ||5||
1064.e: Deluded by doubt, they come and go in reincarnation; they never find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||5||

1064.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1064.t: satigur mele dhe vaddiaaiee ||
1064.e: The True Guru brings Union, and grants glorious greatness.

1064.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
1064.t: satigur kee sevaa dhur furamaiee ||
1064.e: The Primal Lord ordained service to the True Guru.

1064.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1064.t: satigur seve taa naam paae naame hee sukh paidhaa ||6||
1064.e: Serving the True Guru, the Naam is obtained. Through the Naam, one finds peace. ||6||

1064.g: ਸਭ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
1064.t: sabh naavahu upajai naavahu chheejai ||
1064.e: Everything wells up from the Naam, and through the Naam, perishes.

1064.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
1064.t: gur kirapaa te man tan bheejai ||
1064.e: By Guru's Grace, the mind and body are pleased with the Naam.

1064.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਸ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1064.t: rasanaa naam dhiaae ras bheejai ras hee te ras paidhaa ||7||
1064.e: Meditating on the Naam, the tongue is drenched with the Lord's sublime essence. Through this essence, the Essence is obtained. ||7||

1064.g: ਮਹਲੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
1064.t: mahalai a(n)dhar mahal ko paae ||
1064.e: Rare are those who find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within the mansion of their own body.

1064.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
1064.t: gur kai sabadh sach chit laae ||
1064.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they lovingly focus their consciousness on the True Lord.

1064.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1064.t: jis no sach dhei soiee sach paae sache sach milaidhaa ||8||
1064.e: Whoever the Lord blesses with Truth obtains Truth; he merges in Truth, and only Truth. ||8||

1064.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1064.t: naam visaar man tan dhukh paiaa ||
1064.e: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body suffer in pain.

1064.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
1064.t: maiaa moh sabh rog kamaiaa ||
1064.e: Attached to the love of Maya, he earns nothing but disease.

1064.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਨਰਕੇ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1064.t: bin naavai man tan hai kusaTee narake vaasaa paidhaa ||9||
1064.e: Without the Name, his mind and body are afflicted with leprosy, and he obtains his home in hell. ||9||

1064.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
1064.t: naam rate tin niramal dhehaa ||
1064.e: Those who are imbued with the Naam - their bodies are immaculate and pure.

1064.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨੇਹਾ ॥
1064.t: niramal ha(n)saa sadhaa sukh nehaa ||
1064.e: Their soul-swan is immaculate, and in the Lord's Love, they find eternal peace.

1064.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1064.t: naam salaeh sadhaa sukh paiaa nij ghar vaasaa paidhaa ||10||
1064.e: Praising the Naam, they find eternal peace, and dwell in the home of their own inner being. ||10||

1064.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
1064.t: sabh ko vanaj kare vaapaaraa ||
1064.e: Everyone deals and trades.

1064.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
1064.t: vin naavai sabh toTaa sa(n)saaraa ||
1064.e: Without the Name, all the world loses.

1064.g: ਨਾਗੋ ਆਇਆ ਨਾਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1064.t: naago aaiaa naago jaasee vin naavai dhukh paidhaa ||11||
1064.e: Naked they come, and naked they go; without the Name, they suffer in pain. ||11||

1064.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
1064.t: jis no naam dhei so paae ||
1064.e: He alone obtains the Naam, unto whom the Lord gives it.

1064.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
1064.t: gur kai sabadh har ma(n)n vasaae ||
1064.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

1064.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1064.t: gur kirapaa te naam vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar naamo naam dhiaaidhaa ||12||
1064.e: By Guru's Grace, the Naam dwells deep within the heart, and one meditates upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||12||

1064.g: ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਆਈ ॥
1064.t: naavai no lochai jetee sabh aaiee ||
1064.e: Everyone who comes into the world, longs for the Name.

1064.g: ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
1064.t: naau tinaa milai dhur purab kamaiee ||
1064.e: They alone are blessed with the Name, whose past actions were so ordained by the Primal Lord.

1064.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1064.t: jinee naau paiaa se vaddabhaagee gur kai sabadh milaidhaa ||13||
1064.e: Those who obtain the Name are very fortunate. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are united with God. ||13||

1064.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1064.t: kaiaa koT at apaaraa ||
1064.e: Utterly incomparable is the fortress of the body.

1064.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1064.t: tis vich beh prabh kare veechaaraa ||
1064.e: Within it, God sits in contemplation.

1064.g: ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੋ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1064.t: sachaa niaau sacho vaapaaraa nihachal vaasaa paidhaa ||14||
1064.e: He administers true justice, and trades in Truth; through Him, one finds the eternal, unchanging dwelling. ||14||

1064.g: ਅੰਤਰ ਘਰ ਬੰਕੇ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
1064.t: a(n)tar ghar ba(n)ke thaan suhaiaa ||
1064.e: Deep within the inner self are glorious homes and beautiful places.

1064.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਥਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1064.t: gurmukh viralai kinai thaan paiaa ||
1064.e: But rare is that person who, as Gurmukh, finds these places.

1064.g: ਇਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1064.t: eit saath nibahai saalaahe sache har sachaa ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||15||
1064.e: If one stays in these places, and praises the True Lord, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||15||

1064.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਇਕ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
1064.t: merai karatai ik banat banaiee ||
1064.e: My Creator Lord has formed this formation.

1064.g: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
1064.t: eis dhehee vich sabh vath paiee ||
1064.e: He has placed everything within this body.

1064.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੨੦॥
1064.t: naanak naam vanajeh ra(n)g raate gurmukh ko naam paidhaa ||16||6||20||
1064.e: O Nanak, those who deal in the Naam are imbued with His Love. The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||6||20||

1064.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1064.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
1064.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1064.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1064.t: kaiaa ka(n)chan sabadh veechaaraa ||
1064.e: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, the body becomes golden.

1064.g: ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
1064.t: tithai har vasai jis dhaa a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||
1064.e: The Lord abides there; He has no end or limitation.

1064.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1064.t: anadhin har sevih sachee baanee har jeeau sabadh milaidhaa ||1||
1064.e: Night and day, serve the Lord, and chant the True Word of the Guru's Bani. Through the Shabad, meet the Dear Lord. ||1||

1065.g: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
1065.t: har cheteh tin balihaarai jaau ||
1065.e: I am a sacrifice to those who remember the Lord.

1065.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
1065.t: gur kai sabadh tin mel milaau ||
1065.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I unite in Union with the Lord.

1065.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1065.t: tin kee dhoor laiee mukh masatak satasa(n)gat beh gun gaidhaa ||2||
1065.e: I touch the dust of their feet to my face and forehead; sitting in the Society of the Saints, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||2||

1065.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
1065.t: har ke gun gaavaa je har prabh bhaavaa ||
1065.e: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, as I am pleasing to the Lord God.

1065.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
1065.t: a(n)tar har naam sabadh suhaavaa ||
1065.e: With the Lord's Name deep within my inner being, I am adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

1065.g: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1065.t: gurbaanee chahu ku(n)ddee suneeaai saachai naam samaidhaa ||3||
1065.e: The Word of the Guru's Bani is heard throughout the four corners of the world; through it, we merge in the True Name. ||3||

1065.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
1065.t: so jan saachaa j a(n)tar bhaale || gur kai sabadh har nadhar nihaale ||
1065.e: That humble being, who searches within himself, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sees the Lord with his eyes.

1065.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1065.t: giaan a(n)jan paae gur sabadhee nadharee nadhar milaidhaa ||4||
1065.e: Through the Guru's Shabad, he applies the ointment of spiritual wisdom to his eyes; the Gracious Lord, in His Grace, unites him with Himself. ||4||

1065.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1065.t: vaddai bhaag ih sareer paiaa ||
1065.e: By great good fortune, I obtained this body;

1065.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
1065.t: maanas janam sabadh chit laiaa ||
1065.e: in this human life, I have focused my consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

1065.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1065.t: bin sabadhai sabh a(n)dh a(n)dheraa gurmukh kiseh bujhaidhaa ||5||
1065.e: Without the Shabad, everything is enveloped in utter darkness; only the Gurmukh understands. ||5||

1065.g: ਇਕਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
1065.t: eik kit aae janam gavaae ||
1065.e: Some merely waste away their lives - why have they even come into the world?

1065.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
1065.t: manmukh laage dhoojai bhaae ||
1065.e: The self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.

1065.g: ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1065.t: eh velaa fir haath na aavai pag khisiaai pachhutaidhaa ||6||
1065.e: This opportunity shall not into their hands again; their foot slips, and they come to regret and repent. ||6||

1065.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
1065.t: gur kai sabadh pavitr sareeraa ||
1065.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the body is sanctified.

1065.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
1065.t: tis vich vasai sach gunee gaheeraa ||
1065.e: The True Lord, the ocean of virtue, dwells within it.

1065.g: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1065.t: sacho sach vekhai sabh thaiee sach sun ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||7||
1065.e: One who sees the Truest of the True everywhere, hears the Truth, and enshrines it within his mind. ||7||

1065.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
1065.t: haumai ganat gur sabadh nivaare ||
1065.e: Egotism and mental calculations are relieved through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1065.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
1065.t: har jeeau hiradhai rakhahu ur dhaare ||
1065.e: Keep the Dear Lord close, and enshrine Him in your heart.

1065.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1065.t: gur kai sabadh sadhaa saalaahe mil saache sukh paidhaa ||8||
1065.e: One who praises the Lord forever, through the Guru's Shabad, meets with the True Lord, and finds peace. ||8||

1065.g: ਸੋ ਚੇਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਚੇਤਾਏ ॥
1065.t: so chete jis aap chetaae ||
1065.e: He alone remembers the Lord, whom the Lord inspires to remember.

1065.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
1065.t: gur kai sabadh vasai man aae ||
1065.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He comes to dwell in the mind.

1065.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1065.t: aape vekhai aape boojhai aapai aap samaidhaa ||9||
1065.e: He Himself sees, and He Himself understands; He merges all into Himself. ||9||

1065.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
1065.t: jin man vich vath paiee soiee jaanai ||
1065.e: He alone knows, who has placed the object within his mind.

1065.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
1065.t: gur kai sabadhe aap pachhaanai ||
1065.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he comes to understand himself.

1065.g: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1065.t: aap pachhaanai soiee jan niramal baanee sabadh sunaidhaa ||10||
1065.e: That humble being who understands himself is immaculate. He proclaims the Guru's Bani, and the Word of the Shabad. ||10||

1065.g: ਏਹ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
1065.t: eh kaiaa pavit hai sareer ||
1065.e: This body is sanctified and purified;

1065.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਚੇਤੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
1065.t: gur sabadhee chetai gunee gaheer ||
1065.e: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it contemplates the Lord, the ocean of virtue.

1065.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1065.t: anadhin gun gaavai ra(n)g raataa gun keh gunee samaidhaa ||11||
1065.e: One who chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord night and day, and remains attuned to His Love, chants His Glorious Virtues, immersed in the Glorious Lord. ||11||

1065.g: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1065.t: eh sareer sabh mool hai maiaa ||
1065.e: This body is the source of all Maya;

1065.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
1065.t: dhoojai bhai bharam bhulaiaa ||
1065.e: in love with duality, it is deluded by doubt.

1065.g: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1065.t: har na chetai sadhaa dhukh paae bin har chete dhukh paidhaa ||12||
1065.e: It does not remember the Lord, and suffers in eternal pain. Without remembering the Lord, it suffers in pain. ||12||

1065.g: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
1065.t: j satigur seve so paravaan ||
1065.e: One who serves the True Guru is approved and respected.

1065.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
1065.t: kaiaa ha(n)s niramal dhar sachai jaan ||
1065.e: His body and soul-swan are immaculate and pure; in the Court of the Lord, he is known to be true.

1065.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1065.t: har seve har ma(n)n vasaae sohai har gun gaidhaa ||13||
1065.e: He serves the Lord, and enshrines the Lord in his mind; he is exalted, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||13||

1065.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1065.t: bin bhaagaa gur seviaa na jai ||
1065.e: Without good destiny, no one can serve the True Guru.

1065.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
1065.t: manmukh bhoole mue bilalai ||
1065.e: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, and die weeping and wailing.

1065.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1065.t: jin kau nadhar hovai gur keree har jeeau aap milaidhaa ||14||
1065.e: Those who are blessed by the Guru's Glance of Grace - the Dear Lord unites them with Himself. ||14||

1065.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਪਕੇ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
1065.t: kaiaa koT pake haTanaale ||
1065.e: In the body fortress, are the solidly-constructed markets.

1065.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਵੈ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
1065.t: gurmukh levai vasat samaale ||
1065.e: The Gurmukh purchases the object, and takes care of it.

1065.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1065.t: har kaa naam dhiaai dhin raatee uootam padhavee paidhaa ||15||
1065.e: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, day and night, he attains the sublime, exalted status. ||15||

1065.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
1065.t: aape sachaa hai sukhadhaataa ||
1065.e: The True Lord Himself is the Giver of peace.

1065.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
1065.t: poore gur kai sabadh pachhaataa ||
1065.e: Through the Shabad of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.

1065.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੭॥੨੧॥
1065.t: naanak naam salaahe saachaa poorai bhaag ko paidhaa ||16||7||21||
1065.e: Nanak praises the Naam, the True Name of the Lord; through perfect destiny, He is found. ||16||7||21||

1066.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:
The Formless Lord created the universe of form.
By the Hukam of His Command, He created attachment to Maya.

1066.g: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1066.t: aape khel kare sabh karataa sun saachaa ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||1||
1066.e: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; hearing of the True Lord, enshrine Him in your mind. ||1||

1066.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਸੂਤਿ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
1066.t: maiaa maiee trai gun parasoot jamaiaa ||
1066.e: Maya, the mother, gave birth to the three gunas, the three qualities,
and proclaimed the four Vedas to Brahma.

1066.g: ਵਰ੍ਹੇ ਮਾਹ ਵਾਰ ਥਿਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1066.t: varhe maeh vaar thitee kar is jag meh sojhee paidhaa ||2||
1066.e: Creating the years, months, days and dates, He infused intelligence into the world. ||2||
Service to the Guru is the most excellent action.
Enshrine the Lord's Name within your heart.

1066.g: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵਰਤੀ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਇਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1066.t: gurbaanee varatee jag a(n)tar is baanee te har naam paidhaa ||3||
1066.e: The Word of the Guru's Bani prevails throughout the world; through this Bani, the Lord's Name is obtained. ||3||
He reads the Vedas, but he starts arguments night and day.
He does not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

1066.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1066.t: dhoojai bhai sadhaa dhukh paae trai gun bharam bhulaidhaa ||4||
1066.e: In the love of duality, he suffers in pain forever; he is deluded by doubt, and confused by the three gunas. ||4||
The Gurmukh is in love with the One Lord alone;
he submerges in his mind the three-phased desire.

1066.g: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1066.t: saachai sabadh sadhaa hai mukataa maiaa moh chukaidhaa ||5||
1066.e: Through the True Word of the Shabad, he is liberated forever; he renounces emotional attachment to Maya. ||5||

1066.g: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੇ ਹੁਣਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
1066.t: jo dhur raate se hun raate ||
1066.e: Those who are so pre-ordained to be imbued, are imbued with love for the Lord.
By Guru's Grace, they are intuitively intoxicated.

1066.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1066.t: satigur sev sadhaa prabh paiaa aapai aap milaidhaa ||6||
1066.e: Serving the True Guru forever, they find God; He Himself unites them with Himself. ||6||
In attachment to Maya and doubt, the Lord is not found.
Attached to the love of duality, one suffers in pain.

1066.g: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਾਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1066.t: soohaa ra(n)g dhin thoRe hovai is jaadhe bilam na laidhaa ||7||
1066.e: The crimson color lasts for only a few days; all too soon, it fades away. ||7||
So color this mind in the Fear and the Love of God.
Dyed in this color, one merges in the True Lord.

1066.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1066.t: poorai bhaag ko ih ra(n)g paae gurmatee ra(n)g chaRaidhaa ||8||
1066.e: By perfect destiny, some may obtain this color. Through the Guru's Teachings, this color is applied. ||8||
The self-willed manmukhs take great pride in themselves.

1066.g: ਦਰਗਹ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
1066.t: dharageh kab hee na paavai maan ||
1066.e: In the Court of the Lord, they are never honored.

1066.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1066.t: dhoojai laage janam gavaiaa bin boojhe dhukh paidhaa ||9||
1066.e: Attached to duality, they waste their lives; without understanding, they suffer in pain. ||9||
My God has hidden Himself deep within the self.
By Guru's Grace, one is united in the Lord's Union.

1066.g: ਸਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1066.t: sachaa prabh sachaa vaapaaraa naam amolak paidhaa ||10||
1066.e: God is True, and True is His trade, through which the priceless Naam is obtained. ||10||

1066.g: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
1066.t: eis kaiaa kee keemat kinai na paiee ||
1066.e: No one has found this body's value.
My Lord and Master has worked His handiwork.

1066.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧੈ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1066.t: gurmukh hovai su kaiaa sodhai aapeh aap milaidhaa ||11||
1066.e: One who becomes Gurmukh purifies his body, and then the Lord unites him with Himself. ||11||

1066.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
1066.t: kaiaa vich toTaa kaiaa vich laahaa ||
1066.e: Within the body, one loses, and within the body, one wins.
The Gurmukh seeks the self-sustaining Lord.

1066.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1066.t: gurmukh vanaj sadhaa sukh paae sahaje sahaj milaidhaa ||12||
1066.e: The Gurmukh trades, and finds peace forever; he intuitively merges in the Celestial Lord. ||12||
True is the Lord's Mansion, and True is His treasure.
The Great Giver Himself gives.

1066.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1066.t: gurmukh saalaahe sukhadhaate man mele keemat paidhaa ||13||
1066.e: The Gurmukh praises the Giver of peace; his mind is united with the Lord, and he comes to know His worth. ||13||

1066.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
1066.t: kaiaa vich vasat keemat nahee paiee ||
1066.e: Within the body is the object; its value cannot be estimated.
He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh.

1066.g: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹਟੁ ਸੋਈ ਵਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1066.t: jis dhaa haT soiee vath jaanai gurmukh dhei na pachhotaidhaa ||14||
1066.e: He alone knows this object, to whom this store belongs; the Gurmukh is blessed with it, and does not come to regret. ||14||

1066.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
1066.t: har jeeau sabh meh rahiaa samaiee ||
1066.e: The Dear Lord is pervading and permeating all.
By Guru's Grace, He is found.

1066.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1066.t: aape mel milaae aape sabadhe sahaj samaidhaa ||15||
1066.e: He Himself unites in His Union; through the Word of the Shabad, one intuitively merges with Him. ||15||

1067.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
1067.t: aape sachaa sabadh milaae ||
1067.e: The True Lord Himself unites us in the Word of His Shabad.

1067.g: ਸਬਦੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
1067.t: sabadhe vichahu bharam chukaae ||
1067.e: Within the Shabad, doubt is driven out.

1067.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੮॥੨੨॥
1067.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee naame hee sukh paidhaa ||16||8||22||
1067.e: O Nanak, He blesses us with His Naam, and throgh the Naam, peace is found. ||16||8||22||

1067.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1067.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
1067.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

1067.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
1067.t: agam agochar veparavaahe ||
1067.e: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and self-sustaining.

1067.g: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੇ ॥
1067.t: aape miharavaan agam athaahe ||
1067.e: He Himself is merciful, inaccessible and unlimited.

1067.g: ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1067.t: apaR koi na sakai tis no gur sabadhee melaiaa ||1||
1067.e: No one can reach up to Him; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is met. ||1||

1067.g: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
1067.t: tudhuno seveh jo tudh bhaaveh ||
1067.e: He alone serves You, who pleases You.

1067.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
1067.t: gur kai sabadhe sach samaaveh ||
1067.e: Through the Guru's Shabad, he merges in the True Lord.

1067.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1067.t: anadhin gun raveh dhin raatee rasanaa har ras bhaiaa ||2||
1067.e: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Praises, day and night; his tongue savors and delights in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

1067.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ॥
1067.t: sabadh mareh se maran savaareh ||
1067.e: Those who die in the Shabad - their death is exalted and glorified.

1067.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਹਿ ॥
1067.t: har ke gun hiradhai ur dhaareh ||
1067.e: They enshrine the Lord's Glories in their hearts.

1067.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1067.t: janam safal har charanee laage dhoojaa bhaau chukaiaa ||3||
1067.e: Holding tight to the Guru's feet, their lives becomes prosperous, and they are rid of the love of duality. ||3||

1067.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
1067.t: har jeeau mele aap milaae ||
1067.e: The Dear Lord unites them in Union with Himself.

1067.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
1067.t: gur kai sabadhe aap gavaae ||
1067.e: Through the Guru's Shabad, self-conceit is dispelled.

1067.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1067.t: anadhin sadhaa har bhagatee raate is jag meh laahaa paiaa ||4||
1067.e: Those who remain attuned to devotional worship to the Lord, night and day, earn the profit in this world. ||4||

1067.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1067.t: tere gun kahaa mai kahan na jaiee ||
1067.e: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I describe? I cannot describe them.

1067.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
1067.t: a(n)t na paaraa keemat nahee paiee ||
1067.e: You have no end or limitation. Your value cannot be estimated.

1067.g: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
1067.t: aape dhiaa kare sukhadhaataa gun meh gunee samaiaa ||5||
1067.e: When the Giver of peace Himself bestows His Mercy, the virtuous are absorbed in virtue. ||5||

1067.g: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
1067.t: eis jag meh moh hai paasaaraa ||
1067.e: In this world, emotional attachment is spread all over.

1067.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
1067.t: manmukh agiaanee a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||
1067.e: The ignorant, self-willed manmukh is immersed in utter darkness.

1067.g: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
1067.t: dha(n)dhai dhaavat janam gavaiaa bin naavai dhukh paiaa ||6||
1067.e: Chasing after worldly affairs, he wastes away his life in vain; without the Name, he suffers in pain. ||6||

1067.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
1067.t: karam hovai taa satigur paae ||
1067.e: If God grants His Grace, then one finds the True Guru.

1067.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
1067.t: haumai mail sabadh jalaae ||
1067.e: Through the Shabad, the filth of egotism is burned away.

1067.g: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
1067.t: man niramal giaan ratan chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaiaa ||7||
1067.e: The mind becomes immaculate, and the jewel of spiritual wisdom brings enlightenment; the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled. ||7||

1067.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
1067.t: tere naam anek keemat nahee paiee ||
1067.e: Your Names are countless; Your value cannot be estimated.

1067.g: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
1067.t: sach naam har hiradhai vasaiee ||
1067.e: I enshrine the Lord's True Name within my heart.

1067.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
1067.t: keemat kaun kare prabh teree too aape sahaj samaiaa ||8||
1067.e: Who can estimate Your value, God? You are immersed and absorbed in Yourself. ||8||

1067.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1067.t: naam amolak agam apaaraa ||
1067.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.

1067.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1067.t: naa ko hoaa tolanahaaraa ||
1067.e: No one can weigh it.

1067.g: ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
1067.t: aape tole tol tolaae gur sabadhee mel tolaiaa ||9||
1067.e: You Yourself weigh, and estimate all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You unite, when the weight is perfect. ||9||

1067.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
1067.t: sevak seveh kareh aradhaas ||
1067.e: Your servant serves, and offers this prayer.

1067.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਬਹਾਲਹਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
1067.t: too aape mel bahaaleh paas ||
1067.e: Please, let me sit near You, and unite me with Yourself.

1067.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
1067.t: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa sukhadhaataa poorai karam dhiaaiaa ||10||
1067.e: You are the Giver of peace to all beings; by perfect karma, we meditate on You. ||10||

1067.g: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
1067.t: jat sat sa(n)jam j sach kamaavai ||
1067.e: Chastity, truth and self-control come by practicing and living the Truth.

1067.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
1067.t: eih man niramal j har gun gaavai ||
1067.e: This mind becomes immaculate and pure, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

1067.g: ਇਸੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
1067.t: eis bikh meh a(n)mrit paraapat hovai har jeeau mere bhaiaa ||11||
1067.e: In this world of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained, if it pleases my Dear Lord. ||11||

1067.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
1067.t: jis no bujhaae soiee boojhai ||
1067.e: He alone understands, whom God inspires to understand.

1067.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
1067.t: har gun gaavai a(n)dhar soojhai ||
1067.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one's inner being is awakened.

1067.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
1067.t: haumai meraa Thaak rahaae sahaje hee sach paiaa ||12||
1067.e: Egotism and possessiveness are silenced and subdued, and one intuitively finds the True Lord. ||12||

1067.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਹੋਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
1067.t: bin karamaa hor firai ghaneree ||
1067.e: Without good karma, countless others wander around.

1067.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਨ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
1067.t: mar mar ja(n)mai chukai na feree ||
1067.e: They die, and die again, only to be reborn; they cannot escape the cycle of reincarnation.

1067.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
1067.t: bikh kaa raataa bikh kamaavai sukh na kabahoo paiaa ||13||
1067.e: Imbued with poison, they practice poison and corruption, and they never find peace. ||13||

1067.g: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
1067.t: bahute bhekh kare bhekhadhaaree ||
1067.e: Many disguise themselves with religious robes.

1067.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
1067.t: bin sabadhai haumai kinai na maaree ||
1067.e: Without the Shabad, no one has conquered egotism.

1067.g: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
1067.t: jeevat marai taa mukat paae sachai nai samaiaa ||14||
1067.e: One who remains dead while yet alive is liberated, and merges in the True Name. ||14||

1067.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਤਨਹਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
1067.t: agiaan tirasanaa is taneh jalaae ||
1067.e: Spiritual ignorance and desire burn this human body.

1068.g: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
1068.t: tis dhee boojhai j gur sabadh kamaae ||
1068.e: He alone puts out this fire, who practices and lives the Guru's Shabad.

1068.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
1068.t: tan man seetal karodh nivaare haumai maar samaiaa ||15||
1068.e: His body and mind are cooled and soothed, and his anger is silenced; conquering egotism, he merges in the Lord. ||15||
True is the Lord and Master, and True is His glorious greatness.
By Guru's Grace, a rare few attain this.

1068.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੨੩॥
1068.t: naanak ek kahai bena(n)tee naame naam samaiaa ||16||1||23||
1068.e: Nanak offers this one prayer: through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, may I merge in the Lord. ||16||1||23||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
By Your Grace, please unite with Your devotees.
Your devotees ever praise You, lovingly focusing on You.

1068.g: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1068.t: tau saranaiee ubareh karate aape mel milaiaa ||1||
1068.e: In Your Sanctuary, they are saved, O Creator Lord; You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||1||
Sublime and exalted is devotion to the Perfect Word of the Shabad.
Peace prevails within; they are pleasing to Your Mind.

1068.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1068.t: man tan sachee bhagatee raataa sache siau chit laiaa ||2||
1068.e: One whose mind and body are imbued with true devotion, focuses his consciousness on the True Lord. ||2||
In egotism, the body is forever burning.
When God grants His Grace, one meets the Perfect Guru.

1068.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1068.t: a(n)tar agiaan sabadh bujhaae satigur te sukh paiaa ||3||
1068.e: The Shabad dispels the spiritual ignorance within, and through the True Guru, one finds peace. ||3||
The blind, self-willed manmukh acts blindly.
He is in terrible trouble, and wanders in reincarnation.

1068.g: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1068.t: jam kaa jevaRaa kadhe na kaaTai a(n)te bahu dhukh paiaa ||4||
1068.e: He can never snap the noose of Death, and in the end, he suffers in horrible pain. ||4||
Through the Shabad, one's comings and goings in reincarnation are ended.
He keeps the True Name enshrined within his heart.

1068.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
1068.t: gur kai sabadh marai man maare haumai jai samaiaa ||5||
1068.e: He dies in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and conquers his mind; stilling his egotism, he merges in the Lord. ||5||
Coming and going, the people of the world are wasting away.

1068.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1068.t: bin satigur thir koi na hoiee ||
1068.e: Without the True Guru, no one finds permanence and stability.

1068.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
1068.t: a(n)tar jot sabadh sukh vasiaa jotee jot milaiaa ||6||
1068.e: The Shabad shines its Light deep within the self, and one dwells in peace; one's light merges into the Light. ||6||
The five demons think of evil and corruption.
The expanse is the manifestation of emotional attachment to Maya.

1068.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੭॥
1068.t: satigur seve taa mukat hovai pa(n)ch dhoot vas aaiaa ||7||
1068.e: Serving the True Guru, one is liberated, and the five demons are put under his control. ||7||
Without the Guru, there is only the darkness of attachment.
Over and over, time and time again, they are drowned.

1068.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
1068.t: satigur bheTe sach dhiraRaae sach naam man bhaiaa ||8||
1068.e: Meeting the True Guru, Truth is implanted within, and the True Name becomes pleasing to the mind. ||8||
True is His Door, and True is His Court, His Royal Darbaar.
The true ones serve Him, through the Beloved Word of the Shabad.

1068.g: ਸਚੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
1068.t: sachee dhun sache gun gaavaa sache maeh samaiaa ||9||
1068.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, in the true melody, I am immersed and absorbed in Truth. ||9||
Deep within the home of the self, one finds the home of the Lord.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one easily, intuitively finds it.

1068.g: ਓਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
1068.t: othai sog vijog na viaapai sahaje sahaj samaiaa ||10||
1068.e: There, one is not afflicted with sorrow or separation; merge into the Celestial Lord with intuitive ease. ||10||
The evil people live in the love of duality.
They wander around, totally attached and thirsty.

1068.g: ਕੁਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
1068.t: kusa(n)gat baheh sadhaa dhukh paaveh dhukho dhukh kamaiaa ||11||
1068.e: They sit in evil gatherings, and suffer in pain forever; they earn pain, nothing but pain. ||11||
Without the True Guru, there is no Sangat, no Congregation.

1068.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
1068.t: bin sabadhe paar na paae koiee ||
1068.e: Without the Shabad, no one can cross over to the other side.

1068.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
1068.t: sahaje gun raveh dhin raatee jotee jot milaiaa ||12||
1068.e: One who intuitively chants God's Glorious Praises day and night - his light merges into the Light. ||12||
The body is the tree; the bird of the soul dwells within it.
It drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, resting in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1068.g: ਉਡਹਿ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
1068.t: auddeh na moole na aaveh na jaahee nij ghar vaasaa paiaa ||13||
1068.e: It never flies away, and it does not come or go; it dwells within the home of its own self. ||13||
Purify the body, and contemplate the Shabad.
Remove the poisonous drug of emotional attachment, and eradicate doubt.

1068.g: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
1068.t: aape kirapaa kare sukhadhaataa aape mel milaiaa ||14||
1068.e: The Giver of peace Himself bestows His Mercy, and unites us in Union with Himself. ||14||

1069.g: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
1069.t: sadh hee neRai dhoor na jaanahu ||
1069.e: He is always near at hand; He is never far away.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, realize that He is very near.

1069.g: ਬਿਗਸੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
1069.t: bigasai kamal kiran paragaasai paragaT kar dhekhaiaa ||15||
1069.e: Your heart-lotus shall blossom forth, and the ray of God's Divine Light shall illuminate your heart; He shall be revealed to You. ||15||
The True Lord is Himself the Creator.

1069.g: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
1069.t: aape maar jeevaale avar na koiee ||
1069.e: He Himself kills, and gives life; there is no other at all.

1069.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੨੪॥
1069.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee aap gavai sukh paiaa ||16||2||24||
1069.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, glorious greatness is obtained. Eradicating self-conceit, peace is found. ||16||2||24||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fourth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Lord Lord Himself is the One who exalts and embellishes.
Do not consider any other work.

1069.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1069.t: gurmukh sach vasai ghaT a(n)tar sahaje sach samaiee he ||1||
1069.e: The True Lord abides deep within the heart of the Gurmukh, who intuitively merges in the True Lord. ||1||
The True Lord dwells within the minds of all.
By Guru's Grace, they are intuitively absorbed in Him.

1069.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1069.t: gur gur karat sadhaa sukh paiaa gur charanee chit laiee he ||2||
1069.e: Calling out, ""Guru, Guru"", I have found eternal peace; my consciousness is focused on the Guru's feet. ||2||

1069.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
1069.t: satigur hai giaan satigur hai poojaa ||
1069.e: The True Guru is spiritual wisdom; the True Guru is worship and adoration.
I serve the True Guru, and no other.

1069.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1069.t: satigur te naam ratan dhan paiaa satigur kee sevaa bhaiee he ||3||
1069.e: From the True Guru, I have obtained the wealth, the jewel of the Naam. Service to the True Guru is pleasing to me. ||3||
Without the True Guru, those who are attached to duality
come and go, and wander in reincarnation; these unfortunate ones die.

1069.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1069.t: naanak tin kee fir gat hovai j gurmukh raheh saranaiee he ||4||
1069.e: O Nanak, even after they are emancipated, those who become Gurmukh remain in the Guru's Sanctuary. ||4||
The love of the Gurmukh is forever true.
I beg for the invaluable Naam, the Name of the Lord, from the Guru.

1069.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1069.t: hoh dhiaal kirapaa kar har jeeau rakh levahu gur saranaiee he ||5||
1069.e: O Dear Lord, please be kind, and grant Your Grace; please keep me in the Guru's Sanctuary. ||5||
The True Guru trickles the Ambrosial Nectar into my mouth.
My Tenth Gate has been opened and revealed.

1069.g: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1069.t: teh anahadh sabadh vajeh dhun baanee sahaje sahaj samaiee he ||6||
1069.e: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds there, with the melody of the Guru's Bani; one is easily, intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||6||

1069.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
1069.t: jin kau karatai dhur likh paiee ||
1069.e: Those who are so pre-ordained by the Creator,
pass their nights and days calling on the Guru.

1069.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸੀਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1069.t: bin satigur ko seejhai naahee gur charanee chit laiee he ||7||
1069.e: Without the True Guru, no one understands; focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||7||
The Lord Himself blesses those with whom He is pleased.
The Gurmukh receives the wealth of the Naam.

1069.g: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1069.t: aape kirapaa kare naam dhevai naanak naam samaiee he ||8||
1069.e: When the Lord grants His Grace, He bestows the Naam; Nanak is immersed and absorbed in the Naam. ||8||
The jewel of spiritual wisdom is revealed within the mind.
The wealth of the Naam is easily, intuitively received.

1069.g: ਏਹ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1069.t: eh vaddiaaiee gur te paiee satigur kau sadh bal jaiee he ||9||
1069.e: This glorious greatness is obtained from the Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||9||
With the rising of the sun, the darkness of the night is dispelled.
Spiritual ignorance is eradicated, by the priceless jewel of the Guru.

1069.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1069.t: satigur giaan ratan at bhaaree karam milai sukh paiee he ||10||
1069.e: The True Guru is the fantastically valuable jewel of spiritual wisdom; blessed by God's Mercy, peace is found. ||10||
The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, and his good reputation increases.
In all four ages he is considered to be pure and good.

1069.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1069.t: naame naam rate sukh paiaa naam rahiaa liv laiee he ||11||
1069.e: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace. He remains lovingly focused on the Naam. ||11||
The Gurmukh receives the Naam.
In intuitive peace he wakes, and in intuitive peace he sleeps.

1070.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1070.t: gurmukh naam samai samaavai naanak naam dhiaaiee he ||12||
1070.e: The Gurmukh is immersed and absorbed in the Naam; Nanak meditates on the Naam. ||12||

1070.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1070.t: bhagataa mukh a(n)mirat hai baanee ||
1070.e: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Guru's Bani is in the mouth of the devotees.

1070.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
1070.t: gurmukh har naam aakh vakhaanee ||
1070.e: The Gurmukhs chant and repeat the Lord's Name.

1070.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1070.t: har har karat sadhaa man bigasai har charanee man laiee he ||13||
1070.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds forever blossom forth; they focus their minds on the Lord's Feet. ||13||

1070.g: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1070.t: ham moorakh agiaan giaan kichh naahee ||
1070.e: I am foolish and ignorant; I have no wisdom at all.

1070.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਪੜੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
1070.t: satigur te samajh paRee man maahee ||
1070.e: From the True Guru, I have obtained understanding in my mind.

1070.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1070.t: hoh dhiaal kirapaa kar har jeeau satigur kee sevaa laiee he ||14||
1070.e: O Dear Lord, please be kind to me, and grant Your Grace; let me be committed to serving the True Guru. ||14||

1070.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
1070.t: jin satigur jaataa tin ek pachhaataa ||
1070.e: Those who know the True Guru realize the One Lord.

1070.g: ਸਰਬੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
1070.t: sarabe rav rahiaa sukhadhaataa ||
1070.e: The Giver of peace is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

1070.g: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1070.t: aatam cheen param padh paiaa sevaa surat samaiee he ||15||
1070.e: Understanding my own soul, I have obtained the Supreme Status; my awareness is immersed in selfless service. ||15||

1070.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1070.t: jin kau aadh milee vaddiaaiee ||
1070.e: Those who are blessed with glorious greatness by the Primal Lord God

1070.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
1070.t: satigur man vasiaa liv laiee ||
1070.e: are lovingly focused on the True Guru, who dwells within their minds.

1070.g: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
1070.t: aap miliaa jagajeevan dhaataa naanak a(n)k samaiee he ||16||1||
1070.e: The Giver of life to the world Himself meets them; O Nanak, they are absorbed in His Being. ||16||1||

1070.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1070.t: maaroo mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1070.e: Maaroo, Fourth Mehla:

1070.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
1070.t: har agam agochar sadhaa abinaasee ||
1070.e: The Lord is inaccessible and unfathomable; He is eternal and imperishable.

1070.g: ਸਰਬੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
1070.t: sarabe rav rahiaa ghaT vaasee ||
1070.e: He dwells in the heart, and is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

1070.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1070.t: tis bin avar na koiee dhaataa har tiseh sarevahu praanee he ||1||
1070.e: There is no other Giver except Him; worship the Lord, O mortals. ||1||

1070.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
1070.t: jaa kau raakhai har raakhanahaaraa || taa kau koi na saakas maaraa ||
1070.e: No one can kill anyone who is saved by the Savior Lord.

1070.g: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1070.t: so aaisaa har sevahu sa(n)tahu jaa kee uootam baanee he ||2||
1070.e: So serve such a Lord, O Saints, whose Bani is exalted and sublime. ||2||

1070.g: ਜਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1070.t: jaa jaapai kichh kithaauoo naahee ||
1070.e: When it seems that a place is empty and void,

1070.g: ਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
1070.t: taa karataa bharapoor samaahee ||
1070.e: there, the Creator Lord is permeating and pervading.

1070.g: ਸੂਕੇ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1070.t: sooke te fun hariaa keeton har dhiaavahu choj viddaanee he ||3||
1070.e: He causes the dried-up branch to blossom forth in greenery again; so meditate on the Lord - wondrous are His ways! ||3||

1070.g: ਜੋ ਜੀਆ ਕੀ ਵੇਦਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
1070.t: jo jeeaa kee vedhan jaanai ||
1070.e: The One who knows the anguish of all beings

1070.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥
1070.t: tis saahib kai hau kurabaanai ||
1070.e: unto that Lord and Master, I am a sacrifice.

1070.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਜੋ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1070.t: tis aagai jan kar bena(n)tee jo sarab sukhaa kaa dhaanee he ||4||
1070.e: Offer your prayers to the One who is the Giver of all peace and joy. ||4||

1070.g: ਜੋ ਜੀਐ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
1070.t: jo jeeaai kee saar na jaanai ||
1070.e: But one who does not know the state of the soul

1070.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਅਜਾਣੈ ॥
1070.t: tis siau kichh na kaheeaai ajaanai ||
1070.e: do not say anything to such an ignorant person.

1070.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਿਉ ਨਹ ਲੂਝੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1070.t: moorakh siau neh loojh paraanee har japeeaai padh nirabaanee he ||5||
1070.e: Do not argue with fools, O mortals. Meditate on the Lord, in the state of Nirvaanaa. ||5||

1070.g: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹੈ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
1070.t: naa kar chi(n)t chi(n)taa hai karate ||
1070.e: Don't worry - let the Creator take care of it.

1070.g: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਸਭਤੈ ॥
1070.t: har dhevai jal thal ja(n)taa sabhatai ||
1070.e: The Lord gives to all creatures in the water and on the land.

1070.g: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਟ ਪਖਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1070.t: achi(n)t dhaan dhei prabh meraa vich paathar keeT pakhaanee he ||6||
1070.e: My God bestows His blessings without being asked, even to worms in soil and stones. ||6||

1070.g: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
1070.t: naa kar aas meet sut bhaiee ||
1070.e: Do not place your hopes in friends, children and siblings.

1070.g: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਕਿਸੈ ਸਾਹ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
1070.t: naa kar aas kisai saeh biauhaar kee paraiee ||
1070.e: Do not place your hopes in kings or the business of others.

1070.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1070.t: bin har naavai ko belee naahee har japeeaai saara(n)gapaanee he ||7||
1070.e: Without the Lord's Name, no one will be your helper; so meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the world. ||7||

1070.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
1070.t: anadhin naam japahu banavaaree ||
1070.e: Night and day, chant the Naam.

1070.g: ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਥਾਰੀ ॥
1070.t: sabh aasaa manasaa poorai thaaree ||
1070.e: All your hopes and desires shall be fulfilled.

1070.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1070.t: jan naanak naam japahu bhav kha(n)ddan sukh sahaje rain vihaanee he ||8||
1070.e: O servant Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Destroyer of fear, and your life-night shall pass in intuitive peace and poise. ||8||

1070.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1070.t: jin har seviaa tin sukh paiaa ||
1070.e: Those who serve the Lord find peace.

1070.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
1070.t: sahaje hee har naam samaiaa ||
1070.e: They are intuitively absorbed in the Lord's Name.

1070.g: ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1070.t: jo saran parai tis kee pat raakhai jai poochhahu vedh puraanee he ||9||
1070.e: The Lord preserves the honor of those who seek His Sanctuary; go and consult the Vedas and the Puraanas. ||9||

1070.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
1070.t: jis har sevaa laae soiee jan laagai ||
1070.e: That humble being is attached to the Lord's service, whom the Lord so attaches.

1070.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
1070.t: gur kai sabadh bharam bhau bhaagai ||
1070.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, doubt and fear are dispelled.

1070.g: ਵਿਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜਿਉ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1070.t: viche gireh sadhaa rahai udhaasee jiau kamal rahai vich paanee he ||10||
1070.e: In his own home, he remains unattached, like the lotus flower in the water. ||10||

1071.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
1071.t: vich haumai sevaa thai na paae ||
1071.e: One who serves in egotism is not accepted or approved.

1071.g: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
1071.t: janam marai fir aavai jaae ||
1071.e: Such a person is born, only to die again, and come and go in reincarnation.

1071.g: ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਈ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1071.t: so tap pooraa saiee sevaa jo har mere man bhaanee he ||11||
1071.e: Perfect is that penance and that service, which is pleasing to the Mind of my Lord. ||11||

1071.g: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
1071.t: hau kiaa gun tere aakhaa suaamee ||
1071.e: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I chant, O my Lord and Master?

1071.g: ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
1071.t: too sarab jeeaa kaa a(n)tarajaamee ||
1071.e: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all souls.

1071.g: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1071.t: hau maagau dhaan tujhai peh karate har anadhin naam vakhaanee he ||12||
1071.e: I beg for blessings from You, O Creator Lord; I repeat Your Name night and day. ||12||

1071.g: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਬੋਲਣ ਕਾ ॥
1071.t: kis hee jor aha(n)kaar bolan kaa ||
1071.e: Some speak in egotistical power.

1071.g: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ਦੀਬਾਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ॥
1071.t: kis hee jor dheebaan maiaa kaa ||
1071.e: Some have the power of authority and Maya.

1071.g: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਟੇਕ ਧਰ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਤੂ ਕਰਤੇ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1071.t: mai har bin Tek dhar avar na kaiee too karate raakh mai nimaanee he ||13||
1071.e: I have no other Support at all, except the Lord. O Creator Lord, please save me, meek and dishonored. ||13||

1071.g: ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1071.t: nimaane maan kareh tudh bhaavai ||
1071.e: You bless the meek and dishonored with honor, as it pleases You, O Lord.

1071.g: ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
1071.t: hor ketee jhakh jhakh aavai jaavai ||
1071.e: Many others argue in conflict, coming and going in reincarnation.

1071.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਪਖੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਊਪਰਿ ਗਲ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1071.t: jin kaa pakh kareh too suaamee tin kee uoopar gal tudh aanee he ||14||
1071.e: Those people, whose side You take, O Lord and Master, are elevated and successful. ||14||

1071.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
1071.t: har har naam jinee sadhaa dhiaaiaa ||
1071.e: Those who meditate forever on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

1071.g: ਤਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1071.t: tinee gur parasaadh param padh paiaa ||
1071.e: by Guru's Grace, obtain the supreme status.

1071.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1071.t: jin har seviaa tin sukh paiaa bin sevaa pachhotaanee he ||15||
1071.e: Those who serve the Lord find peace; without serving Him, they regret and repent. ||15||

1071.g: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ॥
1071.t: too sabh meh varateh har jaga(n)naath ||
1071.e: You are pervading all, O Lord of the world.

1071.g: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
1071.t: so har japai jis gur masatak haath ||
1071.e: He alone meditates on the Lord, upon whose forehead the Guru places His hand.

1071.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਸਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
1071.t: har kee saran piaa har jaapee jan naanak dhaas dhasaanee he ||16||2||
1071.e: Entering the Sanctuary of the Lord, I meditate on the Lord; servant Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||16||2||

1071.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
1071.t: maaroo solahe mahalaa panjavaa
1071.e: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:

1071.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1071.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1071.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1071.g: ਕਲਾ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਰਣਾ ॥
1071.t: kalaa upai dharee jin dharanaa ||
1071.e: He infused His power into the earth.

1071.g: ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਚਰਣਾ ॥
1071.t: gagan rahaiaa hukame charanaa ||
1071.e: He suspends the heavens upon the feet of His Command.

1071.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਈਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਧੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1071.t: agan upai ieedhan meh baadhee so prabh raakhai bhaiee he ||1||
1071.e: He created fire and locked it into wood. That God protects all, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

1071.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕਉ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ॥
1071.t: jeea ja(n)t kau rijak sa(n)baahe ||
1071.e: He gives nourishment to all beings and creatures.

1071.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਆਪਾਹੇ ॥
1071.t: karan kaaran samarath aapaahe ||
1071.e: He Himself is the all-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes.

1071.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1071.t: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa soiee teraa sahaiee he ||2||
1071.e: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; He is your help and support. ||2||

1071.g: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਆ ॥
1071.t: maat garabh meh jin pratipaaliaa ||
1071.e: He cherished you in your mother's womb.

1071.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
1071.t: saas graas hoi sa(n)g samaaliaa ||
1071.e: With every breath and morsel of food, He is with you, and takes care of you.

1071.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਵਡੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1071.t: sadhaa sadhaa japeeaai so preetam vaddee jis vaddiaaiee he ||3||
1071.e: Forever and ever, meditate on that Beloved; Great is His glorious greatness! ||3||

1071.g: ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਕਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
1071.t: sulataan khaan kare khin keere ||
1071.e: The sultans and nobles are reduced to dust in an instant.

1071.g: ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਰੇ ॥
1071.t: gareeb nivaaj kare prabh meere ||
1071.e: God cherishes the poor, and makes them into rulers.

1071.g: ਗਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ ਸਰਬ ਸਧਾਰਣ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1071.t: garab nivaaran sarab sadhaaran kichh keemat kahee na jaiee he ||4||
1071.e: He is the Destroyer of egotistical pride, the Support of all. His value cannot be estimated. ||4||

1071.g: ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥
1071.t: so pativa(n)taa so dhanava(n)taa ||
1071.e: He alone is honorable, and he alone is wealthy,

1071.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
1071.t: jis man vasiaa har bhagava(n)taa ||
1071.e: within whose mind the Lord God abides.

1071.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1071.t: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhap bhaiee jin ieh sirasaT upaiee he ||5||
1071.e: He alone is my mother, father, child, relative and sibling, who created this Universe. ||5||

1071.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਸਰਣਾ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
1071.t: prabh aae saranaa bhau nahee karanaa ||
1071.e: I have come to God's Sanctuary, and so I fear nothing.

1071.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੈ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
1071.t: saadhasa(n)gat nihachau hai taranaa ||
1071.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am sure to be saved.

1071.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਸਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1071.t: man bach karam araadhe karataa tis naahee kadhe sajaiee he ||6||
1071.e: One who adores the Creator in thought, word and deed, shall never be punished. ||6||

1071.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
1071.t: gun nidhaan man tan meh raviaa ||
1071.e: One whose mind and body are permeated with the Lord, the treasure of virtue,

1071.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਭਵਿਆ ॥
1071.t: janam maran kee jon na bhaviaa ||
1071.e: does not wander in birth, death and reincarnation.

1071.g: ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਕੀਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਡੇਰਾ ਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1071.t: dhookh binaas keeaa sukh dderaa jaa tirapat rahe aaghaiee he ||7||
1071.e: Pain vanishes and peace prevails, when one is satisfied and fulfilled. ||7||

1071.g: ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
1071.t: meet hamaaraa soiee suaamee ||
1071.e: My Lord and Master is my best friend.

1072.g: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
1072.t: thaan thana(n)tar a(n)tarajaamee ||
1072.e: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is in all places and interspaces.

1072.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1072.t: simar simar pooran paramesur chi(n)taa ganat miTaiee he ||8||
1072.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Perfect Transcendent Lord, I am rid of all anxieties and calculations. ||8||

1072.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
1072.t: har kaa naam koT lakh baahaa ||
1072.e: One who has the Name of the Lord has hundreds of thousands and millions of arms.

1072.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਹਾ ॥
1072.t: har jas keeratan sa(n)g dhan taahaa ||
1072.e: The wealth of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is with him.
