1072.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਨਾ ਦੂਤ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1072.t: giaan khaRag kar kirapaa dheenaa dhoot maare kar dhaiee he ||9||
1072.e: In His Mercy, God has blessed me with the sword of spiritual wisdom; I have attacked and killed the demons. ||9||

1072.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥
1072.t: har kaa jaap japahu jap japane ||
1072.e: Chant the Chant of the Lord, the Chant of Chants.

1072.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਵਸਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
1072.t: jeet aavahu vasahu ghar apane ||
1072.e: Be a winner of the game of life and come to abide in your true home.

1072.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਨਰਕ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1072.t: lakh chauraaseeh narak na dhekhahu rasak rasak gun gaiee he ||10||
1072.e: You shall not see the 8.4 million types of hell; sing His Glorious Praises and remain saturated with loving devotion||10||

1072.g: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1072.t: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd udhaaranahaaraa ||
1072.e: He is the Savior of worlds and galaxies.

1072.g: ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1072.t: uooch athaeh aga(n)m apaaraa ||
1072.e: He is lofty, unfathomable, inaccessible and infinite.

1072.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1072.t: jis no kirapaa kare prabh apanee so jan tiseh dhiaaiee he ||11||
1072.e: That humble being, unto whom God grants His Grace, meditates on Him. ||11||

1072.g: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੋਲੇ ॥
1072.t: ba(n)dhan toR le'ee prabh mole ||
1072.e: God has broken my bonds, and claimed me as His own.

1072.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੇ ਘਰ ਗੋਲੇ ॥
1072.t: kar kirapaa keene ghar gole ||
1072.e: In His Mercy, He has made me the slave of His home.

1072.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1072.t: anahadh run jhunakaar sahaj dhun saachee kaar kamaiee he ||12||
1072.e: The unstruck celestial sound current resounds and vibrates, when one performs acts of true service. ||12||

1072.g: ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
1072.t: man parateet banee prabh teree ||
1072.e: O God, I have enshrined faith in You within my mind.

1072.g: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
1072.t: binas giee haumai mat meree ||
1072.e: My egotistical intellect has been driven out.

1072.g: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭ ਸੁਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1072.t: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai jag meh sobh suhaiee he ||13||
1072.e: God has made me His own, and now I have a glorious reputation in this world. ||13||

1072.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥
1072.t: jai jai kaar japahu jagadheesai ||
1072.e: Proclaim His Glorious Victory, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

1072.g: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਈਸੈ ॥
1072.t: bal bal jaiee prabh apune ieesai ||
1072.e: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Lord God.

1072.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕਾ ਜਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1072.t: tis bin dhoojaa avar na dheesai ekaa jagat sabaiee he ||14||
1072.e: I do not see any other except Him. The One Lord pervades the whole world. ||14||

1072.g: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
1072.t: sat sat sat prabh jaataa ||
1072.e: True, True, True is God.

1072.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
1072.t: gur parasaadh sadhaa man raataa ||
1072.e: By Guru's Grace, my mind is attuned to Him forever.

1072.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1072.t: simar simar jeeveh jan tere eka(n)kaar samaiee he ||15||
1072.e: Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating in remembrance on You, merging in You, O One Universal Creator. ||15||

1072.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
1072.t: bhagat janaa kaa preetam piaaraa ||
1072.e: The Dear Lord is the Beloved of His humble devotees.

1072.g: ਸਭੈ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
1072.t: sabhai udhaaran khasam hamaaraa ||
1072.e: My Lord and Master is the Savior of all.

1072.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਭ ਇਛਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
1072.t: simar naam pu(n)nee sabh ichhaa jan naanak paij rakhaiee he ||16||1||
1072.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all desires are fulfilled. He has saved the honor of servant Nanak. ||16||1||

1072.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
1072.t: maaroo solahe mahalaa panjavaa
1072.e: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:

1072.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1072.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1072.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1072.g: ਸੰਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਲਪਟਾਣੀ ॥
1072.t: sa(n)gee jogee naar lapaTaanee ||
1072.e: The body-bride is attached to the Yogi, the husband-soul.

1072.g: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
1072.t: aurajh rahee ra(n)g ras maanee ||
1072.e: She is involved with him, enjoying pleasure and delights.

1072.g: ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਭਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1072.t: kirat sa(n)jogee bhe ikatraa karate bhog bilaasaa he ||1||
1072.e: As a consequence of past actions, they have come together, enjoying pleasurable play. ||1||

1072.g: ਜੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਧਨ ਤਤੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
1072.t: jo pir karai su dhan tat maanai ||
1072.e: Whatever the husband does, the bride willingly accepts.

1072.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਰਖੈ ਸੰਗਾਨੈ ॥
1072.t: pir dhaneh seegaar rakhai sa(n)gaanai ||
1072.e: The husband adorns his bride, and keeps her with himself.

1072.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਤ੍ਰ ਵਸਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਦੇ ਧਨਹਿ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1072.t: mil ekatr vaseh dhin raatee priau dhe dhaneh dhilaasaa he ||2||
1072.e: Joining together, they live in harmony day and night; the husband comforts his wife. ||2||

1072.g: ਧਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
1072.t: dhan maagai priau bahu bidh dhaavai ||
1072.e: When the bride asks, the husband runs around in all sorts of ways.

1072.g: ਜੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਆਣਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
1072.t: jo paavai so aan dhikhaavai ||
1072.e: Whatever he finds, he brings to show his bride.

1072.g: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਕਉ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਧਨ ਰਹਤੀ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1072.t: ek vasat kau pahuch na saakai dhan rahatee bhookh piaasaa he ||3||
1072.e: But there is one thing he cannot reach, and so his bride remains hungry and thirsty. ||3||

1072.g: ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਉ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਜੋਰੈ ॥
1072.t: dhan karai binau dhouoo kar jorai ||
1072.e: With her palms pressed together, the bride offers her prayer,

1072.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੁ ਵਸਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਮੋਰੈ ॥
1072.t: pria paradhes na jaahu vasahu ghar morai ||
1072.e: "O my beloved, do not leave me and go to foreign lands; please stay here with me.

1072.g: ਐਸਾ ਬਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1072.t: aaisaa banaj karahu gireh bheetar jit utarai bhookh piaasaa he ||4||
1072.e: Do such business within our home, that my hunger and thirst may be relieved.""||4||

1072.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
1072.t: sagale karam dharam jug saadhaa ||
1072.e: All sorts of religious rituals are performed in this age,

1072.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
1072.t: bin har ras sukh til nahee laadhaa ||
1072.e: but without the sublime essence of the Lord, not an iota of peace is found.

1072.g: ਭਈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ ਤਉ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1072.t: bhiee kirapaa naanak satasa(n)ge tau dhan pir ana(n)dh ulaasaa he ||5||
1072.e: When the Lord becomes Merciful, O Nanak, then in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the bride and the husband enjoy ecstasy and bliss. ||5||

1073.g: ਧਨ ਅੰਧੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਚਪਲੁ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥
1073.t: dhan a(n)dhee pir chapal siaanaa ||
1073.e: The body-bride is blind, and the groom is clever and wise.

1073.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਾ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਨਾ ॥
1073.t: pa(n)ch tat kaa rachan rachaanaa ||
1073.e: The creation was created of the five elements.

1073.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਆਏ ਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1073.t: jis vakhar kau tum aae hahu so paio satigur paasaa he ||6||
1073.e: That merchandise, for which you have come into the world, is received only from the True Guru. ||6||

1073.g: ਧਨ ਕਹੈ ਤੂ ਵਸੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
1073.t: dhan kahai too vas mai naale ||
1073.e: The body-bride says, ""Please live with me,

1073.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲੇ ॥
1073.t: pria sukhavaasee baal gupaale ||
1073.e: O my beloved, peaceful, young lord.

1073.g: ਤੁਝੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਚਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1073.t: tujhai binaa hau kit hee na lekhai vachan dheh chhodd na jaasaa he ||7||
1073.e: Without you, I am of no account. Please give me your word, that you will not leave me"". ||7||

1073.g: ਪਿਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਹਉ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
1073.t: pir kahiaa hau hukamee ba(n)dhaa ||
1073.e: The soul-husband says, ""I am the slave of my Commander.

1073.g: ਓਹੁ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ॥
1073.t: oh bhaaro Thaakur jis kaan na chha(n)dhaa ||
1073.e: He is my Great Lord and Master, who is fearless and independent.

1073.g: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਜਾ ਸਦੇ ਤ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1073.t: jichar raakhai tichar tum sa(n)g rahanaa jaa sadhe ta uooTh sidhaasaa he ||8||
1073.e: As long as He wills, I will remain with you. When He summons me, I shall arise and depart.""||8||

1073.g: ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਚਨ ਕਹੇ ਧਨ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
1073.t: jau pria bachan kahe dhan saache ||
1073.e: The husband speaks words of Truth to the bride,

1073.g: ਧਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਮਝੈ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
1073.t: dhan kachhoo na samajhai cha(n)chal kaache ||
1073.e: but the bride is restless and inexperienced, and she does not understand anything.

1073.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਬਾਤ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1073.t: bahur bahur pir hee sa(n)g maagai oh baat jaanai kar haasaa he ||9||
1073.e: Again and again, she begs her husband to stay; she thinks that he is just joking when he answers her. ||9||

1073.g: ਆਈ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
1073.t: aaiee aagiaa pirahu bulaiaa ||
1073.e: The Order comes, and the husband-soul is called.

1073.g: ਨਾ ਧਨ ਪੁਛੀ ਨ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
1073.t: naa dhan puchhee na mataa pakaiaa ||
1073.e: He does not consult with his bride, and does not ask her opinion.

1073.g: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ਛੂਟਰਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1073.t: uooTh sidhaio chhooTar maaTee dhekh naanak mithan mohaasaa he ||10||
1073.e: He gets up and marches off, and the discarded body-bride mingles with dust. O Nanak, behold the illusion of emotional attachment and hope. ||10||

1073.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੋਭੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
1073.t: re man lobhee sun man mere ||
1073.e: O greedy mind - listen, O my mind!

1073.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਸਦੇਰੇ ॥
1073.t: satigur sev dhin raat sadhere ||
1073.e: Serve the True Guru day and night forever.

1073.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਚਿ ਮੂਏ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਗਲਿ ਜਮ ਫਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1073.t: bin satigur pach mooe saakat nigure gal jam faasaa he ||11||
1073.e: Without the True Guru, the faithless cynics rot away and die. The noose of Death is around the necks of those who have no guru. ||11||

1073.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
1073.t: manmukh aavai manmukh jaavai ||
1073.e: The self-willed manmukh comes, and the self-willed manmukh goes.

1073.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
1073.t: manmukh fir fir choTaa khaavai ||
1073.e: The manmukh suffers beatings again and again.

1073.g: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਨਰਕ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1073.t: jitane narak se manmukh bhogai gurmukh lep na maasaa he ||12||
1073.e: The manmukh endures as many hells as there are; the Gurmukh is not even touched by them. ||12||

1073.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1073.t: gurmukh soi j har jeeau bhaiaa ||
1073.e: He alone is Gurmukh, who is pleasing to the Dear Lord.

1073.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
1073.t: tis kaun miTaavai j prabh pahiraiaa ||
1073.e: Who can destroy anyone who is robed in honor by the Lord?

1073.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਨੰਦੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਪਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਖਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1073.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh kare aana(n)dhee jis sirapaau piaa gal khaasaa he ||13||
1073.e: The blissful one is forever in bliss; he is dressed in robes of honor. ||13||

1073.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
1073.t: hau balihaaree satigur poore ||
1073.e: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru.

1073.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਬਚਨ ਕੇ ਸੂਰੇ ॥
1073.t: saran ke dhaate bachan ke soore ||
1073.e: He is the Giver of Sanctuary, the Heroic Warrior who keeps His Word.

1073.g: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਜਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1073.t: aaisaa prabh miliaa sukhadhaataa vichhuR na kat hee jaasaa he ||14||
1073.e: Such is the Lord God, the Giver of peace, whom I have met; He shall never leave me or go anywhere else. ||14||

1073.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
1073.t: gun nidhaan kichh keem na paiee ||
1073.e: He is the treasure of virtue; His value cannot be estimated.

1073.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
1073.t: ghaT ghaT poor rahio sabh Thaiee ||
1073.e: He is perfectly permeating each and every heart, prevailing everywhere.

1073.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਉ ਰੇਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੨॥
1073.t: naanak saran dheen dhukh bha(n)jan hau ren tere jo dhaasaa he ||15||1||2||
1073.e: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of the pains of the poor; I am the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||15||1||2||

1073.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
1073.t: maaroo solahe mahalaa panjavaa
1073.e: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:

1073.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1073.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1073.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1073.g: ਕਰੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
1073.t: karai ana(n)dh ana(n)dhee meraa ||
1073.e: My Blissful Lord is forever in bliss.

1073.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਸਿਰਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
1073.t: ghaT ghaT pooran sir sireh niberaa ||
1073.e: He fills each and every heart, and judges each and everyone.

1073.g: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਕੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1073.t: sir saahaa kai sachaa saahib avar naahee ko dhoojaa he ||1||
1073.e: The True Lord and Master is above the heads of all kings; there is none other than Him. ||1||

1073.g: ਹਰਖਵੰਤ ਆਨੰਤ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
1073.t: harakhava(n)t aana(n)t dhiaalaa ||
1073.e: He is joyful, blissful and merciful.

1073.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਰਬ ਉਜਾਲਾ ॥
1073.t: pragaT rahio prabh sarab ujaalaa ||
1073.e: God's Light is manifest everywhere.

1073.g: ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1073.t: roop kare kar vekhai vigasai aape hee aap poojaa he ||2||
1073.e: He creates forms, and gazing upon them, He enjoys them; He Himself worships Himself. ||2||

1073.g: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1073.t: aape kudharat kare veechaaraa ||
1073.e: He contemplates His own creative power.

1073.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
1073.t: aape hee sach kare pasaaraa ||
1073.e: The True Lord Himself creates the expanse of the Universe.

1073.g: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਿਲਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਭੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1073.t: aape khel khilaavai dhin raatee aape sun sun bheejaa he ||3||
1073.e: He Himself stages the play, day and night; He Himself listens, and hearing, rejoices. ||3||

1073.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ॥
1073.t: saachaa takhat sachee paatisaahee ||
1073.e: True is His throne, and True is His kingdom.

1073.g: ਸਚੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੀ ॥
1073.t: sach khajeenaa saachaa saahee ||
1073.e: True is the treasure of the True Banker.

1074.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਵਰਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1074.t: aape sach dhaario sabh saachaa sache sach varateejaa he ||4||
1074.e: He Himself is True, and true is all that He has established. True is the prevailing Order of the True Lord. ||4||
True is the justice of the True Lord.
Your place is forever True, O God.

1074.g: ਸਚੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਕੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1074.t: sachee kudharat sachee baanee sach saahib sukh keejaa he ||5||
1074.e: True is Your Creative Power, and True is the Word of Your Bani. True is the peace which You give, O my Lord and Master. ||5||
You alone are the greatest king.
By the Hukam of Your Command, O True Lord, our affairs are fulfilled.

1074.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1074.t: a(n)tar baahar sabh kichh jaanai aape hee aap pateejaa he ||6||
1074.e: Inwardly and outwardly, You know everything; You Yourself are pleased with Yourself. ||6||

1074.g: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਰਸੀਆ ਤੂ ਵਡ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
1074.t: too vadd raseeaa too vadd bhogee ||
1074.e: You are the great party-goer, You are the great enjoyer.
You are detached in Nirvaanaa, You are the Yogi.

1074.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1074.t: sarab sookh sahaj ghar terai amiau teree dhirasaTeejaa he ||7||
1074.e: All celestial comforts are in Your home; Your Glance of Grace rains Nectar. ||7||
You alone give Your gifts.
You grant Your gifts unto all the beings of the world.

1074.g: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1074.t: toT na aavai poor bha(n)ddaarai tirapat rahe aagheejaa he ||8||
1074.e: Your treasures are overflowing, and are never exhausted; through them, we remain satisfied and fulfilled. ||8||
The Siddhas, seekers and forest-dwellers beg from You.
The celibates and abstainers, and those who abide in peace beg from You.

1074.g: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
1074.t: eik dhaataar sagal hai jaachik dheh dhaan sirasaTeejaa he ||9||
1074.e: You alone are the Great Giver; all are beggars of You. You bless all the world with Your gifts. ||9||
Your devotees worship You with infinite love.
In an instant, You establish and disestablish.

1074.g: ਭਾਰੋ ਤੋਲੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਭਗਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
1074.t: bhaaro tol bea(n)t suaamee hukam ma(n)n bhagateejaa he ||10||
1074.e: Your weight is so heavy, O my infinite Lord and Master. Your devotees surrender to the Hukam of Your Command. ||10||

1074.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
1074.t: jis dheh dharas soiee tudh jaanai ||
1074.e: They alone know You, whom You bless with Your Glance of Grace.

1074.g: ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
1074.t: oh gur kai sabadh sadhaa ra(n)g maanai ||
1074.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enjoy Your Love forever.

1074.g: ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਵੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
1074.t: chatur saroop siaanaa soiee jo man terai bhaaveejaa he ||11||
1074.e: They alone are clever, handsome and wise, who are pleasing to Your Mind. ||11||
One who keeps You in his consciousness, becomes carefree and independent.

1074.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
1074.t: jis cheet aaveh so saachaa saahaa ||
1074.e: One who keeps You in his consciousness, is the true king.

1074.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
1074.t: jis cheet aaveh tis bhau kehaa avar kahaa kichh keejaa he ||12||
1074.e: One who keeps You in his consciousness - what does he have to fear? And what else does he need to do? ||12||
Thirst and desire are quenched, and one's inner being is cooled and soothed.
The True Guru has mended the broken one.

1074.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਅਮਿਉ ਝੋਲਿ ਝੋਲਿ ਪੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
1074.t: surat sabadh ridh a(n)tar jaagee amiau jhol jhol peejaa he ||13||
1074.e: Awareness of the Word of the Shabad has awakened within my heart. Shaking it and vibrating it, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||13||

1074.g: ਮਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
1074.t: marai naahee sadh sadh hee jeevai ||
1074.e: I shall not die; I shall live forever and ever.
I have become immortal; I am eternal and imperishable.

1074.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਭਰਮੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
1074.t: naa ko aavai naa ko jaavai gur dhoor keeaa bharameejaa he ||14||
1074.e: I do not come, and I do not go. The Guru has driven out my doubts. ||14||
Perfect is the Word of the Perfect Guru.
One who is attached to the Perfect Lord, is immersed in the Perfect Lord.

1074.g: ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਰੰਗਾ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
1074.t: chaRai savaiaa nit nit ra(n)gaa ghaTai naahee toleejaa he ||15||
1074.e: His love increases day by day, and when it is weighed, it does not decrease. ||15||
When the gold is made one hundred percent pure,
its color is true to the jeweller's eye.

1074.g: ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਰਾਫੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾਈਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
1074.t: parakh khajaanai paiaa saraafee fir naahee taieejaa he ||16||
1074.e: Assaying it, it is placed in the treasury by God the Jeweller, and it is not melted down again. ||16||
Your Naam is Ambrosial Nectar, O my Lord and Master.
Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice to You.

1074.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੧॥੩॥
1074.t: sa(n)tasa(n)g mahaa sukh paiaa dhekh dharasan ih man bheejaa he ||17||1||3||
1074.e: In the Society of the Saints, I have found great peace; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, this mind is pleased and satisfied. ||17||1||3||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Solhas:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Guru is the Lord of the World, the Guru is the Master of the Universe.
The Guru is merciful, and always forgiving.

1074.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਸਥਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
1074.t: gur saasat simirat khaT karamaa gur pavitr asathaanaa he ||1||
1074.e: The Guru is the Shaastras, the Simritees and the six rituals. The Guru is the Holy Shrine. ||1||

1075.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, all the sins are erased.

1075.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਫਾਸਹਿ ॥
1075.t: gur simarat jam sa(n)g na faaseh ||
1075.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, one is not strangled by the noose of Death.

1075.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
1075.t: gur simarat man niramal hovai gur kaaTe apamaanaa he ||2||
1075.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, the mind becomes immaculate; the Guru eliminates egotistical pride. ||2||

1075.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
1075.t: gur kaa sevak narak na jaae ||
1075.e: The Guru's servant is not consigned to hell.
The Guru's servant meditates on the Supreme Lord God.

1075.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
1075.t: gur kaa sevak saadhasa(n)g paae gur karadhaa nit jeea dhaanaa he ||3||
1075.e: The Guru's servant joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the Guru ever gives the life of the soul. ||3||
At the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

1075.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
1075.t: satigur bheT har jas mukh bhaneeaai ||
1075.e: Meeting with the True Guru, one chants the Lord's Praises.

1075.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
1075.t: kal kales miTaae satigur har dharageh dhevai maanaa(n) he ||4||
1075.e: The True Guru eradicates sorrow and suffering, and bestows honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||
The Guru has revealed the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.
The True Guru returns to the Path, those who have wandered away.

1075.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
1075.t: gur sevak kau bighan na bhagatee har poor dhiraR(h)aiaa giaanaa(n) he ||5||
1075.e: No obstacles stand in the way of devotion to the Lord, for one who serves the Guru. The Guru implants perfect spiritual wisdom. ||5||
The Guru has revealed the Lord everywhere.
The Lord of the Universe is permeating and pervading the water and the land.

1075.g: ਊਚ ਊਨ ਸਭ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
1075.t: uooch uoon sabh ek samaanaa(n) man laagaa sahaj dhiaanaa he ||6||
1075.e: The high and the low are all the same to Him. Focus your mind's meditation intuitively on Him. ||6||
Meeting with the Guru, all thirst is quenched.
Meeting with the Guru, one is not watched by Maya.

1075.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਪਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
1075.t: sat sa(n)tokh dheeaa gur poorai naam a(n)mrit pee paanaa(n) he ||7||
1075.e: The Perfect Guru bestows truth and contentment; I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

1075.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
1075.t: gur kee baanee sabh maeh samaanee ||
1075.e: The Word of the Guru's Bani is contained in all.
He Himself hears it, and He Himself repeats it.

1075.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਸਤ੍ਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਥਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
1075.t: jin jin japee teiee sabh nisatre tin paiaa nihachal thaanaa(n) he ||8||
1075.e: Those who meditate on it, are all emancipated; they attain the eternal and unchanging home. ||8||
The Glory of the True Guru is known only to the True Guru.

1075.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
1075.t: jo kichh kare su aapan bhaanai ||
1075.e: Whatever He does, is according to the Pleasure of His Will.

1075.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੯॥੧॥੪॥
1075.t: saadhoo dhoor jaacheh jan tere naanak sadh kurabaanaa(n) he ||9||1||4||
1075.e: Your humble servants beg for the dust of the feet of the Holy; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||9||1||4||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Primal, Immaculate Lord God is formless.
The Detached Lord is Himself prevailing in all.

1075.g: ਵਰਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
1075.t: varan jaat chihan nahee koiee sabh hukame sirasaT upaidhaa ||1||
1075.e: He has no race or social class, no identifying mark. By the Hukam of His Will, He created the entire universe. ||1||
Out of all the 8.4 million species of beings,
God blessed mankind with glory.

1075.g: ਇਸੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸੋ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
1075.t: eis pauRee te jo nar chookai so aai jai dhukh paidhaa ||2||
1075.e: That human who misses this chance, shall suffer the pains of coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
What should I say, to one who has been created.
The Gurmukh receives the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1075.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭੂਲੈ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
1075.t: jis aap bhulaae soiee bhoolai so boojhai jiseh bujhaidhaa ||3||
1075.e: He alone is confused, whom the Lord Himself confuses. He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. ||3||

1075.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਨਗਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
1075.t: harakh sog kaa nagar ih keeaa ||
1075.e: This body has been made the village of joy and sorrow.
They alone are emancipated, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

1075.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਹਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
1075.t: tirahaa gunaa te rahai niraaraa so gurmukh sobhaa paidhaa ||4||
1075.e: One who remains untouched by the three qualities, the three gunas - such a Gurmukh is blessed with glory. ||4||

1075.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥ ਜੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਪੈਰੇ ॥
1075.t: anik karam ke'ee bahutere || jo keejai so ba(n)dhan paire ||
1075.e: You can do anything, but whatever you do, only serves to tie your feet.

1075.g: ਕੁਰੁਤਾ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
1075.t: kurutaa beej beeje nahee ja(n)mai sabh laahaa mool gavaidhaa ||5||
1075.e: The seed which is planted out of season does not sprout, and all one's capital and profits are lost. ||5||
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are most sublime and exalted.
Become Gurmukh, chant and focus your meditation.

1076.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
1076.t: aap tarai sagale kul taare har dharageh pat siau jaidhaa ||6||
1076.e: You shall save yourself, and save all your generations as well. You shall go to the Court of the Lord with honor. ||6||
All the continents, nether worlds, islands and worlds

1076.g: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
1076.t: sabh kaalai vas aap prabh keeaa ||
1076.e: God Himself has made them all subject to death.

1076.g: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਜੋ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
1076.t: nihachal ek aap abinaasee so nihachal jo tiseh dhiaaidhaa ||7||
1076.e: The One Imperishable Lord Himself is unmoving and unchanging. Meditating on Him, one becomes unchanging. ||7||

1076.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
1076.t: har kaa sevak so har jehaa ||
1076.e: The Lord's servant becomes like the Lord.
Do not think that, because of his human body, he is different.

1076.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
1076.t: jiau jal tara(n)g uTheh bahu bhaatee fir salalai salal samaidhaa ||8||
1076.e: The waves of the water rise up in various ways, and then the water merges again in water. ||8||
A beggar begs for charity at His Door.

1076.g: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
1076.t: jaa prabh bhaavai taa kirapaa dhaarai ||
1076.e: When God pleases, He takes pity on him.

1076.g: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
1076.t: dheh dharas jit man tirapataasai har keeratan man Thaharaidhaa ||9||
1076.e: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, to satisfy my mind, O Lord. Through the Kirtan of Your Praises, my mind is held steady. ||9||

1076.g: ਰੂੜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
1076.t: rooRo Thaakur kitai vas na aavai ||
1076.e: The Beauteous Lord and Master is not controlled in any way.

1076.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1076.t: har so kichh kare j har kiaa sa(n)taa bhaavai ||
1076.e: The Lord does that which pleases the Saints of the Lord.

1076.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਨਿ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
1076.t: keetaa loRan soiee karain dhar fer na koiee paidhaa ||10||
1076.e: He does whatever they wish to be done; nothing blocks their way at His Door. ||10||

1076.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਉਘਟੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
1076.t: jithai aaughaT aai banat hai praanee ||
1076.e: Wherever the mortal is confronted with difficulty,
there he should meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

1076.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
1076.t: jithai putr kalatr na belee koiee tithai har aap chhaddaidhaa ||11||
1076.e: Where there are no children, spouse or friends, there the Lord Himself comes to the rescue. ||11||
The Great Lord and Master is inaccessible and unfathomable.
How can anyone meet with God, the self-suficient One?

1076.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
1076.t: kaaT silak jis maarag paae so vich sa(n)gat vaasaa paidhaa ||12||
1076.e: Those who have had the noose cut away from around their necks, whom God has set back upon the Path, obtain a place in the Sangat, the Congregation. ||12||
One who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command is said to be His servant.
He endures both bad and good equally.

1076.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
1076.t: haumai jai ta eko boojhai so gurmukh sahaj samaidhaa ||13||
1076.e: When egotism is silenced, then one comes to know the One Lord. Such a Gurmukh intuitively merges in the Lord. ||13||
The devotees of the Lord dwell forever in peace.
With a child-like, innocent nature, they remain detached, turning away from the world.

1076.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਲਾਡਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
1076.t: anik ra(n)g kareh bahu bhaatee jiau pitaa poot laaddaidhaa ||14||
1076.e: They enjoy various pleasures in many ways; God caresses them, like a father caressing his son. ||14||
He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be estimated.
We meet Him, only when He causes us to meet.

1076.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
1076.t: gurmukh pragaT bhiaa tin jan kau jin dhur masatak lekh likhaidhaa ||15||
1076.e: The Lord is revealed to those humble Gurmukhs, who have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||15||
You Yourself are the Creator Lord, the Cause of causes.
You created the Universe, and You support the whole earth.

1076.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੫॥
1076.t: jan naanak saran piaa har dhuaarai har bhaavai laaj rakhaidhaa ||16||1||5||
1076.e: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Door, O Lord; if it is Your Will, please preserve his honor. ||16||1||5||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Whatever is seen is You, O One Lord.
What the ears hear is the Word of Your Bani.

1076.g: ਦੂਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਪਸਿ ਕਾਈ ਸਗਲ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
1076.t: dhoojee avar na jaapas kaiee sagal tumaaree dhaaranaa ||1||
1076.e: There is nothing else to be seen at all. You give support to all. ||1||
You Yourself are conscious of Your Creation.
You Yourself established Yourself, O God.

1076.g: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਚਿਓਨੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
1076.t: aap upai rachion pasaaraa aape ghaT ghaT saaranaa ||2||
1076.e: Creating Yourself, You formed the expanse of the Universe; You Yourself cherish and sustain each and every heart. ||2||
You created some to hold great and royal courts.
Some turn away from the world in renunciation, and some maintain their households.

1077.g: ਇਕਿ ਭੂਖੇ ਇਕਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਸਭਸੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਣਾ ॥੩॥
1077.t: eik bhookhe ik tirapat aghaae sabhasai teraa paaranaa ||3||
1077.e: Some are hungry and some are satisfied and satiated, but all lean on Your Support. ||3||
The True Lord Himself is True, True, True.
He is woven into the essence of His devotees, through and through.

1077.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਸਾਰਣਾ ॥੪॥
1077.t: aape gupat aape hai paragaT apanaa aap pasaaranaa ||4||
1077.e: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed. He Himself spreads Himself out. ||4||
Forever, forever and ever, He shall always exist.
He is lofty, inaccessible, unfathomable and infinite.

1077.g: ਊਣੇ ਭਰੇ ਭਰੇ ਭਰਿ ਊਣੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਣਾ ॥੫॥
1077.t: uoone bhare bhare bhar uoone eh chalat suaamee ke kaaranaa ||5||
1077.e: He fills the empty, and empties out the filled; such are the plays and dramas of my Lord and Master. ||5||
With my mouth, I praise my True Lord King.
With my eyes, I behold the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.

1077.g: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
1077.t: karanee sun sun man tan hariaa mere saahib sagal udhaaranaa ||6||
1077.e: Listening, listening with my ears, my mind and body are rejuvenated; my Lord and Master saves all. ||6||
He created the creation, and gazes upon what He has created.
All beings and creatures meditate on Him.

1077.g: ਅਪਣੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਣਾ ॥੭॥
1077.t: apanee kudharat aape jaanai nadharee nadhar nihaalanaa ||7||
1077.e: He Himself knows His creative power; He blesses with His Glance of Grace. ||7||

1077.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜਹ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
1077.t: sa(n)t sabhaa jeh baiseh prabh paase ||
1077.e: Where the Saints gather together and sit, God dwells close at hand.
They abide in bliss and joy, beholding the Lord's wondrous play.

1077.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਣਾ ॥੮॥
1077.t: gun gaaveh anahadh dhun baanee teh naanak dhaas chitaaranaa ||8||
1077.e: They sing the Glories of the Lord, and the unstruck sound current of His Bani; O Nanak, His slaves remain conscious of Him. ||8||
Coming and going is all Your wondrous play.
Creating the Creation, You gaze upon Your infinite play.

1077.g: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਲਣਾ ॥੯॥
1077.t: aap upaae upaavanahaaraa apanaa keeaa paalanaa ||9||
1077.e: Creating the Creation, You Yourself cherish and nurture it. ||9||
Listening, listening to Your Glory, I live.
Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to You.

1077.g: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
1077.t: dhui kar joR simarau dhin raatee mere suaamee agam apaaranaa ||10||
1077.e: With my palms pressed together, I meditate in remembrance on You, day and night, O my inaccessible, infinite Lord and Master. ||10||
Other than You, who else should I praise?
I meditate on the One and Only Lord within my mind.

1077.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਇਹ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
1077.t: hukam boojh jan bhe nihaalaa ieh bhagataa kee ghaalanaa ||11||
1077.e: Realizing the Hukam of Your Will, Your humble servants are enraptured; this is the achievement of Your devotees. ||11||
Following the Guru's Teachings, I meditate on the True Lord within my mind.
Following the Guru's Teachings, I am immersed in the Lord's Love.

1077.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
1077.t: gur upadhes tuTeh sabh ba(n)dhan ih bharam moh parajaalanaa ||12||
1077.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, all bonds are broken, and this doubt and emotional attachment are burnt away. ||12||
Wherever He keeps me, is my place of rest.
Whatever naturally happens, I accept that as good.

1077.g: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਬੈਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਬੈਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
1077.t: binase bair naahee ko bairee sabh eko hai bhaalanaa ||13||
1077.e: Hatred is gone - I have no hatred at all; I see the One Lord in all. ||13||
Fear has been removed, and darkness has been dispelled.
The all-powerful, primal, detached Lord God has been revealed.

1077.g: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਘਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
1077.t: aap chhodd pe saranaiee jis kaa saa tis ghaalanaa ||14||
1077.e: Forsaking self-conceit, I have entered His Sanctuary, and I work for Him. ||14||
Rare are those few, very blessed people, who come into the world,
and meditate on their Lord and Master, twenty-four hours a day.

1077.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੫॥
1077.t: tis jan kai sa(n)g tarai sabh koiee so paravaar sadhaaranaa ||15||
1077.e: Associating with such humble people, all are saved, and their families are saved as well. ||15||
This is the blessing which I have received from my Lord and Master.
Twenty-four hours a day, with my palms pressed together, I meditate on Him.

1077.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਉਚਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੬॥
1077.t: naam japee naam sahaj samaavaa naam naanak milai uchaaranaa ||16||1||6||
1077.e: I chant the Naam, and through the Naam, I intuitively merge into the Lord; O Nanak, may I be blessed with the Naam, and ever repeat it. ||16||1||6||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
Do not be fooled by appearances, you fool.
This is a false attachment to the expanse of an illusion.

1077.g: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੧॥
1077.t: jag meh koiee rahan na paae nihachal ek naarainaa ||1||
1077.e: No one can remain in this world; only the One Lord is permanent and unchanging. ||1||
Seek the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru.
He shall eradicate all emotional attachment, sorrow and doubt.

1077.g: ਏਕੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਗਾਇਣਾ ॥੨॥
1077.t: eko ma(n)tr dhiraRaae aaukhadh sach naam ridh gainaa ||2||
1077.e: He shall administer the medicine, the Mantra of the One Name. Sing the True Name within your heart. ||2||

1078.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਕਉ ਤਰਸਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
1078.t: jis naamai kau taraseh bahu dhevaa ||
1078.e: So many gods yearn for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1078.g: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
1078.t: sagal bhagat jaa kee karadhe sevaa ||
1078.e: All the devotees serve Him.

1078.g: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੩॥
1078.t: anaathaa naath dheen dhukh bha(n)jan so gur poore te painaa ||3||
1078.e: He is the Master of the masterless, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor. His Name is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||3||

1078.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
1078.t: hor dhuaaraa koi na soojhai ||
1078.e: I cannot conceive of any other door.

1078.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
1078.t: tirabhavan dhaavai taa kichhoo na boojhai ||
1078.e: One who wanders through the three worlds, understands nothing.

1078.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਨਾਮ ਜਿਸੁ ਇਹੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੪॥
1078.t: satigur saahu bha(n)ddaar naam jis ih ratan tisai te painaa ||4||
1078.e: The True Guru is the banker, with the treasure of the Naam. This jewel is obtained from Him. ||4||

1078.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
1078.t: jaa kee dhoor kare puneetaa ||
1078.e: The dust of His feet purifies.

1078.g: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
1078.t: sur nar dhev na paaveh meetaa ||
1078.e: Even the angelic beings and gods cannot obtain it, O friend.

1078.g: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੫॥
1078.t: sat purakh satigur paramesar jis bheTat paar parainaa ||5||
1078.e: The True Guru is the True Primal Being, the Transcendent Lord God; meeting with Him, one is carried across to the other side. ||5||

1078.g: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
1078.t: paarajaat loReh man piaare ||
1078.e: O my beloved mind, if you wish for the 'tree of life';

1078.g: ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਸੋਹੀ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
1078.t: kaamadhen sohee dharabaare ||
1078.e: if you wish for Kaamadhayna, the wish-fulfilling cow to adorn your court;

1078.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਰਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੬॥
1078.t: tirapat sa(n)tokh sevaa gur poore naam kamai rasainaa ||6||
1078.e: if you wish to be satisfied and contented, then serve the Perfect Guru, and practice the Naam, the source of nectar. ||6||

1078.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ॥
1078.t: gur kai sabadh mareh pa(n)ch dhaatoo ||
1078.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the five thieves of desire are conquered.

1078.g: ਭੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਤੂ ॥
1078.t: bhai paarabraham hoveh niramalaa too ||
1078.e: In the Fear of the Supreme Lord God, you shall become immaculate and pure.

1078.g: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਜਬ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਣਾ ॥੭॥
1078.t: paaras jab bheTai gur pooraa taa paaras paras dhikhainaa ||7||
1078.e: When one meets the Perfect Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, His touch reveals the Lord, the Philosopher's Stone. ||7||

1078.g: ਕਈ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਵੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
1078.t: kiee baiku(n)Th naahee lavai laage ||
1078.e: Myriads of heavens do not equal the Lord's Name.

1078.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਭੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤਿਆਗੇ ॥
1078.t: mukat bapuRee bhee giaanee tiaage ||
1078.e: The spiritually wise forsake mere liberation.

1078.g: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੮॥
1078.t: eka(n)kaar satigur te paieeaai hau bal bal gur dharasainaa ||8||
1078.e: The One Universal Creator Lord is found through the True Guru. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||8||

1078.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
1078.t: gur kee sev na jaanai koiee ||
1078.e: No one knows how to serve the Guru.

1078.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
1078.t: gur paarabraham agochar soiee ||
1078.e: The Guru is the unfathomable, Supreme Lord God.

1078.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਇਣਾ ॥੯॥
1078.t: jis no lai le so sevak jis vaddabhaag mathainaa ||9||
1078.e: He alone is the Guru's servant, whom the Guru Himself links to His service, and upon whose forehead such blessed destiny is inscribed. ||9||

1078.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
1078.t: gur kee mahimaa bedh na jaaneh ||
1078.e: Even the Vedas do not know the Guru's Glory.

1078.g: ਤੁਛ ਮਾਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
1078.t: tuchh maat sun sun vakhaaneh ||
1078.e: They narrate only a tiny bit of what is heard.

1078.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
1078.t: paarabraham apara(n)par satigur jis simarat man seetalainaa ||10||
1078.e: The True Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Incomparable One; meditating in remembrance on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed. ||10||

1078.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
1078.t: jaa kee soi sunee man jeevai ||
1078.e: Hearing of Him, the mind comes to life.

1078.g: ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਠੰਢਾ ਥੀਵੈ ॥
1078.t: ridhai vasai taa Tha(n)ddaa theevai ||
1078.e: When He dwells within the heart, one becomes peaceful and cool.

1078.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਲਾਏ ਤਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
1078.t: gur mukhahu alaae taa sobhaa paae tis jam kai pa(n)th na painaa ||11||
1078.e: Chanting the Guru's Name with the mouth, one obtains glory, and does not have to walk on the Path of Death. ||11||

1078.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
1078.t: sa(n)tan kee saranaiee paRiaa ||
1078.e: I have entered the Sanctuary of the Saints,

1078.g: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਧਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
1078.t: jeeau praan dhan aagai dhariaa ||
1078.e: and placed before them my soul, my breath of life and wealth.

1078.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਾਈ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਿਰਮਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
1078.t: sevaa surat na jaanaa kaiee tum karahu dhiaa kiramainaa ||12||
1078.e: I know nothing about service and awareness; please take pity upon this worm. ||12||

1078.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਰਲਾਏ ॥
1078.t: niragun kau sa(n)g leh ralaae ||
1078.e: I am unworthy; please merge me into Yourself.

1078.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਟਹਲੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
1078.t: kar kirapaa moh Tahalai laae ||
1078.e: Please bless me with Your Grace, and link me to Your service.

1078.g: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰਉ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
1078.t: pakhaa ferau peesau sa(n)t aagai charan dhoi sukh painaa ||13||
1078.e: I wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; washing their feet, I find peace. ||13||

1078.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
1078.t: bahut dhuaare bhram bhram aaiaa ||
1078.e: After wandering around at so many doors, I have come to Yours, O Lord.

1078.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥
1078.t: tumaree kirapaa te tum saranaiaa ||
1078.e: By Your Grace, I have entered Your Sanctuary.

1078.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
1078.t: sadhaa sadhaa sa(n)teh sa(n)g raakhahu eh naam dhaan dhevainaa ||14||
1078.e: Forever and ever, keep me in the Company of the Saints; please bless me with this Gift of Your Name. ||14||

1078.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
1078.t: bhe kirapaal gusaiee mere ||
1078.e: My World-Lord has become merciful,

1078.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
1078.t: dharasan paiaa satigur poore ||
1078.e: and I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Perfect True Guru.

1078.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੫॥੨॥੭॥
1078.t: sookh sahaj sadhaa aana(n)dhaa naanak dhaas dhasainaa ||15||2||7||
1078.e: I have found eternal peace, poise and bliss; Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||15||2||7||

1078.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
1078.t: maaroo solahe mahalaa panjavaa
1078.e: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:

1078.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1078.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1078.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1078.g: ਸਿਮਰੈ ਧਰਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਆਕਾਸਾ ॥
1078.t: simarai dharatee ar aakaasaa ||
1078.e: The earth and the Akaashic ethers meditate in remembrance.

1078.g: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥
1078.t: simareh cha(n)dh sooraj gunataasaa ||
1078.e: The moon and the sun meditate in remembrance on You, O treasure of virtue.

1078.g: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
1078.t: paun paanee baisa(n)tar simareh simarai sagal upaarajanaa ||1||
1078.e: Air, water and fire meditate in remembrance. All creation meditates in remembrance. ||1||

1079.e: All the continents, islands and worlds meditate in remembrance.
The nether worlds and spheres meditate in remembrance on that True Lord.

1079.g: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
1079.t: simareh khaanee simareh baanee simareh sagale har janaa ||2||
1079.e: The sources of creation and speech meditate in remembrance; all the Lord's humble servants meditate in remembrance. ||2||
Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva meditate in remembrance.
The three hundred thirty million gods meditate in remembrance.

1079.g: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਜਖੵਿ ਦੈਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਗਨਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜਸੁ ਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
1079.t: simareh jakhiye dhait sabh simareh aganat na jaiee jas ganaa ||3||
1079.e: The titans and demons all meditate in remembrance; Your Praises are uncountable - they cannot be counted. ||3||
All the beasts, birds and demons meditate in remembrance.
The forests, mountains and hermits meditate in remembrance.

1079.g: ਲਤਾ ਬਲੀ ਸਾਖ ਸਭ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਮਨਾ ॥੪॥
1079.t: lataa balee saakh sabh simareh rav rahiaa suaamee sabh manaa ||4||
1079.e: All the vines and branches meditate in remembrance; O my Lord and Master, You are permeating and pervading all minds. ||4||
All beings, both subtle and gross, meditate in remembrance.
The Siddhas and seekers meditate in remembrance on the Lord's Mantra.

1079.g: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨਾ ॥੫॥
1079.t: gupat pragaT simareh prabh mere sagal bhavan kaa prabh dhanaa ||5||
1079.e: Both the visible and the invisible meditate in remembrance on my God; God is the Master of all worlds. ||5||
Men and women, throughout the four stages of life, meditate in remembrance on You.
All social classes and souls of all races meditate in remembrance on You.

1079.g: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਭਿ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਰੈਣੀ ਅਰੁ ਦਿਨਾ ॥੬॥
1079.t: simareh gunee chatur sabh bete simareh rainee ar dhinaa ||6||
1079.e: All the virtuous, clever and wise people meditate in remembrance; night and day meditate in remembrance. ||6||
Hours, minutes and seconds meditate in remembrance.
Death and life, and thoughts of purification, meditate in remembrance.

1079.g: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਉਣ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨਾ ॥੭॥
1079.t: simareh saun saasatr sa(n)jogaa alakh na lakheeaai ik khinaa ||7||
1079.e: The Shaastras, with their lucky signs and joinings, meditate in remembrance; the invisible cannot be seen, even for an instant. ||7||
The Lord and Master is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts.

1079.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੋ ਜਿਨਾ ॥੮॥
1079.t: kar kirapaa jis bhagatee laavahu janam padhaarath so jinaa ||8||
1079.e: That person, whom You bless with Your Grace, and link to Your devotional service, wins this invaluable human life. ||8||

1079.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
1079.t: jaa kai man vooThaa prabh apanaa ||
1079.e: He, within whose mind God dwells,

1079.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
1079.t: poorai karam gur kaa jap japanaa ||
1079.e: has perfect karma, and chants the Chant of the Guru.

1079.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਰੁਨਾ ॥੯॥
1079.t: sarab nira(n)tar so prabh jaataa bahuR na jonee bharam runaa ||9||
1079.e: One who realizes God pervading deep within all, does not wander crying in reincarnation again. ||9||

1079.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
1079.t: gur kaa sabadh vasai man jaa kai || dhookh dharadh bhram taa kaa bhaagai ||
1079.e: Pain, sorrow and doubt run away from that one, within whose mind the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides.

1079.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਾ ॥੧੦॥
1079.t: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh naam ras anahadh baanee sahaj dhunaa ||10||
1079.e: Intuitive peace, poise and bliss come from the sublime essence of the Naam; the unstruck sound current of the Guru's Bani intuitively vibrates and resounds. ||10||
He alone is wealthy, who meditates on God.
He alone is honorable, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

1079.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਸੋ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਨਾ ਛਿਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
1079.t: paarabraham jaa kai man vooThaa so poor kara(n)maa naa chhinaa ||11||
1079.e: That person, within whose mind the Supreme Lord God abides, has perfect karma, and becomes famous. ||11||
The Lord and Master is pervading the water, land and sky.
There is no other said to be so.

1079.g: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨਿ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
1079.t: gur giaan a(n)jan kaaTio bhram sagalaa avar na dheesai ek binaa ||12||
1079.e: The ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom has eradicated all doubts; except the One Lord, I do not see any other at all. ||12||
The Lord's Court is the highest of the high.

1079.g: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
1079.t: kahan na jaiee a(n)t na paaraa ||
1079.e: His limit and extent cannot be described.

1079.g: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮਿਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
1079.t: gahir ga(n)bheer athaeh suaamee atul na jaiee kiaa minaa ||13||
1079.e: The Lord and Master is profoundly deep, unfathomable and unweighable; how can He be measured? ||13||
You are the Creator; all is created by You.

1079.g: ਤੁਝੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੀਆ ॥
1079.t: tujh bin avar na koiee beeaa ||
1079.e: Without You, there is no other at all.

1079.g: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਤੁਮ ਤਨਾ ॥੧੪॥
1079.t: aadh madh a(n)t prabh toohai sagal pasaaraa tum tanaa ||14||
1079.e: You alone, God, are in the beginning, the middle and the end. You are the root of the entire expanse. ||14||
The Messenger of Death does not even approach that person
who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

1079.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੋ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧੫॥
1079.t: sagal manorath taa ke pooran jo sravanee prabh kaa jas sunaa ||15||
1079.e: All desires are fulfilled, for one who listens with his ears to the Praises of God. ||15||

1079.g: ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
1079.t: too sabhanaa kaa sabh ko teraa || saache saahib gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
1079.e: You belong to all, and all belong to You, O my true, deep and profound Lord and Master.

1080.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਮਨਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੮॥
1080.t: kahu naanak seiee jan uootam jo bhaaveh suaamee tum manaa ||16||1||8||
1080.e: Says Nanak, those humble beings are exalted, who are pleasing to Your Mind, O my Lord and Master. ||16||1||8||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
God is the almighty Giver of all peace and joy.
Be merciful to me, that I may meditate in remembrance on Your Name.

1080.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜਨੁ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਜਾਚੰਗਨਾ ॥੧॥
1080.t: har dhaataa jeea ja(n)t bhekhaaree jan baa(n)chhai jaacha(n)ganaa ||1||
1080.e: The Lord is the Great Giver; all beings and creatures are beggars; His humble servants yearn to beg from Him. ||1||

1080.g: ਮਾਗਉ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
1080.t: maagau jan dhoor param gat paavau ||
1080.e: I beg for the dust of the feet of the humble, that I may be blessed with the supreme status,
and the filth of countless lifetimes may be erased.

1080.g: ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਰਾਪੈ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੨॥
1080.t: dheeragh rog miTeh har aaukhadh har niramal raapai ma(n)ganaa ||2||
1080.e: The chronic diseases are cured by the medicine of the Lord's Name; I beg to be imbued with the Immaculate Lord. ||2||
With my ears, I listen to the Pure Praises of my Lord and Master.
With the Support of the One Lord, I have abandoned corruption, sexuality and desire.

1080.g: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
1080.t: niv niv pai lagau dhaas tere kar sukirat naahee sa(n)ganaa ||3||
1080.e: I humbly bow and fall at the feet of Your slaves; I do not hesitate to do good deeds. ||3||
O Lord, with my tongue I sing Your Glorious Praises.
The sins which I have committed are erased.

1080.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤਜਿ ਤੰਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
1080.t: simar simar suaamee man jeevai pa(n)ch dhoot taj ta(n)ganaa ||4||
1080.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Lord and Master, my mind lives; I am rid of the five oppressive demons. ||4||
Meditating on Your lotus feet, I have come aboard Your boat.
Joining the Society of the Saints, I cross over the world-ocean.

1080.g: ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਮਤ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਨੰਗਨਾ ॥੫॥
1080.t: arachaa ba(n)dhan har samat nivaasee baahuR jon na na(n)ganaa ||5||
1080.e: My flower-offering and worship is to realize that the Lord is dwelling alike in all; I shall not be reincarnated naked again. ||5||

1080.g: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
1080.t: dhaas dhaasan ko kar leh guopaalaa ||
1080.e: Please make me the slave of Your slaves, O Lord of the world.
You are the treasure of Grace, merciful to the meek.

1080.g: ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਿਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭੰਗਨਾ ॥੬॥
1080.t: sakhaa sahaiee pooran paramesur mil kadhe na hovee bha(n)ganaa ||6||
1080.e: Meet with your companion and helper, the Perfect Transcendent Lord God; you shall never be separated from Him again. ||6||

1080.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ॥
1080.t: man tan arap dharee har aagai ||
1080.e: I dedicate my mind and body, and place them in offering before the Lord.
Asleep for countless lifetimes, I have awakened.

1080.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕੁ ਹਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੰਤਨਾ ॥੭॥
1080.t: jis kaa saa soiee pratipaalak hat tiaagee haumai ha(n)tanaa ||7||
1080.e: He, to whom I belong, is my cherisher and nurturer. I have killed and discarded my murderous self-conceit. ||7||
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is pervading the water and the land.
The undeceivable Lord and Master is permeating each and every heart.

1080.g: ਭਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬੰਗਨਾ ॥੮॥
1080.t: bharam bheet khoiee gur poorai ek raviaa saraba(n)ganaa ||8||
1080.e: The Perfect Guru has demolished the wall of doubt, and now I see the One Lord pervading everywhere. ||8||

1080.g: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
1080.t: jat kat pekhau prabh sukh saagar ||
1080.e: Wherever I look, there I see God, the ocean of peace.
The Lord's treasure is never exhausted; He is the storehouse of jewels.

1080.g: ਅਗਹ ਅਗਾਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪੰਗਨਾ ॥੯॥
1080.t: ageh agaeh kichh mit nahee paieeaai so boojhai jis kirapa(n)ganaa ||9||
1080.e: He cannot be seized; He is inaccessible, and His limits cannot be found. He is realized when the Lord bestows His Grace. ||9||
My heart is cooled, and my mind and body are calmed and soothed.
The craving for birth and death is quenched.

1080.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਅਮਿਓ ਧਾਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੦॥
1080.t: kar geh kaadd le'ee prabh apunai amio dhaar dhirasaTa(n)ganaa ||10||
1080.e: Grasping hold of my hand, He has lifted me up and out; He has blessed me with His Ambrosial Glance of Grace. ||10||
The One and Only Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.
There is none other than Him at all.

1080.g: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਭਰਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
1080.t: aadh madh a(n)t prabh raviaa tirasan bujhee bharama(n)ganaa ||11||
1080.e: God permeates the beginning, the middle and the end; He has subdued my desires and doubts. ||11||
The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.
The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is forever forgiving.

1080.g: ਗੁਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਜਪਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
1080.t: gur jap jaap japat fal paiaa giaan dheepak sa(n)t sa(n)ganaa ||12||
1080.e: Meditating, chanting the Guru's Chant, I have obtained the fruits and rewards; in the Company of the Saints, I have been blessed with the lamp of spiritual wisdom. ||12||

1080.g: ਜੋ ਪੇਖਾ ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
1080.t: jo pekhaa so sabh kichh suaamee ||
1080.e: Whatever I see, is my Lord and Master God.

1080.g: ਜੋ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
1080.t: jo sunanaa so prabh kee baanee ||
1080.e: Whatever I hear, is the Bani of God's Word.

1080.g: ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਕਰਾਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤਹ ਤਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
1080.t: jo keeno so tumeh karaio saran sahaiee sa(n)teh tanaa ||13||
1080.e: Whatever I do, You make me do; You are the Sanctuary, the help and support of the Saints, Your children. ||13||
The beggar begs, and worships You in adoration.
You are the Purifier of the sinners, O Perfectly Holy Lord God.

1080.g: ਏਕੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਨ ਮੰਗਨ ਨਿਹਕਿੰਚਨਾ ॥੧੪॥
1080.t: eko dhaan sarab sukh gun nidh aan ma(n)gan nihaki(n)chanaa ||14||
1080.e: Please bless me with this one gift, O treasure of all bliss and virtue; I do not ask for anything else. ||14||

1081.e: God is the Creator of the body-vessel.
In the Society of the Saints, the dye is produced.

1081.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ਬਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੫॥
1081.t: niramal soi banee har baanee man naam majeeThai ra(n)ganaa ||15||
1081.e: Through the Word of the Lord's Bani, one's reputation becomes immaculate, and the mind is colored by the dye of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||15||
The sixteen powers, absolute perfection and fruitful rewards are obtained,
when the Lord and Master of infinite power is revealed.

1081.g: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੯॥
1081.t: anadh binodh har naam sukh naanak a(n)mirat ras har bhu(n)chanaa ||16||2||9||
1081.e: The Lord's Name is Nanak's bliss, play and peace; he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord. ||16||2||9||
Maaroo, Solhas, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
You are my Lord and Master; You have made me Your servant.
My soul and body are all gifts from You.

1081.g: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ ॥੧॥
1081.t: karan karaavan sabh toohai toohai hai naahee kichh asaaRaa ||1||
1081.e: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes; nothing belongs to me. ||1||

1081.g: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਠਾਏ ਤਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
1081.t: tumeh paThaae taa jag meh aae ||
1081.e: When You sent me, I came into the world.

1081.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
1081.t: jo tudh bhaanaa se karam kamaae ||
1081.e: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will, I do.

1081.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਆ ਤਾ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾੜਾ ॥੨॥
1081.t: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hoaa taa bhee naahee kichh kaaRaa ||2||
1081.e: Without You, nothing is done, so I am not anxious at all. ||2||
In the world hereafter, the Hukam of Your Command is heard.
In this world, I chant Your Praises, Lord.

1081.g: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਝਾੜਾ ॥੩॥
1081.t: aape lekh alekhai aape tum siau naahee kichh jhaaRaa ||3||
1081.e: You Yourself write the account, and You Yourself erase it; no one can argue with You. ||3||
You are our father; we are all Your children.
We play as You cause us to play.

1081.g: ਉਝੜ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਵੇਪਾੜਾ ॥੪॥
1081.t: aujhaR maarag sabh tum hee keenaa chalai naahee ko vepaaRaa ||4||
1081.e: The wilderness and the path are all made by You. No one can take the wrong path. ||4||
Some remain seated within their homes.
Some wander across the country and through foreign lands.

1081.g: ਇਕ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਘਾਸੁ ਇਕ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਰਾਜਾ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕੂੜਾ ॥੫॥
1081.t: eik hee kau ghaas ik hee kau raajaa in meh kaheeaai kiaa kooRaa ||5||
1081.e: Some are grass-cutters, and some are kings. Who among these can be called false? ||5||

1081.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਨਰਕਾ ॥
1081.t: kavan su mukatee kavan su narakaa ||
1081.e: Who is liberated, and who will land in hell?
Who is worldly, and who is a devotee?

1081.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਦਾਨਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਹੋਛਾ ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਜੜਾ ॥੬॥
1081.t: kavan su dhaanaa kavanu su hochhaa kavan su surataa kavan jaRaa ||6||
1081.e: Who is wise, and who is shallow? Who is aware, and who is ignorant? ||6||
By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one is liberated, and by His Hukam, one falls into hell.
By His Hukam, one is worldly, and by His Hukam, one is a devotee.

1081.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਛਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਧੜਾ ॥੭॥
1081.t: hukame hochhaa hukame dhaanaa dhoojaa naahee avar dhaRaa ||7||
1081.e: By His Hukam, one is shallow, and by His Hukam, one is wise. There is no other side except His. ||7||
You made the ocean vast and huge.

1081.g: ਇਕਿ ਖੜੇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
1081.t: eik khaRe rasaatal kar manmukh gaavaaraa ||
1081.e: You made some into foolish self-willed manmukhs, and dragged them into hell.

1081.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੇੜਾ ॥੮॥
1081.t: eikanaa paar la(n)ghaaveh aape satigur jin kaa sach beRaa ||8||
1081.e: Some are carried across, in the ship of Truth of the True Guru. ||8||
You issue Your Command for this amazing thing, death.
You create all beings and creatures, and absorb them back into Yourself.

1081.g: ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਆਖਾੜਾ ॥੯॥
1081.t: vekhai vigasai sabh ra(n)g maane rachan keenaa ik aakhaaRaa ||9||
1081.e: You gaze in delight upon the one arena of the world, and enjoy all the pleasures. ||9||
Great is the Lord and Master, and Great is His Name.
He is the Great Giver; Great is His place.

1081.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਤੋਲਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਹਾੜਾ ॥੧੦॥
1081.t: agam agochar bea(n)t atolaa hai naahee kichh aahaaRaa ||10||
1081.e: He is inaccessible and unfathomable, infinite and unweighable. He cannot be measureed. ||10||
No one else knows His value.
Only You Yourself, O Immaculate Lord, are equal to Yourself.

1081.g: ਆਪਿ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਤਵੰਤਾ ਅਤਿ ਗਾੜਾ ॥੧੧॥
1081.t: aap su giaanee aap dhiaanee aap satava(n)taa at gaaRaa ||11||
1081.e: You Yourself are the spiritual teacher, You Yourself are the One who meditates. You Yourself are the great and immense Being of Truth. ||11||
For so many days, You remained invisible.
For so many days, You were absorbed in silent absorption.

1081.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਰਗਟੜਾ ॥੧੨॥
1081.t: ketaRiaa dhin dhu(n)dhookaaraa aape karataa paragaTaRaa ||12||
1081.e: For so many days, there was only pitch darkness, and then the Creator revealed Himself. ||12||
You Yourself are called the God of Supreme Power.

1082.e: You Yourself are the hero, exerting Your regal power.

1082.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਵ ਵਰਤਾਈਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਠਾਰੁ ਗੜਾ ॥੧੩॥
1082.t: aape siv varataieean a(n)tar aape seetal Thaar gaRaa ||13||
1082.e: You Yourself spread peace within; You are cool and icy calm. ||13||
One whom You bless and make Gurmukh
the Naam abides within him, and the unstruck sound current vibrates for him.

1082.g: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਾ ॥੧੪॥
1082.t: tis hee sukh tis hee Thakuraiee tiseh na aavai jam neRaa ||14||
1082.e: He is peaceful, and he is the master of all; the Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||14||
His value cannot be described on paper.
Says Nanak, the Lord of the world is infinite.

1082.g: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਾਥਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਨੇਬੇੜਾ ॥੧੫॥
1082.t: aadh madh a(n)t prabh soiee haath tisai kai nebeRaa ||15||
1082.e: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, God exists. Judgement is in His Hands alone. ||15||
No one is equal to Him.

1082.g: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਬੁਤੈ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1082.t: kis hee butai jabaab na hoiee ||
1082.e: No one can stand up against Him by any means.

1082.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਚੋਜ ਖੜਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
1082.t: naanak kaa prabh aape aape kar kar vekhai choj khaRaa ||16||1||10||
1082.e: Nanak's God is Himself all-in-all. He creates and stages and watches His wondrous plays. ||16||1||10||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
The Supreme Lord God is imperishable, the Transcendent Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
He is the Slayer of demons, our Supreme Lord and Master.

1082.g: ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸ ਗੋਵਰਧਨ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੁਰਲੀ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
1082.t: rikheekes govaradhan dhaaree muralee manohar har ra(n)gaa ||1||
1082.e: The Supreme Rishi, the Master of the sensory organs, the uplifter of mountains, the joyful Lord playing His enticing flute. ||1||
The Enticer of Hearts, the Lord of wealth, Krishna, the Enemy of ego.
The Lord of the Universe, the Dear Lord, the Destroyer of demons.

1082.g: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
1082.t: jagajeevan abinaasee Thaakur ghaT ghaT vaasee hai sa(n)gaa ||2||
1082.e: The Life of the World, our eternal and ever-stable Lord and Master dwells within each and every heart, and is always with us. ||2||
The Support of the Earth, the man-lion, the Supreme Lord God.
The Protector who tears apart demons with His teeth, the Upholder of the earth.

1082.g: ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਚੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
1082.t: baavan roop keeaa tudh karate sabh hee setee hai cha(n)gaa ||3||
1082.e: O Creator, You assumed the form of the pygmy to humble the demons; You are the Lord God of all. ||3||

1082.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਜਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ॥
1082.t: sree raamacha(n)dh jis roop na rekhiaa ||
1082.e: You are the Great Raam Chand, who has no form or feature.
Adorned with flowers, holding the chakra in Your hand, Your form is incomparably beautiful.

1082.g: ਸਹਸ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਹੈ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੪॥
1082.t: sahas netr moorat hai sahasaa ik dhaataa sabh hai ma(n)gaa ||4||
1082.e: You have thousands of eyes, and thousands of forms. You alone are the Giver, and all are beggars of You. ||4||
You are the Lover of Your devotees, the Master of the masterless.
The Lord and Master of the milk-maids, You are the companion of all.

1082.g: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਗਾ ॥੫॥
1082.t: baasudhev nira(n)jan dhaate baran na saakau gun a(n)gaa ||5||
1082.e: O Lord, Immacuate Great Giver, I cannot describe even an iota of Your Glorious Virtues. ||5||
Liberator, Enticing Lord, Lord of Lakshmi, Supreme Lord God.
Savior of Dropadi's honor.

1082.g: ਕਮਲਾਕੰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਕੰਤੂਹਲ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਨਿਹਸੰਗਾ ॥੬॥
1082.t: kamalaaka(n)t kareh ka(n)toohal anadh binodhee nihasa(n)gaa ||6||
1082.e: Lord of Maya, miracle-worker, absorbed in delightful play, unattached. ||6||
The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; He is not born, He is self-existent.

1082.g: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਉ ॥
1082.t: akaal moorat jis kadhe naahee khau ||
1082.e: His form is undying; it is never destroyed.

1082.g: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਲਗਾ ॥੭॥
1082.t: abinaasee abigat agochar sabh kichh tujh hee hai lagaa ||7||
1082.e: O imperishable, eternal, unfathomable Lord, everything is attached to You. ||7||
The Lover of greatness, who dwells in heaven.
By the Pleasure of His Will, He took incarnation as the great fish and the tortoise.

1082.g: ਕੇਸਵ ਚਲਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਗਾ ॥੮॥
1082.t: kesav chalat kareh niraale keetaa loReh so hoigaa ||8||
1082.e: The Lord of beauteous hair, the Worker of miraculous deeds, whatever He wishes, comes to pass. ||8||
He is beyond need of any sustenance, free of hate and all-pervading.
He has staged His play; He is called the four-armed Lord.

1082.g: ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰੂਪ ਬਣਾਵਹਿ ਬੇਣੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੈਗਾ ॥੯॥
1082.t: saaval su(n)dhar roop banaaveh ben sunat sabh mohaigaa ||9||
1082.e: He assumed the beautiful form of the blue-skinned Krishna; hearing His flute, all are fascinated and enticed. ||9||
He is adorned with garlands of flowers, with lotus eyes.
His ear-rings, crown and flute are so beautiful.

1082.g: ਸੰਖ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਰਥੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੦॥
1082.t: sa(n)kh chakar gadhaa hai dhaaree mahaa saarathee satasa(n)gaa ||10||
1082.e: He carries the conch, the chakra and the war club; He is the Great Charioteer, who stays with His Saints. ||10||
The Lord of yellow robes, the Master of the three worlds.
The Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the world; with my mouth, I chant His Name.

1082.g: ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸਰਬੰਗਾ ॥੧੧॥
1082.t: saari(n)gadhar bhagavaan beeThulaa mai ganat na aavai saraba(n)gaa ||11||
1082.e: The Archer who draws the bow, the Beloved Lord God; I cannot count all His limbs. ||11||
He is said to be free of anguish, and absolutely immaculate.
The Lord of prosperity, pervading the water, the land and the sky.

1083.g: ਮਿਰਤ ਲੋਕ ਪਇਆਲ ਸਮੀਪਤ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਭਗਾ ॥੧੨॥
1083.t: mirat lok piaal sameepat asathir thaan jis hai abhagaa ||12||
1083.e: He is near this world and the nether regions of the underworld; His Place is permanent, ever-stable and imperishable. ||12||
The Purifier of sinners, the Destroyer of pain and fear.
The Eliminator of egotism, the Eradicator of coming and going.

1083.g: ਭਗਤੀ ਤੋਖਿਤ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਗੁਣੇ ਨ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਭਿਗਾ ॥੧੩॥
1083.t: bhagatee tokhit dheen kirapaalaa gune na kit hee hai bhigaa ||13||
1083.e: He is pleased with devotional worship, and merciful to the meek; He cannot be appeased by any other qualities. ||13||
The Formless Lord is undeceivable and unchanging.
He is the Embodiment of Light; through Him, the whole world blossoms forth.

1083.g: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪਹੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ ॥੧੪॥
1083.t: so milai jis aap milaae aapahu koi na paavaigaa ||14||
1083.e: He alone unites with Him, whom He unites with Himself. No one can attain the Lord by himself. ||14||
He Himself is the milk-maid, and He Himself is Krishna.
He Himself grazes the cows in the forest.

1083.g: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧੫॥
1083.t: aap upaaveh aap khapaaveh tudh lep nahee ik til ra(n)gaa ||15||
1083.e: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy. Not even a particle of filth attaches to You. ||15||
Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I chant with my one tongue?

1083.g: ਸਹਸ ਫਨੀ ਸੇਖ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
1083.t: sahas fanee sekh a(n)t na jaanai ||
1083.e: Even the thousand-headed serpent does not know Your limit.

1083.g: ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੬॥
1083.t: navatan naam japai dhin raatee ik gun naahee prabh keh sa(n)gaa ||16||
1083.e: One may chant new names for You day and night, but even so, O God, no one can describe even one of Your Glorious Virtues. ||16||
I have grasped the Support, and entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Father of the world.

1083.g: ਭੈ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਦੁਤਰ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1083.t: bhai bhiaanak jamadhoot dhutar hai maiaa ||
1083.e: The Messenger of Death is terrifying and horrendous, and sea of Maya is impassable.

1083.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਇਛਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੭॥
1083.t: hoh kirapaal ichhaa kar raakhahu saadh sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g sa(n)gaa ||17||
1083.e: Please be merciful, Lord, and save me, if it is Your Will; please lead me to join with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||17||
All that is seen is an illusion.

1083.g: ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
1083.t: eik maagau dhaan gobidh sa(n)t renaa ||
1083.e: I beg for this one gift, for the dust of the feet of the Saints, O Lord of the Universe.

1083.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ ॥੧੮॥
1083.t: masatak lai param padh paavau jis praapat so paavaigaa ||18||
1083.e: Applying it to my forehead, I obtain the supreme status; he alone obtains it, unto whom You give it. ||18||
Those, unto whom the Lord, the Giver of peace, grants His Mercy,

1083.g: ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਲੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥
1083.t: tin saadhoo charan lai ridhai paraate ||
1083.e: grasp the feet of the Holy, and weave them into their hearts.

1083.g: ਸਗਲ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਜੰਗਾ ॥੧੯॥
1083.t: sagal naam nidhaan tin paiaa anahadh sabadh man vaaja(n)gaa ||19||
1083.e: They obtain all the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds within their minds. ||19||
With my tongue I chant the Names given to You.
'Sat Naam' is Your perfect, primal Name.

1083.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ॥੨੦॥
1083.t: kahu naanak bhagat pe saranaiee dheh dharas man ra(n)g lagaa ||20||
1083.e: Says Nanak, Your devotees have entered Your Sanctuary. Please bestow the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; their minds are filled with love for You. ||20||
You alone know Your state and extent.

1083.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਥਹਿ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
1083.t: too aape katheh tai aap vakhaaneh ||
1083.e: You Yourself speak, and You Yourself describe it.

1083.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਦਾਸਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
1083.t: naanak dhaas dhaasan ko kareeahu har bhaavai dhaasaa raakh sa(n)gaa ||21||2||11||
1083.e: Please make Nanak the slave of Your slaves, O Lord; as it pleases Your Will, please keep him with Your slaves. ||21||2||11||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
O slave of the inaccessible Lord God Allah,
forsake thoughts of worldly entanglements.

1083.g: ਹੋਇ ਪੈ ਖਾਕ ਫਕੀਰ ਮੁਸਾਫਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ ਦਰਾ ॥੧॥
1083.t: hoi pai khaak fakeer musaafar ih dharaves kabool dharaa ||1||
1083.e: Become the dust of the feet of the humble fakeers, and consider yourself a traveller on this journey. O saintly dervish, you shall be approved in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
Let Truth be your prayer, and faith your prayer-mat.
Subdue your desires, and overcome your hopes.

1083.g: ਦੇਹ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾਣਾ ਕਲਮ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਪਾਕੁ ਖਰਾ ॥੨॥
1083.t: dheh maseet man maulaanaa kalam khudhaiee paak kharaa ||2||
1083.e: Let your body be the mosque, and your mind the priest. Let true purity be God's Word for you. ||2||
Let your practice be to live the spiritual life.
Let your spiritual cleansing be to renounce the world and seek God.

1083.g: ਮਾਰਫਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਹੁ ਅਬਦਾਲਾ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਹਕੀਕਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
1083.t: maarafat man maarahu abadhaalaa milahu hakeekat jit fir na maraa ||3||
1083.e: Let control of the mind be your spiritual wisdom, O holy man; meeting with God, you shall never die again. ||3||
Practice within your heart the teachings of the Koran and the Bible;
restrain the ten sensory organs from straying into evil.

1083.g: ਪੰਚ ਮਰਦ ਸਿਦਕਿ ਲੇ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਖੈਰਿ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਕਬੂਲ ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥
1083.t: pa(n)ch maradh sidhak le baadhahu khair sabooree kabool paraa ||4||
1083.e: Tie up the five demons of desire with faith, charity and contentment, and you shall be acceptable. ||4||
Let compassion be your Mecca, and the dust of the feet of the holy your fast.
Let Paradise be your practice of the Prophet's Word.

1083.g: ਹੂਰ ਨੂਰ ਮੁਸਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਅਲਹ ਆਲਾ ਹੁਜਰਾ ॥੫॥
1083.t: hoor noor musak khudhaiaa ba(n)dhagee aleh aalaa hujaraa ||5||
1083.e: God is the beauty, the light and the fragrance. Meditation on Allah is the secluded meditation chamber. ||5||

1084.e: He alone is a Qazi, who practices the Truth.
He alone is a Haji, a pilgrim to Mecca, who purifies his heart.

1084.g: ਸੋ ਮੁਲਾ ਮਲਊਨ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੋ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਧਰਾ ॥੬॥
1084.t: so mulaa maluoon nivaarai so dharaves jis sifat dharaa ||6||
1084.e: He alone is a Mullah, who banishes evil; he alone is a saintly dervish, who takes the Support of the Lord's Praise. ||6||

1084.g: ਸਭੇ ਵਖਤ ਸਭੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ॥ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਯਾਦਿ ਦਿਲੈ ਮਹਿ ਮਉਲਾ ॥
1084.t: sabhe vakhat sabhe kar velaa || khaalak yaadh dhilai meh maulaa ||
1084.e: Always, at every moment, remember God, the Creator within your heart.

1084.g: ਤਸਬੀ ਯਾਦਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਸ ਮਰਦਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਬੰਧਾਨਿ ਬਰਾ ॥੭॥
1084.t: tasabee yaadh karahu dhas maradhan su(n)nat seel ba(n)dhaan baraa ||7||
1084.e: Let your meditation beads be the subjugation of the ten senses. Let good conduct and self-restraint be your circumcision. ||7||
You must know in your heart that everything is temporary.
Family, household and siblings are all entanglements.

1084.g: ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ ਉਮਰੇ ਫਾਨਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਮੁਕਾਮ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦਰਾ ॥੮॥
1084.t: meer malak umare faanaiaa ek mukaam khudhai dharaa ||8||
1084.e: Kings, rulers and nobles are mortal and transitory; only God's Gate is the permanent place. ||8||
First, is the Lord's Praise; second, contentment;
third, humility, and fourth, giving to charities.

1084.g: ਪੰਜਵੈ ਪੰਜੇ ਇਕਤੁ ਮੁਕਾਮੈ ਏਹਿ ਪੰਜਿ ਵਖਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥੯॥
1084.t: pa(n)javai pa(n)je ikat mukaamai eh pa(n)j vakhat tere aparaparaa ||9||
1084.e: Fifth is to hold one's desires in restraint. These are the five most sublime daily prayers. ||9||
Let your daily worship be the knowledge that God is everywhere.

1084.g: ਬਦ ਅਮਲ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਥਿ ਕੂਜਾ ॥
1084.t: badh amal chhodd karahu hath koojaa ||
1084.e: Let renunciation of evil actions be the water-jug you carry.

1084.g: ਖੁਦਾਇ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਬਾਂਗਾਂ ਬੁਰਗੂ ਬਰਖੁਰਦਾਰ ਖਰਾ ॥੧੦॥
1084.t: khudhai ek bujh dhevahu baa(n)gaa(n) buragoo barakhuradhaar kharaa ||10||
1084.e: Let realization of the One Lord God be your call to prayer; be a good child of God - let this be your trumpet. ||10||
Let what is earned righteously be your blessed food.
Wash away pollution with the river of your heart.

1084.g: ਪੀਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਭਿਸਤੀ ਸੋਈ ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਨ ਦੋਜ ਠਰਾ ॥੧੧॥
1084.t: peer pachhaanai bhisatee soiee ajaraieel na dhoj Tharaa ||11||
1084.e: One who realizes the Prophet attains heaven. Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, does not cast him into hell. ||11||
Let good deeds be your body, and faith your bride.
Play and enjoy the Lord's love and delight.

1084.g: ਨਾਪਾਕ ਪਾਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹਦੀਸਾ ਸਾਬਤ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਦਸਤਾਰ ਸਿਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
1084.t: naapaak paak kar hadhoor hadheesaa saabat soorat dhasataar siraa ||12||
1084.e: Purify what is impure, and let the Lord's Presence be your religious tradition. Let your total awareness be the turban on your head. ||12||
To be Muslim is to be kind-hearted,

1084.g: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਦਿਲ ਤੇ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
1084.t: a(n)tar kee mal dhil te dhovai ||
1084.e: and wash away pollution from within the heart.

1084.g: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਪਾਟੁ ਘਿਉ ਪਾਕੁ ਹਰਾ ॥੧੩॥
1084.t: dhuneeaa ra(n)g na aavai neRai jiau kusam paaT ghiau paak haraa ||13||
1084.e: He does not even approach worldly pleasures; he is pure, like flowers, silk, ghee and the deer-skin. ||13||
One who is blessed with the mercy and compassion of the Merciful Lord,
is the manliest man among men.

1084.g: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਖੁ ਮਸਾਇਕੁ ਹਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਬੰਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਜਰਿ ਨਰਾ ॥੧੪॥
1084.t: soiee sekh masaik haajee so ba(n)dhaa jis najar naraa ||14||
1084.e: He alone is a Shaykh, a preacher, a Haji, and he alone is God's slave, who is blessed with God's Grace. ||14||
The Creator Lord has Creative Power; the Merciful Lord has Mercy.
The Praises and the Love of the Merciful Lord are unfathomable.

1084.g: ਹਕੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ਬੁਝਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸ ਤਰਾ ॥੧੫॥੩॥੧੨॥
1084.t: hak hukam sach khudhaiaa bujh naanak ba(n)dh khalaas taraa ||15||3||12||
1084.e: Realize the True Hukam, the Command of the Lord, O Nanak; you shall be released from bondage, and carried across. ||15||3||12||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
The Abode of the Supreme Lord God is above all.
He Himself establishes, establishes and creates.

1084.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਬਾਲ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
1084.t: prabh kee saran gahat sukh paieeaai kichh bhau na viaapai baal kaa ||1||
1084.e: Holding tight to the Sanctuary of God, peace is found, and one is not afflicted by the fear of Maya. ||1||
He saved you from the fire of the womb,
and did not destroy you, when you were an egg in your mother's ovary.

1084.g: ਅਪਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਮਾਲਕਾ ॥੨॥
1084.t: apanaa simaran dhe pratipaaliaa oh sagal ghaTaa kaa maalakaa ||2||
1084.e: Blessing you with meditative remembrance upon Himself, He nurtured you and cherished you; He is the Master of all hearts. ||2||
I have come to the Sanctuary of His lotus feet.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Praises of the Lord.

1084.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਲ ਕਾ ॥੩॥
1084.t: janam maran sabh dhookh nivaare jap har har bhau nahee kaal kaa ||3||
1084.e: I have erased all the pains of birth and death; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, I have no fear of death. ||3||
God is all-powerful, indescribable, unfathomable and divine.

1084.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
1084.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh taa kee sevaa ||
1084.e: All beings and creatures serve Him.

1084.g: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ਪਾਲਕਾ ॥੪॥
1084.t: a(n)ddaj jeraj setaj utabhuj bahu parakaaree paalakaa ||4||
1084.e: In so many ways, He cherishes those born from eggs, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth. ||4||
He alone obtains this wealth,
who savors and enjoys, deep within his mind, the Name of the Lord.

1084.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਸਾਲਕਾ ॥੫॥
1084.t: kar geh leene a(n)dh koop te virale keiee saalakaa ||5||
1084.e: Grasping hold of his arm, God lifts him up and pulls him out of the deep, dark pit. Such a devotee of the Lord is very rare. ||5||

1085.e: God exists in the beginning, in the middle and in the end.
Whatever the Creator Lord Himself does, comes to pass.

1085.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਤੇ ਦਾਲਿਦ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਘਾਲਕਾ ॥੬॥
1085.t: bhram bhau miTiaa saadhasa(n)g te dhaalidh na koiee ghaalakaa ||6||
1085.e: Doubt and fear are erased, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and then one is not afflicted by deadly pain. ||6||
I sing the most Sublime Bani, the Word of the Lord of the Universe.
I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saadh Sangat.

1085.g: ਬਾਸਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਿਬਾਸਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਲਮਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਲਕਾ ॥੭॥
1085.t: baasan meT nibaasan hoieeaai kalamal sagale jaalakaa ||7||
1085.e: Eradicating desire, I have become free of desire; I have burnt away all my sins. ||7||
