1095.e: As You Yourself become merciful, Lord, You link us to the service of the True Guru.

1095.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥੩॥
1095.t: tis kadhe na aavai toT jo har gun gaavahee ||3||
1095.e: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, never suffers any deficiency. ||3||

1095.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1095.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1095.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1095.g: ਜਾ ਮੂ ਪਸੀ ਹਠ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੀ ਮਹਿਜੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1095.t: jaa moo pasee haTh mai piree mahijai naal ||
1095.e: When I look within my being, I find that my Beloved is with me.

1095.g: ਹਭੇ ਡੁਖ ਉਲਾਹਿਅਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
1095.t: habhe ddukh ulaahiam naanak nadhar nihaal ||1||
1095.e: All pains are relieved, O Nanak, when He bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1||

1095.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1095.e: Fifth Mehla:

1095.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੈਠਾ ਭਖੇ ਵਾਉ ਲੰਮੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਦਰੁ ਖੜਾ ॥
1095.t: naanak baiThaa bhakhe vaau la(n)me seveh dhar khaRaa ||
1095.e: Nanak sits, waiting for news of the Lord, and stands at the Lord's Door; serving Him for so long.

1095.g: ਪਿਰੀਏ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੁ ਮਹਿਜਾ ਸਾਉ ਜੋਈ ਸਾਈ ਮੁਹੁ ਖੜਾ ॥੨॥
1095.t: pire'e too jaan mahijaa saau joiee saiee muh khaRaa ||2||
1095.e: O my Beloved, only You know my objective; I stand, waiting to see the Lord's face. ||2||

1095.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1095.e: Fifth Mehla:

1095.g: ਕਿਆ ਗਾਲਾਇਓ ਭੂਛ ਪਰ ਵੇਲਿ ਨ ਜੋਹੇ ਕੰਤ ਤੂ ॥
1095.t: kiaa gaalaio bhoochh par vel na johe ka(n)t too ||
1095.e: What should I say to you, you fool? Don't look at the vines of others - be a true husband.

1095.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਫੁਲਾ ਸੰਦੀ ਵਾੜਿ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਹਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਜਿਉ ॥੩॥
1095.t: naanak fulaa sa(n)dhee vaaR khiRiaa habh sa(n)saar jiau ||3||
1095.e: O Nanak, the entire world is blooming, like a garden of flowers. ||3||

1095.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1095.t: pauRee ||
1095.e: Pauree:

1095.g: ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥
1095.t: sughaR sujaan saroop too sabh meh varata(n)taa ||
1095.e: You are Wise, all-knowing and beautiful; You are pervading and permeating all.

1095.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਜੰਤਾ ॥
1095.t: too aape Thaakur sevako aape pooja(n)taa ||
1095.e: You Yourself are the Lord and Master, and the servant; You worship and adore Yourself.

1095.g: ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਵੰਤਾ ॥
1095.t: dhaanaa beenaa aap too aape satava(n)taa ||
1095.e: You are all-wise and all-seeing; You Yourself are true and pure.

1095.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
1095.t: jatee satee prabh niramalaa mere har bhagava(n)taa ||
1095.e: The Immaculate Lord, my Lord God, is celibate and True.

1095.g: ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਓ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੰਤਾ ॥
1095.t: sabh braham pasaar pasaario aape khela(n)taa ||
1095.e: God spreads out the expanse of the entire universe, and He Himself plays in it.

1095.g: ਇਹੁ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਦੇਖੰਤਾ ॥
1095.t: eih aavaa gavan rachaio kar choj dhekha(n)taa ||
1095.e: He created this coming and going of reincarnation; creating the wondrous play, He gazes upon it.

1095.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
1095.t: tis baahuR garabh na paavahee jis dheveh gur ma(n)taa ||
1095.e: One who is blessed with the Guru's Teachings, is not consigned to the womb of reincarnation, ever again.

1095.g: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਦੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਜੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
1095.t: jiau aap chalaaveh tiau chaladhe kichh vas na ja(n)taa ||4||
1095.e: All walk as He makes them walk; nothing is under the control of the created beings. ||4||

1095.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1095.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1095.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1095.g: ਕੁਰੀਏ ਕੁਰੀਏ ਵੈਦਿਆ ਤਲਿ ਗਾੜਾ ਮਹਰੇਰੁ ॥
1095.t: kure'e kure'e vaidhiaa tal gaaRaa maharer ||
1095.e: You are walking along the river-bank, but the land is giving way beneath you.

1095.g: ਵੇਖੇ ਛਿਟੜਿ ਥੀਵਦੋ ਜਾਮਿ ਖਿਸੰਦੋ ਪੇਰੁ ॥੧॥
1095.t: vekhe chhiTaR theevadho jaam khisa(n)dho per ||1||
1095.e: Watch out! Your foot might slip, and you'll fall in and die. ||1||

1095.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1095.e: Fifth Mehla:

1095.g: ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਚੁ ਵੈਦਿਓ ਤੂ ਆਘੂ ਆਘੇ ਸਲਵੇ ॥
1095.t: sach jaanai kach vaidhio too aaghoo aaghe salave ||
1095.e: You believe what is false and temporary to be true, and so you run on and on.

1095.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਸੜੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਨੈਣੂ ਬਿਆ ਢਲਿ ਪਬਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਜੁੰਮਿਓ ॥੨॥
1095.t: naanak aatasaRee ma(n)jh nainoo biaa ddal paban jiau ju(n)mio ||2||
1095.e: O Nanak, like butter in the fire, it shall melt away; it shall fade away like the water-lily. ||2||

1095.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1095.e: Fifth Mehla:

1095.g: ਭੋਰੇ ਭੋਰੇ ਰੂਹੜੇ ਸੇਵੇਦੇ ਆਲਕੁ ॥
1095.t: bhore bhore roohaRe sevedhe aalak ||
1095.e: O my foolish and silly soul, why are you too lazy to serve?

1095.g: ਮੁਦਤਿ ਪਈ ਚਿਰਾਣੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਡੂ ਆਵੈ ਰੁਤਿ ॥੩॥
1095.t: mudhat piee chiraaneeaa fir kaddoo aavai rut ||3||
1095.e: Such a long time has passed. When will this opportunity come again? ||3||

1096.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1096.t: pauRee ||
1096.e: Pauree:

1096.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
1096.t: tudh roop na rekhiaa jaat too varanaa baaharaa ||
1096.e: You have no form or shape, no social class or race.

1096.g: ਏ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
1096.t: e maanas jaaneh dhoor too varateh jaaharaa ||
1096.e: These humans believe that You are far away; but You are quite obviously apparent.

1096.g: ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਹਰਾ ॥
1096.t: too sabh ghaT bhogeh aap tudh lep na laaharaa ||
1096.e: You enjoy Yourself in every heart, and no filth sticks to You.

1096.g: ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਅਨੰਤ ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਾ ॥
1096.t: too purakh ana(n)dhee ana(n)t sabh jot samaaharaa ||
1096.e: You are the blissful and infinite Primal Lord God; Your Light is all-pervading.

1096.g: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਨਰਹਰਾ ॥
1096.t: too sabh dhevaa meh dhev bidhaate naraharaa ||
1096.e: Among all divine beings, You are the most divine, O Creator-architect, Rejuvenator of all.

1096.g: ਕਿਆ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇਕ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥
1096.t: kiaa aaraadhe jihavaa ik too abinaasee aparaparaa ||
1096.e: How can my single tongue worship and adore You? You are the eternal, imperishable, infinite Lord God.

1096.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਰਾ ॥
1096.t: jis meleh satigur aap tis ke sabh kul taraa ||
1096.e: One whom You Yourself unite with the True Guru - all his generations are saved.

1096.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਦੇ ਸੇਵ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੫॥
1096.t: sevak sabh karadhe sev dhar naanak jan teraa ||5||
1096.e: All Your servants serve You; Nanak is a humble servant at Your Door. ||5||

1096.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1096.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1096.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1096.g: ਗਹਡੜੜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਛਾਇਆ ਗਾਫਲ ਜਲਿਓਹੁ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
1096.t: gahaddaRaRaa tiran chhaiaa gaafal jalioh bhaeh ||
1096.e: He builds a hut of straw, and the fool lights a fire in it.

1096.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਹੜੈ ਤਿਨ ਉਸਤਾਦ ਪਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
1096.t: jinaa bhaag mathaahaRai tin usataadh panaeh ||1||
1096.e: Only those who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads, find Shelter with the Master. ||1||

1096.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1096.e: Fifth Mehla:

1096.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀਠਾ ਪਕਾ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਧਰਿਆ ਆਣਿ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ॥
1096.t: naanak peeThaa pakaa saajiaa dhariaa aan maujoodh ||
1096.e: O Nanak, he grinds the corn, cooks it and places it before himself.

1096.g: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਬੈਠਾ ਝਾਕੁ ਦਰੂਦ ॥੨॥
1096.t: baajhahu satigur aapane baiThaa jhaak dharoodh ||2||
1096.e: But without his True Guru, he sits and waits for his food to be blessed. ||2||

1096.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1096.e: Fifth Mehla:

1096.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੁਸਰੀਆ ਪਕਾਈਆ ਪਾਈਆ ਥਾਲੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1096.t: naanak bhusareeaa pakaieeaa paieeaa thaalai maeh ||
1096.e: O Nanak, the loaves of bread are baked and placed on the plate.

1096.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਾਇਆ ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਸੇਈ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
1096.t: jinee guroo manaiaa raj raj seiee khaeh ||3||
1096.e: Those who obey their Guru, eat and are totally satisfied. ||3||

1096.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1096.t: pauRee ||
1096.e: Pauree:

1096.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
1096.t: tudh jag meh khel rachaiaa vich haumai paieeaa ||
1096.e: You have staged this play in the world, and infused egotism into all beings.

1096.g: ਏਕੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ॥
1096.t: ek ma(n)dhar pa(n)ch chor heh nit kareh buriaaieeaa ||
1096.e: In the one temple of the body are the five thieves, who continually misbehave.

1096.g: ਦਸ ਨਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਈਆ ॥
1096.t: dhas naaree ik purakh kar dhase saadh luobhaieeaa ||
1096.e: The ten brides, the sensory organs were created, and the one husband, the self; the ten are engrossed in flavors and tastes.

1096.g: ਏਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੋਹੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਈਆ ॥
1096.t: en maiaa mohanee moheeaa nit fireh bharamaieeaa ||
1096.e: This Maya fascinates and entices them; they wander continually in doubt.

1096.g: ਹਾਠਾ ਦੋਵੈ ਕੀਤੀਓ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਵਰਤਾਈਆ ॥
1096.t: haaThaa dhovai keeteeo siv sakat varataieeaa ||
1096.e: You created both sides, spirit and matter, Shiva and Shakti.

1096.g: ਸਿਵ ਅਗੈ ਸਕਤੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਏਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
1096.t: siv agai sakatee haariaa evai har bhaieeaa ||
1096.e: Matter loses out to spirit; this is pleasing to the Lord.

1096.g: ਇਕਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਜੋ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ॥
1096.t: eik vichahu hee tudh rakhiaa jo satasa(n)g milaieeaa ||
1096.e: You enshrined spirit within, which leads to merger with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

1096.g: ਜਲ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਬਿੰਬੁ ਉਠਾਲਿਓ ਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈਆ ॥੬॥
1096.t: jal vichahu bi(n)b uThaalio jal maeh samaieeaa ||6||
1096.e: Within the bubble, You formed the bubble, which shall once again merge into the water. ||6||

1096.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1096.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1096.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1096.g: ਆਗਾਹਾ ਕੂ ਤ੍ਰਾਘਿ ਪਿਛਾ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਮੁਹਡੜਾ ॥
1096.t: aagaahaa koo traagh pichhaa fer na muhaddaRaa ||
1096.e: Look ahead; don't turn your face backwards.

1096.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਝਿ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਵਾਰ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਜਨਮੜਾ ॥੧॥
1096.t: naanak sijh ivehaa vaar bahuR na hovee janamaRaa ||1||
1096.e: O Nanak, be successful this time, and you shall not be reincarnated again. ||1||

1096.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1096.e: Fifth Mehla:

1096.g: ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਚਾਈਆ ਹਭ ਕਹੀ ਦਾ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
1096.t: sajan maiddaa chaieeaa habh kahee dhaa mit ||
1096.e: My joyful friend is called the friend of all.

1096.g: ਹਭੇ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਠਾਹੇ ਚਿਤੁ ॥੨॥
1096.t: habhe jaanan aapanaa kahee na Thaahe chit ||2||
1096.e: All think of Him as their own; He never breaks anyone's heart. ||2||

1096.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1096.e: Fifth Mehla:

1096.g: ਗੁਝੜਾ ਲਧਮੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਮਥੈ ਹੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਥਿਆ ॥
1096.t: gujhaRaa ladham laal mathai hee paragaT thiaa ||
1096.e: The hidden jewel has been found; it has appeared on my forehead.

1096.g: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਪਿਰੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਿਆ ॥੩॥
1096.t: soiee suhaavaa thaan jithai pire'e naanak jee too vuThiaa ||3||
1096.e: Beautiful and exalted is that place, O Nanak, where You dwell, O my Dear Lord. ||3||

1096.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1096.t: pauRee ||
1096.e: Pauree:

1096.g: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਛੰਦਾ ॥
1096.t: jaa too merai val hai taa kiaa muhachha(n)dhaa ||
1096.e: When You are on my side, Lord, what do I need to worry about?

1096.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਨੋ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਜਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
1096.t: tudh sabh kichh maino saupiaa jaa teraa ba(n)dhaa ||
1096.e: You entrusted everything to me, when I became Your slave.

1096.g: ਲਖਮੀ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੰਦਾ ॥
1096.t: lakhamee toT na aaviee khai kharach raha(n)dhaa ||
1096.e: My wealth is inexhaustible, no matter how much I spend and consume.

1096.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸਭ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦਾ ॥
1096.t: lakh chauraaseeh medhanee sabh sev kara(n)dhaa ||
1096.e: The 8.4 million species of beings all work to serve me.

1096.g: ਏਹ ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਨਹ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
1096.t: eh vairee mitr sabh keetiaa neh ma(n)geh ma(n)dhaa ||
1096.e: All these enemies have become my friends, and no one wishes me ill.

1096.g: ਲੇਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਛਈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੰਦਾ ॥
1096.t: lekhaa koi na puchhiee jaa har bakhasa(n)dhaa ||
1096.e: No one calls me to account, since God is my forgiver.

1096.g: ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
1096.t: ana(n)dh bhiaa sukh paiaa mil gur govi(n)dhaa ||
1096.e: I have become blissful, and I have found peace, meeting with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

1096.g: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਐ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ॥੭॥
1096.t: sabhe kaaj savaariaai jaa tudh bhaava(n)dhaa ||7||
1096.e: All my affairs have been resolved, since You are pleased with me. ||7||

1096.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1096.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1096.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1096.g: ਡੇਖਣ ਕੂ ਮੁਸਤਾਕੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਿਜੇਹਾ ਤਉ ਧਣੀ ॥
1096.t: ddekhan koo musataak mukh kijehaa tau dhanee ||
1096.e: I am so eager to see You, O Lord; what does Your face look like?

1096.g: ਫਿਰਦਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਹਾਲਿ ਜਾ ਡਿਠਮੁ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿਆ ॥੧॥
1096.t: firadhaa kitai haal jaa ddiTham taa man dhraapiaa ||1||
1096.e: I wandered around in such a miserable state, but when I saw You, my mind was comforted and consoled. ||1||

1097.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1097.e: Fifth Mehla:

1097.g: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦਰਦ ਘਣੇ ਵੇਦਨ ਜਾਣੇ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ॥
1097.t: dhukheeaa dharadh ghane vedhan jaane too dhanee ||
1097.e: The miserable endure so much suffering and pain; You alone know their pain, Lord.

1097.g: ਜਾਣਾ ਲਖ ਭਵੇ ਪਿਰੀ ਡਿਖੰਦੋ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਸਾ ॥੨॥
1097.t: jaanaa lakh bhave piree ddikha(n)dho taa jeevasaa ||2||
1097.e: I may know hundreds of thousands of remedies, but I shall live only if I see my Husband Lord. ||2||

1097.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1097.e: Fifth Mehla:

1097.g: ਢਹਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਰਾਰਿ ਵਹਣਿ ਵਹੰਦੇ ਮੈ ਡਿਠਿਆ ॥
1097.t: ddahadhee jai karaar vahan vaha(n)dhe mai ddiThiaa ||
1097.e: I have seen the river-bank washed away by the raging waters of the river.

1097.g: ਸੇਈ ਰਹੇ ਅਮਾਣ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥੩॥
1097.t: seiee rahe amaan jinaa satigur bheTiaa ||3||
1097.e: They alone remain intact, who meet with the True Guru. ||3||

1097.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1097.t: pauRee ||
1097.e: Pauree:

1097.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
1097.t: jis jan teree bhukh hai tis dhukh na viaapai ||
1097.e: No pain afflicts that humble being who hungers for You, Lord.

1097.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਸੁ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
1097.t: jin jan gurmukh bujhiaa su chahu ku(n)ddee jaapai ||
1097.e: That humble Gurmukh who understands, is celebrated in the four directions.

1097.g: ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਉਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਬਹਿ ਪਾਪੈ ॥
1097.t: jo nar us kee saranee parai tis ka(n)beh paapai ||
1097.e: Sins run away from that man, who seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord.

1097.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਾਪੈ ॥
1097.t: janam janam kee mal utarai gur dhooRee naapai ||
1097.e: The filth of countless incarnations is washed away, bathing in the dust of the Guru's feet.

1097.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
1097.t: jin har bhaanaa ma(n)niaa tis sog na sa(n)taapai ||
1097.e: Whoever submits to the Lord's Will does not suffer in sorrow.

1097.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੈ ॥
1097.t: har jeeau too sabhanaa kaa mit hai sabh jaaneh aapai ||
1097.e: O Dear Lord, You are the friend of all; all believe that You are theirs.

1097.g: ਐਸੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਨੈ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ॥
1097.t: aaisee sobhaa janai kee jevadd har parataapai ||
1097.e: The glory of the Lord's humble servant is as great as the Glorious Radiance of the Lord.

1097.g: ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਨ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੮॥
1097.t: sabh a(n)tar jan varataiaa har jan te jaapai ||8||
1097.e: Among all, His humble servant is pre-eminent; through His humble servant, the Lord is known. ||8||

1097.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1097.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1097.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1097.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਹਉ ਗਈ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਭੀ ਰਵਿਆਸੁ ॥
1097.t: jinaa pichhai hau giee se mai pichhai bhee raviaas ||
1097.e: Those whom I followed, now follow me.

1097.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਆਸੜੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਹਿਜੀ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
1097.t: jinaa kee mai aasaRee tinaa mahijee aas ||1||
1097.e: Those in whom I placed my hopes, now place their hopes in me. ||1||

1097.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1097.e: Fifth Mehla:

1097.g: ਗਿਲੀ ਗਿਲੀ ਰੋਡੜੀ ਭਉਦੀ ਭਵਿ ਭਵਿ ਆਇ ॥
1097.t: gilee gilee roddaRee bhaudhee bhav bhav aai ||
1097.e: The fly flies around, and comes to the wet lump of molasses.

1097.g: ਜੋ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੇ ਫਾਥਿਆ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਇ ॥੨॥
1097.t: jo baiThe se faathiaa ubare bhaag mathai ||2||
1097.e: Whoever sits on it, is caught; they alone are saved, who have good destiny on their foreheads. ||2||

1097.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1097.e: Fifth Mehla:

1097.g: ਡਿਠਾ ਹਭ ਮਝਾਹਿ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
1097.t: ddiThaa habh majhaeh khaalee koi na jaaneeaai ||
1097.e: I see Him within all. No one is without Him.

1097.g: ਤੈ ਸਖੀ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
1097.t: tai sakhee bhaag mathaeh jinee meraa sajan raaviaa ||3||
1097.e: Good destiny is inscribed on the forehead of that companion, who who enjoys the Lord, my Friend. ||3||

1097.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1097.t: pauRee ||
1097.e: Pauree:

1097.g: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦਾ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1097.t: hau ddaaddee dhar gun gaavadhaa je har prabh bhaavai ||
1097.e: I am a minstrel at His Door, singing His Glorious Praises, to please to my Lord God.

1097.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਥਿਰ ਥਾਵਰੀ ਹੋਰ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
1097.t: prabh meraa thir thaavaree hor aavai jaavai ||
1097.e: My God is permanent and stable; others continue coming and going.

1097.g: ਸੋ ਮੰਗਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੋੁਸਾਈਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
1097.t: so ma(n)gaa dhaan guosaieeaa jit bhukh leh jaavai ||
1097.e: I beg for that gift from the Lord of the World, which will satisfy my hunger.

1097.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
1097.t: prabh jeeau dhevahu dharasan aapanaa jit ddaaddee tirapataavai ||
1097.e: O Dear Lord God, please bless Your minstrel with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, that I might be satisfied and fulfilled.

1097.g: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਉ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
1097.t: aradhaas sunee dhaataar prabh ddaaddee kau mahal bulaavai ||
1097.e: God, the Great Giver, hears the prayer, and summons the minstrel to the Mansion of His Presence.

1097.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਦਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਉ ਮੰਗਣੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
1097.t: prabh dhekhadhiaa dhukh bhukh giee ddaaddee kau ma(n)gan chit na aavai ||
1097.e: Gazing upon God, the minstrel is rid of pain and hunger; he does not think to ask for anything else.

1097.g: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1097.t: sabhe ichhaa pooreeaa lag prabh kai paavai ||
1097.e: All desires are fulfilled, touching the feet of God.

1097.g: ਹਉ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਵੇਦਾਵੈ ॥੯॥
1097.t: hau niragun ddaaddee bakhasion prabh purakh vedhaavai ||9||
1097.e: I am His humble, unworthy minstrel; the Primal Lord God has forgiven me. ||9||

1097.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1097.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1097.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1097.g: ਜਾ ਛੁਟੇ ਤਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਤੂ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ॥
1097.t: jaa chhuTe taa khaak too su(n)n(j)ee ka(n)t na jaanahee ||
1097.e: When the soul leaves, you shall become dust, O vacant body; why do you not realize your Husband Lord?

1097.g: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਨੇਹੁ ਤੂ ਕੈ ਗੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਹੀ ॥੧॥
1097.t: dhurajan setee neh too kai gun har ra(n)g maanahee ||1||
1097.e: You are in love with evil people; by what virtues will you enjoy the Lord's Love? ||1||

1097.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1097.e: Fifth Mehla:

1097.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਸਰੈ ਨ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
1097.t: naanak jis bin ghaRee na jeevanaa visare sarai na bi(n)dh ||
1097.e: O Nanak, without Him, you cannot survive, even for an instant; you cannot afford to forget Him, even for a moment.

1097.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਨ ਰੂਸੀਐ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
1097.t: tis siau kiau man rooseeaai jiseh hamaaree chi(n)dh ||2||
1097.e: Why are you alienated from Him, O my mind? He takes care of you. ||2||

1097.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1097.e: Fifth Mehla:

1097.g: ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ॥
1097.t: rate ra(n)g paarabraham kai man tan at gulaal ||
1097.e: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God, their minds and bodies are colored deep crimson.

1097.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਆਲੂਦਿਆ ਜਿਤੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਿਆਲੁ ॥੩॥
1097.t: naanak vin naavai aaloodhiaa jitee hor khiaal ||3||
1097.e: O Nanak, without the Name, other thoughts are polluted and corrupt. ||3||

1097.g: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
1097.t: pavaRee ||
1097.e: Pauree:

1097.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੈ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
1097.t: har jeeau jaa too meraa mitr hai taa kiaa mai kaaRaa ||
1097.e: O Dear Lord, when You are my friend, what sorrow can afflict me?

1097.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਠਗੀ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾੜਾ ॥
1097.t: jinee Thagee jag Thagiaa se tudh maar nivaaRaa ||
1097.e: You have beaten off and destroyed the cheats that cheat the world.

1097.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ਜਿਤਾ ਪਾਵਾੜਾ ॥
1097.t: gur bhaujal paar la(n)ghaiaa jitaa paavaaRaa ||
1097.e: The Guru has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean, and I have won the battle.

1097.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਵਡਾ ਆਖਾੜਾ ॥
1097.t: gurmatee sabh ras bhogadhaa vaddaa aakhaaRaa ||
1097.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, I enjoy all the pleasures in the great world-arena.

1097.g: ਸਭਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀਆ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਤੀਓ ਸਤਵੰਤਾ ਸਾੜਾ ॥
1097.t: sabh i(n)dhreeaa vas kar dhiteeo satava(n)taa saaRaa ||
1097.e: The True Lord has brought all my senses and organs under my control.

1098.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਅਨਿ ਤਿਤੈ ਲਗਦੀਆ ਨਹ ਖਿੰਜੋਤਾੜਾ ॥
1098.t: jit laieean titai lagadheeaa neh khi(n)jotaaRaa ||
1098.e: Wherever I join them, there they are joined; they do not struggle against me.

1098.g: ਜੋ ਇਛੀ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾੜਾ ॥
1098.t: jo ichhee so fal paidhaa gur a(n)dhar vaaRaa ||
1098.e: I obtain the fruits of my desires; the Guru has directed me within.

1098.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਦਾ ਨੇੜਾ ॥੧੦॥
1098.t: gur naanak tuThaa bhairahu har vasadhaa neRaa ||10||
1098.e: When Guru Nanak is pleased, O Siblings of Destiny, the Lord is seen to be dwelling near at hand. ||10||

1098.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1098.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1098.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1098.g: ਜਾ ਮੂੰ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਹਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਾਉ ॥
1098.t: jaa moo(n) aaveh chit too taa habhe sukh lahaau ||
1098.e: When You come into my consciousness, then I obtain all peace and comfort.

1098.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਤਹਿਜਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
1098.t: naanak man hee ma(n)jh ra(n)gaavalaa piree tahijaa naau ||1||
1098.e: Nanak: with Your Name within my mind, O my Husband Lord, I am filled with delight. ||1||

1098.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1098.e: Fifth Mehla:

1098.g: ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਏ ਹਭੇ ਹੀ ਛਾਰ ॥
1098.t: kapaR bhog vikaar e habhe hee chhaar ||
1098.e: Enjoyment of clothes and corrupt pleasures - all these are nothing more than dust.

1098.g: ਖਾਕੁ ਲੋੁੜੇਦਾ ਤੰਨਿ ਖੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ॥੨॥
1098.t: khaak luoRedhaa ta(n)n khe jo rate dheedhaar ||2||
1098.e: I long for the dust of the feet of those who are imbued with the Lord's Vision. ||2||

1098.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1098.e: Fifth Mehla:

1098.g: ਕਿਆ ਤਕਹਿ ਬਿਆ ਪਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਹੀਅੜੇ ਹਿਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
1098.t: kiaa takeh biaa paas kar heeaRe hik adhaar ||
1098.e: Why do you look in other directions? O my heart, take the Support of the Lord alone.

1098.g: ਥੀਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਭੀ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
1098.t: theeau sa(n)tan kee ren jit labhee sukh dhaataar ||3||
1098.e: Become the dust of the feet of the Saints, and find the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||3||

1098.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1098.t: pauRee ||
1098.e: Pauree:

1098.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਲਗੈ ॥
1098.t: vin karamaa har jeeau na paieeaai bin satigur manooaa na lagai ||
1098.e: Without good karma, the Dear Lord is not found; without the True Guru, the mind is not joined to Him.

1098.g: ਧਰਮੁ ਧੀਰਾ ਕਲਿ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਤਗੈ ॥
1098.t: dharam dheeraa kal a(n)dhare ih paapee mool na tagai ||
1098.e: Only the Dharma remains stable in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; these sinners will not last at all.

1098.g: ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ॥
1098.t: eh kar kare su eh kar paae ik ghaRee muhat na lagai ||
1098.e: Whatever one does with this hand, he obtains with the other hand, without a moment's delay.

1098.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਮੈ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਗੈ ॥
1098.t: chaare jug mai sodhiaa vin sa(n)gat aha(n)kaar na bhagai ||
1098.e: I have examined the four ages, and without the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, egotism does not depart.

1098.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਛੁਟਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਸੰਗੈ ॥
1098.t: haumai mool na chhuTiee vin saadhoo satasa(n)gai ||
1098.e: Egotism is never eradicated without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

1098.g: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਥਾਹ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਭੰਗੈ ॥
1098.t: tichar thaeh na paaviee jichar saahib siau man bha(n)gai ||
1098.e: As long as one's mind is torn away from his Lord and Master, he finds no place of rest.

1098.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਅਭਗੈ ॥
1098.t: jin jan gurmukh seviaa tis ghar dheebaan abhagai ||
1098.e: That humble being, who, as Gurmukh, serves the Lord, has the Support of the Imperishable Lord in the home of his heart.

1098.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗੈ ॥੧੧॥
1098.t: har kirapaa te sukh paiaa gur satigur charanee lagai ||11||
1098.e: By the Lord's Grace, peace is obtained, and one is attached to the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||11||

1098.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1098.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1098.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1098.g: ਲੋੜੀਦੋ ਹਭ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਮੀਰਾ ਮੀਰੰਨ ਸਿਰਿ ॥
1098.t: loReedho habh jai so meeraa meera(n)n sir ||
1098.e: I have searched everywhere for the King over the heads of kings.

1098.g: ਹਠ ਮੰਝਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਚਉਦੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
1098.t: haTh ma(n)jhaahoo so dhanee chaudho mukh alai ||1||
1098.e: That Master is within my heart; I chant His Name with my mouth. ||1||

1098.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1098.e: Fifth Mehla:

1098.g: ਮਾਣਿਕੂ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਉ ਡਿੰਨਾ ਧਣੀ ਅਪਾਹਿ ॥
1098.t: maanikoo moh maau ddi(n)naa dhanee apaeh ||
1098.e: O my mother, the Master has blessed me with the jewel.

1098.g: ਹਿਆਉ ਮਹਿਜਾ ਠੰਢੜਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
1098.t: hiaau mahijaa Tha(n)ddaRaa mukhahu sach alai ||2||
1098.e: My heart is cooled and soothed, chanting the True Name with my mouth. ||2||

1098.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1098.e: Fifth Mehla:

1098.g: ਮੂ ਥੀਆਊ ਸੇਜ ਨੈਣਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਵਿਛਾਵਣਾ ॥
1098.t: moo theeaauoo sej nainaa piree vichhaavanaa ||
1098.e: I have become the bed for my Beloved Husband Lord; my eyes have become the sheets.

1098.g: ਜੇ ਡੇਖੈ ਹਿਕ ਵਾਰ ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਮਾ ਹੂ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥੩॥
1098.t: je ddekhai hik vaar taa sukh keemaa hoo baahare ||3||
1098.e: If You look at me, even for an instant, then I obtain peace beyond all price. ||3||

1098.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1098.t: pauRee ||
1098.e: Pauree:

1098.g: ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
1098.t: man lochai har milan kau kiau dharasan paieeaa ||
1098.e: My mind longs to meet the Lord; how can I obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan?

1098.g: ਮੈ ਲਖ ਵਿੜਤੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਜੇ ਬਿੰਦ ਬੋੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
1098.t: mai lakh viRate saahibaa je bi(n)dh buolaieeaa ||
1098.e: I obtain hundreds of thousands, if my Lord and Master speaks to me, even for an instant.

1098.g: ਮੈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਸਾਈਆ ॥
1098.t: mai chaare ku(n)ddaa bhaaleeaa tudh jevadd na saieeaa ||
1098.e: I have searched in four directions; there is no other as great as You, Lord.

1098.g: ਮੈ ਦਸਿਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤਹੋ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ॥
1098.t: mai dhasih maarag sa(n)taho kiau prabhoo milaieeaa ||
1098.e: Show me the Path, O Saints. How can I meet God?

1098.g: ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਹੁ ਇਤੁ ਪੰਥਿ ਜੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
1098.t: man arapih haumai tajahu it pa(n)th julaieeaa ||
1098.e: I dedicate my mind to Him, and renounce my ego. This is the Path which I shall take.

1098.g: ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ॥
1098.t: nit sevih saahib aapanaa satasa(n)g milaieeaa ||
1098.e: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I serve my Lord and Master continually.

1098.g: ਸਭੇ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
1098.t: sabhe aasaa pooreeaa gur mahal bulaieeaa ||
1098.e: All my hopes are fulfilled; the Guru has ushered me into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

1098.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੋੁਸਾਈਆ ॥੧੨॥
1098.t: tudh jevadd hor na sujhiee mere mitr guosaieeaa ||12||
1098.e: I cannot conceive of any other as great as You, O my Friend, O Lord of the World. ||12||

1098.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1098.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1098.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1098.g: ਮੂ ਥੀਆਊ ਤਖਤੁ ਪਿਰੀ ਮਹਿੰਜੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
1098.t: moo theeaauoo takhat piree mahi(n)je paatisaeh ||
1098.e: I have become the throne for my Beloved Lord King.

1098.g: ਪਾਵ ਮਿਲਾਵੇ ਕੋਲਿ ਕਵਲ ਜਿਵੈ ਬਿਗਸਾਵਦੋ ॥੧॥
1098.t: paav milaave kol kaval jivai bigasaavadho ||1||
1098.e: If You place Your foot on me, I blossom forth like the lotus flower. ||1||

1098.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1098.e: Fifth Mehla:

1098.g: ਪਿਰੀਆ ਸੰਦੜੀ ਭੁਖ ਮੂ ਲਾਵਣ ਥੀ ਵਿਥਰਾ ॥
1098.t: pireeaa sa(n)dhaRee bhukh moo laavan thee vitharaa ||
1098.e: If my Beloved becomes hungry, I will become food, and place myself before Him.

1098.g: ਜਾਣੁ ਮਿਠਾਈ ਇਖ ਬੇਈ ਪੀੜੇ ਨਾ ਹੁਟੈ ॥੨॥
1098.t: jaan miThaiee ikh beiee peeRe naa huTai ||2||
1098.e: I may be crushed, again and again, but like sugarcane, I do not stop yielding sweet juice. ||2||

1098.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1098.e: Fifth Mehla:

1098.g: ਠਗਾ ਨੀਹੁ ਮਤ੍ਰੋੜਿ ਜਾਣੁ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬਾ ਨਗਰੀ ॥
1098.t: Thagaa neeh matroR jaan ga(n)dhrabaa nagaree ||
1098.e: Break off your love with the cheaters; realize that it is a mirage.

1098.g: ਸੁਖ ਘਟਾਊ ਡੂਇ ਇਸੁ ਪੰਧਾਣੂ ਘਰ ਘਣੇ ॥੩॥
1098.t: sukh ghaTaauoo ddooi is pa(n)dhaanoo ghar ghane ||3||
1098.e: Your pleasure lasts for only two moments; this traveller wanders through countless homes. ||3||

1098.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1098.t: pauRee ||
1098.e: Pauree:

1098.g: ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਨਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਲੇਖੰ ॥
1098.t: akal kalaa neh paieeaai prabh alakh alekha(n) ||
1098.e: God is not found by intellectual devices; He is unknowable and unseen.

1099.g: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭੇਖੰ ॥
1099.t: khaT dharasan bhramate fireh neh mileeaai bhekha(n) ||
1099.e: The followers of the six orders wander and roam around wearing religious robes, but they do not meet God.

1099.g: ਵਰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਇਣਾ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੰ ॥
1099.t: varat kareh cha(n)dhrainaa se kitai na lekha(n) ||
1099.e: They keep the lunar fasts, but they are of no account.

1099.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਾ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪੇਖੰ ॥
1099.t: bedh paReh sa(n)pooranaa tat saar na pekha(n) ||
1099.e: Those who read the Vedas in their entirety, still do not see the sublime essence of reality.

1099.g: ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਢਹਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਲੇਖੰ ॥
1099.t: tilak kaddeh isanaan kar a(n)tar kaalekha(n) ||
1099.e: They apply ceremonial marks to their foreheads, and take cleansing baths, but they are blackened within.

1099.g: ਭੇਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੀ ਸਿਖੰ ॥
1099.t: bhekhee prabhoo na labhiee vin sachee sikha(n) ||
1099.e: They wear religious robes, but without the True Teachings, God is not found.

1099.g: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੰ ॥
1099.t: bhoolaa maarag so pavai jis dhur masatak lekha(n) ||
1099.e: One who had strayed, finds the Path again, if such pre-ordained destiny is written on his forehead.

1099.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖੰ ॥੧੩॥
1099.t: tin janam savaariaa aapanaa jin gur akhee dhekha(n) ||13||
1099.e: One who sees the Guru with his eyes, embellishes and exalts his human life. ||13||

1099.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1099.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1099.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1099.g: ਸੋ ਨਿਵਾਹੂ ਗਡਿ ਜੋ ਚਲਾਊ ਨ ਥੀਐ ॥
1099.t: so nivaahoo gadd jo chalaauoo na theeaai ||
1099.e: Focus on that which will not pass away.

1099.g: ਕਾਰ ਕੂੜਾਵੀ ਛਡਿ ਸੰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
1099.t: kaar kooRaavee chhadd sa(n)mal sach dhanee ||1||
1099.e: Abandon your false actions, and meditate on the True Master. ||1||

1099.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1099.e: Fifth Mehla:

1099.g: ਹਭ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਘਟਾਊ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ॥
1099.t: habh samaanee jot jiau jal ghaTaauoo cha(n)dhramaa ||
1099.e: God's Light is permeating all, like the moon reflected in the water.

1099.g: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਥੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥੨॥
1099.t: paragaT theeaa aap naanak masatak likhiaa ||2||
1099.e: He Himself is revealed, O Nanak, to one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||2||

1099.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1099.e: Fifth Mehla:

1099.g: ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਉ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
1099.t: mukh suhaave naam chau aaTh pahar gun gaau ||
1099.e: One's face becomes beautiful, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and singing His Glorious Praises, twenty-four hours a day.

1099.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੩॥
1099.t: naanak dharageh ma(n)ne'eeh milee nithaave thaau ||3||
1099.e: O Nanak, in the Court of the Lord, you shall be accepted; even the homeless find a home there. ||3||

1099.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1099.t: pauRee ||
1099.e: Pauree:

1099.g: ਬਾਹਰ ਭੇਖਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
1099.t: baahar bhekh na paieeaai prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
1099.e: By wearing religious robes outwardly, God, the Inner-knower is not found.

1099.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਨਿਕਾਮੀ ॥
1099.t: eikas har jeeau baaharee sabh firai nikaamee ||
1099.e: Without the One Dear Lord, all wander around aimlessly.

1099.g: ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਗਰਬਿ ਫਿਰਾਮੀ ॥
1099.t: man rataa kuTa(n)b siau nit garab firaamee ||
1099.e: Their minds are imbued with attachment to family, and so they continually wander around, puffed up with pride.

1099.g: ਫਿਰਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬਹਿ ਦਾਮੀ ॥
1099.t: fireh gumaanee jag meh kiaa garabeh dhaamee ||
1099.e: The arrogant wander around the world; why are they so proud of their wealth?

1099.g: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਖਿਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਮੀ ॥
1099.t: chaladhiaa naal na chaliee khin jai bilaamee ||
1099.e: Their wealth shall not go with them when they depart; in an instant, it is gone.

1099.g: ਬਿਚਰਦੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਹੁਕਾਮੀ ॥
1099.t: bicharadhe fireh sa(n)saar meh har jee hukaamee ||
1099.e: They wander around in the world, according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

1099.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਖੁਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
1099.t: karam khulaa gur paiaa har miliaa suaamee ||
1099.e: When one's karma is activated, one finds the Guru, and through Him, the Lord and Master is found.

1099.g: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੧੪॥
1099.t: jo jan har kaa sevako har tis kee kaamee ||14||
1099.e: That humble being, who serves the Lord, has his affairs resolved by the Lord. ||14||

1099.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1099.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1099.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1099.g: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਲਾਏ ਹਭ ਮਰਣੁ ਪਛਾਣੰਦੋ ਕੋਇ ॥
1099.t: mukhahu alaae habh maran pachhaana(n)dho koi ||
1099.e: All speak with their mouths, but rare are those one who realize death.

1099.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਯਕੀਨਾ ਹਿਕ ਸਿਉ ॥੧॥
1099.t: naanak tinaa khaak jinaa yakeenaa hik siau ||1||
1099.e: Nanak is the dust of the feet of those who have faith in the One Lord. ||1||

1099.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1099.e: Fifth Mehla:

1099.g: ਜਾਣੁ ਵਸੰਦੋ ਮੰਝਿ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਕੋ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
1099.t: jaan vasa(n)dho ma(n)jh pachhaanoo ko hekaRo ||
1099.e: Know that He dwells within all; rare are those who realize this.

1099.g: ਤੈ ਤਨਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥੨॥
1099.t: tai tan paRadhaa naeh naanak jai gur bheTiaa ||2||
1099.e: There is no obscuring veil on the body of that one, O Nanak, who meets the Guru. ||2||

1099.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1099.e: Fifth Mehla:

1099.g: ਮਤੜੀ ਕਾਂਢਕੁ ਆਹ ਪਾਵ ਧੋਵੰਦੋ ਪੀਵਸਾ ॥
1099.t: mataRee kaa(n)ddak aaeh paav dhova(n)dho peevasaa ||
1099.e: I drink in the water which has washed the feet of those who share the Teachings.

1099.g: ਮੂ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਅਥਾਹ ਪਸਣ ਕੂ ਸਚਾ ਧਣੀ ॥੩॥
1099.t: moo tan prem athaeh pasan koo sachaa dhanee ||3||
1099.e: My body is filled with infinite love to see my True Master. ||3||

1099.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1099.t: pauRee ||
1099.e: Pauree:

1099.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਾ ॥
1099.t: nirabhau naam visaariaa naal maiaa rachaa ||
1099.e: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord, he becomes attached to Maya.

1099.g: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਚਾ ॥
1099.t: aavai jai bhavaieeaai bahu jonee nachaa ||
1099.e: He comes and goes, and wanders, dancing in countless incarnations.

1099.g: ਬਚਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਖਿਸਕਿ ਜਾਇ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਚਾ ॥
1099.t: bachan kare tai khisak jai bole sabh kachaa ||
1099.e: He gives his word, but then backs out. All that he says is false.

1099.g: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਥੋਥਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਸਭ ਖਚਾ ॥
1099.t: a(n)dharahu thothaa kooRiaar kooRee sabh khachaa ||
1099.e: The false person is hollow within; he is totally engrossed in falsehood.

1099.g: ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚਾ ॥
1099.t: vair kare niravair naal jhooThe laalachaa ||
1099.e: He tries to take vengeance upon the Lord, who bears no vengeance; such a person is trapped by falsehood and greed.

1099.g: ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਚਾ ॥
1099.t: maariaa sachai paatisaeh vekh dhur karamachaa ||
1099.e: The True King, the Primal Lord God, kills him when He sees what he has done.

1099.g: ਜਮਦੂਤੀ ਹੈ ਹੇਰਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਚਾ ॥
1099.t: jamadhootee hai heriaa dhukh hee meh pachaa ||
1099.e: The Messenger of Death sees him, and he rots away in pain.

1099.g: ਹੋਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ॥੧੫॥
1099.t: hoaa tapaavas dharam kaa naanak dhar sachaa ||15||
1099.e: Even-handed justice is administered, O Nanak, in the Court of the True Lord. ||15||

1099.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1099.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1099.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1099.g: ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
1099.t: parabhaate prabh naam jap gur ke charan dhiaai ||
1099.e: In the early hours of the morning, chant the Name of God, and meditate on the Feet of the Guru.

1099.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
1099.t: janam maran mal utarai sache ke gun gai ||1||
1099.e: The filth of birth and death is erased, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||1||

1099.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1099.e: Fifth Mehla:

1099.g: ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥
1099.t: dheh a(n)dhaaree a(n)dh su(n)n(j)ee naam vihooneeaa ||
1099.e: The body is dark, blind and empty, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1099.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
1099.t: naanak safal jana(n)m jai ghaT vuThaa sach dhanee ||2||
1099.e: O Nanak, fruitful is the birth of one, within whose heart the True Master dwells. ||2||

1099.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1099.e: Fifth Mehla:

1099.g: ਲੋਇਣ ਲੋਈ ਡਿਠ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਮੂ ਘਣੀ ॥
1099.t: loin loiee ddiTh piaas na bujhai moo ghanee ||
1099.e: With my eyes, I have seen the Light; my great thirst for Him is not quenched.

1100.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਅਖੜੀਆ ਬਿਅੰਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਸੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੩॥
1100.t: naanak se akhaReeaa bia(n)n jinee ddisa(n)dho maa piree ||3||
1100.e: O Nanak, these are not the eyes which can see my Beloved Husband Lord. ||3||

1100.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1100.t: pauRee ||
1100.e: Pauree:

1100.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈ ॥
1100.t: jin jan gurmukh seviaa tin sabh sukh paiee ||
1100.e: That humble being, who, as Gurmukh, serves the Lord, obtains all peace and pleasure.

1100.g: ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਈ ॥
1100.t: oh aap tariaa kuTa(n)b siau sabh jagat taraiee ||
1100.e: He Himself is saved, along with his family, and all the world is saved as well.

1100.g: ਓਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
1100.t: on har naamaa dhan sa(n)chiaa sabh tikhaa bujhaiee ||
1100.e: He collects the wealth of the Lord's Name, and all his thirst is quenched.

1100.g: ਓਨਿ ਛਡੇ ਲਾਲਚ ਦੁਨੀ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
1100.t: on chhadde laalach dhunee ke a(n)tar liv laiee ||
1100.e: He renounces worldly greed, and his inner being is lovingly attuned to the Lord.

1100.g: ਓਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਘਰਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
1100.t: os sadhaa sadhaa ghar ana(n)dh hai har sakhaa sahaiee ||
1100.e: Forever and ever, the home of his heart is filled with bliss; the Lord is his companion, help and support.

1100.g: ਓਨਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਸਭ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
1100.t: on vairee mitr sam keetiaa sabh naal subhaiee ||
1100.e: He looks alike upon enemy and friend, and wishes well to all.

1100.g: ਹੋਆ ਓਹੀ ਅਲੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਪਾਈ ॥
1100.t: hoaa ohee al jag meh gur giaan japaiee ||
1100.e: He alone is fulfilled in this world, who meditates on the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

1100.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੧੬॥
1100.t: poorab likhiaa paiaa har siau ban aaiee ||16||
1100.e: He obtains what is pre-ordained for him, according to the Lord. ||16||

1100.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1100.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1100.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1100.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
1100.t: sach suhaavaa kaaddeeaai kooRai kooRee soi ||
1100.e: The true person is said to be beautiful; false is the reputation of the false.

1100.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
1100.t: naanak virale jaane'eeh jin sach palai hoi ||1||
1100.e: O Nanak, rare are those who have Truth in their laps. ||1||

1100.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1100.e: Fifth Mehla:

1100.g: ਸਜਣ ਮੁਖੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਨਿਹਾਲਸਾ ॥
1100.t: sajan mukh anoop aThe pahar nihaalasaa ||
1100.e: The face of my friend, the Lord, is incomparably beautiful; I would watch Him, twenty-four hours a day.

1100.g: ਸੁਤੜੀ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਡਿਠੁ ਤੈ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਹਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ॥੨॥
1100.t: sutaRee so sahu ddiTh tai supane hau kha(n)neeaai ||2||
1100.e: In sleep, I saw my Husband Lord; I am a sacrifice to that dream. ||2||

1100.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1100.e: Fifth Mehla:

1100.g: ਸਜਣ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਾਵਣੁ ਥੋਥਰਾ ॥
1100.t: sajan sach parakh mukh alaavan thotharaa ||
1100.e: O my friend, realize the True Lord. Just to talk about Him is useless.

1100.g: ਮੰਨ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਲਖਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਸੁ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੩॥
1100.t: ma(n)n majhaahoo lakh tudhahu dhoor na su piree ||3||
1100.e: See Him within your mind; your Beloved is not far away. ||3||

1100.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1100.t: pauRee ||
1100.e: Pauree:

1100.g: ਧਰਤਿ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਪਾਤਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: dharat aakaas paataal hai cha(n)dh soor binaasee ||
1100.e: The earth, the Akaashic ethers of the sky, the nether regions of the underworld, the moon and the sun shall pass away.

1100.g: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਉਮਰਾਵ ਖਾਨ ਢਾਹਿ ਡੇਰੇ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: baadhisaeh saeh umaraav khaan ddaeh ddere jaasee ||
1100.e: Emperors, bankers, rulers and leaders shall depart, and their homes shall be demolished.

1100.g: ਰੰਗ ਤੁੰਗ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਤ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਿਧਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: ra(n)g tu(n)g gareeb masat sabh lok sidhaasee ||
1100.e: The poor and the rich, the humble and the intoxicated, all these people shall pass away.

1100.g: ਕਾਜੀ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕਾ ਸਭੇ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: kaajee sekh masaikaa sabhe uTh jaasee ||
1100.e: The Qazis, Shaykhs and preachers shall all arise and depart.

1100.g: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕਾਬਰ ਅਉਲੀਏ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: peer paikaabar aaule'ee ko thir na rahaasee ||
1100.e: The spiritual teachers, prophets and disciples - none of these shall remain permanently.

1100.g: ਰੋਜਾ ਬਾਗ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਕਤੇਬ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੁਝੇ ਸਭ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: rojaa baag nivaaj kateb vin bujhe sabh jaasee ||
1100.e: Fasts, calls to prayer and sacred scriptures - without understanding, all these shall vanish.

1100.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸਭ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: lakh chauraaseeh medhanee sabh aavai jaasee ||
1100.e: The 8.4 million species of beings of the earth shall all continue coming and going in reincarnation.

1100.g: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਏਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਬੰਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੧੭॥
1100.t: nihachal sach khudhai ek khudhai ba(n)dhaa abinaasee ||17||
1100.e: The One True Lord God is eternal and unchanging. The Lord's slave is also eternal. ||17||

1100.g: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1100.t: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1100.e: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1100.g: ਡਿਠੀ ਹਭ ਢੰਢੋਲਿ ਹਿਕਸੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
1100.t: ddiThee habh dda(n)ddol hikas baajh na koi ||
1100.e: I have seen and examined all; without the One Lord, there is none at all.

1100.g: ਆਉ ਸਜਣ ਤੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਠੰਢਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
1100.t: aau sajan too mukh lag meraa tan man Tha(n)ddaa hoi ||1||
1100.e: Come, and show me Your face, O my friend, so that my body and mind may be cooled and soothed. ||1||

1100.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1100.e: Fifth Mehla:

1100.g: ਆਸਕੁ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਮੂ ਮਨਿ ਵਡੀ ਆਸ ॥
1100.t: aasak aasaa baaharaa moo man vaddee aas ||
1100.e: The lover is without hope, but within my mind, there is great hope.

1100.g: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹਿਕੁ ਤੂ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗਈਆਸ ॥੨॥
1100.t: aas niraasaa hik too hau bal bal bal gieeaas ||2||
1100.e: In the midst of hope, only You, O Lord, remain free of hope; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||2||

1100.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1100.e: Fifth Mehla:

1100.g: ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਸੁਣੇ ਡੁਖੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਡਿਠੇ ਮਰਿਓਦਿ ॥
1100.t: vichhoRaa sune ddukh vin ddiThe mariodh ||
1100.e: Even if I just hear of separation from You, I am in pain; without seeing You, O Lord, I die.

1100.g: ਬਾਝੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾ ਧੀਰੋਦਿ ॥੩॥
1100.t: baajh piaare aapane birahee naa dheerodh ||3||
1100.e: Without her Beloved, the separated lover takes no comfort. ||3||

1100.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1100.t: pauRee ||
1100.e: Pauree:

1100.g: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਲਿਆ ਕੇਦਾਰੁ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਕਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: taT teerath dhev dhevaaliaa kedhaar mathuraa kaasee ||
1100.e: River-banks, sacred shrines, idols, temples, and places of pilgrimage like Kaydarnaat'h, Mat'huraa and Benares,

1100.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਸਣੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: koT teteesaa dhevate san i(n)dhrai jaasee ||
1100.e: the three hundred thirty million gods, along with Indra, shall all pass away.

1100.g: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰਿ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: simirat saasatr bedh chaar khaT dharas samaasee ||
1100.e: The Simritees, Shaastras, the four Vedas and the six systems of philosophy shall vanish.

1100.g: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗੀਤ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਵਤੇ ਭੀ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: pothee pa(n)ddit geet kavit kavate bhee jaasee ||
1100.e: Prayer books, Pandits, religious scholars, songs, poems and poets shall also depart.

1100.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: jatee satee sa(n)niaaseeaa sabh kaalai vaasee ||
1100.e: Those who are celibate, truthful and charitiable, and the Sannyaasee hermits are all subject to death.

1100.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਦਿਗੰਬਰਾ ਜਮੈ ਸਣੁ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: mun jogee dhiga(n)baraa jamai san jaasee ||
1100.e: The silent sages, the Yogis and the nudists, along with the Messengers of Death, shall pass away.

1100.g: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
1100.t: jo dheesai so vinasanaa sabh binas binaasee ||
1100.e: Whatever is seen shall perish; all will dissolve and disappear.

1100.g: ਥਿਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਸੀ ॥੧੮॥
1100.t: thir paarabraham paramesaro sevak thir hosee ||18||
1100.e: Only the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is permanent. His servant becomes permanent as well. ||18||

1100.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1100.t: salok ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
1100.e: Shalok Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

1100.g: ਸੈ ਨੰਗੇ ਨਹ ਨੰਗ ਭੁਖੇ ਲਖ ਨ ਭੁਖਿਆ ॥
1100.t: sai na(n)ge neh na(n)g bhukhe lakh na bhukhiaa ||
1100.e: Hundreds of times naked does not make the person naked; tens of thousands of hungers do not make him hungry;

1100.g: ਡੁਖੇ ਕੋੜਿ ਨ ਡੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਿਖੰਦੋ ਸੁਭ ਦਿਸਟਿ ॥੧॥
1100.t: ddukhe koR na ddukh naanak piree pikha(n)dho subh dhisaT ||1||
1100.e: millions of pains do not cause him pain. O Nanak, the Husband Lord blesses him with his Glance of Grace. ||1||
